tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' ga
bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' ga

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /dge bsnyen mtsho klong gter byon nor sgrub rmad/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub skor thems byang dbye/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni bka' phur thugs gsum gyi ya gyal thugs sgrub bder 'dus kyi cha lag bsam lhun le'u bcu gsum gyi nang gses o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i sgos sgrub man ngag zur gsal du bkod pa'i shog dril yang gsang mchong gur smug mo ti la ka'i rak+ta ltar btus pa'i yang snying bsod nams dbang thang sogs rgyas pa dang*/ snang srid skye 'gro gang 'dod dbang du bsdu bar byed pa'i las tshogs gtso bor ston pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i chos skor te/ de la'ang zab pa gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag kha skong skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs skor ro/ dang po zab pa gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbang chog dngos grub kun 'byung*/ kha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbang thang rgyas pa'i tsakra nor bu'i bang mdzod/ ga) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbang sdud nor bu zhags pa'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/ nga) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sri'u srung nag po kun thub pu tra thar byed/ ca) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ ma hā dhe wa'i rlung zhags thim med/ cha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ ma lha bu rdzi'i rten 'dzugs/ ja) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu/ nya) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbul sri rmangs 'dre bkar yas/ ta) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dam sri sgab 'dre mnan pa dmod pa dgu skor/

tha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: sngon 'gro snang ba'i 'dod yon bde legs kun 'byung*/ da) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbang sdud nor bu zhags pa bsgrub pa'i las byang*/ na) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ rin chen khang bzang yid bzhin gter mdzod/ pa) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dzam lha dkar po'i sgrub pa 'dod rgu mchod sbyin/ pha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gnod sbyin nag po'i sgrub thabs/ ba) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ drag po kā la yak+sha'i sgos sgrub/ ma) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gter srung klu'i dge bsnyen chen po bsgrub pa'i gsol kha dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ tsa) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ nor skyong klu mo'i gtor 'bul/ tsha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gnod sbyin dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul/ dza) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ tshogs mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ wa) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bskang ba 'dod rgu bsam 'phel/ zha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ g.yang 'bod srid gsum dbang sgyur rin chen bang mdzod/ za) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ g.yang 'gugs srid gsum dbang sdud/ 'a) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ drag po kā la yak+ṣa'i las mtha' bzlog pa dug gi spu gri gnam lcags ur mo/ ya) yang bzlog 'phyong*/ gnyis pa yan lag kha skong skor la/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gsol 'debs nges don rab bskul ldeb/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ yan lag bdun pa/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las dkar gtor byin rlabs dang bgegs gtor/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/

byin 'bebs bcud bsdus/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ g.yang 'gugs kha skong senghas mdzad pa/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bdud rtsi lag mchod bde chen sprin phung*/ bdud rtsi lag mchod chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa gsum spyi'i me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod las dbang gi me mchod khol phyung ba/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po rab gsal/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ drag po kā la yak+sha'i rgyun khyer/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gtor 'bul khams gsum dbang bsgyur/ dzam dkar las tshogs las/ dbang sdud man ngag khyad par can/ pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med kyi bla 'khor/ dzam dkar las tshogs las/ tshogs kyi bdag pos lag bsgul zas nor 'gugs pa'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can/ dzam dkar las tshogs las/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ myur mgyogs rlung 'khor gdams pa zab mo/ tshogs kyi bdag pos sho dang rgyan las rgyal ba'i man ngag /dzam dkar las tshogs las/ za yig longs spyod char 'bebs gdams pa/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed 'khor lo bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed/ klu yi be bum las char 'beb man ngag /yang klu rgyal gyi gu ru la phul ba'i man ngag klu yi bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ pad+ma rgyal po'i dbang bsdud man ngag zur rgyan/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las/ las tshogs nor sgrub phywa spel man ngag skor/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ myur mgyogs rlung 'khor gdams pa zab mo/ pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med kyi bla 'khor bri thabs/ ༈ gsum pa chog khrigs sna tshogs skor la/ pad+ma rgyal po'i nor sgrub g.yang 'gugs bum sgrub sogs spros pa dang bcas pa'i skabs zur 'gebs/

bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dbang sdud zhags sgrub kyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po/ nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i gsang sgrub them byang gud sbas yid bzhin nor bu/ o rgyan nor lha dbang ltar sgrub pa 'chi med bcud dril ldeb/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ nor bdag dzam lha dkar po'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin gter 'byung*/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dzam lha dkar po'i sgrub thabs chog khrigs phan bde 'dod rgu'i mchog sbyin/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i las tshogs dzam dkar tshogs mchod/ nor sgrub bla ma'i bsang mchod/ gu ru nor lha dbyer med kyi g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen gyi zhi sgrub khrigs su bsdebs pa bsod nams dpal skyed/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bsod nams gter bum sba thabs 'dod 'jo bum bzang*/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bum gter sgrub tshul lag len dwang shel me long*/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gter srung klu yi sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i klu bum sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i g.yang chog dang 'brel ba'i god sri mnan pa dmod pa dgu skor nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod pa/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu bklag chog tu bkod pa srid zhi'i dpal yon 'gugs pa'i 'phrul zhags/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bsnyen yig dgos 'dod char 'bebs/ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ zin bris 'don bsgrigs shel dkar me long bcas so/ de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/

chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ //

ka)bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dbang chog dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: pad 'byung nor lha rigs 'dus tshogs la bstod: sa ma ya: dbang gi rim pa ni: bum pa kha rgyan cha tshang : bhan+dha me long gtor ma g.yang rdzas sna tshogs: bgrang phreng tsa ka li dang bcas pa bya: phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams shing : bkra shis dus tshes la slob ma khrus dang gos dkar rgyan dang gral du 'khod: maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po phul: rten 'brel mkhas par bya: de nas bu slob rnams kyis: kyaiḥ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: dpal zhing sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan bdag cag 'jug par stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: slob mas: hoḥ bdag cag yang dag dam tshig can: srog dang snying gi dwangs ltar bsgrub: gtso bos bdag la gnang ba stsol: de nas dam chu sbyin la: hoḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: bsrung na dngos grub sna tshogs rnyed: nyams na pho nyas snying khrag 'thung : de bas dam la 'da' ma byed: oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: de nas rgyud ma dag pa sbyong zhing dag pa lha skur ston pa ni: bsang chu 'thor la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs spungs pa'i khrir: hrī las gu ru pad+ma dbang sdud rgyal po dmar la snum pa'i mdangs ldan sgeg cing sbom la gsus khyim che ba: zhal gsum khro 'dzum mdzes la dbu skra nor bus brgyan pa: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu 'dzin pa: g.yon gsum bhan+dha ne'u le pad+ma bsnams pa: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum phyed skyil bzhugs pa: g.yas su lha lcam dmar mos ne'u le dang lcags kyu: g.yon du mtsho rgyal dkar mos rdo rje dang bum pa: mdun du klu mo nor skyong nor bu dang zhags pa:

phyi rol dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: pad 'byung nor lha'i tshogs bcas spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya hoḥ de nas rdo rje mgor bzhag la: oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas slob mas: hoḥ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan smin par mdzod: lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul: mi 'da' dam tshig bsrung lags so: maṇ+ḍal phul zhing bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: longs spyod gter bum gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi nor bdag yab yum sku: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: mnga' thang chos kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha lhun grub gsang ba'i dbyings: dbang sdud nor lha bdud rtsi mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bsod nams longs spyod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: me long thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes rol pa'i rtsal: snang stong bde stong ngo bo nyid kyi sku: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bde chen 'bras bu mngon gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: dngos grub sna tshogs legs 'byung ba: dbang sdud yab yum yon tan mdzod: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sku 'khor thogs la: hūm̐: phyi nang yongs rdzogs 'khor lo bskor: dbang sdud yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bum: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags phreng thogs la: hūm̐: bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i gzungs ba sngags: spro bsdu zer gyi phreng ba yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: las bzhi phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra me la dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas longs spyod sna tshogs kyi phrom thogs la:

hūm̐: bsod nams longs spyod 'dod rgu'i gter: dkar gsum mngar dang shing 'bras 'bru: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: bang mdzod dkor cha'i dbang thob shog: oṃ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: gser g.yu mu tig la sogs pa: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rdzas mchog 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: zad med gter gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra swa ra ser ran a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rgyan gos sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: yid 'ong mdzes rgyan sna tshogs 'di: 'jam dkar gos bkrag legs pa'i mchog: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog: oṃ badz+ra bhi me gha sme sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'khor lo gtad la: hoḥ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang : snyan grags mnga' thang stobs ldan pa'i: deng 'dir sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtad: che btsan dpal gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ swa na tsakra ma hā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gtad: de nas me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: bla mar rin chen sna tshogs kyi yon phul: bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel bya: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan la: 'dod rgu longs spyod 'byung ba yi: dbang mchog dngos grub kun 'byung bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal yi ger thob: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: ma 'ongs nyi shu la nye dus: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thargyargyargyan+yaṭa: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing sbas tshal pad+ma rong du shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o// // kha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dbang thang rgyas pa'i tsakra nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so: bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog pad+ma rā dza'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: h+ya yaṃ maṃ: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las:

kun 'dus nor bu'i bang mdzod phyir: dbang thang rgyas pa'i tsakra bstan: ḍāk+kis brda yi yi ger gzugs: da lta rin chen gter du sbos: klu yi dbang mos brda 'di skyongs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gaṃ thi kyagyaḥ de yang dbang thang rgyas pa'i tsakra bkod pa ste: thog mar tshes bzang bkra shis pa'i mgo la: rdzas dang 'byor cha bsags pa ni: dang po sman gyi rnam dbye bstan pa la: dzā ti pad+ma rgyal po:li shi man+da ra ba: a ru ye shes mtsho rgyal: gur gum rdo rje dbang sdud: gi waṃ rin chen dbang sdud: tsan+dan pad+ma dbang sdud: sug smel karma dbang sdud: cu gang nor skyong ma: dbang lag klu'i dge bsnyen: rin po che ni gser dngul: zangs lcags g.yu byi ru mu men shel lta bu ste gang bzhin no: khyad par gyi rdzas li khri rgya mtshal mu zi shing mngar mtshal lu'i snying po: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi pañtsa sin+dhu ra zho sha bzhi bud med bu bdun pa'i lag nas blangs pa'i rin chen rigs: dbang thang can gyi gos dar khyad par can: longs spyod can gyi 'bru sna dang : zhing kha thab ka'i sa bcas so: rdzas de rnams bsags nas rin chen snod du bzhag: shog bu 'jam pa'i log tu rgya snag gam rgya mtshal gyis bris: yi ge yang dbu can du bya: 'bri tshe smra ba'i tshig gis bar ma chod cing mi mang gis mi mthong bar bya: thog mar nor bu'i 'khor lo ni: nor bu sum tshugs 'bar ba'i rnam pa can gyi dbyibs sngags shong tshad dang dpag dag par bris: nor bu thog ma'i dbus su 'di'o: de yi phyi rol sngags 'dis bskor: oṃ ma ni rat+na ma ma kuṇ+ḍa li sarba a nu ta ra hri rā ga pa shaṃ shrī ye thun thun 'dus 'dus swā hā: kyaid kyaid ma hā de wa rā dza khye'u sid+dhi dzaḥ sogs kha bsgyur: nor bu g.yas pa'i nang du: lte ba yin: oṃ sarba ma hā su kha dī paṃ k+ṣa ak+ṣo u ma e ka ra ka ra a yur k+ṣ+yaṃ du swā hā: 'chang ba po la srid dang bsod nams spel du gsol:

sogs gong bzhin no: nor bu g.yon pa'i nang du lte bar: tsāṃ/: oṃ a yur puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru gha a dhe wa an ṭa she pha: a ling ga mu dha ra sarba pa ni badz+ra ra ak+ṣo trām̐ mu sa t+ya ti maṅga laṃ t+ya thā shrī ma hā hūm̐ hrī swā hā: zhes gong gi kha bsgyur skabs su bsod nams spel na: tshe chos zas nor gos kyi dngos grub thams cad bdag la spel du gsol swā hā: zhes dang : srid spel ba'i lte bsgyur yin na: bdag 'chang ba mo 'di la srid pa lha'i bu spel cig khye'u dhar sid+dhi swā hā: shwa ra ma hā dhe wa srid pa'i bu pho ru sgyur cig: an+ḍa badz+ra gar+bha dha ra ye swā hā: zhes pas 'dod gsol kha bsgyur: rta nor phyugs lug bang ba zhing kha rgyan gos sogs bcang ba'i dngos grub thams cad kha bsgyur bya: mtshon yang kha dog gang legs mdzes mtshon bya: rab gnas sngags ni: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza rat+na a dhiṣ+ṭha ma ma kun+da sha ra ṇa sarba tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: gzhan yang dbyangs gsal rten snying rab gnas sngags sogs spyi mthun bya: bkra shis dge ba'i nyin mor 'chang bar bya: de nas khye'u lte bsgyur za yig ni: : rdzas gong bzhin: mtshal tsan dan dmar po lan tshwa sin+dhu ra bcas dang : dbang thang can gyi ka cha zer ba rnams za yig skabs su bri bar bya'o: gzhan yang sman rnams za yig la byugs: srid 'khor na bdun phrag la re re za: zla ba gsum nas nyin bzhin za: za yig sngags ni: oṃ ma hā de wa su pra ṇi shwa ra an+ḍa li sha ye khye'u sid+dhi dza pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pa'i za yig la 'bum tsho gcig phu btab: srung ba skyes pa'i og na gong bar 'chang : bud med kyi sked par 'chang : do gal che na gso chud g.yas g.yon du re re 'chang : mi nyams shing mi lag mi 'grim grib la 'dzem: rtag tu lha khrus: sa ma ya: zla ba re la bzhin ma lha skyar: byis pa mthong nas srung ba bu la spo: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bzhag:

man ngag zab pa'i mthar thug go: ྀatsha: nor sgrub phywa spel gyi las tshogs 'di nyid thog mar ban gyi chos ka ru med pa yin la: phyi mor bon thams cad mtha' ru spyugs pas: bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can ma dga' bas 'byung ba thams cad 'khrugs bod kyi bsod nams dang sa bcud lo gsum du nyams: bsam yas sogs lha sde mi sde'i khang khyim phal cher du 'gong po mngon rgyug tu gyur: yul gyi sa dang mi yi mdog nyams: sems can phal cher mu ge'i 'jigs pas gzir: de'i tshe rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon la gser g.yu rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dpag tu med pa phul nas zhus pa: kyaiḥ slob dpon rin po che lags: nyid sangs rgyas dbang po dus gsum mkhyen cing dus med rdzogs pa'i bla ma dam pa phebs pa'i skabs su: bod 'bangs dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di ci ltar lags: 'di la phan pa'i thabs bsod nams dang ldan pa'i man ngag stsal du gsol: zhes zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas: kyaiḥ rgyal po chen po legs par gsan 'tshal: spyir sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa rin po che dar ba la: sems can phra mo legs nyes ma ltos pa'i: spobs pa dang brtul zhugs gtong phod rnams che dgos pa yin: sems can dbul ba rnams sngon gyi sbyin shugs chung zhing 'phral du lha 'dre gdug pa can bon la dgyes pa rnams kyi cho 'phrul dang nag phyogs kyi kha 'dzin pa yin: 'di la phan pa'i gnad rgyal pos dbu mdzad 'bangs rnams kyis sbyin pa rgya che ba thongs: bsod nams sa bcud kyi bum gter sbos: 'phral phug kun tu bsod nams dang dbang thang gi rgyas thebs par 'dod na: kho bo dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du gnas pa'i tshe pad+ma rgyal po'i ngo bor gyur nas lha dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa dbang du bsdus te: man ngag nor bu zhags pa'i gdams pa rnams mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ger btab nas da lta klu'i rgyal po zla skyong la bcol nas rgya bsdams pa yod de:

rgyal pos zhus pa shin tu legs pas de dag 'byin par byas na phan pa yin: zhes bka' yis gnang ngo : yang de'i tshe kho mo mtsho rgyal rdzu 'phrul gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi lam la zhugs te gdams pa'i man ngag khyad par can bcu gsum gdan drangs nas: rje gu ru'i phyag tu phul: gu rus rgyal pos dbu mdzad rje 'bangs grogs lnga la gnang : mtsho rgyal gyis slar brda yi yi ger btab pa'o: yang de'i dus na: rje ma hā gu rus dbu mdzad grogs dang bcas te mchims phu'i dben tshal du sgrub pa zhag bdun nas me tog dang myu gu shing 'bras dgun dus 'khrungs: mkha' nas 'brug ldir: nyi zla zung gcig tu shar ba sogs ltas bzang po byung : bod mi thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob yul thams cad bkra shis lo legs byung : bsam yas kyi bsgrub bya thams cad 'grub pa'i tshe gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub skor nor bdag dzam nag sgrub pa'i rten bcas: dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling du gter sbas: gter bdag rgyal po mdung dmar can la bcol lo: sgrub pa'i las rim cha bdun mdo khams rong bzhi la sbas: gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen la bcol: gzhan dang sgrub skor mang zhig mon kha'i phyogs su sbas: dbang phyug rlung zhags kyi skor rnams ra sa 'phrul snang gi byang phyogs su sbas so: gter srung phal cher yak+sha bh+ya tri mu kha li la bcol: sa ma ya: 262d+ya7nga*/: e maḥ snying thig gud du sbas pa'i ti la ka: nam mkha'i mdzod la nor bu spungs pa'i dpyid: ma 'ongs pre ta'i 'ching grol 'dod 'jo'i gnyen: sngo sangs dbang mo'i rgyan bzhin mdzes pa'i tog: gang zhig gtib po'i g.yan rnams g.yel ba'i phyir: 'dod rgur grangs med 'bum las 'bum 'khyil ltar: thabs shes dwangs pas 'khril shing dkri ba'i tshogs: rtog ges mi rtogs 'dod rgu gud du sbos: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams la 'phrad par shog: snying thig yid bzhin dbang gi 'khor lo 'di:

nā ga aṣ+ṭi ma ṇi pā las srungs: sa ma ya: kha/ny+yad/h+yed: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas glang gi lo ru gdan drangs shing spre'u lo ru bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'o: za yig rtsad+yar+ha // // ga)bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dbang sdud nor bu zhags pa'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so: pad 'byung nor lha dbang sdud sku la 'dud: nor bu zhags pa 'khor lo'-i gdams pa bstan: dang po bkra shis yar tshes dge ba'i nyin: shog bu dkar 'jam legs pa'i ngos su ni: pho 'khor rdo rje yang na nor bus mtshan: lte ba mu khyud gnyis bskor nang du ni: sngags rnams tsheg med srung ba ltar du bris: phyi rol nor bu brgyad mtshan zhags pas bskor: dang po lte ba'i dbus su 'di ltar bris: de yi phyi rim pad 'dab bzhi la sngags 'di bris: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ oṃ ḍāk+ki nī bi shwa rū pa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra dharma sam+bha gha tshur+bhi dza dzaḥ yo gi ni u ta rā ga he sha ka ma le ma ma ā gats+tsha su ṇe sa ma pa ri mi ta ku mā ra ṇi dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sid+dhi satwaṃ: 'byung ba rlung gi khyab byed kyis mnga' thang thams cad thun dzaḥ ma la rak+ṣa ye hūm̐ hrīḥ gnyis pa phyi yi zhags pa'i sngags ni 'di ltar ro: oṃ gu ru yo gi badz+ra ni dza dzaḥ oṃ ma hā ra tsa ni dza dzaḥ oṃ ku mā ra sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ lok+ka pa ti kau ma rī bha ha ya pa shaṃ ku ru a dhe ye ma ma dza dzaḥ oṃ ra tri ta ka ma le dza satwaṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ ma ma sid+dhi dza dzaḥ pa shaṃ thun thun: 'dzam gling srid pa'i snang ba dbang du bsdus thun dza dzaḥ zhes bris pho 'khor mo yi steng du 'khor ram btags: mo 'khor pad+mas mtshan pa mu khyud snga ma ltar phyi rol pad+ma'i lcags kyu bcu drug bya: sngar ltar rim bzhin sngags phreng tsheg med du chad lhag spangs nas dang po lte ba ru: pad 'dab bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma tri ma ma yo gi ni shwa ri ku mā ra dza dzaḥ

oṃ yo gi ni ā ru sa bha dra ku mā rā dza dzaḥ nā ga ma ṇi pha la kau ma rī ma ma dza dzaḥ badz+ra pra bha ti a dhiṣ+ṭha te tsit+ta rū pa rat+na sā ti bha dra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ra tsa pu ru kha su khaṃ tsar+ya ma hā pra ni dha na phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ ga ga na bhū mi pa ti ḍāk+ki nī tā re puṇ+ye ma hā dhe wi tshur+dhi lok+ka ka li rā ga he sha ma na tsit+ta pa ri wā ra ma ma thun thun dza u ta ā gats+tsha ba ha ya dza dzaḥ ma ma pa shaṃ thun dza sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ sa ma ya rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i chos srid sid+dhi dzaḥ gnyis pa lcags kyu'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi ma hā puṇ+ye ka ma la ḍāk+ki nī ga ra he sha tshur+dhi oṃ aṅku sha dza dzaḥ badz+ra yo gi ni mu tra ni ru pa ṇi su khaṃ pra mo ti ri pra dz+nyā sūr+ya dhe bi dza dzaḥ i tra rat+na sa ma ya sid+dhi ṇi ma ni ma ma sid+dhi dza dzaḥ khye'u bsdus pa'i sngags 'di sbyar: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi dha ra dha ra rā ga he sha tsit+ta pa ri wā ra ye swā hā: ṇi badz+ra na ha ya shwa ri ma he dza dzaḥ ma ma kyaid kyaid khye'u sid+dhi dzaḥdzaḥ yab yum sngags 'di tshul bzhin legs par bris: rang nyid 'chang na gong ba g.yas g.yon nam: pho g.yas mo g.yon dar dmar nang du dril: 'khor lo bskor na pho 'khor mo 'khor bya: de ltar byas na bskor kyang 'thus: khye'u 'dod na drod ldan sked par 'chang : byis pa mthong na bu la spo bar bya: gzhan dbang sdud ltar na gong ba'i rtse mor 'chang : zil gyis gnon na pad 'byung nor lha yi: phyi rol sku yi nang du sngags 'khor ni: yab 'khor snying kha yum 'khor lte bar bris: sku 'khor las gzhung bzhin du 'chang bar shes: pho 'khor ser la rtsibs brgyad mdzes mtshon bya: mo 'khor dmar la rtsibs rnams lnga ldan bya: sgrub pa'i dus su thod pa'i nang du bzhag: 'grub rtags byung nas rang nyid 'chang bar bya: zhag bdun bar du kun ldan dam tshig gces: phyag rgya dam med g.yel mo'i rigs mi bya:

dbul por dam sri gri bor bstan mi bya: phyogs su 'gro tshe chus bar mi chod 'chang : rab bsnyen zla gcig 'bring bdun tha ma lnga: rdzas ni pho 'khor khab len rdo dang gri lcags dang : dbang lag gi waṃ a ru sde bzhi dang : dzā ti sug smel snying zho sha: yum sman gur gum pi pi ling rnams dang : rgya mtshal lcags phye yungs dkar ka ra dang : bu ram sbrang dang dkar rdzas phran bu tsam: rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna dar sna lnga: shing gong lnga ldan phye ma zhib par bya: 'khor lo dag la rang rang sman bzhin byug: ril bu bya na dbang lag ra mo shag: dam sbyar zhu'am sman rnams gcig tu dril: bsgrubs pas 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med gter: longs spyod dpal 'byor 'dzam gling mdzod rdol 'gyur: e maḥ nor sgrub yid bzhin zhags pa'i las tshogs 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu yang mtha' la bsngags nas: pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med gcig tu dril: 'di 'dra gzhan la ma grags khyad par 'phags: 'o ma'i rgya mtsho gter chos mang lags kyang : bcud bsdus mar gyi snying po 'di 'dra dkon: bod khams sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: tshig nyung don 'brel yang zab gcig bsdus mchog: sum cu yang mtha'i 'dul zhing chos lung bstan: 'dzam gling sgron me mtsho rgyal khyod nyid kyis: brda 'di yi ger la mor gzugs kyis sbos: bka' yi mtha' skyong las 'brel gling la sprod: des kyang gnod sbyin tshangs pa'i gzugs dang sprod: des kyang shes rab blo ldan drag po la: dam med lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: gter srung klu bdud mgo dgu myur mgyogs dang : gter bdag klu mo nor skyong mdzes ldan ma: dam chos 'di yi mel tshe rogs dan mdzod: las 'phro blo ldan shes rab can la sprod: dam nyams log lta bdud rigs dbang po snubs: mtsho nag drag rgyas mi nub a thaṃ rgya: bka' rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: karma las 'brel gling pas dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

nga) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: sri'u srung nag po kun thub pu tra thar byed bzhugs so: bla ma dang dregs pa kun 'dul he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: khaṃ: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug yid bzhin nor mchog las: rdo rje rdzong chen gnam lcags ur mo bstan: pu tra thar byed nag po kun thub yin: sri nag kha 'byams yin kyang sos par 'gyur: sa ma ya: dang po rdzas kyi rim pa la: nag po dgu sbyor khwa ta'i tshang : khyung lnga gri lcags phye ma: zangs rdo: pha bang long bu: mdung rtse sbal rgyab: byi'u khug ta'i tshang : bya rog tshang dang sder mo: stag gi mche ba: dom dred kyi sbar mo dang mche ba: byang g.yag gi snying rkyang gi ze ba: sbrul dang sbal pa'i sha bcas thams cad zhib tu 'thag nas tsakra la byug: tsakra'i phyi yi dbyibs ni rus sbal du bkod: li yi ling tshe ru: raṃ ka ri ṭa hūm̐: khon la: suṃ trag gi tha ta hūm̐: dwa la: laṃ he ka k+ṣa hūm̐: khen la: hreṃ e ṭa ya hūm̐: kham la: kham ṇi ak+ṣa hūm̐: ging la: shrī sa nan ṭa hūm̐: zin la: yaṃ yi he thaṃ hūm̐: zon la: yak+ṣa trig shu hūm̐: lto ba'i dbus su mu khyud che ba zhig bskor ba'i mthil du: mu khyud nang du srog yig la g.yas skor gyis: oṃ yak+ṣa kā la ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa shrī hrī ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ ma ma ma hā bha le a pa rā tsit+ta a dzī te shrī dz+wa la raṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: bdag 'chang ba po la dam sri te phur nag mo kha la za 'dre ma yis mi tshugs par srungs shig a dhiṣ+ṭha te ka ru ṇa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: rus sbal gyi phyi rol me ris bskor: sngags 'di srung ba la yang sngags: sngags bzla bya la nu zho ma 'thung gong la sbyin: khyad par rgyun du sbyin: oṃ tri sod tra sod dur ta sod dur mi sod: te phur nag mo'i snying mgo la chod chod ka la dza chung sri rmugs 'dre kaṃ shaṃ tri rbad phaṭ swā hā:

sngags 'di dang bkar yas kha chings sngags rnams khyi ra phag gsum gyi spu la mdud pa dgu byas pa ma ni dung sngags nas byis pa dang a ma la 'dogs: srung ba'i steng du gri lcags kyi mda' gzhus brgyan: srung ba'i thum nag po bya: a tsa ra bi sa k+ṣa'i gdon srung bye ma la sngags te khang pa'i phyogs su gtor: a raṃ han+ha han+ha raṃ ka tsi la thi thi raṃ raṃ: 'di mang du sngags nas skyer pa'i tsher ma sgo khang gong nas rtse mo phyi ru bstan na gdon gang yang thub bo: srung ba'i sngags dang rdzas kyi rim pa 'di nyid shin tu zab pas gang snyed du spel bar mi bya'o: khyad par rmangs po bsod nams chung ba'i sngags srung mi bya ba gnad yin: ci'i phyir gcig gso ba dang brgya bsad pa gnyis go log yin pas spang ba'i dgos ched do: sdig can 'bum gso ba las: chos pa gcig gso ba yon tan yin phyir: 'di nyid rig 'dzin dam pa'i gdung ngam chos rgyal rnams kyi don du kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi lha gu ru'i gsung bzhin bkod pa'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: gnam lcags rdo rjes dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ca) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: ma hā de wa'i rlung zhags thim med bzhugs so: shan*/ h+yah+ya: rgya gar skad du: ma hā de wa yaṃ ye pa sha sa ma ya: bod skad du: lha chen rlung zhags kyi dam tshig bka' rgya can: dbang thang srid pa lte sbyor zab gnad rin chen sgrom bu zhes bya ba: 'di la don gsum ste: lo rgyus gud du sbas ny+ya: rdzas rim gi waṃ gur gum gro shog khab len: 2 za yig tsakra bcas rgya : bzhi yod dus sbyor dang thim rgya rba rnga: kur du tshim bzang ma mtshams bcad grib la 'dzem: sa ma ya: dang po spyi tsam lo rgyus bstan pa ni: srid pa bud med spyi yi ngang tshul las: khrag rnag chu ser chu nad bzhi 'byung bas: de las za yig sbyin nas brtag pa bya:

sngon du khrag rnag lnga gsum byung gyur na: de la lte sbyor za yig srung ba 'bad: chu ser chu nad sngon 'byung srid mi 'khor: de la 'bad rtsol bgyid kyang dgos gsol chung : rtsa ni dug can bong nga gnas pas len: ci ste sri'u la sogs shi 'phro'i rigs: za yig 'khor lo 'di yis nges par thub: yon dang lha rten bzang po ma byung bar: srung ba za yig mi sbyin dam bca' yin: sa ma ya: lte sbyor thabs shes 'khor lo bya ba dang : lte ba zlum po'i dbus su mda' 'gengs bris: gzhu dkar mda' dmar bzhin ni rlung ljang ngo : sgro dang mde'u bu zhes bsgyur du bris: de'i phyi rol gru bzhi rtsibs ser la: pho bzhi bris nas phyi rol zlum skor la: rtsibs bzhi bzhi nas mda' stong nas thad ka'i mtshams: pho lha'i lte sbyor: zhang lha'i lte sbyor: yul lha'i lte sbyor: dgra lha'i lte sbyor: de yi phyi rol gru bzhi'i rtsibs bzhi la: a mu rtsa mu rtsa swā hā: oṃ na ma ra ta na tra a a swā hā: a tra na ma ma na swā hā: a yar swā hā: phyi rims rtsibs mchan zlum skor du: ra tsa trig hur nan: ra tsa tig ka hur nan: na ga ra tsa tri hur nan: ra tsa trig hur nan: rtsibs ser mu khyud dmar ljang dag tu'o: phyi rol me ri phreng bas bskor bar bya: rdzas ni bud med bu bdun rin chen rigs: khyad par 'bru sman khungs yod thams cad dam: khyi spu ra bal lug thug sogs bal la: srung skud bgyis nas srung ba 'dogs thabs yin: rta bong lug thug rmong kha'i spu dang ni: bud med skye zhol gos dum lhan cig dril: dar dmar btums nas drod ldan sked par 'chang : khye'u mthong tshe ma bu gnyis kar 'dogs: de yang sri sogs mi 'byung rten 'brel la: lte ba ma sos 'chas gcod pa gnad: lte ba dum gcig chang phud btums nas su: ma yi nyal 'og mi mthong sba bar gnad: lte bar dum gcig ma hā de was sngags: lo gsum ma lon bar du 'chang nas su:

ma bcad lung tshe zhu sman kha sbyor btang : srung ba dag kyang gro ba'i pags par bris: bzang drug nus pa bskyed par kha tshar btab: dus bzang yar ngo dag tu 'chang bar gces: sa ma ya: ma arga rga: ma hā de wa'i thim med skor: kā la hūm̐ gis so: chu 'bab za yig rab za yig rnam 'khrugs pa'i gro ga bris nas za'o/ 'dra min cung 'dug 'di phag min bu dang zung du rbeb la'o/ 12rgadhuradzadzadzadzadza: mngal pa sha za yig gro la bris zhag bdun phrag za'o/ cha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: ma lha bu rdzi'i rten 'dzugs bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus nas: srid skyed 'dod rgu'i bang mdzod gdams pa bkod: ma 'ongs sems can pre ta'i duḥkha dang : rmugs 'dre mi la la sogs 'gong po'i rigs: bsod nams dman zhing 'byung po phra mo rnams: mkha' la 'gyu dang yul la chags pa yis: mi 'dod sna tshogs sdang ba'i rkyen byed pas: de dag skyabs dang bskrad nas mtha' ru bsring : 'go ba'i lha lnga rab tu gnas pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi gdams pa bstan par bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang ma lha bu rdzi'i rten 'dzugs ni: thog mar pad+ma rgyal po'i gzhung bsrang la: mchod rdzas sogs ni spyi mthun de bzhin te: dbang rdzas sogs ni tshig rang gzhung dang bstun: yar gzhi'i steng du 'go ba'i lha lnga la: zhi gtor zlum po dkar ser dmar ljang lnga: pad 'dab bskor ba rgyan gyis spras pa bsham: dbang gtor dag ni zhi ba spyi mthun ltar: khol bu 'di la rab tu 'jug pa la: sbyin bdag mo'am rigs rgyud byis pa bcas: legs par khrus bstsal zangs gzhong nang du blugs: de nas sbrus pa'i bag zan dag la ni: dri za'i rgyal po rta mgo can gyi gzugs: de'i 'khor du ngar mi'i rigs la ni: gzig dang glang mgo ra yi mgo can dang :

sbrul mgo shwa mgo glang po che yi mgo: sri li'i mgo dang byi la sre mong mgo: phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo dang bya gag mgo: spre'u mgo can dang bcas 'khor gyis bskor: de yi phyi rol changs bu mar me dang : ting lo sha dum dang bcas bskor ba ni: bgegs gtor lta bu bskrad pa'i chas su bsham: de bzhin bca' gzhi legs par 'grigs nas su: slob ma g.yung drung tshom bu'i steng du bzhugs: rnal 'byor zhal kha lho yi phyogs su blta: drag sngags dang bcas bskrad par bya ba ni: chu gtsang bran la bgegs gtor lan gsum 'gugs: de nas bstim zhing las la bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen drag po thod phreng khro rgyal gyi: rang bzhin thugs las spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bcu khyab par skar ltar 'khrugs: deng 'dir bsod nams sgrub la mi dbang ba'i: 'byung po skal med gdon chen bgegs kyi tshogs: yas stags glud kyi gzugs byang 'di la mchis: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po tri yaṃ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la: hūm̐: nyon cig phyogs skyong gdon gyi tshogs: byis pa'i bgegs chen bco lnga dang : 'byung po yi dwags tshogs rnams kun: mthun 'jug mchod sbyin 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: drag po dmod pa'i rig sngags mtshon: nyungs dkar khro bo thun gyi rdzas: tshwa tshwa'i sgong bu 'gril ba yis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams: gzhom zhing bshig par gdon mi za: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: rdo rje'i bka' las 'da' ma byed: myur ba nyid du bskrad kyis byol: oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bskrad pas 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rang rang gnas su song bar bsam: de nas srung zhing mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: ral gri 'khor lo srung ba'i gur khang ni: mi shigs rim dgu 'khrigs pas mtshams bcad nas: nam yang bgegs kyi 'gyu ba mi dmigs shing :

bsod nams dpal 'byor brtan pa'i bh+rūm̐ du gyur: oṃ bh+rūm̐ sarba tsakra dz+nyā na badz+ra ye swā hā: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang du ni: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin dpag yas 'khrigs: ma lha g.yang gi dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas: 'dod rgu yid 'ong phun tshogs spyod gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ā hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las: bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang chen po mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ zhes pas yig 'bru yongs su gyur pa las: dbus su rnam par snang mdzad: shar du rdo rje tshe bdag: lho ru rat+na tshe bdag: nub tu pad+ma tshe bdag: byang du karma tshe bdag ste rang rang gi phyag mtshan ldan pa: de'i mtshams su ye shes rlung gi lha mo dang rang mdog gi rgyan ldan phyag na ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa: rigs lnga yab yum gyi lha tshogs thams cad snang la rang bzhin bral ba gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da'i bar brjod: de nas bum pa bsgrub phyir bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rigs kyi gtso bo rnam snang mdzad: ye shes bzhi sbyor phrin las lnga: tshe bcud bsod nams 'dzin la sogs: dbang lnga bsgrub phyir bdag bstod do: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī ā: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza sarba puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

zhes brgya'am nyer gcig bsgrubs te sham bu 'dis kha bsgyur bgyis nas srung skud dkar po mdud pa gsum bor te ma lha'i rten du bsams la sngags bzlas: oṃ aṣ+ṭi ye dhe ma dha ri ta puṇ+ye sarba ra ga wi tra kyaid kyaid de ye swā hā: zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin brlabs nas srung skud mda' dar gyi mgul du 'chang : de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir bsang chus lan gsum sbyangs la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ak+ṣo bh+ya pra mo ti dzaḥhūm̐ swā hā: de nas maṇ+ḍal phul zhing dam tshig bsgo ba ni: kyaiḥ rigs ldan tshogs rnams legs par nyon: sngon 'byung srid pa'i ma lha 'di: de ring khyod la rten btsugs phyir: tshe dang dpal gyi dbang bskur bas: dngos grub len phyir spro'am ci: slob mas: e maḥ rigs 'dus byin rlabs rtsa ba'i mchog: rje lngas dam tshig stsal ba'i ngang : g.ya' spang rten la gus pas mos: dam pas bdag la gnang bar stsol: de nas dmigs pa 'bog pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ā yu pa smra ra na sa ma ya ti la thā swā hā: hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang gi lus de dang bskyed bya'i gtor ma tha mi dad pa srid pa'i ma lha dbang phyug rgyal mo sku mdog dkar la bag dro snum pa'i nyams chags pa: dar dkar gyi lhab lhub gsol zhing phyag na mda' dar dang bhi dza pu ra bsnams pa: dpral bar lhan cig skyes pa'i lha mo dkar mo rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pa: mgrin par lus kyi lha mo pad+ma dang g.yung drung 'dzin pa: snying gar srog gi lha mo mthing ga rdo rje dang bhan+dha 'dzin pa: lte bar srid pa'i lha mo ser mo nor bu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa: gsang ba rgyud 'dzin lha mo ljang mo rlung gi zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa: phrag pa g.yas su srid pa'i pha lha rdo rje ge mdzod: zla ba dang dung dkar 'dzin pa: phrag pa g.yon du srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang skyes mo nyi ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa:

pus mgo g.yas su phyugs lha rnam rgyal rin po che'i gzhong pa dang 'bras snye 'dzin pa: pus mgo g.yon du bu rdzi'i bsod nams tshe 'dzin ma mda' dar dang tshe yi gwa'u 'dzin pa te thams cad rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan zhing rang mdog gi na bza' gsol ba'o: ma lha tshe 'dzin rgyal mo'i spyi bor dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum dang bcas pa gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: ma lha srid pa'i rgyal mo 'go ba'i lha lngas bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ: lha yi dbang phyug srid kyi rje: srog skyabs 'go ba'i dpung gnyen pa: de ring ma lha'i rten 'dzugs phyir: thogs med dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a be sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas de nas dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor btegs shing : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya bh+rūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bum pa thogs la: āḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang rtags sbyin pas sku yi lha mo gzi brjid ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis: de ring sku yi dbang bskur bas: lhan skyes ma lhar bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ pra mo ti badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang rtags sbyin pas: gsung gi lha mo dbang sdud kul+le ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyis: de ring gsung gi dbang bskur bas:

gsung gi ma lhar bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ rā ga badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'khor lo thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang rtags sbyin pas: thugs kyi lha mo srid pa sa le ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis: de ring thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: srog gi ma lhar bdag gyur cig: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ su khaṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: de ring skal ldan khyod la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbang rtags sbyin pas yon tan lha mo kun 'byung 'dod rgyal ma mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis: de ring yon tan dbang bskur bas: srid 'dzin ma lhar bdag gyur cig: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ tsar+ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags phreng thogs la: hoḥ de ring skal ldan khyod la don yod grub pa'i dbang rtags sbyin pas phrin las lha mo tshe 'dzin ma de mngon du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan don yod grub pa yis: de ring phrin las dbang bskur bas: rgyud 'dzin ma lha bdag gyur nas: srid dang phywa g.yang brtan gyur cig: oṃ mu tra badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas lus kyi 'go ba'i lhas dbang bskur ba ni: spyi bor srid kyi ma lha dbang phyug rgyal mo thogs la: hūm̐: srid gsum gling bzhi bdag mo che: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ i shwa ra dhe ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phrag pa g.yas su srid kyi pha lha ge mdzod kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i pho lha chen po yi: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ lo ki dhi wa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

phrag pa g.yon du srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang gi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ma lha g.ya' spang gi: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ dhe wi dha ra ya ni a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pus mgo g.yas su phyugs lha rnam rgyal gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: phyugs lha gang ba rnam rgyal gyi: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ puṇ+ye sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pus mgo g.yon du bu rdzi bsod nams tshe 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rgyud 'dzin chen mo bu rdzi yi: de ring phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ma lha rab tu brtan gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dzi wan+dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phye mar ram 'brang rgyas dkar po srung btsugs shing brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi rgyud 'dzin ma: srid lha skyes lha srung du 'dzugs: lus lha srog lha srung du 'dzugs: srid 'dzin brgyud 'dzin srung du 'dzugs: pha lha ma lha srung du 'dzugs: phyug lha bu rdzi srung du 'dzugs: srid kyi phywa g.yang gnas gyur cig: oṃ sarba su khaṃ pra mo ti puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: de nas srung skud brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i tshe dar dkar mo'i gzhi: 'jam legs ra bzhi'i spu las grub: ye shes sna lngar bsgrims pa las: rdo rje rgya chings mdud pa ldan: 'dod rgu'i zar bu chen po 'phyangs: ma lha 'khor ba'i srung du 'dzugs: srid kyi phywa g.yang gnas gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsakra tiṣ+ṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas brgyan: de nas ma lha rten 'dzugs pa ni: mda' mo rgod sgro ma mtshal ldan dang dar sna lnga dang rin po ches brgyan pa thogs la: hūm̐: phywa g.yang rten 'dzugs gang nas byung : ye thog srid pa dang po la: gling bzhi ri rab zom shed na:

gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i gnas: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin pho brang nas: g.yang zhag srid pa'i rol mtsho 'khyil: de dag lha klu 'tshogs pas bsrubs: spyod pas sgo nga lnga ru grub: de yi nang nas brdol pa la: srid pa 'go ba'i lha lnga byung : lha klu rnams kyis rten btsugs bzhin: lha ni tshangs pa dbang phyug dang : 'phrog byed bcas pas 'jig rten la: dbang bzhi kha lor bsgyur ba byung : klu ni gtsug na rin chen dang : dga' byed 'jog po la sogs gnas: mi zad 'dod rgu'i pho brang gyur: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: mtsho mo srid kyi gzhi tshugs shig: hūm̐: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi yi: btsun mo lha lcam bde chen la: 'go ba'i lha rnams rten btsugs pas: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub thob: phywa yi ma lha bu rdzi brtan: rgya gar yul gling kha lo sgyur: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: mtsho mo srid kyi gzhi tshugs shig: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: ḍāk+ki dzi wan dza ya la: 'go ba'i lha rnams rten btsugs bzhin: bod 'bangs lo legs sa bcud smin: phywa yi ma lha bu rdzi brtan: chos 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub: de bzhin de ring phywa g.yang 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: ma lha bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: mtsho mo srid kyi gzhi tshugs shig: hūm̐: de nas phywa rten gang nas byung : de ring rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la: g.yang gi mtsho mo 'khyil ba 'di: 'go ba'i lha la brten btsugs shing : ma lha bu rdzi mnga' gsol phyir: srid kyi rten 'dzugs 'di ltar 'dzugs: hūm̐: rin chen tshe yi mda' mo 'di: rgyu rkyen rten 'brel phun sum tshogs: cang stong dkar mo zhi ba'i mda':

me long ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas spyan mas byin gyis rlobs: ma lha rdo rje'i tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: snyug ma ser po rgyas pa'i mda': mnyam nyid ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: mā ma kī yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha rin chen tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: mtshal brgyan dmar po dbang gi mda': sor rtog ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: gos dkar mo yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha pad+ma'i rten 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: lcags mde'u sngon po drag po'i mda': bya grub ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: dam tshig sgrol mas byin gyis rlobs: ma lha las kyi tshe 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: rgod sgro thams cad lhun grub mda': chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir: dbyings phyug ma yis byin gyis rlobs: ma lha g.yung drung rten 'dzugs phyir: g.yang gi bu rdzi brtan gyur cig: le brgan dar tshon sna lnga yis: ma lha tshe dang dpal skyobs shig: bkra shis rin chen sna lnga yis: phyugs dang srid kyi g.yang spel cig: hūm̐: mda' mo rdo rje srog mkhar 'di: 'go ba'i lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: srid kyi ma lha bu rdzis skyobs: skyob pa lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: tshe dang srid kyi bu rdzis skyongs: srog gi lha lnga'i rten du 'dzugs: g.yang spel rgyud srung 'khor ba dang : 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang : ma lha dbang bskur bdag gyur cig: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: oṃ u ta rā ga tsar+ya dha ra ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐: zhes pas mda' dar gyi dbang bskur: bkra shis brjod me tog 'thor rjes chog bsdu ba dngos grub len pa rnams pad+ma rgyal po sogs gang rigs bya rung : zhes pa 'di nyid shin tu zab pa yin te:

srid phywa la 'dod rgu gang mos kyang phyugs kyi bu rdzi ma 'di rang la rag las shing : byis pa sogs yin na mda' dar tshe yi rten du 'dzugs pad+ma rgyal po'i sku 'khor btags: ma lha bu rdzi ma yi gzhung rkyang ni bud med kyi zhu bar bshad mod kyang : 'di 'go ba'i lha dang sbrags pa yin pas skyes pa rnams kyis zhu yang rung : bag ma gtong len skabs yin na phar 'gro ma lha 'di bskyur nas g.yang 'gugs bya: tshur yong yin na g.yang 'gugs ma lha bya: byis pa sri che na khyim gyi phywa g.yang nyams pa tshe dang dpal nyams par byung na 'di shin tu gtso che: 'di nyid ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis bsgrigs chag tu bkod pa yin pas shin tu byin rlabs che zhing gzhan las kyang 'phags par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi pho brang nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o// //

ja)bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so: bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: bsod nams kun ldan lho phyogs reg bya rlung gi lcags kyu las phran kha skong : de yang sbyin sreg la nye bar 'jug pa brtsam pa'i skor las: thog mar gzhi lho phyogs kyi phrin las nang 'khod cha dbang gi rnal 'byor bkod pa la theg chen bcu drug dang : stegs bur sbrags pa'i mu ran kha khyer dbyibs gru bzhi zla gam du bcad pa'i lha tshogs tshom bu dbus su nor bus mtshan pa'i lcags kyu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje mu ran pad+ma'i lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor: bud shing brtsegs thabs zla gam yin: bye brag shing tshad dmar po dbang gi rigs: yar gzhi lha gzhung rang lugs bslad med bzhin: mchod gtor me lha gtor ma rnam lnga dang : yo byad grangs ldan nges par 'bad: las mtha' mdun gzhi'i rdzas rim bkod pa ni: dūrba chun brgyad: yam shing mar khu 'bras mngar gsum zas mchog til nas gro sran ma dūrba bilba shing 'bras sna tshogs dpal 'bar me dar tshon ldan: rlung g.yab lcags kyu phrin las gzhung ltar lha mdog rgyan gyis spras: bdag bskyed mchod bstod tshar gcig sngon du song nas: dngos gzhi nang mchod dang thab bsang sbyang gi rim pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs? oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li ha na oṃ: bhi mu shu ma ra āḥ bh+rūm̐ eṃ dzeṃ kham̐ hūm̐: oṃ sarba sañtso a mṛ ta rak+ta dz+wa la bha ling+ta pū dza ga ṇa tsakra ga ṇa la badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: hoḥ zhes pas rang byung bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dung dmar snod du rang byung gi dmar chen mchog chen gyi zhal bur gtor ma'i mchod pa: phyi mchod rnam lnga rnam drug:

bsreg rdzas kyi rim pa bsam las 'das pa: dag gtsang lha'i rol pa'i dga' ston gyi rnam par brgyan cing : mchod pa'i bye brag bsam las 'das pa dag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i bla med sngags kyi mchod sprin nam mkha' mtha' las su dmigs shing : gzhal las 'gran su bral ba 'di dag dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshogs la 'bul mchod mnyes pa'i rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi lang tsho ltar zad mi shes par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs dgang gzar gyis reg tsam byas la: oṃ shrī swā hā: oṃ dzeṃ swā hā: oṃ a swā hā: oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā: thab khung bcas sngags 'dis g.yas skor gsum: oṃ āḥhrīḥ i hūm̐: u trām̐ e muṃ e bh+rūm̐: oṃ dza swā hā: me dar la oṃ dz+nyā na baṃ pañtsa li ka swā hā: rlung g.yab la: oṃ: yam̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ swā hā: dpal 'bar la: ram̐ ri ri badz+ra dz+wa la ye swā hā: zhes rdzas thams cad byin rlabs sta gon bgyis nas me thab bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs? stong pa'i ngang las snang srid dbang du byed pa'i me thab phyi rol rgyas pa'i thab rgya khyon tshad med pa nang dbang gi zla gam dmar po gru chad kha khyer mu ran bcas kha chod rdo rje'i phreng ba mu ran pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'od zer khor yug tu mchod pas gtams pa: de'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla ram̐ dang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rdo rje yi gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pas bsrungs te dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du ma gtong : nang gi dngos grub phyi ru mi 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du gsal ba'o: badz+ra tsakra: de nas me sbar ba ni: dpal 'bar thogs la phyogs bzhi nas sngags dang bcas: hūm̐: dam tshig dbang gi gzhal yas su: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir:

deng 'dir mchod pa'i zan bya bskyed: oṃ ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ sa ma ye swā hā: rlung g.yab la: hūm̐: dam tshig dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes 'bebs pa'i las brtsam phyir: deng 'dir 'byung bzhi rlung 'phyo la: 'bar mched sreg blugs gzi byin bskul: oṃ yam̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sarba phu ta ya swā hā: de nas me dar me mtshams 'dzin pa ni: hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las: deng 'dir phrin las brtsam pa la: me lce phyogs min mi 'phro phyir: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me sgo skyongs: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ muṃ maṃ tiṣ+ṭha ye satwaṃ swā hā: zhes pas dam tshig pa bskyed chog thams cad me 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang spyan drangs pa'i me lha ye shes pa mos nas dam bsre zhing 'don bsgom gzhung tshig bstun: de yi dbus su ram̐ dang bgrang phreng lcags kyu las me lha sku mdog dmar ser ra skyes la chibs nas bgrang phreng lcags kyu 'dzin pa drang srong gi nyams 'gyur can: gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas drang srong me lha'i rgyal po la rang mdangs lnga yi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas thab dang zung du 'brel bar bsgom: hūm̐: dad pa tshur gshegs dam tshig 'brel ba'i lha: mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog drang srong 'od po che: srid gsum dbang du byed pa'i las brtsam phyir: bstar ba'i sreg blugs 'bul phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dhe wa ag+ne ye dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: spyan drangs dbang bskur snang mthas dbur brgyan nas: gdan 'bul thab tu 'bar ba'i nus pa bskyed: ku sha dag gtsang brgyan phyir 'bul gyis bzhugs: rdo rje sbu gu'i ljags kyis mchod pa bzhes: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye tiṣ+ṭha lhan: badz+ra sa twa āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ mar khu lnga bdun gang rung 'bul: oṃ ag+ne ye a dhi bh+ya a dhi bh+yaḥbi shud+dho ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya:

bha ha na ya swā hā: thabs shes sbyor la 'bul: hoḥ phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin kho na nyid: bla med sngags rdzas mchod mchog 'dod rgu'i gter: bcom ldan me lha'i 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ag+ne ye a hu te dz+wa la raṃ swā hā: bdag gis sbyin sreg gi mchod pa dam pa 'di brtsams pas skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar gyur cig ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: che bar bsngags pa: hūm̐: tshangs dbang lha chen mgon sras gzhon nu legs: rjes chags dbang gis phrin las mdangs 'phrog pa: ma rig ka dag sa le 'od po che: shes rab nyi ma 'bum 'dra'i dbang 'byin bstod: badz+ra pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa rgyas par bstar bas ye shes kyi me lha dang snang srid kyi byed po kun tu 'gro ba'am: mi 'phro bar thams cad me lha'i ngo bor bsams la: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: badz+ra shab+da swā hā: badz+ra rū pa swā hā: badz+ra shab+da swā hā: badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: badz+ra rā sa swā hā: oṃ badz+ra spar+she swā hā: oṃ ag+ne ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: ma hā rak+ta swā hā: ma hā bha ling+ta swā hā: lnga bdun 'bul ba ci rigs 'dod: de nas rdzas 'bul ba ni: yam shing la: oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ye swā hā: mar khu la: oṃ ag+ne swā hā: 'bras la: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā: zas mchog la: sarba saṃ sa ye swā hā: til la: sarba pa paṃ ye swā hā: so ba la: badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā: nas la: ma hā bhe ga ya swā hā: gro la: badz+ra gasma ri swā hā: sran ma la: ma hā bha la ya swā hā:

dūrba la: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: bilba la: oṃ badz+ra bi wa shu swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la: oṃ mu la ge sar bi shwa swā hā: ku sha la: oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā: slar yang mar khu dang bcas phul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: bdag gis sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di brtsams pa la brten nas lha dang drang srong gnod sbyin dbang phyug la sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa dang skyong ba khyad par 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'khor 'bangs rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum bdag gi dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun 'dus 'dus ye swā hā: zhes pas phrin las dmigs yul gang yin dngos 'byung bar bsam: gong bzhin me lha bstod: de nas 'das rjes su ye shes dngos gzhi 'byung gyur bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi me dpung tsha ba'i dbal ldan ngad g.yo zhing mchod pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du hūm̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las: zhes pa'i pad+ma rgyal po bskyed chog las rim ltar bskyed pa'i: spyan 'dren mchod pa'i mtshams su bsreg rdzas slar yang 'bul rjes phrin las bcol ba 'dod gsol rang blo'i rgya dpangs dang sbrags: mchod rdzas thams cad la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis 'bul: brgya stong sogs grangs ci mang bgyis pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnad yin: dmigs pa ye shes za byed dpa' bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer glog zhags dang tshwa tshwa'i rnam pa las bzhi'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs phyir 'phros pas dmigs bya'i dmigs bsal yod na 'od zer bzhi 'dus kyi pho yi sna bug dang mo yi gsang gnas nas zhugs snying gar sleb pas lus g.yo zhing : bde ba mi bzod pa'i 'byung ba 'khrugs nas khyab pas dga' bas smyos nas dran bzod dngos mi thogs pa'i ngang nas tshe bsod nus pa'i mdangs dang gdung ba'i shugs bcas nas rang gi dbang du bgyis nas nus stobs bdag la thim:

tshogs drug gdung zhing dbang med du mos par bsam: de'i tshe bar du bcod pa'i bgegs dang sgab 'dre sogs glo bur du lhags pa rnams ye shes kyi me rab tu mched pas 'khor yug 'ub kyis bsdus nas me thab tu sbyangs pas bsregs shing gtor ba'i 'dun pa yang yang bgyis: khyad par dbul sri chung sri sogs dngos grub la bar du gcod pa byung na yak+sha kā la'i mngon rtogs la bsreg rdzas tshar gcig phul nas phrin las kha bsgyur bya: deng 'dir dpal chen khro rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'bul ba la brten nas bdag sgrub pa po la gling bzhi yi ya kha 'bebs pa: khyad par che sri chung sri god 'dre sri bse rag 'gong po la sogs pa dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig: gnod byed 'byung po thams cad ha na ha na dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces sogs dang zhal bstab mos na zan ling 'bul: thugs dam bskul ba'i las gtor bshams nas: hūm̐: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi ri rab ngogs: dur khrod dbang mo 'gyu ba gnas kyi bdag: dbang lhun yid bzhin lha chen sgeg pa'i nyams: dkar dmar bsrubs pa'i myos byed bsnun thabs can: srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: yid la 'khu ba'i nor skyug ne'u le thogs: khams gsum snying 'degs lcags kyu'i 'od zer g.yo: ku mud ze'u 'brur 'brub pas kun da bzhad: gsos 'khyil bsod nams zhum med zhabs dkyil bzhugs: stobs ldan mgrin bzang mu kha'i bcud lta bu'i: reg bya g.yo bas lang tsho 'dza' ma'i 'khor: rjes su chags pas gzugs bzang longs spyod spel: pad+ma rā ga'i cha shas lang tsho skyud: 'ga' zhig zla gzhol lan brgyar byi dor g.yab: la la sa snying bzhed mdzes chu skyed rgyas: phal cher 'dar ma'i sgras bskul mar gad 'tsher: kun kyang sgra gcan srang 'jug gug rtse bsgrengs:

yid las spyod pa'i nor 'dzin ne'u 'phyo: pad+ma rā dza 'khor dang phywa brnyan la: bstod cing dus la mi 'da' phrin las nyid: che btsan dmu rabs gtsug rabs rgyal po 'khor: lung rigs mkhas dbang mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta: btsun mo 'khor 'bangs chos srid lugs gnyis kyis: ci srid bsdus pa'i skye 'gro ma lus dang : de srid lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kun: deng 'dir dbang du sdud pa'i las brtsam phyir: sreg blugs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: chos srid mnga' thang 'dod rgu'i dpal zhing sogs: mthong thos dran reg bdag gi bran du shog: rgyal ba'i thugs rje ye shes dbyings nas bskul: pad 'byung nor gyi lha khyod bdag bsgrub kyi: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med deng 'dir stsol: oṃ ā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ ma ma ye swā hā: zhes pas phrin las ci rigs brjod bzhin 'don bsgom sbrags: skabs su me lha la gtor ma 'bul zhing : gshegs skyems tshar gcig 'grub na legs: hūm̐: ye shes rang bzhin 'bar ba'i gzi 'od can: kun la 'khri ba'i nags klong 'joms mdzad phyir: skabs su gshegs sam phyi nas byon pa'i skyel: 'byor ldan mthun pa'i rdzas mchod sreg blugs 'bul: bzhes nas dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar phyin mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: zhes pas me lha'i gtor ma dang bsreg rdzas bcas phul nas rjes chog kha skong yig brgya dang bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs bya: me zhags yal nas thal ba gtsang chen la bskur: gzhan phyi nang gi bya ba phal cher dkyir 'khor spyi 'gros kun dang mthun: 'di nyid dbang sdud nor 'gugs sogs kun la kha tshar med thabs med pas de ltar go rim bgyid: 'di nyid phrin las bzhi ru kha bsgyur kyang rung : dkyil 'khor lha gzhung phyogs mthun gzhan la rigs 'gres kyang mi 'gal bar dkyus lung nas bzhag: 'on kyang 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pas snying ltar brtse la srog ltar 'chang ba gnad che nges par dam med kyis mi rig par gces so:

sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs ba'o// // nya) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dbul sri rmangs 'dre bkar yas bzhugs so: bla ma rigs 'dus pad+ma rgyal po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: de yang gu ru pad+ma rgyal po sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas: nyams su len pa'i go rim 'khyer bde bsgrigs chag tu bkod pa la don gsum ste: thog mar bca' gzhi bkod pa: bar du gzhung bsrang ba: tha mar bskrad cing mdos lam rdzong ba dang gsum mo: dang po sgrub pa ma byas pa'i sngon du sbang ma: ram pa bra bo go gsum gyi thal ba: lam gsum 'dus pa'i sa sna bcas: gzhan yang phyugs nor bang khang zhing kha bcas glud 'jal la: khyad par 'gong po zhugs pa'i rigs gang du yang mi mthun pa'i rdzas bcas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba'i sbrus zan la: bu chung mdzes pa lus la khrab rmog phub dang mda' gzhu 'khor gsum gyi brgyan pa ri bong la zhon pa: de'i mdun du byi ba'i mgo can: rgyab tu sre mong mgo can: g.yas su 'gong po rnga mong mgo can: g.yon du phung byed bya'i mgo can: de yi 'khor du byis pa lto ba 'dir ba dgu: sprang po'i dbyibs can khres po khur nas mkhar ba thogs pa dgu: de rnams snod sgog po'i nang du bzhag: gzhan yang 'o rul ja lad chang lad bcas mi kha'i yas stags rnams kyis bskor: rtse mor bya nag nam mkha' nag pos brgyan pa: glang mi pho thang mo thang dgu yis mtha' bskor: de nas rang nyid yi dam gang rung zhig gi mngon rtogs btang nas: dmigs pa gsal btab nas: mdun du stegs bu nag po zhig gi kha ru thal bas khram dgu bris nas de'i steng du bzhag: zhag gcig gam gsum du bsgrub kyang gtso bo'-i sngags yin: dmigs pa ni tshe rabs nas da lta bar du mi 'dod pa'i bgegs rigs dbul sri 'gong po gnod par byed pa'i rigs thams cad yas gzugs de la thim par bsam:

sngags brgya re 'gro mtshams 'gugs gzhug re dang thal ba'i 'debs kha re sbrags: de yang yang du bskyal bas: sprang po mang por skyas spro ba: byi ba bsad pa phe dgu brdung ba khyi gu brdung ba: khang rul bcog pa 'dir so bshig pa gzhan yang rmangs po'i rigs mang po bskrad par rmis na: de skabs 'gong po 'tshogs pa'i rgya lam khang rul lam tshong dus sam dur khrod sogs gang rung du bskyal la sgab 'dre mnan cing bcad: dgos ched rnal 'byor pa'am khyim bdag gang la la zhig tu: dbul sri dang mi kha zug pa rnams la shin tu nas kyang 'di nyid dgos pa'o: de'i ched du kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bzhag pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas yas stags bskyed chog ni: rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum ldan pa'i ngang nas: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du: yi ge tri dang pre yongs su gyur pa las: dbul sri bse rag 'gong po byis pa'i gzugs can: lus la khrab rmog phub dang mda' gzhu sogs: pho chas kyis brgyan pa spre'u gar mkhan gyis byad ltar nyams 'gyur ba: ri bong sngon po la zhon pa: de'i g.yas su 'gong po rnga mong gi mgo can mig dgu pa: g.yon du phung byed nag mo bya'i mgo can: mdun du dbul sri mi la byi ba'i mgo can: rgyab tu chung sri bse rag sre mong gi mgo can: de'i 'khor du rmangs 'dre yi dwags pho ther dgu: gzhan yang ltog 'dre yul 'dre byur 'dre bcas: dbul po nyam thag pa'i gzugs can dgu: lan chags pho thang mo thang steng na god bya nag po ma rig mun pa'i nam mkha' dang babs: yas stags glud kyi mdos gzhi mngon sum du gsal ba'o: tri pre ti ka a kar+ṣa ya thun thun: de nas 'gugs pa ni: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang :

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par rig 'dzin pad+ma rgyal po thod phreng 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags gsar rnying phyi nang sngags dang ting 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa la brten nas deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub pa la mi dbang ba'i rigs: dam sri 'byung po spun dgu 'gong po bse rag mi la chung sri sgab 'dre yul 'dre gri bo gri mo phung sri rmangs 'dre gson 'dre pho mo mi kha bram mchu'i bdag po bgegs rigs 'dre chag byur yugs ngan pa mi 'dod rkyen ngan gyi bdag po gang yin pa thams cad lan chags glud kyi yas stags 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ bgegs srin 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas lan gsum mam bdun gyis bkug: de nas 'gugs pa'i sngags ni: oṃ ra tri dam sri te phur nag mo'i snying la dza dzaḥ tri tri mi la rmangs sri ti ti ha du shag dza dzaḥ 'grig 'grig rak+mo 'grig 'gong po dbul sri kha la dun tshe dzaḥ dam sri ya ma phung sri yas gzugs la dun shag shag phob phob: ya ma shin+ta dam sri'i srog la dza dzaḥ zhes sngags brgya rtsa tsam gyis 'gugs: de nas glud rnams la thal ba cung zad re gtor ba sngags sbrags nas: oṃ sgrig shog nag mo kha la dun tse rbad: ka li ra tri phe sha nag po'i srog la thun bh+yoḥ nag mo za 'dre rmugs 'dre'i kha chings: 'gong po'i kha chings chings: mi la'i kha chings chings: phung sri'i kha chings chings: bse rag gi kha chings chings: chung sri'i kha chings chings: dbul sri'i kha chings chings: god sri'i kha chings chings: na sri'i kha chings chings: mi kha'i kha chings chings: dam sri'i kha chings chings: gri sri'i kha chings chings: dgra sri'i kha chings chings:

byur yugs kyi kha chings chings: oṃ trag thur shag rbad: dun tse mā ra ya nan: oṃ kra ma hri ma bse rag 'gong po'i kha chings chings nan: sngags 'di shing skyer pa'i byang bu la sngags bris nas sngags pas zho chang bsrung na snod du 'dog: ces pas thal ba la phu btab par bya: dmigs pa dang 'don tshig sbrags nas dmod pa'i bgegs thams cad kyi kha bcing zhing rdo rje nag po'i rgya gram gyis bgegs rnams kyi kha bcings par bsam la: sngags 'di dmigs rtags gong ltar bgrang : dmigs rtags rdzogs nas rdzong 'debs bya ba ni: kha phyir bstan la zho lad chang lad 'o rul zo she sbang ma ram pa sogs mi 'dod pa'i rigs thams cad btab la: hūm̐ nga ni che mchog 'dus pa'i dpal: drag po chen po drag shul can: bskal pa'i me 'dra'i gzi brjid 'bar: gtum chen g.yul las rgyal ba'i sku: che btsan kun las 'gran zla bral: de bas bden pa'i tshig la nyon: hūm̐: rkang gnyis sangs rgyas gtso bo bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags pa bral bas bden pa'i mchog: tshogs gnyis zhing mchog dge 'dun bden pa'i mchog: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bden pa'i mchog: dkon mchog bden pa'i tshig la mi nyan med: rig sngags dmod pa'i tshig 'di phyir mi ldog: sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus: nye bar bskul nas bskrad cing mthar ba'i phyir: lan chags rnams la 'di ltar rdzongs su gdab: kyaiḥ zho lad chang lad 'o rul rnams: 'gong po'i tshogs la rdzongs su 'debs: ja ro rus pa sbang ma rnams: bse rag rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: tshwa g.yer sgog pa ram pa rnams: chung sri rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: god sha god lpags god rus rnams: god bdag rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: ka cha chag grum gas pa rnams: phung sri rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: mda' chag gzhu chag gri chag rnams: gri sri rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: phung sa thal ba rgya lam sa: dam sri rnams la rdzongs su 'debs:

nyams pa'i rdzas dang sgong chag rnams: mi kha'i bdag por rdzongs su 'debs: phag gi sre long a 'grang rnams: te phur nag mor rdzongs su 'debs: pho thang mo thang gar pa rnams: za 'dre rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: gzhan yang mi kha'i yas stags rnams: lan chags rnams la rdzongs su 'debs: da nas bzung ste ji srid bar: gnas 'dir ma 'tshe ma sdang zhig: ci ste 'gyur ldog sdang srid na: las kyi rdo rje lcags sgrog gis: khyod kyi dbang po'i rtsa bcings nas: za ba'i kha ni sdom par 'gyur: myong ba'i lce ni rid par 'gyur: snom pa'i dri ni 'gags par 'gyur: lta ba'i mig ni dong du lhung : bsam pa'i snying yang 'gas par byed: de bzhin nga ni he ru kaḥ phyag mtshan rdo rje char du 'bebs: gnod byed rnams kyi mgo lus 'gems: pho brang phyi nang mtshon char 'khrigs: 'byung po brlag par gdon mi za: de bas gzhan du lam bstan no: de nas cung zad dpag la lam bstan pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig dam sri bgegs rnams nyon: bse rag 'gong po'i tshogs rnams nyon: de ring drag po'i las byed phyir: sngags nag phur thogs hri li li: ban gyi thal rdeb lams se lam: bon gyi bswo sgra di ri ri: skyes pa'i gri 'debs yugs se yug: bud med thal zor sha ra ra: me zor rdo chu char du 'bebs: rnga shing ldir zhing 'cham rngam gyis: the'u rang 'byung po'i klad khrag 'gems: gnod byed sdod pa'i gnas med pas: de bas khyod la lam bstan no: kyaiḥ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma shar phyogs pha ki na: mun gling dgu yi pha rol na: rgya nag gling gi shar phyogs na: dri za 'bum gyi pho brang yod: pho brang de yi nang shed na: dri za'i rgyal po rta mgo can: de la longs spyod zad mi shes: dbang po lnga yis rig pas tshim: 'jig rten zas la 'dzin pa bral: dri za'i sras mo a sman mtshar: snyan pa'i rta ring dbyangs su len: de la khyo pho ma mchis pas:

gzhon nu khyod la yong du re: gtan gyi grogs la bskos su re: mtshar sdug yid gar len du re: de ru 'gong po'i ming mi grags: 'dod yon lta bas ngoms sa yin: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i gling de la: bse rag kha chings byed mkhan med: de 'dra'i yul la lam bstan no: de ru song dang de ru dga': de ru song dang de ru skyid: gnas 'di mi bde yam ma yam: khang pa mi bde sgang ma sgang : mi rnams khro tshul srin po'i gzugs: 'dod yon thams cad me ru mthong : gab skung khro chu'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: nyi bzhin bse rag kha chings zer: de bas sdod yul 'di min pa'i: lam bstan bzhin du da song zhig: mdos lam sngon mo gtsang po'i gzhung : mar 'bab bzhin du lam bstan no: chu bo gyen la mi ldog ltar: de nas phyir mi ldog tu gsol: khyad par dmod de lam bstan pas: rgya lam 'dus pa'i mdo ru song : tshong dus rnying pa'i mthil du song : khang ral sgog po'i nang du song : gza' 'dzing 'thab 'khon can la song : pho 'dre gre bo'i yul du song : mo 'dre lha bab can la song : yul mi bsam ngan 'chang la song : grong mi kha ya can la song : shag ngan sna 'dren can la song : gang la dmod pa de la song : su la 'phrad pa de la sgyur: phu nas brdzang ba mda' ru song : la nas brdzang ba lung la song : lung nas brdzang ba mtha' ru song : mtha' nas de bzhin yang mthar song : skye ba med pa'i lam la song : 'gags pa med pa'i klong du song : rang bzhin khyab brdal klong du thim: 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces sum+bha ni sogs dang : khro bo'i sngags bcas kyi thun dang me zor sogs 'don tshig sbrags nas: gnas khang mi mthong ba'i chu ngogs sam lam chen po'i mdo'am: dur khrod kyi gling ngam khang rul lam gnas gzhi sgog po'am: ci ltar 'tshams par bskyal la phyi mig mi blta bar nang du log: drag sngags me yi srung 'khor bsgom: thun gyi tha ma stong par bzhag:

sa ma ya: de yang 'di dag dgos ched rnam pa gsum: sgrub pa po'i sbyin bdag gang zhig la: phyi nas mi kha bram mchu 'brug ltar ldir: nang du dpon slob 'am ni dpon g.yog 'khrugs: phal pa'i gza' tshang rnams kyang 'thab 'khon mang : gzhan yang ka cha rnams la chag grug sdang : khang khyim byi bas g.yengs shing chas la sdang : phyi ru dgra rkun jag chom rlung ltar 'tshubs: zhing kha'i lam rnams rgud cing nyams pa dang : nang du longs spyod rnams kyi bcud kyang yal: bang ba sgo bzhi rnams kyang rim par stong : khang par tsha 'ub drod med shin tu grang : don med mgron po sleb kyang ltog snang skye: zas kyang ston mo gzab kyang tshur la smra: mi yi gdong dang gos lag rnams kyang nyams: rgyan dang gdong dang skya yam thal skya chags: 'gro rnams mi mthun 'dug na kun gyis sdang : ja chang mdangs nyams dkar gzhon bcud mi 'byung : khang par sel dang sbra la skya thig 'byung : rmi lam 'gong po'i rmi ltas mang ba dang : 'phral du lto za de ma thag tu ltog: snang ba yad yud sdod snying mi 'dod pa: don med go tshig ma bsran sems rlung langs: khyad par phyi dro rnams su snying mi dga': bzang du 'dod kyang ngan pa 'phral du 'gyur: ci byas lam du mi 'gro sna tshogs 'byung : de dag thams cad dam sri'i cho 'phrul te: 'gong po bse rag zhugs pa'i ltas yin no: de 'dra byung na 'di nyid med thabs med: khyad par nor sgrub dngos 'grub 'gugs pa'i tshe: bar chad rtsom pas 'di nyid shin tu gces: ma 'ongs sems can rmu rgod gang zhig la: dbul phongs bkres skom sred pas 'ching ba'i tshe: pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med sgrub thabs kyi: cha lag zab mo las phran gdams pa bzhag: gang du ma spel shin tu dam pa gces: gang phyir snying rje bral ba'i slob dpon gyis: rtag tu 'byung po kha chings a 'thas na: phyi mar dbul por lus su skyon yod 'ga': de bas dam tshig ldan rnams bsgrub brtson no:

dus ma yin la mi bya zhal gdams yin: las 'phro bsod nams can dang 'phrad pa'i phyir: dbyangs can bdag gis bkod nas rgyas gdab bo: klu rgyal la thod dkar pos rgya 'di srungs: nā ga rā dza si ta ni bhi gu kha ta ye rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: [WP:180,0]ྀatsha: sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes byi ba'i lor dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing sa sprel lor bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so: maṅga laṃ// //

ta) ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dam sri sgab 'dre mnan pa dmod pa dgu skor bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: drag po thod phreng 'dus pa rtsa ba'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: gang zhig dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa: dbul sri sgab 'dre mnan pa'i gdams pa ni: khyi dug klu dug phag dug re lcag sogs: rgya rtsi dug lo shing kun ru ta yis: ngar btab shog bur gri khrag mngal khrag gis: liṅga bud med gzugs can bya mgo can: mgo ru shwa ba'i ra dang ldan par bris: yan lag lcags sgrog bsdams nas sbrul gyis dkris: gnad kyi liṅga yi ge spyi mthun bya: de nas lto ba'i dbus su sngags 'dis bskor: tri dza dza sgrig shog nag po kha tsha dzaḥ ka li ra tri ya ma dun tse dza: tri tri sham long te phur nag mo dzaḥ 'ub shu 'ub shu shag ti dbul sri dzaḥ dam sri bhi sha mu ru mu ru dzaḥ ka li dung dung dza dza rmugs 'dre mo dza nag mo za 'dre ma kha thaṃ: rlom byed nag mo'i yid chings: mi kha'i bu mo bya mchu ma kha thaṃ: hag thaṃ nan nan tri tri dza dzaḥ nan nan: tri ra tri ra ma ya ya ma te phur nag mo'i srog la dzaḥ dung dung kham shog gur ling 'gong po mi la chung sri'i snying la mā ra ya: 'gong po mig dgu phung byed lag dgu dza dzaḥ mi la chung bse rag chung sri'i snying la dza dzaḥ dbul sri god sri gyod sri la dza dzaḥ dgra sri 'chi sri nad sri la dza dzaḥ krig ha la thaṃ bse rag mi la'i snying la mā ra ya: hur thum thog tu tri kha la dza dzaḥ mā ra ya nan nan: phyi rol sbrul gyi nang du sngags 'di bris: nā ga this pa de ya dun te phur dun+tu ya che sri pho sri ri bo'i rtse nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: mo sri 'dre mo rgya mtsho'i mthil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: chung sri bse rag mngal du tshud pa mā ra ya nan brub: god sri rwa ba'i phugs nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: dar sri dur khrod mthil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub:

gri sri phung shul gyi dkyil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: bse rag tshong 'dus gling nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: phung sri gri bo gling yul la chags pa mā ra ya nan brub: gson 'dre pho mo rgya grong gru nas langs pa 'gong po sde dgu'i tshogs thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: za 'dre khā kha mu kha zlog zlog: gur ma gur ting gur lan gur sman gur raṃ gur nan: gur srin gser 'brong g.yu 'brong sman 'brong srin 'brong la sogs dam sri pho mo'i snying rtsa la shig shig baṃ ril nan nan tri tri this pa te ya zlog zlog: satwaṃ bha ya zlog zlog: rdzas bya gag gi spu: srin bya'i gtsug phud: rdo srig nag po: g.yer ma: ram pa: sgog pa: bra bo bcas liṅga'i nang du btab: yugs sa'i skras bcing : phag mgo gam: sprel mgo: ba yi ra co'am: ra ru'am: lcung ka'i thod pa bcas gang rnyed nang du bcug: khyad par gyis 'gugs: dbul sri bkar yas nang gi sngags dang sbrags: thun mong bden stobs yi dam gang rung nas blang : dmigs rtags dbul sri bkar yas dang mthun: rtags rdzogs nas la chas kha bsdam: mun rub dus sgrub khang mi mthong ba'i lam rgya gram du mnan: sāts+tsha nag po dang skyer pa'i phur pa mtho gang gis steng du gzugs: kha ro g.yam nag pos bcad: dmod dgu bzlog pa tshar gsum gyis bro bor: dmod dgu ni: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags gsum: de rnams kyi bden pas mnan: phyi mig mi lta nang du log: mtshams gcod bya zhing srung 'khor bsgom: sgo yi ya them la g.yung drung bri: zhogs ni nyi ma rtse shar dus sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzugs: dkyil 'khor gyi dam bca' sogs dang las byang dang phywa 'bod rgyas bsdus ltar bya: 'di'i dgos ched ni rnal 'byor gang la la zhig gis nor bsgrub pa'am: dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'am:

bsgrub pa rab 'bring gang la 'jug kyang bar chad bdud kyis 'tshe ba nges par snang bas 'di kho na dgos par bshad pa dang : dam sri tri'u zhugs pa rnams la shin tu dgos: spyir bsgrub pa'am: bsod nams sam: phan dge'i rigs phyogs su ji ltar 'jug pa'i rigs la mi mthun pa'i rkyen gang byung yang : dam sri pho mo yi cho 'phrul yin pas de'i ched du 'di nyid bzhag pa'o: khyad par dbang thang rgya yi sri srung nag po kun thub kyi skabs su yang 'di shin tu zab pa'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: ྀatsha: rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rjes dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du shog ser las bsgyur ba'o// // tha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: sngon 'gro snang ba'i 'dod yon bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so: rig 'dzin ma hā nor lha'i tshogs la 'dud: rgya rgya rgya: kyichai: 'dod yon phun tshogs rin chen gter mdzod nyid: snang srid tshim byed 'dod yon dpag med gter: bdag blo'i re skong mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: ro brgya zag med snang srid mgror bsngos pas: 'dzad med srid pa'i re bas 'gengs mdzad pa: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis dpyid du bkod: sa ma ya: ye shes dang phyi rgyud skyong ba'i dregs sde srung ma rnams la gser skyems dang sngon 'gro'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: snod bzang rin chen dag tu bshos bu dkar gtor 'dab ma brgyad kyis brgyan pa mar tshon gyis phra gdab pa: gser skyems bcud ldan bshams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la bsngo ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ oṃ swa bhā w stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du yig 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bcud rdzas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bde ba phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur:

oṃ a kā ro sogs? oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga sogs? na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs? bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo: de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo: de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo: de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nyon cig lha srin dregs sde tshogs: pad+ma rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du: bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi dal bzung phyir: khyed rnams rogs dan ma g.yail sgrubs: de bzhin bden pa'i tshig la nyon: hūm̐ hrīḥ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: bden pa'i mchog ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka': dkon mchog gsum la mi nyon gang yang med: 'phags pa'i spyan gyis mi gzigs gang yang med: sgra gcan zom du mi gnas gang yang med: 'byung ba lnga la ma bsdus gang yang med: tshogs drug 'dod yon mi rol gang yang med: chos sku'i zil gyis mi non gang yang med: thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi zin gang yang med: lha 'dre sems su ma grub gang yang med: bzang ngan rgyu 'bras mi ltos gang yang med: mna' dang khrims la mi 'dzem gang yang med: smras pa'i tshig la mi nyon gang yang med: longs spyod chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: de ltar bden pa'i tshig la legs par nyon: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: bdag gis byang chub snying po bsgrub pa la: 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen bsam don sgrubs: mi mthun nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: tha tshig gnyer ba'i gter srung dam can tshogs: las su srog bdag bya rog gdong can tshogs: dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gza' klu rgyal po btsan: ma bdud srid pa'i mgul lha bcu gsum sogs:
