phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : 'jigs byed dgu dang gling phran bdag po rnams: so so'i yid mthun mchod gtor gser skyems 'di: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin dregs sde sogs: sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang : gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod dpa' bo ging : brtan ma skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis dang : spar sme lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang : rgya gar rgya nag bal bod mtshams shed dang : mnga' ris dbus gtsang mdo khams sgang drug sogs: sbas yul rong chen gnas chen pad+ma bkod: gter gnas drag rtsal gter srung myur mgyogs bdun: khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : pha ri tshul ri g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gis legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di stsal du gsol: slon dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: khyed cag bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: chos don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhu mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar skyel: sgrub pa ltar yin na sgrub khang gi mdun gang rung du phul: gzhi bdag so so'i las phran gzhung bzhin du bcol: 'di nyid dkyil 'khor sogs kun gyi sngon 'gro'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma hoḥ gsang sngags rgyal po rin chen za ma tog /bcu pa'i bco lnga'i nyin khrom sum brgya'i skor dang bcas te dge bsnyen mgon po'i kha nas khrom gter du bgyis/ sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi byang sgo rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang nye bar ka nam sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang pad+ma mngon dga'i yang rtse ru shog ser du zheng sor gsum dkyus mdzub gang ba za hor seng ha'i yi ge ru 'dug pa bod yig tu legs par bsgyur ba'o/

sarba maṅga laṃ// da) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dbang sdud nor bu zhags pa sgrub pa'i las byang bzhugs so: pad 'byung nor lha rigs 'dus tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ongs sems can dbul phongs sgrib bsal phyir: nor sgrub yang snying dzam lha dbang sdud kyi: snying byang dmar po rin chen gsang rgya 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phun tshogs yid 'ong dgos 'dod 'grub pa'i sar: bsod nams rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang gi dal: rab thig 'bring thang tha ma 'bru tshom ni: lha grangs ci ltar lag len bzhin du bkod: mnga' thang rgyas pa'i longs spyod dkor cha dang : phun tshogs 'byor ldan can gyi zas nor dang : sa sna chu sna shing sna 'dzoms tshad dang : sman sna 'bru sna dar sna rin chen rnams: legs par bsags shing dkyil 'khor mtha' bzhir bskor: mchod rdzas gzhung bzhin gang 'os dkor chas bsham: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan kha sbyor nang : bsod nams nor rdzas dbang sdud 'khor lo bzhag: g.yas su dzam gtor g.yon du bum rdzas gtams: dam por mtshams bcad smra bar mi chod par: gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo zhing phrin las bcol: bgegs gtor bsngo zhing dbul sri bkar yas bya: dkar chas rgyan spras rig ma mtshan ldan gyis: sgrub pa'i grogs bcol rten 'brel mkhas par bya: sku gsum tshul ldan ngang nas bag lhod nas: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal btab 'dzin med ngang : sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa rnams: slob dpon bka' bzhin 'khrul med brtson par bya: de nas bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas: phyogs mtshams 'gugs bsgral mtshon 'phros pas: tshe bsod longs spyod mnga' thang la: gnod byed yi dwags bgegs rigs kun: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kā la gnod byed mā ra ya khug dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gnod byed bgegs rigs lan chags rnams:

'dod yon glud gtor 'di bzhes la: phyi rol dpag tshad bcu ru dengs: dam tshig 'gal na rdul du rlog: hūm̐ kro ta kā la tsaṇ+ḍa bhū ta gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: thod phreng drag po khro rgyal gyis: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rnams: mtshams bcad khro bo'i gur gyur nas: 'jigs med rdo rje'i bh+rūm̐ du gyur: oṃ āḥbadz+ra rak+ṣa tsakra bh+rūm̐: de nas dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: pad 'byung sku gsum dbang sdud skur ston pa: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal bzung nas: nam yang mi shigs tsit+ta dag tu bsgrub: ting 'dzin rnam gsum brda rtags bsten bgyid do: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta nan sa ma ya ho hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal: kun tshang mchod pa phyi nang sgrub rdzas rnams: zad med longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' rgyas bzhin: dgos 'dod 'bad med mchog tu 'grub gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye sogs lan gsum gyis byin brlab: de nas dkyil 'khor lha bskyed pa ni: rin chen khang bzang byin 'bebs bya: hūm̐ hrī mā: kun khyab ye shes dbyings kyi ngang : rang byung 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs thabs: de dbus bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : rin chen las grub rgyas pa'i dbyibs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs: phyi nang brtsegs rim chos tog tshang : de nang dgos 'byung rin chen khrir: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+mas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs:

g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: rat+na'i rgyan 'phyangs dbang sdud tshul: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: dal 'gying 'gros kyi tshul du gnas: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: phyag gnyis rdo rje pad+ma bsnams: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud brda 'gros tshul: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rgyan ldan gar: phyogs bzhir mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan ni: rang rtags ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: mdun du klu mo nor skyong ma: na chung mdzes pa'i cha lugs can: khog stod mi la khog smad sbrul: sbrul mgo gsum gdengs nor bus brgyan: g.yas g.yon nor bu zhags pa bsnams: rin chen 'dod 'byin tshul gyis bskyed: gzhan yang nor skyong dbang sdud ma: phyi nang sprin 'khrigs snang bzhin bsgom: bdag nyid gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: skad gcig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: pad+ma rgyal po dbang sdud rtsal: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: nor bdag 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dgos 'dod lhun grub rat+na'i khrir: dbang sdud pad+ma yab yum 'khor: dngos grub kun 'byung brten pa'i phyir: 'dzum bag 'gying brjid tshul gyis bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: bdag gzhan dbul phongs skyon bsal phyir: gu ru nor lha'i dkyil 'khor la: bsod nams bskyed phyir phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dgos 'dod 'byung gnas mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

kun 'byung rat+na'i rdzas su byin brlabs nas: dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung gnas nor lha mo: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma pū dza hoḥ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa tī waṃ se pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: de nas brda bstod ni: hūm̐: kun 'byung longs spyod bdag po 'dod rgu'i rje: bde stong mchog gsum rang byung ngang nyid las: ral pa'i cod pan rin chen brgyan pa ni: dgos 'dod nor bu char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: zhi 'dzum rgyan dang ga shal 'phyang ba ni: zab cing spros bral dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: zhal gsum dmar zhing dkar la rgyas pa ni: sku gsum thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams pa ni: rdo rje'i sku brnyes rtogs med don ldan brda: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams pa ni: dam chos rgyas phyir dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i brda: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+ma bsnams pa ni: gzhan snang 'gugs shing pad+ma dbang sdud brda: sgeg cing gsus khyim che la 'gying ba ni: khams gsum zil gnon longs spyod 'byung ba'i brda: thung la sbom zhing rgyan kun rdzogs pa ni: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro nor lhar mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs su dpa' ba ni: ma rungs log 'dren zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: rat+na'i khrir bzhugs gzi brjid ldan pa ni: pad 'byung rjes 'jug 'dzam gling khyab pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs dbang sdud rgyal por bstod: g.yas su lha lcam 'jo sgeg dmar ba ni: tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba'i brda: rat+na rgyan 'chang mdzes 'chang gzigs pa ni:

pad 'byung brda rtags thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams pa ni: khams gsum dbang sdud dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i brda: dal zhing 'gros kyi tshul du gnas pa ni: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gtso mo'i brda: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar ba ni: gsang sngags bstan rgyas dam chos 'phel ba'i brda: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs 'gro don lhun grub brda: phyag gnyis rdo rje pad+ma bsnams pa ni: thabs shes lam spyod bde stong mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud tshul gyis brda 'gros ni: gzhan snang dbang sdud dug lnga zil gnon brda: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ldan pa ni: rtsa rlung dbang sdud chags lam grol ba'i brda: zung 'jug bde chen rab tu rgyas pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang dbang sdud zil gnon brda: gsang ba bde stong rig ma'i tshogs la bstod: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'gyed pa ni: phrin las bzhi ldan dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: phyag g.yas rang rtags lcags kyus mtshan pa ni: pho nya sgo ma'i sgo gsum 'gugs stim brda: g.yon na nor skyug ne'u le bsnams pa ni: bsod nams longs spyod char rgyun myur 'bebs brda: bzhi ka gar stabs mkha' la bsgyur ba ni: rdzu 'phrul drwa bas gang 'dul ston pa'i brda: phrin las bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: mdun du klu mo nor skyong mdzes pa ni: klu dbyangs dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: na chung mdzes ma'i cha lugs 'chang ba ni: zab gter bka' srung khyad par mdzad pa'i brda: khog stod mi mo mdzes 'dzum chags pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang gang 'dod ster ba'i brda: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khyil ba ni: chos dbyings bde drod rig mar brdzu ba'i brda: sbrul mgo gdengs ka nor bus brgyan pa ni: sgrub la grogs mdzad bar chad sel ba'i brda:

phyag gnyis zhags pa nor bu 'dzin pa ni: zab chos mthar phyin kun snang khyab pa'i brda: rin chen gling bzhugs rtse gcig gus pa ni: sa 'og dbang bsgyur sgrub mchog skyong ba'i brda: rol mchog bcud 'dzin klu mo mdzes la bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phra men ma: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin ḍāk+ki nor lha'i tshogs: sku gsum dag pa'i klong yangs bde ba'i ngang : 'khor 'das chos nyid grol bar phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod: las kyi rig ma gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: klu mo nor skyong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang : las sbyor bsgrub pa'i sngags phreng dbang sdud yid bzhin zhags pa ni: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza sid+dhi sa ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun sid+dhi dzaḥ nor sgrub dbang sdud dmar po'i sngags phreng 'di: las rim sngags zhag bdun bzlas pa gal che: longs spyod 'gugs pa'i zas nor thun dza zhes pho mo 'gugs pa'i ming dang dbang po bris: zil gyis gnon na rang nyid pad+ma ni: dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul du bsgom: de nas 'grub rtags rdzogs nas dbang bzhi blangs dkyil 'khor rnams kyi las rim gang mos pa: dar dmar dril rang nyid 'chang bar bya'o: g.yang khug yin na g.yang sgye nang du bcug par bya: de nas dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: pad+ma rgyal po dbang sdud mkha' 'gro tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin rlabs bcud bsdus dbang bzhi mchog tu bskur: 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med nor gyi mdzod: snyan grags mnga' thang chos gos srid la sogs: yid la gang smon skal ldan bdag la stsol:

'dzam gling 'jig rten khams gsum dbang sdud la: 'dzad med 'dzam gling longs spyod kun thob shog: rtsa sngags la: e kā ya sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi baṃ hoḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi ho dzaḥ sa ma ya sid+dhi dza dzaḥ zhes dbang dang dngos grub rol te: ye shes pa brtan rang sar rang la bsdu: oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: ma rig 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: de kun mgon por bzod par gsol: zhes lhag chad bkang zhing yig brgya brjod: bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam mchog: zil gnon pad+ma dbang sdud rgyal po rtsal: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho klu mo gter gyi bdag: phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ ye shes ngang las dgongs pa zang thal gyis: dkyil 'khor hūm̐ bsdu hūm̐ yang gsal stong ngang : sku bzhi ma bcos spros bral stong pa yis: ka dag dbyings rig shar grol a la bzhag: a a āḥ zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs kyis rgyas btab: gong gi dbang dang dngos grub rnams kyang : rig ma'i phyag rgyud nas blang zhing brgyud na rten 'brel dge: e ma: zab gsang legs sgyur zla bzhin gar: snying byang dkor gyi nor sgrub yang snying 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu'i kha dar dus: las kyi thugs sras dbang rtags hūm̐ gis mtshan: rtags rgya lnga ldan de la chos 'di sprod: gter srung dge bsnyen drag po mthu chen dang : gter bdag klu mo nor skyong mdzes ma rnams: nor sgrub snying byang 'di nyid thub par srungs: dam nyams log lta bdud rigs dbang po snubs: chos bdag sras la sprod cig a thaṃ rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thub par srungs shig rgya: dbang sdud rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang hūm̐ ka la daṇ+ḍa rtsal gyis dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing*/ dga' rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i mgul 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug tu shog ser nas phab pa'o//

na) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: rin chen khang bzang yid bzhin gter mdzod bzhugs so: yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po rje btsun zhabs: pad 'byung lha yi lha dang dbyer med pa: pre ta'i tshad gdung sel mdzad ljon pa'i bsil: dpag bsam dbyug gu smin pa'i bcud g.yo ba: ngad tshim lha la 'khu ba'i dri bsung chags: gang gis reg nas mi bzod mchog dga'i bde: lhan skyes bcud 'phrog ting 'dzin ro mchog bzhin: yid la rnam par rgyal ba'i mdangs 'phro ba: rmad byung lta na sdug pa'i dgyes gar 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po zhes: o rgyan nor gyi lha dang dbyer med bsgrub pa'i le'u bcu gsum pa'i nang nas man ngag zur gsal du bkod pa'i shog dril yang gsang mchong gur smug mo'i ti la ka'i rak+ta ltar btus pa'i rgyud las: rnam par bskrun pa'i go rim la: thog mar dus dang gnas skabs sogs yid dang 'thad pa'i sa ru yon tan phun sum tshogs nas: gzhung gi bsgrigs chag bkod pas brgyan pa'i las rim rnams: gtan la phab rjes: g.yang rten rnam rgyal khang bzang bzo ba la: thog mar bcud chags pa'i sbrus zan gang rung la: gzhi snod gtsang ma mdzes pa'i dbus su ri rab bang rim mu khyud lcags ri ldan zhing khang bzang thog so gsum dang ldan pa la: rtse mor nor bu 'bar ba'i bum pa rgyan mdzes: gzhal yas kyi logs cha rnams dang gru chad rnams su bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyi byug pa: 'ja' gur dang mu tig sogs rin chen lan tshar me tog phreng ba rgyan spyod dang 'phan 'phyangs sogs phal cher mdzes tshon gyi sdeb legs kun gyi yid du mchis par bya: rgyas par spro na gling bzhi gling g.yog gi mkhar dang ldan pa mkhar dbus mi rgyab rten dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa 'bras bu dang lo 'dab kyis phyug pa: khra khru rnams la rol mtsho g.yang zhag gi bdud rtsi 'khyil ba:

mi yi yo byad: lha klu yi gzugs 'gros: dud 'gro'i 'gyur khug bcas spyan gzigs du mas mdzes par bkram pa'o: de nas rnam rgyal khang bzang bskyed pa ni: (cha) oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: oṃ rat+na mu la dha mañdza ye swā hā: zhes pas byin brlab par bya: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza hri ha ho phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las gzhi e las nam mkha': yam̐ rlung gi rgya gram: ram̐ me yi tsakra: kham̐ chu yi dkyil 'khor: bh+rūm̐ rin chen pho brang : hri ma a ho zhes pas: rang byung lhun grub kyi pho brang : phyi nang gi bkod pa rgyan yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ste: srid pa gsum g.yo nus pa'i mdangs chags pa khams gsum gyi nor sna dkor cha sogs lta bas chog mi shes pa blo las 'das pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba: pho brang gi nang thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'grub pa bsam pas brjod du mi lang bas rab tu gang ba 'di nyid rje ma hā gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yi dkyil 'khor dang khyad par nor bdag dzam+bha la bka' dang gter gyi srung ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas bsgrub pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i rdzas: mchod pa'i rdzas: rten pa'i rdzas: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang nam mkha' bar snang 'khor yug mu mtha' snang bas bzung dang ma bzung 'byams klas pa'i rang bzhin thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ sarba ga na e ma la shrī pa ri wā ra rat+na pha la ma ṇi dha ra ma la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas g.yang rten rnams byin 'bebs pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngo bo ka dag klong dkyil nas: dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yis: ma rig dbyings su dag pa'i byin phob cig: snang stong mkha' la bsgrib bya'i g.ya' bral ba: bgres rgud bral ba rdo rje sems dpa' yis: zhe sdang rnyog ma bral ba'i byin phob cig:

khyab brdal ngang la ci yang lhun gyis grub: tshogs gnyis yid kyi gter las rin chen 'byung : nga rgyal mtshan ma zhig pa'i byin phob cig: ma 'dres chu zla'i byad bzhin so sor snang : ci yang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i snang mtha' yas: 'dod sred chags pas grol ba'i byin phob cig: 'khor 'das dmigs su ma mchis rtsod bral ba: bdag 'dzin snying po zhig pa'i don yod grub: phrag dog rlung dmar gzhom pa'i byin phob cig: ting 'dzin yan lag brgyad ldan snyoms par 'jug: nges pa'i lam ston drug pa'i rnam par snang : gti mug tshogs bcom ye shes byin phob cig: shes rab dbyangs dang rnam gzigs snying rje can: mthu stobs 'chang mdzad sku gsum rdo rje'i thugs: sgo gsum tha mal zhig pa'i byin phob cig: nyag gcig thig le rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rig stong grangs med 'od sku'i rnam rol can: ma skyes gsal rdzogs ye shes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rje btsun mgon po snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs: mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma rgyal po yis: dkyil 'khor g.yang rten rdzas la byin phob cig: tshe yi dbang mo lha lcam man+da ra: chos sku yum chen jo mo mtsho rgyal mas: zas nor snyan grags 'phel ba'i byin phob cig: gtsug na nor bu'i gdengs ka klu yi rgyal: dgos 'dod mchod sbyin klu mo nor skyong mas: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub pa'i byin phob cig: shar phyogs 'gugs byed lha mo lcags kyu ma: yul 'khor srung gi tshe bsod mnga' thang rnams: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: lho phyogs dbang sdud ma mo zhags pa ma: 'phags skyes po yi dpal 'byor snyan grags srid: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: nub phyogs tshe 'phel lha mo lcags sgrog ma: spyan mi bzang gi 'byor rgyas rgyan gos tshogs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig:

byang phyogs g.yul las rab rgyal dril bu ma: rnam thos sras kyi phywa g.yang 'dod rgu'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: rnam rgyal khang bzang dgos 'dod bum pa ru: tshangs pa'i 'byor ldan tshogs pa'i bcud chags nas: dgos 'dod 'bad rtsol mi dgos lhun grub stsol: phywa g.yang 'dod rgu dpal 'byor byin phob cig: hūm̐: ye sngon lta bur bstan pa mtho ba dang : gser ri'i lhun ltar bsod nams rgyun chags nas: rtsi shing grangs ltar 'dod rgu lhun gyis grub: rol mtsho'i klung ltar g.yang zhag khad kyis 'khyil: khu rlangs gtibs bzhin phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub: dbyar gyi pho nya snyan grags 'brug ltar sgrog: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i byin rlabs glog bzhin myur: 'bad rtsol mi dgos thugs rje char bzhin 'bebs: dam sri tshar bcad nus pa thog ltar 'bebs: de ltar byin rlabs shugs 'byin bsgrubs pa'i lha: deng 'dir byin rlabs dbang bskur bstsal nas su: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ma ṇi bha dra bi ru pāk+ṣā ra tsa hring hring ma ma thun thun sarba dza dzaḥ maṅga la shrī ye a dhiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: zhes rol mo dang bcas byin 'bebs bya: sa ma ya: 'dod rgu'i bum bzang dpal gyi bcud: thugs rje sprin dpung klong nas 'bebs: mos pa'i sa gzhir bcud du smin: skal par ldan no dbul ba sel: yang dag nges so sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: rig pa 'dzin pa lo ha badz+ra kyis gdan drangs pa'o// // pa) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: dzam lha dkar po'i sgrub pa 'dod rgu mchog sbyin bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: pad+ma rgyal po dbang sdud sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: longs spyod 'dod rgu phywa g.yang sdud pa'i thabs: nor sgrub dzam lha dkar po'i las rim bstan:

dbyangs can mtsho rgyal lcam gyis legs par nyon: mi brjed brda yi ri mor gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang smon lam thob: bka' yi gter gtad klu mo 'od ldan rgyal: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag gis: lag len bca' gzhi rim pa dbye gsal ni: gzhi gtsang steng du 'bru tshom legs par bkod: de steng bhan+dha mtshan ldan yangs pa'i nang : pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub gtor rgyan bzang 'dzugs: rtse mo sku 'khor bla 'khor dbang sdud gsum: 'dzugs shing dar dmar mgul chings cod pan spras: mdun du lha chen tshogs bdag gtor ma bsham: g.yas g.yon mda' dar rin chen sna tshogs bsham: gzhan yang g.yang rdzas mchod sprin sna tshogs bsham: sa ma ya: rtse mor sku 'khor bris pa'i rim pa ni: dang po lte ba'i dbus su sngags 'di bris: 'di yi phyi rol mu khyud sngags 'di bris: oṃ ma hā bhai shrī gu ya dha ra sa ma ya: dza hūm̐ kyaid kyaid sid+dhi sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi hri dha sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ rat+na puṇ+ye sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ pad+ma sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ karma a mo gha sid+dhi dza dzaḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ma ma sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hūm̐: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ pad+ma ra dza phe sha a liṅga ku mā ra ma ṇi ḍāk+ki sa mā ya dza dzaḥ oṃ sarba ṇi ra la sha li thun thun: lha 'dre mi gsum gyi snang ba dbang du bsdus la dus 'dir thun thun: 'dzam gling 'jig rten yangs pa'i zas nor thams cad dbang du sdud sdud thun thun ya spra mo re breng sarba ma ma pa shaṃ 'dus 'dus sid+dhi hūm̐: de yi phyi rol sku 'khor legs par bris: gtor ma'i rtse mor dag la 'dzugs par bya: de nas bla 'khor 'bri ba'i gdams pa ni: dang po lte ba'i dbus su sngags 'di bris: de yi mu khyud la: oṃ ār+ya ma ṇi tra dha ra ru pa ni bi shwa dha ra dz+nyā na gu h+ya satwi pad+ma sid+dhi rā dza ya sarba sid+dhi a hūm̐:

bdag cag sgrub pa po la don gnyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i snying srog brtan par gyur cig: de yi phyir rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ pad+ma a sho li hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma ki ta ri hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma dha ra hrī hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma ku mā ri hūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ ma ma su khaṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ dzaḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ dz+nyā na rā dza ma ni ma ma sarba ra hi na bud+dha bud+dho nan badz+ra u ta pra mo hriṃ dzaḥ sgrub pa po la tshe chos zas nor snyan grags sogs 'dod pa'i don thams cad bde blag nyid du stsol cig: a ti sha thun dza pad+ma sid+dhi dzaḥ de yi phyi rol thabs kyi nor bu bris: gtor ma'i gshog zur g.yas su 'dzugs par bya: de nas dbang sdud 'khor lo bri ba ni: lte ba'i dbus su srog sngags legs par bkod: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la sngags 'di bkod: oṃ ḍāk+ki ku mā ra dz+nyā na shi ta ra sarba dzi wan dza ya dhe wi ya myur myur sarba puṇ+ye sid+dhi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung lnga'i bcud sogs 'gro ba'i chos snyan grags thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: sarba pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ ka liṅga u tri pa shaṃ dzaḥ oṃ ku ru kul+le sarba pa shaṃ dzaḥ oṃ ku ru mā ra tā re dz+nyā na pa shaṃ dzaḥ oṃ ga ma ha he sha thu ya pa shaṃ dzaḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ mo ha ya pra mo dzaḥ de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ sa ma ya: ḍāk+ki nī de ra ba la spra mo thun spe spa thun ra ti thun gu ra ma thun na lo ma te thun kirti thun ṭa thun sarba pa shaṃ ma ma bdag sgrub pa pos snang srid kyi zas nor longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'dod rgu snyan grags stobs dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad dbang du bsdus la char bzhin du 'bebs par gyur cig: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na gu h+ya pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

de yi phyi rim sho pha phreng ba bris: gtor ma'i gshog zur g.yon du 'dzugs par bya: de nas rab tu gnas pa'i sngags phreng bstan: thog mar rdzas snag gang rung la: oṃ dha ra ti sa ma ya swā hā: de nas 'khor lo sngags 'dis rab tu gnas: oṃ sarba ma hā bha la mu tra tsakra su pra tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: gtor mar gzug la rtsa sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab: oṃ ma hā shwa ri ta ma la muṃ shrī sarba thun: de nas 'khor lo gzhung gi rdzas dag ni: gi waṃ li khri cu gang ga pur dang : dzā ti sug smel li shi tig ta dang : tsan+dan dkar dmar gu gul snying zho sha: dbang lag pha bang long bu rgya mtshal dang : khab len rdo dang mu tig rin chen dang : gser dngul zangs sogs nor bu mang po'i rdzas: slob dpon yab yum byang sems gzhi byas te: 'khor lor byugs dang gtor ma dag la bsre: de ni rdzas dang gzhung gi lag len no: sa ma ya: khyad par 'di la byed lugs gnyis 'dod de: nor sgrub byas na thod pa'i nang du bzhag: las sgrub ltar na gtor ma'i rtse ru 'dzugs: dbang sdud ltar na mchan khung g.yon du 'chang : stobs bskyed ltar na rgyal mtshan tog tu 'dzugs: khyad par srung ba ltar du sbyor ba'i tshe: sku 'khor yab yin bla 'khor sras su 'dod: dbang sdud yum yin de bzhin rim par sprad: yang na bla 'khor dbang sdud kha sbyor na: sku 'khor spyi mthun ltar du sprad kyang rung : lus la 'chang na za 'og dmar pos thum: steng du rin chen sna lnga'i rigs kyang brgyan: bud med rnams kyis mi reg 'chang bar bya: de ni zur bkod yig chung bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: da ni las tshogs phran bu gdams pa bstan: thog mar bsod nams longs spyod sdud pa las: 'gro ba'i snang ba dbang du 'du ba'i phyir: za yig longs spyod char 'bebs gdams pa bstan: 'di dag 'gro ba gang gis reg gyur na: gdung shugs rtsol med skye zhing dbang du 'dus: de yi gdams pa yig rgod sa ma ya:

hakalararadang yahaza//ཿ 'di gong gi rdzas su sbyar nas su: mjug nas dril te sbyin pas longs spyod 'du: gnyis pa pho mo dbang sdud za yig ni: tamaralahabasag: gsum pa nor 'gugs bgyis pa'i za yig ni: btanyanalab: bzhi pa khye'u dbang sdud za yig ni: kha'angabasag: lnga pa 'byung ba dbang sdud za yig ni: karachanyapar+pa/: drug pa khams bskyed g.yo byed za yig ni: khamakayangabasag: bdun pa bud med srid 'phel za yig ni: hadahahirbagyaḥ brgyad pa rnam pa gzhon byed za yig ni: sagasamaganagayashan: dgu pa rtsa rlung bskyed pa'i za yig ni: tsaralashakayangacagag: bcu pa shes rab blo 'phel za yig ni: khalarabahalagataya: bcu gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i za yig ni: sadagasatakaṭ+ṭa ṇa/: bcu gnyis myong grol man ngag za yig ni: bsalahirgya: bcu gsum pa ḍāk+ki dbang sdud za yig ni: ṭakagangabangangashangaha: de rnams thams cad mjug nas yar la dril: gong gi sman dang lhan cig sbyar nas su: dbang sdud rnams ni gzhan la sbyin par bya: blo 'phel la sogs rang nyid za bar bya: sa ma ya: da ni bsgrub par 'jug pa'i rim pa ni: yar tshes dge ba'i bkra shis dus nyid du: gong gzhi mchod tshogs legs par bshams nas su: sngon 'gro tshogs dang las kyi kha skong ni: pad+ma rgyal po'i nang nas len par bya: dngos gzhi bsgrub pa'i dal du 'jug par bya nas: ma bcos gnyug ma'i ting 'dzin ngang rgyun gyis: bzo med snang sgros tsam du 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: rat+na bh+rūm̐ gyur 'od zer gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad nyi rin chen khri 'phang du: hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i dbang sdud mi g.yo mgon: nor bdag dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: thung la sbom zhing gsus khyim rab tu 'khyil: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan ral pa nor bus brgyan: snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub 'khrol: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nor skyug pho mo brdzis:

pang du 'khyud pa'i ku ru kul+le ma: dmar mo mdzes ldan g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor ma: g.yas pas bum pa g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan bde stong brkyang bskum 'khril: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rat+na'i dbus su gsal: hūm̐: yab yum mdun du nor lha tshogs kyi bdag: glang po'i gdong can gser mdog phyag gnyis pa: rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang du ma spras: phyag g.yas thabs kyi dbang sdud chos can 'dzin: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i shes rab pad+ma bsnams: phyed skyil zhabs g.yon nor skyug ne'u le 'dzin: pang du 'khyud pa'i khyab 'jug mgrin bzang ma: sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor bus brgyan: g.yas g.yon sgra snyan 'gugs pa'i pi waṃ bsnams: zung 'jug 'khyud sbyor zhabs gnyis sked nas 'khyud: gzhan snang 'gro ba dbang sdud tshur du gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i nor skyong tshogs: sgyu ma rol pa'i cho 'phrul ji lta bzhin: dmigs med snang gzugs tsam du wal gyis gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dang po spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dzam bha la: yab yum pho nya dang bcas gshegs su gsol: mthun 'grub yid 'ong rin chen khri la bzhugs: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: dkar gsum zag med bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: sman mchog la sogs dza gad rgyas pa'i phud: bha ling tshogs gtor ga ṇa rdzas kyi bcud: mthun spyod yid la rgyal ba'i sbrags ma kun: dpal ldan dzam lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i tshogs: rtsol med lhug pa rgyun gyi sbyin nas kyang : skye 'gro snang srid dbang du sdud pa dang : mchog thun 'dod don 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rin chen las grub 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang : sna tshogs yid kyi 'dod 'jo rin chen steng : dpal ldan nor gyi dbang phyug dzam+bha la: kai la'i mdangs ldan lcags kyu ne'u le 'dzin: rat+na'i rgyan ldan brkyang bskum 'gying bag can: longs spyod bdag po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: shes rab gzhon nu chags pa'i yid 'phrog ma: yum chen kul+le pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: bde ba'i lang tsho rab rgyas nor bus brgyan: zung 'jug phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor sgyur byed ma: 'gro ba'i bsod nams dbang du sdud la bstod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen po ma hā dhe wa'i bu: tshogs kyi bdag po khyab 'jug sna ring gdong : gtso las 'khyud cing mdangs ldan nor bus brgyan: dbang sdud phyag mtshan u ma pang du 'khyud: skye 'gro yid 'gul longs spyod bdag gi che: sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa: lha chen tshogs bdag khyed la bdag bstod do: de nas 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' ltar khyab pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo nas: sgyu ma'i gar gyis cho rol dgyes mdzad pa: longs spyod bdag po skye dgu'i dbang sdud che: nor bdag mgon po pho nya lha chen bcas: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam rgyud bskul lo: lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba dbang du sdud: sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad phyir: deng sang 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: 'dod don dpal 'byor thugs dam deng stsol cig: dang po bsnyen pa'i sngags ni: oṃ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i sngags ni: oṃ pad+ma puṇ+yai rā ga pra mo ti ku mā ra sarba sid+dhi thun dzaḥ gsum pa las sbyor sngags ni:

oṃ pad+ma tsar+ya rā ga h+ya sha mu ṭa dhe wi ma hā gha na pa ti ku ru kul+le sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun sarba sid+dhi: zhes pas sngags phreng rim pa bzhin bsnyen pa sgrub sngags khri 'bum ste: las sbyor gang 'os skabs dang bstun: khyad par 'di nyid sgrub pa'i tshe: rtags tshad rmi lam bstan pa ni: bu mo rgyan bzang yid 'phrog rigs: skyes pa gos bzang gyon sogs kyis: zas dkar longs spyod sbyin pa dang : shing 'bras bcud rtsi bkram pa dang : skyid mo'i tshal du sleb pa dang : me tog sna tshogs 'thu ba dang : rin chen du ma rnyed dang brgyan: gos dkar gyon dang khrus bstsal bar: gzhan yang gos rigs gsar pa gyon: khang khyim gsar par sleb pa dang : mtho ba'i ri la gyen du 'dzeg: rol mo dga' spro glu gar rtse: chas bzang gang rigs rnyed pa sogs: dngos grub thob pa'i brda rtags yin: de min phar la shor rigs dag: nam du byung na bsgrub pa bskyar: dngos grub thob pa'i brda byung na: dbang bzhi blangs shing smon lam sbyar: sa ma ya: man ngag zab pa'i mthar thug las: dbang sdud 'khor lo'i gdams pa ni: ma hā dhe wa'i khyad chos la: 'gugs pa'i man ngag zab khyad can: skye 'gro pho mo ma lus kun: 'chang ba rtsal gyis mdangs 'phrog pa'i: stobs can rdo rje'i lcags kyu bstan: de yang dbye gsal byed lugs te: dang po shes rab mo bzang la: gser dngul la sogs rin chen sbyar: bskol btul bgyis pa'i zhun ma la: rdo rje chos can gzugs su bcos: tshad kyang tshon gsum longs par bya: de nas rdzas rim bstan pa ni: khye'u pho mo byang sems dang : gla rtsi rgya mtshal cu gang dang : bya pho ra lug bong bu yi: ma nyams 'bras dang chu rgyun bcas: zhib btags sbyar ba'i khu ba sogs: sngags dang yig 'bru'i steng du byug: sa ma ya: de nas sngags rim bstan pa ni: zhes pas brda yig sum cu 'di: thog mar nang du dril bar bya: de yi phyi rol sngags 'di bris:

oṃ ma hā de wa khu ta bha la sarba mo ha rā ga ma ṇi bha dra kau rī ma u ma dhe wa ru ta sa twa ti ka li ma ti pra mo du na puṇ+ye ma tsar+ya la nu ta ra sa ma ya pa shaṃ thun thun dza dza sa ma ya du ha ra ni thun thun 'dus 'dus: skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du sdud sdud srid pa'i dkyil 'khor dung sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mi li li ya breng dza dza pra du ra dza dza mi snying 'gul 'gul sems rtsa myog myog mi sems dkrugs dkrugs bla yid dung dung 'jig rten srid pa pho mo dbang du sdud la bla yig srid pa ti ri dza dzaḥ mu shu ya zas nor thams cad dbang du sdus sdus bha ri bha ri ta ma ta ma ya snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad yid 'gul la zas nor thun thun ma ma yar 'dus 'dus swā hā: zhes pa'i sngags rnams phreng bu bgyis nas su: shog kha de'i nang du legs par bcug: sngags 'di sum brtsegs lta bur sgo yang bkag: srog shing sngags 'di tshad med dag tu bris 'di la sngags ring gong las dril bar bya: de nas dar tshon sna lnga'i rgya chings rgyan: rab tu gnas pa'i sngags 'di brgya bgrangs nas: 'bru la sngags nas byin gyis brlab par bya: oṃ a liṅga she pha tri ra pad+ma u ta pra mo te dzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes pas byin rlabs bgyis nas thod gang ngam: gar bde mchod pa gzhi'i kha ru bzhag: rgyun du sngags 'di bzla zhing byin brlab: oṃ ko ri phe sha ka li ma ma thun dza dzaḥ //////////zhes pa'i sngags rnams yang yang bskyar: rgyun du lus la 'chang ba'am: sgrom bu'i dkyil du sba bar bya: gsang ba kun gyi yang bcud de: snod min rnams la mi ston 'tshal: 'di nyid 'chang ba'i skal ldan la: 'gro ba lha 'dre mi gsum rnams: sha rul sbrang bu btibs pa bzhin: dbang med bdag tu 'du bar 'gyur: longs spyod phywa dang g.yang rnams kun: mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor bar 'gyur: de bas gdams pa 'di nyid zab: lha chen las tshogs sa ma ya:

gzhan yang tshogs kyi bdag po las: lag bsgul zas 'gugs gdams pa ni: tsha ba gsum gyi sro sman dang : cong zhi shing mngar sbyar ba yi: ril bu sran ma tsam du dril: kha dog dmar po dag tu 'dod: lug pho mgo dmar rlig sgrom blug: bcu gsum lo ma'i kha sgrog sbyar: pha bong long bu gcig kyang bcug: rgyun du sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab: dus la bab tshe sbyin par bya: de nas longs spyod char ltar 'bebs: oṃ tri 'u tri 'u tri du tri du 'ur 'ur rgyug rgyug mi yi snying du rgyugs mi snying sgul bla yid khug: zas nor thams cad sdud sdud thun thun dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags 'di'i ril bu dag: phyi rol gang gis myong gyur kyang : dbang du 'du bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: gzhan yang tshogs kyi bdag po las: sho dang rgyan las rgyal 'dod na: dngul dkar me long rma bya'i mdongs: sin+dhu ra bcas tshags su bcug: sngags 'di khri yi byin gyis brlab: oṃ a ri ma ṇi rat+na pha la dhi: zhes pas byin gyis brlab nas su: sgro mdongs spyi bo'i gtsug tu brgyan: me long brang gi steng du 'dogs: sin+dhu ra ni dpral bar byug: de nas sho rgyan rgyal ba dang : khe tshong bdag kyang rgyal bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: de yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams: lam du lhong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis: dbang bzhi dngos grub blang ba ni: sgrub rten rdzas kun thogs nas su: gnas lngar dbang bskur 'di ltar bya: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes dbyings nyid las: lhun grub sgyu mar bzhengs pa'i sku: nor bdag chen po longs spyod rje: dbang sdud mgon po 'khor bcas rnams: sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: phywa g.yang longs spyod char ltar phob: pha rol 'gro ba dbang du sdud: dpal dang snyan grags deng 'dir stsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma dha ra bai shra ma na rā ga pra ma ku ru kul+le: pra ti dza sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas 'od zhu bdag la bstim:

dngos grub sna tshogs thob par bsam: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: pad+ma rgyal po'i cha lag nyid: longs spyod nor sgrub chos skor bzhag: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang ni: skal ldan las 'phro can dang sprod: nor skyong klu mos rgya 'di srungs: g.yu 'od mthing kha'i dbus su gtad: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i ming can gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje bdud 'dul rol pa rtsal gyis glang lor sbas yul dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing gser mo bya 'phyang zhes pa chu stag lor sbas yul gling du shog ser las bsgyur ro// //

pha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: gnod sbyin nag po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so: rje btsun pad+ma nor bdag sku la 'dud: de yang gnod sbyin nag po nor bdag sgrub pa ni: bhan+dha'i snod du rin chen phye ma la: chos can mtho gang ba la: pad+ma 'dab bzhi bskang phreng ril bu bzhis bskor: dar dmar nag gyi gdugs phub: mdun du pañtsa'i mchod pa bsham: bdag mdun bskyed rim lung gcig nas drangs: hrags bsdus su rtsa tho yi bsgrub pa ni: oṃ: bh+rūm̐ las rang byung gzhal yas khang : āḥ skye med ngang las lhun gyis grub: hūm̐: bskyed par byed pa'i srog tu trām̐: ngo bo lugs su gyur pa las: gnod sbyin dbang phyug ma hā dhe: smug nag rin chen rgyan gyis spras: g.yas pas gug rtse thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'dzed kha gyen la phyogs: dar mtshon rgyan ldan phyed skyil bzhugs: rang bzhin bde chen rol pas bsrub: bsgoms pas bsod nams longs spyod 'tshub: spros pas zag med mchod pa 'bul: bsdus pas skye 'gro dbang du sdus: gnas pas longs spyod char ltar phob: lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba khug: tshangs dbang bdag gi 'gro ba kun: mthong thos las su 'khor bar shog: oṃ bhe yu ṣe dzaḥ ta ra dzaḥ ma ghaṃ dzaḥ gu laṃ gu laṃ dzaḥ ma ma dung dung thun thunaḥ pra mo thun pra mo thun: mi sems dkrugs sems rtsa myog: ka dza dung dung lha 'dre mi gsum gyi longs spyod snang ba dbang du sdud sdud thun thun u tsa ta ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas bsnyen pa rgyun du bya zhing seng ldeng gi sho pha la sngags bzlas pa: lus la 'chang bas snang ba srid pa'i rgyu dngos gang rigs 'du bar 'gyur ro: spro bsdu mchod pa spyi dang mthun: gdams ngag gong khug ma bya'o: phywa bskul gnod sbyin nag po them med shin tu zab: las sbyor sgrub pa'i sngags pha rol dbang sdud ni: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa na ga ni pha la ni sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nṛ baṃ dza sid+dhi ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun sid+dhi dzaḥ gang 'dod ming bcas thun dza zhes: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rig 'dzin lo ha badz+ra gyi gter ma'o/ 'di la rang re'i sa khul yul lugs pa tshos dzam nag ces brjod pa ni gzugs mthun tsam la brten nas brjod par chu nag lam 'gros su song bar snang la/ yin ni dbang phyug nag po yin te gnod sbyin dbang phyug ma hā dhe zhes dngos su gsal ba'i phyir dang 'di ga'i lo rgyus kyang gu ru nyid dga' ba tshal du bzhugs skabs lha chen ma hā dhai ba dbang du bsdus nas dam la bzhag pa'i ma hā dhe ba'i dbang sdud rlung zhags sogs gdams pa rnams kyang phul ba'i lo rgyus dang mthun no/ phyag mtshan ni/ g.yas pas mjug rtse thugs kar 'dzin: zhes pa 'di brda gsar rnying mngon brjod gang du'ang mjug rtse zhes rnga ma'i rtse mo las gzhan mi snang la des na lha la rnga ma yod pa'i lo rgyus mi 'dug la/ mkhas pa 'gas mdzub rtse yin 'ong zer yang des na thugs kar 'dzin rgyu yang mi 'thad pas gug rtse yin par kho bo'i thag bcad do*/ gug rtse ni brda rnying la lcags kyu'i don du snang ba'i dbang phyug phal che ba'i phyag mtshan kyang lcags kyu snang bas 'thad do/ yang*/ g.yon pas 'dzed kha gyen la phyogs: zhes pa'i 'dzed kha'am 'dzed zhal zhes bzed snod kyi brda rnying du 'dug pas thod phor min nam snyam mo/ zhes pa'ang gu h+yas so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ba) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: drag po kā la yak+sha'i sgos sgrub bzhugs pa'i dbu'i gzigs phyogs lags so: dregs pa 'dul byed thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: bla ma'i nor sgrub yang snying las: phywa g.yang dpal la spyod pa'i tshe: he ru ka yi ting 'dzin ni: 'tsham rngam drag po'i bskyed rim bstan: de yang don gsum lung gnyis las: phyi ltar spros pa'i mchod pa dang : nang ltar spros med mchod pa dang :

gnyis med zung du 'jug pa dang gsum: drang don lung las spros pa gtso: nges don lung las spros med gtso: 'on kyang thabs dang shes rab phyir: gcig la gcig brten rten 'brel bzhin: rdzas kyis bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bskyed rim lha sku'i pho brang gdab: rdzogs rim de ni ting nge 'dzin: spro bsdu sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur nas: rgyu dang rkyen gyis las byed do: sa ma ya: de yang drag po sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam gtsang gang zhig gis: bkram pa'i mchod pa spyi mthun la: zur bkod drag po'i gtor mchod ni: lcags zangs sam ni bhan+dha ru: dpal gtor zlum po'i dbyibs can las: logs gsum chos 'byung bdud rtsi'i lam: pad 'dab bzhi yis legs par brgyan: rtse mor drag po'i rgyan khra btsugs: thun gtor la sogs mdun du bsham: gu gul yungs thun rdo phye thun: bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod rdzas kyang bsags: gzhan rnams las tshogs gang 'jug ltar: de la der ston shes par bya: sa ma ya: de nas bgegs gtor bshams la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi? rig sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi? khyad par che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: sku 'jam dpal: gsung rta mgrin: thugs phyag na rdo rje: yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga: sprul pa yak+sha me dbal: stobs ldan sdig pa nag po: drag po rigs bzhi: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu: bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dang bcas pa: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa: bka' srung bdud btsan klu gsum: gter srung nā ga rak+sha la sogs srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi bka' bden pas: bdag cag dpon slob mi nor bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po log par 'dren pa'i bdud dang dam sri khyad par che sri chung sri rgas sri gzhon sri dar sri dur sri phung sri 'gong po bse rag dbul sri pho gdon gre bo:

mo gdon 'dre mo za 'dre shi gshed la sogs tshe dang bsod nams la bar du gcod pa'i bdud: lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rigs byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad la sogs pa: gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad yas gzugs rang rtags 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis bkug: de nas glud bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: dpal chen khro rgyal bka' la nyon: yang yang snying po'i don la soms: khyod rnams las ngan 'byung po'i rigs: tshe rabs lan chags bu lon la: 'dod yon glud dang changs bu dang : mar me ting lo sha dum bcas: yid mthun dpag med spel nas bsngo: srog bcad tshe thung lan chags 'jal: rdung rdeg nad mang lan chags 'jal: rku 'phrog nor dbul lan chags 'jal: sgro skur mi kha'i lan chags 'jal: skye ba snga rol da bar du: phyi mor 'byung 'gyur la sogs pa: mi mthun bgegs kyi tshogs rnams la: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i glud gtor bsngo: bsngos pa bzhin du tshims gyur cig: re ba'i yas kha khengs gyur cig: bu lon sha 'khon dag gyur cig: deng nas bsngos bzhin tshims gyur nas: so sor rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste 'gal zhing 'tshe gyur na: nga nyid khrag 'thung thod phreng rtsal: srid gsum 'di yi gnod sbyin che: drag po chen po'i skur bzhengs nas: bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: bka' la mi gnas sdig can rnams: mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru khos: lus ni dum bu stong du thongs: yid rten gnas sa med par gyis: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs bgegs bskrad thun gtor: gu gul gyi dud pa btang : yas glud rnams gom pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'i mtshams su dor:

phyi mig mi lta nang du log: de nas mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen dpa' bo'i sku: thugs las spros pa'i khro bo ni: yak+ṣa me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs: bya khyung dmag tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: steng 'og khyab pa rdo rje'i gur: drwa mig gnam lcags sdig pa 'phro: mtshon cha'i gur khang so 'thab 'khrigs: me dpung tshwa tshwa glog ltar mched: rlung lnga spu gri 'khor los gtams: rang bzhin mched pa'i tsakra yis: bdud dang dam sri 'byung po rnams: bgrod 'gyu med par mtshams chod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas nang gi lha dang gzhal yas kyi mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid che btsan drag po che: rang bzhin dbyings las spros pa'i lha: mtshams gcod khro bo mngon spyod can: sku la bar du gcod pa rnams: ya mān+ta kas mtshams chod cig: oṃ ya mān+ta ka gnod byed thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsung la bar du gcod pa rnams: h+ya ghṛ was mtshams chod cig: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa gnod byed thams cad bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ thugs la bar du gcod pa rnams: badz+ra pā ṇis mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi gnod byed thams cad ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ yon tan bar du gcod pa rnams: badz+ra yo gis mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ṇ-i gnod byed thams cad da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ phrin las bar du gcod pa rnams: yak+sha kā las mtshams chod cig: oṃ yak+sha kā la gnod byed thams cad pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: khro bo badz+ra he ru kaḥ rdo rje drag pos mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: khro bo rat+na he ru kaḥ rat+na drag pos mtshams chod cig: oṃ rat+na kro ta tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: khro bo pad+ma he ru kaḥ pad+ma drag pos mtshams chod cig: oṃ pad+ma kro ta tsakra tsakra ye swā hā:

hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: khro bo karma he ru kaḥ karma drag pos mtshams chod cig: oṃ karma kro ta tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas mtshams gcod pa: sku las spros pa'i khro mo ni: badz+ra kro tis mtshams chod cig: oṃ kā ya kro ti tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas mtshams gcod pa: yon tan spros pa'i khro mo ste: rat+na kro tis mtshams chod cig: oṃ gu ṇa kro ti tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: nub byang mtshams nas mtshams gcod pa: gsung las spros pa'i khro mo ste: pad+ma kro tis mtshams chod cig: oṃ pad+ma wāk+ka kro ti tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas mtshams gcod pa: phrin las spros pa'i khro mo ste: karma kro tis mtshams chod cig: oṃ karma gu h+ya kro ti tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: steng gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: ye shes sprul pa'i ga ru ṭaḥ bya khyung rgyal pos mtshams chod cig: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'og gi phyogs nas mtshams gcod pa: pho nya rngam byed zhe sdang can: gnam lcags sdig pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ lo hi biṣatsha kha tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: hūm̐: bgegs kyi sbyor ba mtshams bcad nas: gnam lcags ur mo'i gzhal yas khang : mi shigs rdo rje'i gur du bsgom: oṃ badz+ra tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: zhes pas bskal pa'i klong yang bgrod 'gyu med pa'i gur du bsgom: mtshams gcod kyi gur khang 'di nyid dgos ched: nor sgrub skabs dang : sgab 'dre mnan pa dang : sri'u gso ba sogs gur khang dgos rigs thams cad la sbyar ba'i cha lag ste: kun la 'gres so: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang : oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs: stong pa'i ngang las mdun du rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du ā las byung ba'i thod pa bum ril yangs shing rgya che ba: srid pa'i khyon dang mnyam pa de yi nang du sha lnga rdzas lnga dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i phyi nang mchod pa spyan gzigs zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi bkod pa dang mtshungs shing thogs pa med pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas mchog ster ba bla na med par gyur:

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hri'aḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis sbyang : de nas ma bcos snang srid skye med kyi ngang nas dpal che mchog he ru ka'i ting 'dzin la 'jug pa ni: gdod nas rang byung gi gzhal yas khang : rang shar gyi yi dam: 'byung 'jug gi gsal gdab bgyis pa la: thog mar rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs pas: oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: bi shwa bi shud+dhe: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: hūm̐ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hrī ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas rten bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid bdag med de bzhin las: e mthing klong nas 'byung lnga brtsegs: thabs shes rnam par snyoms pa las: skye med rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang : rnam pa drag po'i pho brang ni: ma 'gags rgyan bkod so sor gsal: de dbus pad+ma zla nyi dang : ti ra dam sri bsnol ba'i steng : mthing smug hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du las: dpal chen rdo rje dpa' bo'i sku: smug nag yak+sha kā la che: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i chas: spyan bgrad am gtsigs smin ma 'bar: thod skam skra chings dar dmar brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri bsnams: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bu bsgril: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bzhugs: go cha'i lha rnams hūm̐ du gsal: me dpung mched pa'i klong du bsgom: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul gyi dbus:

thod mkhar dgung du bsnyegs pa'i khyon gyi rtser: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: snang srid dbang sgyur smug nag srin po'i zhal: ma rungs 'dul phyir gnod sbyin khros pa'i sku: badz+ra kā la yak+sha gshegs su gsol: rdo rje srin po drag po thod phreng rtsal: ma rungs 'dul phyir che btsan skur bzhengs shig: snang srid lha 'dre 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 'gong po dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: phung sri 'dre rgod 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dbul sri rmangs 'dre 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dmag 'khrug lo nyes zhi phyir gshegs su gsol: mi nad phyugs nad zhi phyir gshegs su gsol: mthu rtsal gzi byin bskyed phyir gshegs su gsol: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: e mthing dbus su bskyed nas brten pa'i phyir: snang srid lha srin bsnol nas spungs pa'i khrir: thabs shes zung ltar pad nyi ro yi gdan: smug nag ya 'dor gyad kyis bzhugs su gsol: mi 'da' chos kyi dbyings nas bskul ba'i lha: rnam dag skye med rdo rje'i hūm̐ sgra can: 'gogs med nus pa'i rtsal bcu'i phrin las kyis: ma rungs bdud sde phyogs rnams 'gems mdzad pa: mngon spyod chen po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: che btsan khro bo smug nag gtum zhal can: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: dgyes par bya phyir bskyed nas 'bul ba ni: stong gsum khams gang 'jig rten gzhan dag tu: ji srid 'byung dang de las spros pa yi: snod kyis bsdus pa'i bhan+dha lcang lo ru: ri ltar spungs pa'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di:

khro rgyal yak+sha kā la'i zhal du 'bul: bdud dang dam sri 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: ru tra ma rungs gang zhig bsgral ba yi: bum ril nang du sman raka phud sna dang : sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i bha ling+ta: dmar chen la sogs phreng ba'i mchod pa 'di: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i zhal du 'bul: dbul sri 'gong po 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta nas bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: e las grub pa'i gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : snang srid kun gyis lta bar m-i nus shing : khro chu'i byad bzhin tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bdud srin 'dul ba'i khri steng du: lhag pa'i lha mchog smug nag gtum chen zhal: spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'gyu ba yis: khro bo khro mo zil gyis gnon par byed: mche ba zur gsum ma mchu mnan pa yis: lha srin sde brgyad bsngangs shing 'dar bar byed: shangs nas rlung g.yo dbu skra bsigs pa yis: gzugs med khams rnams yom zhing 'gul bar byed: thod skam brgyan zhing dar dmar cod pan gyis: rigs lnga'i sa bon dbyings su rdzogs par byed: snyan la drag po'i wang long brgyan pa yis: ma sring mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du bar byed: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri phyar ba yis: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod par byed: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bur bsgril ba yis: 'gong po dam sri dam nyams 'dul bar byed: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: snang srid kun gyi gdug pa 'joms par byed: thod rlon ga sha sbrul lnga'i chings rgyan gyis: klu srin 'byung po snying rtsa 'dar bar byed: rus pa'i rgyan dang thig le tshom bu yis: gzugs khams 'dod khams dbyings su sgrol bar byed: zhabs gnyis dam sri pho mo brdzis pa yis: ma rungs 'byung po'i sde tshogs thar bar byed:

me dpung klong bzhugs smug nag dpa' bo'i sku: kā la yak+sha srin po khros 'dra'i zhal: rdo rje drag po gar dgu'i he ru kaḥ dpal chen g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha mchog khyed la bstod cing bskul ba ni: snang srid lha srin 'dul ba'i dus la bab: 'gong po dbul sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gson 'dre pho mo 'dul ba'i dus la bab: che sri chung sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgas sri dar sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: god sri bse rag 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rmangs 'dre rmugs 'dre 'dul ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mi mthun bar chad zhi ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo che btsan mthu ma chung : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rtsa sngags ni: oṃ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hrī ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags me yi gur khang ni: oṃ ma ma ma hā bha la a pa rā tsit+ta a dzi te shrī dz+wa la raṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: zhes rtsa sngags 'bum tsho las sngags gang dgos sri'u la sogs gso ba dang : khyad par las kyi mtha' gang rung 'jug pa'i skabs dang bstun: 'di nyid nor sgrub kyi gzhung gang rung 'jug kyang dgos te: mtshan yang khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po la sogs bgegs mthar byed stobs po che yak+sha kā la zhes dbang drag rdo rje srin po mngon spyod du chas pa rgya gar gyi dur khrod dga' ba tshal du bzhengs pa'o: 'di'i 'grub rtags ni spyi lung kun dang mthun: skabs su bab pa'i tshe thun gtor 'bul ba ni: thun gtor la dgra bgegs 'gugs shing : hūm̐: kā la yak+sha skur bzhengs shig: mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs dang : phung sri 'gong po 'dre rgod sogs: tshe dang bsod nams la gnod pa'i: bdud dang dam sri'i tshogs rnams kun: thun gyi gtor mar bstims nas kyang :

dpal chen khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol: oṃ i daṃ du bha ling+ta dgra bgegs dam sri rnams kyi dbang po rnam pa lnga la kha kha khā hi: zhes pa'i byad ma dam sri yid du bkod pa thams cad bzhes nas lhag med du tshar bcad par bsam: dkyil 'khor las phrin gang la 'jug kyang ma grol gyi bar: drag po'i srung 'khor dang ting 'dzin la gnas so: thun bsdu ba'i tshe srung 'khor gzhal yas lha sngags sa bon rang la bsdu: mi dmigs chos dbyings dgongs pa ā ru bzhag: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug las: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'jigs pa dang la: dmag 'khrug lo nyes sdang ba'i tshe: de dag 'dul ba'i gnyen po mchog: nga nyid kā la yak+sha yi: sgrub thabs gud du sbas pa bzhag: yang mthar 'di nyid 'byin pa'i tshe: bsgrub dang skur bzhengs sngags bzlas shing : srung ba yul du gnas gyur na: dbul phongs nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi: dngos grub thams cad dus gcig 'grub: de bas skal ldan las 'phro can: snying du chongs shig sa ma ya: rgya 'di klu yi rgyal pos srungs: gtsug na nor bu+-i atsha rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes dge bsnyen klu'i phrong nas gdan drangs shing dben tshal du bsgyur ba'o/ maṅga laṃ// //

ma) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen chen po sgrub pa'i gsol kha dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so: bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las: bka' yi gter srung gter gyi rgya gnyer ba: gnod sbyin gyi dad dpon chen po dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi tha tshig gter bdag gtsug na nor bu las me 'bar ba'am: gnod sbyin la thod dkar po zhes mtshan gsol pa ste: rigs lha nas chad pas yab gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa: yum klu mo dung skyong ma gnyis ri rab kyi byang phyogs su dbyar ra ba'i gnam gang du bshos pa las: dpyid tha chung gi bco lnga la g.yu yi drod pa skyes: gnam stong du rdol ba la: nya nag po dpral ba ru mdung yod pa: spyi bor sbrul mgo gsum la nor bus brgyan pa: lag pa gnyis yod pa zhig skyes pa: de byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi pho brang gi nang mdun du rol mtsho chen po yod pa'i nang du bor ba klu mo nor skyong ma'i pho brang steng du phog nor skyong ma'i khyo'am rnam par bgyis pa'i klu mo'i 'od zer phog pas sems kyi lus zhig nas mi'i rnam par gyur: de yi tshe sangs rgyas gzhon nu rnam par rol la chos zhus te sems bskyed pas: sems blo gros dge bar bkod: de'i 'og tu ma la ya: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po zhes dpa' bo rdo rje la bla med sngags kyi gdams pa zhus: dkyil 'khor gyi gral du bkod: gnod sbyin klu yi dge bsnyen nor bu 'od 'bar mtshan du gsol: bla med sngags kyi bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtad: yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nor bu 'od mtsho zhes mtshan gsol: zab lam snyan brgyud kyi grogs mor mnga' gsol: dge bsnyen yab yum gyi gsang bdag la nor bu rin chen rigs kyi maṇ+ḍal phul bas: khyod rtag tu 'dod don myos pas pre ta'i 'ching ba grol:

ming yang gnod sbyin rtag myos zhes bgyi'o: khyod kyi sprul pas 'dod don klu'i cha lugs 'chang rdo rje theg pa'i: gsang sngags kyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi bstan pa skyong zhing : gter rgya rin chen skyong bar 'gyur ro: zhes lung bstan no: de nas phyis 'byung gi skabs su klu'i dge bsnyen de nyid lho nub tu chags pas: mtsho 'o ma zhes pa ni 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i sdom tshig go: 'od ma'i mtsho 'khyil klu yi pho brang chen po'i mtsho bdag 'jog po dga' bo nor rgyas dung skyong zhes pa dang : rtag myos rnams tshig don mtshan nyid gcig pa'o: ci yin zhes na 'jog po dang 'jo ba zad mi shes pa: dga' bo ni sdug bsngal ye mi srid pas nor rgyas ni phyug po yang dag pa: dung skyong zhes pa ni sems can kun dung dung gi gdung ba ltar skyong ba grogs ltar brtse bas 'dzam gling du 'dod rgu char du 'bebs pa ston no: rtag myos zhes pa 'bad rtsol gyis sgrub dgos ye mi srid pa ste bde ba chen pos myos pa'o: pho brang ri'i tshes bco lnga la btab pas nya gang mal 'phel grib brjod du mi gtub pa sgra gcan rgyas pa'i dus yod: srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i ma ma nor bu me shel dang chu shel las grub pa dang : tshangs pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi rā hu las blangs pas mtsho bdag kha la rak+sha gzugs su bstan pa de: ye shes dang nyon mongs pa'i don no: klu la sa brgyad non zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan gling phran brgyad de sems bskyed kyi rgyur gyur ro: khyab 'jug rā hu las sa bcu non pa ni: 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las: rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon: rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang : tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon: don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don: zhes pas: brgyad la gnyis bsnan pas bcu ste 'go gong 'og gnyis: des na sa bcu po ni: gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la: dug gsum dag pas sku gsum rdzogs:

me long sor rtog chos kyi dbyings: sku gsung thugs gsum rdo rje gsum: gdan sar gnas pa rgyal po mchog: thabs shes gnyis bsnan bcu gsum mo: byang chub dbu ma bde chen zhing : de yi bka' ni skyong ba'i phyir: gza' klu rgyal po gsum du grags: rgyal po bam gyi cha 'dzin cing : klu yi sgo ma kha ru 'dzin: gza' yi ra sa mo ma 'dzin: de phyir srid pa rdo rje 'dzin: rgyal po thabs kyi rang bzhin la: klu ni shes rab rang bzhin te: gza' ni gnyis med ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin klong las 'di ltar khyab: rten 'brel de las bab pa ni: me pho sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu nyin las gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas klu'i pho brang nas sku 'khrungs: shing mo bya lo bya zla nyer lnga la ye shes mtsho rgyal sku 'khrungs: pho brang klu'i mtsho kha rgyas: mtsho bdag ma gros gzi chen zhes spyi gtsug nor bu me shel gzi brjid me ltar 'bar te klu'i rgyal po dgun gsum rgya mtsho dbus su bsam gtan la gnas: dgun chos thams cad thugs dam 'phel zhing snang ba dwangs pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin: dpyid gsum thugs dam gong 'phel gyis nyams tshung gyen du 'phags pas nor bu gzi byin drod 'phel sa la chu rlangs gtib: dbyar gsum tshangs pa'i gnas man chod bskor zhing lha'i bu klu'i tsha bo yin pas pho brang de ru spyan 'dren mchod pa 'bul bar rtsed 'jo rta nyams dga' dang bcas nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la dgyes pas bstod: de'i shugs las lha mo klu mo rgyan cha btags: spra sprel dang bya dang ri dwags rnams kyang shing kha ru gar bsgyur: ri dwags dang 'dab chags phal cher kyang : ri rtse mthon po nas bya ra byed: yul gyi mi rje dang : dge bshes rnams kyang skyo sangs 'gro ba'i skabs: mi rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes longs spyod 'phel klu'i dngos grub 'byung :

drang srong khyab 'jug gi nus pa'i rang skad 'byin: seṅge phul nas dpe dkar gyi dkor mdzod bkang ba'i mgo btsugs: skye 'gro rnams kyi gnyer ma 'dzin: srog chags phra mo yang bstan pa'i 'gyur skad sgrog: sems can phra mo yan chad nyams dga' ba'i las la spyod: klu g.yang dngos grub thams cad 'gugs kyang 'byung ba'i dus: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi snying rje'i glog 'khyug: thugs rjes sprin gtib: theg chen gyi 'brug ldir: byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs: mos gus kyi rgya mtsho mer: gsang sngags kyi skyed tshal rgyas: dngos grub kyi 'bras bu phyur: de skye 'gro thams cad kyi longs spyod pa'i gnas su gyur pas dus chen po'o: de nas klu'i dge bsnyen chen po 'di nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la chos kyi zhu ba bsam bgyid: dbyar gnas kyi gzhi blangs: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khrungs pa'i gnas tshang phul: in+d+ra bo dhi la nor bu'i sbyin bdag mdzad: bhi na sa la chang gi dngos grub gnang : man+da ra ba la 'chi med tshe chu phul: drang srong la sman rgyud bdud rtsi'i bum pa phul: ming zhang blon du grags: rje btsun chen po'i zhabs 'bring chad du sngon las chas: dur khrod brgyad du klu brgyad du sprul: slob dpon gyi grub rtags brgyad bskul: bal yul nyi ma khud la gnas: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud bskul mdzad: a su ra la klu gyong du sprul: hūm̐ ka ra'i phur gcig ma rgya gar nas len pa'i thugs dam bskul: gter bdag bswe yi lha mo mched bzhi klu mo bcud 'dzin bzhi yin rje yi grogs mo la phul: slob dpon gyis rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i gral du bkod: yang phur sngags kyi gdams pa gnang : gser mtsho zhag mtsho khrag mtsho dung mtsho bzhi la brtan ma'i snying gter sbas: yang chu mig byang chub ris su slob dpon la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul:

yang me gro gzi chen du sprul nas bod kyi lo bcud thams cad bkag: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su dbul phongs sel ba dang slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa'i ched du o rgyan nor lha dbyer med sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i thugs dam bskul: bsam yas kyi shing cha thams cad phul ba dang : rdzogs pa chen po'i mkha' lding rtsol med gshog pa bskyod cing bden gnyis kyi rwa bar gtsug rgyan nor bu ltar 'phags pa'i chos zhig zhu ba yong la slob dpon gyis thugs ga ru ṭa ye shes sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas: rgyal po don med kyi gtam smras dgos dgra lha mo bskul mjal go ba nas: skad bsgrags pas slob dpon gyi dgongs pa slod: zhus pa'i don med par bya ba'i rkyen sdum la rgyal po blon po gong skyes tshe chu ma 'byor ba sogs thams cad dbyen byas pa mkhyen: yang sdong po gser lag can du gnas skabs slob dpon la gser phul ba phyis 'byung gi bā su dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling dang lha mi 'jog po'i khri gdan la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag rnams su sbas pas: ma 'ongs skabs su gtsug lag 'di rnams la gser chab mang po sgron mkhan 'byung gsungs pa: ming yang klu rgyal drag po zla skyong du mtshan gsol: de'i skabs su pad zhwa khyung gshog mar bar nyi zla nor bus mtshan dgos pas zil gnon gyi cha lag go: pad zhwa rtse phod nor bu baiḍūr+ya rtse brgyad kyi tog mtshan pa de'i dus su phul lo: yang rje btsun chen po 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro la 'byon skabs ti sgro brag dkar mdun gyi chu tshan de me gro nas sman gyi chu tshan bhan+dha gang bcud len me tog phul ba la rje btsun gyis smon lam mdzad pa 'byung dus kyi nad kun la phan no: bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang thams cad grub rab gnas sbyor nas bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa mdzad pa'i tshe gser phu+ul ba kun klu rang la dngos grub sbyin pa'i bdag po yin pas bkra shis bya gsu+ungs nas chu chen mtsho dang gdengs ka lu ma rnams la gtor gser ldan gyi chu'o zhes so:

gzhan yang gser sa le sbram gyi rigs rnams dang klu'i nor bu rigs byed rnams phul gtsug lag khang dang ri sul lhag tu chu chen bco brgyad dang rol mtsho sogs lung las grags pa dang lung ma bstan pa'i gnas nges med rnams la gter sbas: gter rgya yang klu'i rgyal po la bcol bye brag o rgyan nor lha'i sgrub pa 'di nyid klu'i dge bsnyen yab yum dang klu mo nor bu mdzes byed la sogs la bcol: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i mthar thug pa'i tshe rong chen rnams dang sbas pa'i yul bzhi dben pa'i ljongs bzhi: bka' bab gter la longs spyod pa'i gnas lnga gangs ri gtan chags: mtsho mo gtan 'khyil rnams bdud rtsi klu'i chu mig zhes dngos grub 'byung ba'i mdzod yin pas sgrub gnas bya'o: sa ma ya: de yang gter bdag klu'i dge bsnyen sgrub par byed pa'i rim pa ni: gzhi dkar gtsang steng du 'bru tshom bkod: snod rin chen las grub kyi pad gzhong du: gtor ma nor bus mtshan pa'i zlum po 'khor rang 'dra bzhi mdun du klu bshos sngon po sbrul dkris can gtsos 'khor thams cad nor bus brgyan pa: mtheb skyu nyer gcig bcas: yang mdun du drag po'i lcags zangs gang rung gi snod du dpal gtor zur gsum pa sbrul mgo can sbrul gdengs gsum gyis mtshan pa dmar rgyan can: gtor mdun mig dang kha yis mtshan pa 'khor bcu bzhis bskor ba mtheb skyu de mtshungs bya: zor gtor yin na 'khor nyer gcig dang nyer brgyad bya: mtheb skyu yang rung : mdun du phud rgod sna tshogs bsham: bsang mchod gser skyems spyan gzigs dang bcas la: zhi ba la bdud rtsis bran: drag po la bha ling mchod: zhi ba la klu sman gyis mchod: drag po rbad pa'i skabs gtor ma btegs la rak+ta mchod: gzhan yang rol mo dbyangs sogs spyi 'gros ci rigs mos: thog mar pad+ma rgyal po'am mchod phreng ngam rtsa gsum gang rigs song ba'i rjes su:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gsum: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig pad+ma 'byung gnas dmar: thugs rje'i spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil: smug nag phod kha sngags chas rnam gsum gsol: dbu la zil gnon pad zhwa mthon mthing la: baiḍūr+ya dang nyi zla nor bus brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan+dha bsnams: de nang yid bzhin nor bu'i bcud kyis bkang : gru mor dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: rin chen sna tshogs sku la drwa ba bris: g.yer kha dang ni me long rgyan gyis spras: rgya lham gsol nas zhabs gnyis dor stabs bzhugs: pad+ma nyi zla nor bu'i khri 'phang mtho: phyi rol nor bu'i gzugs dang gur ras phub: nor bu'i tog dang drwa ba phyogs bzhir brgyangs: gsang ba mkha' 'gro sde bzhis cod pan 'dzin: g.yas su tshe la dbang ba'i sgeg mo dmar: g.yon du bde chen bskyed pa'i dpa' mo dkar: gnyis ka gzhon tshul mdzes rgyan rigs lnga spras: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa'i bhan+dha'i nang : dngos grub ster ba'i nor bu du mas bkang : sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i rnam par bsgom: hūm̐: yab yum mdun du klu yi pho brang ni: yid mtshar lta na sdug pa'i pho brang dbus: sa brgyad non pa'i tshul can sems pa'i gzugs: sku mdog sngon po spyi bor la thod nang : nor bu 'bar ba'i yid bzhin 'khor los brgyan: sbrul rigs lnga yi chings dang cod pan tshul: phyag gnyis nor bu 'bar ba'i gzhong pa thogs: dar ljang stod g.yogs dar dmar ang rag can: gnod sbyin gzugs can pus btsugs gus pa yis: tshur la mos pas mchod de 'bul bar bskyed: g.yas g.yon mdun sogs phyogs mtshams brgyad dag nas: klu yi dbang mo yid 'ong mdzes ldan ni: kha dog phyogs mthun spyi bor nor bus brgyan: sku smad sbrul du gnas pa'i rnam pa can: phyag na bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs dang : nor bu rig byed rna cha'i bye brag sogs:

yid mtshar lha klu mi yul ci srid pa: de srid thogs nas rje la 'bul bar bsgom: de yi phyi rol rgyal srid sna bdun dang : mkho ba'i 'dod rgu phun tshogs tshang bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: tshangs pa'i yul dang ri rab zom gyi shed: rol mtsho gling bcas rang rang gnas mchog nas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nub phyogs o rgyan zhing mchog nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum la: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: dkyil 'khor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dal: klu yi pho brang chen po ru: zad med gter gyi khang bzang du: dgyes pa bskyed de 'byung gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ hrīḥ 'od kyi 'gugs pa'i dza yig las: spros pa 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: klu yi gnas su phog pa las: thugs rje shugs kyis spyan drangs gyur: tshangs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: gtsang ma lha yi bshos pa'i bu: lha bu gzi brjid gshegs su gsol: chags pa mi yi bshos pa'i bu: bram ze klu dbang gshegs su gsol: bde ba klu yi bshos pa'i bu: la thod dkar po gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin dga' ba ldan pa'i bu: nor bu 'od 'bar gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin gling bzhir dbang sgyur ba: klu mo mched brgyad gshegs su gsol: dus bzhi 'gyu ba gnod sbyin mo: mtsho bdag klu yi dbang mo che: sprul pa dang bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ nā ga rā dza ma ṇi dha ra nā ga a dhiṣ+ṭha rasmi sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sku yi dbang bskur bum pa mkha': āḥ gsung gi dbang bskur sngags dbang bcud: hūm̐: thugs kyi dbang bskur chos dbang sems: hrīḥ de bzhin dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: sku gang dri ma dag pa yis:

lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las: gu ru yab yum dbur rgyan gyur: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ gu ru bhi dho dha ra dha ra hūm̐: de nas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: spyan la dgyes pa'i gzugs mdzes ma: snyan la dgyes pa'i sgra snyan ma: shangs la dgyes pa'i dri mchog ma: ljags la dgyes pa'i ro mchog ma: sku la dgyes pa'i reg bya ma: rje btsun pad+ma yab yum gyis: phyi yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: dri bzang byugs pa'i bcud ldan sman: longs spyod ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: dam tshig gtsang ma'i rak+ta bcud: dam rdzas gser skyems dza gad chang : phyag rgya drug bcas bde ba'i mchog: nang gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba oṇ+yo pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling+ta rak+ta byaṃ ta ya a si mu sa ṭa ye swā hā: hūm̐: yid 'ong 'chi med bcud kyis legs sbyar ba: gtsang ma'i phud dang dri bzang gtams pa'i ro: lnga ldan 'dod yon sna tshogs gser skyems dang : klu bshos dkar gsum phud dang shing 'bras 'bru: yid la mthun pa'i spyan gzigs la sogs pa: bkra shis rdzas rtags phun sum tshogs pa'i rten: klu yi rgyal po klu mo dbang mo bcas: dngos grub 'dod rgu sbyin la mchod rdzas 'bul: bzhes nas klu g.yang dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ dhe wa nā ga rā dza yak+ṣa aṇ+ḍa ma ṇi dha ra ya: oṃ nā ga dhe wi ma ṇi mu tra sarba ka na ma aṣ+ṭi ya: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta pañtsa pū dza bha ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra oṃ aḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag mkha' la nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: dri med gzi brjid dbang po'i phreng ba bzhin: phyogs bcu'i zhing nas mngon 'phags pad+ma 'byung : kun mkhyen 'khor lo'i khyab bdag bde ba'i bcud: g.yo ba rab rgyas gzugs kyi rab skyud pa: zla rgyas 'bum gyi mdangs la byi dor bzhin: gsang ye man+da ra dang mtsho rgyal yum:

bgrang yas zhing gi bkod pa gcig tu rgyas: snang srid dbang bsgyur zung 'jug 'od kyi sku: mtshan dpe'i bkod rdzogs bla ma yab yum la: mi phyed gdung bas btud de phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badz+ra gu ru a bhi bhu ya ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa mu ṭa sid+dhi hūm̐: klu yi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gnod sbyin pho brang yid 'ong rgya mtsho'i klong : 'dzam gling bye ba khrag khrig bcud du bsdus: rnam rgyal rin chen nor bu'i khang bzang dbus: lha klu mi yi 'dod rgu srid kyi mchog: ma hā dhe wa pho nyas bskul ba ltar: 'dod rgu dpal la bzhad pa'i gnas mchog tu: klu yi rje bo in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs: kai la sha ltar thod rgyan mdzes pa'i dbus: rin chen rat+na'i zur phud 'od rab 'byin: gdengs ka nā ga ra la'i cod pan brgyan: phyag gnyis 'dod 'byung ma ṇi aṣ+ḍi gzhong : legs par bkang nas swa na'i mdangs bzhin 'bar: lha rdzas mar gad mdangs ldan stod du g.yogs: bklubs pa'i smad g.yogs pad+ma rā ga'i chud: zhabs gnyis gus pa'i la sha pus btsugs tshul: gter bdag klu yi dbang mor bdag bstod do: hrīḥ srub skyed nor bu 'khyil ba'i rol mtsho'i gling : 'byung lnga'i zhag g.yo bcud kyis gtams pa'i dbus: dri med mdangs ldan khor yug 'od kyis khengs: smig sgyu bskyod pa'i ltad mo'i snang tshul bzhin: 'phyo zhing rlabs mi g.yo ba'i dkyil shed na: gter bdag chen po nā ga dha ra ni: mi mo mthing bzang lan tshar skyud pa'i nyams: rab dkar g.yo ba dwangs pa'i zla gzhon ltar: yid 'dzin klu yi dbang mo 'dod 'byung ma: chags pa g.yo ba'i skye 'gro'i bcud du 'dzin: bde bas rtag tu myos pa'i bum bzang ma: dga' ba 'khor lo phreng ba'i dwangs cha 'dren: khyab 'jug rlung gi dza zhur g.yas su thogs: zad med kun 'byung gzhong pa g.yon du bsnams: thabs kyi sgrub pas shes rab bskyed pa'i yum: rat+na'i phreng ba'i rgyan 'phyangs khra la la:

rang 'dra bdun kyang rin chen sna tshogs thogs: sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i dbang mo che: gter grogs lha mo brgyad la bdag bstod do: nor bu 'od mtsho yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i ljongs: rnal 'byor bdag gis bsgrub cing mchod lags nas: longs spyod sna tshogs char bzhin 'bebs pa dang : rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: klu yab sngags: oṃ ma hā de wa nā ga ra tsa dhe wi an+ḍi rat+na sarba sid+dhi dza dzaḥ klu mo nor skyong ma yi sngags ni: oṃ nā ga dha ra ma ṇi mu ṭa u ma dhe wi iṣ+ṭa pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun swā hā: gzungs sngags so sor tsit+ta mos bzhin rim par bgrang : klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed 'khor lo ni: thog mar lte ba'i gnas su sngags 'di bris: de yi mu khyud gu ru sku gsum sngags bris 'dod gsol kha sgyur dang ci mthun bsgyur: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: oṃ nā ga dha ra hūm̐: rtsibs mchan la oṃ bā su ku puṣ+ṭiṃ hūm̐: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: klu yab yum gyi sngags bris: 'dod gsol la: bdag sgrub pa po'am 'chang ba pos lha klu mi gsum longs spyod bsod nams dpal 'byor kha rje dbang thang zas nor longs spyod thams cad dbang du 'dus shing char bzhin du 'bebs par gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun sid+dhi dza dzaḥtsakra bh+rūm̐: de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ rgyal rigs la swā hā: oṃ rje rigs la swā hā: oṃ bram ze la swā hā: oṃ dga' bo la swā hā: oṃ 'jog po la swā hā: oṃ dung skyong la swā hā: oṃ pad+ma la swā hā: oṃ nor rgyas la swā hā: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ yaṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ raṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ khaṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ bh+rūm̐ ma'i nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ mu le k+ṣi nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ e ma la nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ lo ha se nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ nā ga dhe wi dza swā hā:

de yi phyi rol dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rab gnas sngags kyi sham bur bsgyur: rdzas klu sman sna tshogs dang : rdo khab len lcags phye bram ze bu mo'i rna cha rnyed na mu ku mu ti tra: g.yu byi ru gzi mig dgu mu men spos shel gser gyi 'khor lo dngul gyi rdo rje mtshal gyi pad+ma yang bzang ngo : dar zab sna tshogs bcas bris sam: bsnyung ba zung du 'chang : rtsa sngags khri bdun rab gnas bya: lus la 'changs na zhag bdun bar dmar gyi rigs dang mtshon cha spang : ban btsun dam nyams yugs mo dang : shan pa'i lag gis mi reg kyang : zangs kyi gwa'u'i nang du 'chang : gang zhig char 'bebs la sogs skabs: 'khor lo mthing shog ngos su ni: rin chen zhun ma'-i khu bas bris: sngags 'di khri yis rab gnas bya: dri bzang klu sman chu rgyun gyis: klu gtor zhib dang sbrags nas su: me long yi ge 'gying logs khrus: chu mig nang du 'phro bar bya: des ni lha srin 'khrug pa dang : char med than pa byung ba dang : klu yi nad las grol bar 'gyur: khyad par dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung : 'di dag khye'u pho mo yi: ma yi lus su gnas pa'i tshe: srung ba 'di nyid btags pa ni: rigs ldan gtsang mas longs spyod 'du: gang zhig btsas pa'i dus su ni: bu la klu mgon klu phyug dang : klu rgyal klu 'bum la sogs btags: bu mo klu mtsho klu skyed dbang : klu sgron klu mo bu khrid sogs: khye'u rang gzugs ming dang sbyar: sa ma ya: gang zhig shu thor 'brum pa dang : sur+ya bas ldag me dbal la: gzungs sngags sin+dhu ra dang cha la brdar ba'i phye ma la: sngags ni khri 'bum bzla ba dang : chu la sbyar nas byug par bya: rma kha nang du btang mi bya: gang phyir mo nad dag la phan: 'thung dang mkhar sked byug par bya: grum bu chu ser 'bam kyang phan: de bas gdams pa khyad par can: kun la ma spel sa ma ya: yang gcig bad kan skya smug la: tsha la cong zhi rgya tsha dang :

cu gang a ru ra dang bcas: mi rta khyi gsum rus pa dang : bya sha zan ri dwags g.yung dag gi: rus pa'i rigs tshang thams cad bsdus: bul tog shug bal gang rnyed nang : btsos nas snum bag med par bya: rus pa thams cad bsdus nas kyang : rdza ma gsar pa'i nang du ni: mtshams su bug pa yod pa bya: rus pa sol ba zung du bsre: sbub rus brgyab nas tshos par bsring : sol thal ming yang med par bya: rus pa dwangs ma zhib tu 'thag: cong zhi bsregs pa'i thal ba dang : rus thal gsum bcas mang bar bya: de la tshwa sna thams cad bsre: a ru gser gdog khu ba bsdus: tsan+dan cung zad khu ba dang : bzang drug phye ma bag tsam btab: de rnams phyogs gcig 'dam 'thag bya: khyi la wa ra khu ba yang : 'dam 'thag nang du bsre bar bya: sba sbrul nya rus mang na bzang : zhag lnga bar du 'dam 'thag bcad: mtha' ru ril bu sran ma tsam: sgril ba ril chags bgyis pa dang : pa ru nang du mi sang bya: sngags ni khri yis rab tu sngags: zhogs la gsum re bsten par bya: 'di nyid rlung mkhris bad kan dang : 'dus pa'i nad bcas 'gos nad grol: khyad par mdze la shin tu bzang : sbyar dug btsan dug dag kyang thub: nag po sum sgril nad byung ni: dpa' dkar bong nga hong len dang : gla rtsi shu dag ru ta bcas: glang chen myos pa'i rta la bskyon: sil bu bshig nas mnyam por 'thag: des ni nad las grol bar 'gyur: khyad par srin glang rigs dag la: kha sgyur dur byed thar nu dang : chu rtsa bcas pas 'og sgor thon: mkhris pa'i mig ser lhog nad 'joms: man ngag klu yi bdud rtsi'i bum: sa ma ya: de nas drag po ltar bsgrub pa ni: bha ling bran la: mtshams su gser skyems mchod: hūm̐: dbang drag pad+ma'i bka' nyan ni: gter bdag chen po mi bsrun pa: yab ni gnod sbyin ma hā dhe: yum ni klu mo dung skyong ma: de gnyis ri rab byang phyogs su: 'khrig cing sbyor bar gnas pa la: g.yu yi drod pa skyes pa'i nang :

gnod sbyin chen po nya nag gdong : pho brang 'od ldan mtsho la bor: dung skyong klu mo'i zer bskrun pas: sdug bsngal srid pa'i lus rgya grol: sangs rgyas gzhon nu rnam rol gyis: dam tshig blang nas dge bsnyen phog: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de nas ri bo ma la yar: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po yi: dkyil 'khor gral du bcug pa nas: nor bu 'od 'bar mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bla med sngags la 'jug pa'i phyir: zab lam gnyan gyi bka' gtad tshe: gsang ba yum la mtshan gsol ba: klu mo nor bu 'od mtsho ma: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ston pa shākya thub pa yis: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: nor bu phul nas dam chos bskul: gtsug na nor bu mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: o rgyan za hor gnas mchog tu: pad 'byung 'khrungs pa'i bla mtsho phul:
