klu rgyal 'jog po mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: thor cog dgu ldan pho brang du: chos rgyal in+d+ra bo dhi la: bu nor spyan gsum sbyin bdag mdzad: klu rgyal dga' bo mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: o rgyan rgyal khams byang phyogs su: rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i bhi na zar: bdud rtsi chang gi sbyin bdag mdzad: dung skyong ma ru mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: lha lcam man+da ra ba la: 'chi med tshang pa'i tshe chu phul: klu rgyal nor rgyas mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo la: drang srong nā ga an+ḍi la: man ngag bdud rtsi bum pa phul: klu rgyal rtag myos mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas mchog tu: pad 'byung spyod pa gshegs pa'i tshe: so so klu yi gzugs bstan nas: klu chen brgyad du mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bal yul nyi ma khud kyi gnas: slob dpon pad+ma byon pa'i tshe: rin chen nor bu'i sgrom bu phul: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ri gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: a su ra yi brag phug tu: rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan zhus: sring mo bzhi ni grogs su phul: dge bsnyen drag po rtsal du gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: khye'u sha yi zur phud can: phyag 'tshal gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul: klu rgyal dbang lag mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol:

hūm̐: bod yul me gro lung pa ru: sman chu dgu yi gter kha phul: sman sgrub bdud rtsi'i sbyin bdag zhus: rdo rje gzi 'bar mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i tshe: gser phye glang chen rlid bu gang : maṇ+ḍal phul nas nor sgrub zhus: mthu stobs dbang phyug mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bsam yas grub nas rab gnas bskyal: sdong po gser lag gdengs ka nas: rin chen gser phye dpag med phul: drag po zla skyong mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro ru: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe: chu tshan sman dang bcud len phul: dge bsnyen chos 'phan chen po gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor zab rgya gtad pa'i tshe: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes dang : klu mo nor bu mdzes byed ma:

gter bdag chen po mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dge bsnyen mtsho nag rba klong nas: pad+ma rgyal po spyan drangs nas: dgos 'dod kun 'byung grub pa'i tshe: gter bdag yab yum mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : ba liṃ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ nā ga ra tsa dhe wa aṣ+ṭi sarba ma hā dhe wa yak+sha dha ra nā ga dha ra aṣ+ṭi rismi bha wa kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: 'di yan rak+ta mchod: hūm̐: rong chen bco brgyad gnas kyi bdag: chu chen bco brgyad dbang yang sgyur: rol mtsho gling dgu'i mnga' bdag mdzad: rin chen gter gyi rgya srung ba: ngo bo gcig la sprul pa stong : bye ba grangs med las la 'gyed: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i pho nya ru: rje btsun chen po'i bka' nyan pa: phrin las drag po bzhengs pa'i tshe: bdud dgra rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: tshangs pa lha yi gnod sbyin che: rnam rgyal khang bzang dag la gnas: sprul pa lha yi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dri za zur phud lnga pa zhes: rno ba mtshon cha'i mkha' ru gnas: sprul pa gza' yi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no:

'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho rgyal bdud po zla ba'i gdong : bdud mtsho ri nag bco brgyad bdag: sprul pa bdud kyi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: mon mkhar gnod sbyin bkrag med ma: dben gnas sgrub phug rnams kyi bdag: sprul pa gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: seṅge rdzong gsum zu ra ba: pho brang lcags mkhar nag por chags: sprul pa dam can 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho dmar klu bdud mgo dgu pa: brag rdzong ri bo'i khang du gnas: sprul pa klu'i 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: mkhar chu'i smyo kha chen po zhes: pho brang smyo kha'i mtsho la gnas: sprul pa gnyan gyi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang gi thang lha skyed po zhes: gangs ri rtse mtho'i gnas su chags: sprul pa rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lci shod rdo rje mkhar nag zhes: gtsug lag khang dang gnas bzhi ru:

sprul pa dmu yi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lci yi rdo rje bdud 'dul zhes: chu chen mtsho 'khor rnams la chags: sprul pa btsan gyi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rdza ngom rdo rje bdud 'joms pa: bla mtsho dmar nag gnas su 'khor: sprul pa ma mo 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: spu rong rdo rje btsan grags pa: gter gnas sgrub khang dag la gnas: sprul pa gter srung 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: mtsho bdag ti pa ra tsa ba: nags phyogs rong chen rnams la rgyu: sprul pa gshin rje 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dus kyi pho nya dkar nag dmar: nyin mtshan dus drug phyogs la rgyu: sprul pa lha yi 'khor dang bcas: dge bsnyen chen po spyan 'dren no: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: mngon spyod chen pos phrin las mdzod: oṃ nā ga rā dza nā ga ka la ti pa ra tsa ya: nā ga du pra ma ha ni dhi pa ti ye sa twa sa ma ya swā hā: hūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta rak+ta pū dza ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa pū dza a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐:

de nas bskang mchod ni: slar yang tshogs dang mchod pa'i bye brag thams cad kha gsos nas: bskang mchod lha grangs bzhin mtheb skyu gser skyems 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen mnyes pa'i rdzas: ri rab lhun po nyi zla'i phreng bas brgyan: skar tshogs grangs med 'od 'khyil 'bum 'bum 'gyed: rol mtsho gling dgu lcags ri mu khyud bcas: nye ba'i gser ri bdun dang sbas mtsho bdun: dpag bsam ljon shing ma rmos lo tog dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun: skyed tshal tshang tshing 'khrigs dang nags ma'i khrod: klu yi yul ljongs spang gshong bde mo'i dpyid: ne'u seng sman ljongs me tog skyed mo'i tshal: 'bab chu khron pa gdengs ka lu ma dang : dal ldan gtsang po yang 'khor smrig ga chags: gzhan snang rba 'khrugs rlabs kyis bskyod pa dang : yar rgyas tshangs pa'i sgang du 'bab pa sogs: gzhan yang dri zhim khor yug khyab pa'i gling : de ru 'khor ba'i bya gcan ri dwags dang : sbal sbrul sdig srin gshe mo rta bla ma: rkang drug rkang mang dud 'gro'i rigs byed sogs: gzhan yang mkha' yi rgyan 'gyur rnam pa lnga: g.yu 'brug sde lnga glog gi zhags pa 'khyugs: chu 'dzin ngam nag khu rlangs phyu ru ru: 'ga' zhig phyogs su sprin dkar thul pa bklubs: me tog spungs 'dra'i sbrang char si li li: 'ja' 'od lu gu rgyud du phrig phrig g.yo: rgya mtsho mdangs kun zhag g.yo lnga ldan phyur: rnam par bkod pa'i gling mchog dam pa 'dis: yab mchog ma hā dhe wa'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: yum mchog klu mo dung skyong thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: sras mchog la thod dkar po'i thugs dam bskang :

mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: gnod sbyin nya nag gdong gi thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu rgyal nor bu 'od 'bar thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu mo nor bu 'od mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu rgyal gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu yi rgyal po 'jog po'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu yi rgyal po dga' bo'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu yi rgyal po dung skyong thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu yi rgyal po rtag myos thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu rgyal chen po brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ri'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod:

dge bsnyen dbang lag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen rdo rje gzi 'bar thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen mthu stobs dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen drag po zla skyong thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: klu mo nor bu mdzes byed thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen gter srung chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: gzhi bdag klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: tshangs pa lha yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen zur phud lnga pa'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen zla ba gdong gi thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen nag po bkrag med thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen zu ra zur ra'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen klu bdud mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang :

mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen smyo kha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen thang lha 'bar gyi thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen mkhar nag rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen rdo rje btsan grags thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dge bsnyen ti pa ra tsa'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa dkar dmar nag gsum thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: nang mchod sman raka bdud rtsi gtor ma dang : ga ṇa tsakra ta na sbyor ba'i phud: sman spos dri bzang a ka ru dang ni: klu sman dar zab spyan gzigs dkor chas dang : rta sngon g.yag sngon lug sngon ra sngon dang : bya sngon sprel sngon sbrul sngon sbal sngon dang : dar mdung sngon po nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang : rin chen sna tshogs dar sngon nang du dril: gzhan yang rang rang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan ni: gnam lcags 'khor lo lcags par mtshon cha'i sgrom: chu gri spu gri ral gri star ba yi: lcags sdig zangs sbrul bdud zhags lcags kyu bcas: g.yu khrab mthing rmog dang ru sngon po dang : phod kha sngon po chu ris gong lag can:

gzhan yang pho nya mnyes pa'i las byed rdzas: bya dmar sprel dmar zangs khyi dmar po dang : zhol g.yag kham pa 'bri dmar glang dmar po: ra dmar lug dmar rta dmar zangs khrab rmog: dar dmar ru mtshon zangs ral mda' gzhu dang : rgyal mtshan rnga thug dmar po dar dmar po: zhags dmar lcags kyus brgyan pa'i wang long can: gzhan yang g.yag nag rta nag lug nag dang : khyi nag dom nag sbrul nag nam mkha' nag: dar nag dang ni mdung nag ba dan can: lcags khrab phub la rnga zhol nag pos brgyan: khram shing rtsis rdo nag po mun pa nag: phod kha nag po bdud zhags la sogs pa: klu btsan klu bdud dge bsnyen chen po yi: mnyes pa'i phyi nang mchod pa spyan gzigs kyis: yab mchog ma hā dhe wa'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bskangs gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drag po bla ma'i bka' nyan mi bsrun pa: dregs sde las byed 'gyed pa'i gter srung ni: sku mdog mthing nag shin tu mi bzad pa: dar nag ral pa thod skam lnga yis brgyan: sbrul nag lan tshar bdun dang nor bus brgyan: spyi bor me 'bar dud pa phyu ru ru: gza' yi las byed 'gyu 'dra shin tu khro: gcer bu rus rgyan g.yang gzhi stag sham gsol: phyag g.yas rno ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs dgu gdeng : g.yon pas lcags par mtshon gyi gru gu thogs: yan lag lhu tshigs bzhi la mig gis brgyan: lte ba nyer po zhal ni shin tu gdangs: zhal gyi nang nas gnam lcags tshwa tshwa khol: rta nag rting dkar dpral bar me long brgyan: rnga rngog gseb nas sbrul sdig sbal lcong 'phro: srin po thod sga pags pa'i stan dang bcas: gong smed sbrul rigs lnga yi zar bus brgyan: me long 'tshub ma dbyings la bsnyegs bzhin 'gyu: yum mchog chu srin gdong can gcer mo ni: mi lpags gos gyon sbrul zhags lcags sdig 'dzin:

sku smad sbrul mjug sbal pa mgo dgu zhon: 'khor du sprul pa'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs 'gyed: 'bar ba bdud chas 'dzin la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: res 'ga' sku mdog dmar po rak+ta'i mdog: dmar nag dbu dgu srid pa'i dbyings la bsnyegs: sbrul nag ral bsigs gling bzhi chol bur 'phen: phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon 'og ma rim pa bzhin: chu srin chu gri sbrul zhags sdig rgod 'dzin: sbrul mjug ma he dmar po ru ring zhon: klu mo spos 'gros sbal pa'i mgo bo can: gcer mo g.yas g.yon lcags phur nad rkyal thogs: sku smad gdug pa sper gyi rnam pa can: 'khor du gdol ba nag po'i tshogs dang bcas: bstan dgra bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa: klu btsan dmar po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: res 'ga' zhi ba'i cha lugs 'chang ba'i tshe: mi pho sngon po dung gi la thod can: spyi bor dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu'i tog: sbrul rigs lnga yi cod pan 'khyil bas brgyan: sku stod dar ljang stod g.yogs mdzes par spras: phyag g.yas nor bu g.yon pas gter sgrom 'dzin: sku smad dar dmar chun po'i ang rag bklubs: zhabs gnyis bshibs te mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshul: g.yon du klu mo nor bu 'od ldan ma: sku mdog dkar mo rin chen thor tshugs brgyan: sku stod dar dmar cod pan na ra ra: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: sku yi cha la nor bu rgyan drug gsol: zhabs gnyis brda 'gros ldem pa'i nyams dang ldan: klu yi dbang mo mtsho bdag dpal lha mo: 'khor du nor bu sman gzhong bcud bzang gis: gtams pa'i rin chen snod mchog thogs pa 'bum: bro gar glu bcas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dang : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gus pas mchod: gter gyi sgo 'byed gsang sngags sbyin pa'i grogs: zhi ba'i mthu chen bsgrub pa'i cha lugs can: gter bdag yab yum gtso la bdag bstod do: klu zhi ba'i gtor ma 'bul:

rol mo bgyis nas dmar gyi gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs te dgra phyogs la 'phang : hūm̐: pha rol rig sngags dmod dang bstan pa'i dgra: gsang sngags gnyan la sdang ba'i bdud dang bgegs: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa dang : kha yog 'gel dang do bsdo 'gras 'tshol zhing : mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: 'gras ya 'dzing ya 'khon ya byed pa dang : 'gag rtsod 'phrang sgug rgyab 'ded byed pa dang : khyad par rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra: dge bsnyen klu bdud btsan gsum 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: mngon spyod dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma dgra bgegs raṃ raṃ ye swā hā: de nas klu bshos dkar gtor bdud rtsis bran nas: hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho gling gi mnga' dbang bsgyur: rin chen gter gyi rgya srung bya ra bgyid: rtag tu gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: sgrub pa'i bu la brtse bas ma bzhin skyongs: mchog thun yid bzhin dngos grub char ltar phob: bsod nams re skong phrin las sna tshogs sgrubs: 'dod rgu'i srid la 'dzam gling kha lor sgyur: 'bad rtsol med pa'i dbul phongs pre ta sol: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas skyongs: sngags 'chang bdag la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: phyag rgya drug gi grol lam dga' bzhir skyed: phun tshogs yar zla ltar bskyed phrin las mdzod: grogs ldan bgyis pa'i klu dbang yab yum gyi: dam rdzas gser skyems phud dang dkar gsum sogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma phul ba bzhes su gsol: mnyes shing dgongs pa dgyes pa bskyed nas su: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud: dgos 'dod bsod nams dpag med nam mkha'i khyon: ji ltar dmod pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa'i grogs: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

zhes gtor ma gtsang phyogs su phul: dgyes shing tshims nas bdag dang mkha' mnyam thams cad klu'i bang mdzod dang gnod sbyin gyi pho brang lta bu 'dod don la rab tu dgyes par bsgom: gter bdag klu yi rgyal po la thod can gyi sgrub thabs su: thun mong ma yin pa yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rgyan gyis phyug pa ste: 'bad rtsol mi dgos klu yi bdag pos rang bzhin gyi char rgyun 'bebs pa ltar: sgrub pa po la 'phral gyi dngos grub ma ltos phug tu yang : rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas la sems bskyed zhus shing : pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs bskyed bla na med pas rgyas gdab: spyir sngon gyi dus su dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal mthong ba dang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gzhi bsrings: khyad par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa phul: klu'i khu bo gnod sbyin rtag myos yin: nu bo gnod sbyin gzhong thogs yin: 'bring ba gnod sbyin bya ra ba yin: lcam mo gnod sbyin klu mo nor skyong yin: sring gcig nor bu 'od mtsho yin: 'di rnams thams cad bla med rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs pa ste: chos sgrub pa'i gang zag rnams dang : khyad par gnas bzang 'grim pa gter la dbang ba rig 'dzin rnams kyi grogs yang dag pa ste: rje ma lab sgron gyis kyang chu mig brgyad la gnyan sa 'grim pa'i mthar zangs ri mkhar dmar du: dam pa sangs rgyas mjal ba'i sne mo mkha' spyod du gshegs: yang sdong po gser lag can nas grub pa thob: rje btsun rnal 'byor ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gdams pa'i sdong po yid bzhin skor zhus skabs dang : ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos pa yongs kyi srid zhu ba khyad par rig 'dzin gter ston rnams kyi 'tsho ba mthun rkyen sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa: bris sgrub dmigs te klu yi dge bsnyen yid bzhin nor bu ltar sgrub thabs:

mtshon cha ltar 'gyed thabs: bdud rtsi ltar myong thabs yid bzhin mdzod ltar kha phye ba'i gdams pa ste: 'di rnams mkha' 'gro mas brda yi yi ger btab nas: bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi sgrub khog spyi yi bka' gter skyong ba khyad par o rgyan nor lha dbyer med sgrub thabs kyi gter du skyong pa'i las la dmigs te zhus shing : rje btsun gyi de ltar gnyer du bskos pa'i: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa phag lor: dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor: mdo khams klu rgyal rdzong gi nye 'dabs mi dbang sa bdag rgyal po'i ur dgus su shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o// //

tsa)pad+ma rgyal po las: nor skyong klu mo'i gtor 'bul gsol mchod bzhugs so: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po rtsal la 'dud: nor skyong klu mo'i gtor 'bul ni: bswe phor zangs snod gang rung du: bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can: mtheb skyu bzhi yis bskor bar bya: dkar gsum bya zhing byin brlabs nas: mchod bstod rim pa 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho rab 'khyil mer ba'i dbus: dgos 'dod mchod sbyin klu mo nor skyong ma: dngos grub bdag mo mched bzhi skur bzhengs la: thogs med dkyil 'khor skyong phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ nā ga ni dha ra mu tra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mchog gsum bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: klu bshos 'dod yon zag med tshogs mchod 'di: nor skyong klu mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas gter dang klu g.yang dngos grub stsol: oṃ nā ga ni dha ra ma ṇi mu tra sa ma ya ma hā bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bstod bskul gtor ma 'bul bsdu ni: hūm̐: rol mtsho gling dgu'i bcud kyi mnga' bdag mo: zab gter gnyan gyi bka' srung mthu mo che: 'khor dang sprul pa klu mo 'bum dang bcas: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog la rab tu bstod: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: sangs rgyas bstan srung brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs: 'dzam gling stong gsum klu g.yang srid bsdus la: skal ldan sgrub pa'i las bzhi smin par mdzod: zab chos gsang ba'i grogs po 'khor bcas tshogs: sngags 'chang bdag la grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang : phrin las thogs med lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: ces rtsa sngags btags la 'bul: e ma hoḥ dgos 'dod kun 'byung klu mo bcud 'dzin gyi: zab pa'i gsol mchod las rim sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di yang karma las 'brel rtsal gyis shog ser nas dag par phab pa'o// // tsha) gnod sbyin dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung gnas po dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul bzhugs so:

hūm̐: pad+ma'i bka' nyan mthu stobs dbang phyug rgyal: dregs pa yongs rdzogs rdo rje bdud 'dul zhes: klu btsan gzi 'bar dge bsnyen thogs med rtsal: khro tshogs sprul pa'i 'jigs rung rol rtsal shugs: srog la dbang byed nā ga klu bdud che: sku mdog dmar nag dbu dgu srid rtser bslebs: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha chas drug ni: spu gri 'khor los ma rungs log lta sgrol: chu gri ral gris nyams pa'i srog dbugs sdud: sbrul zhags sdig rgod sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : dbu skra dmar ser bar snang mkha' la bskyod: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs srid gsum bsngangs shing brgyal: dur khrod chas rdzogs yan lag mig gis brgyan: chu gri'i 'dab gshog sa gzhi brdar sha gcod: lte bar khro zhal klu gnyan zas su za: sbyor yum chu srin gdong can gnyis med 'khril: dug sbrul mjug 'phyangs bdud rta rlung gshog bcibs: gong smed sbrul rigs sdom sdig sbal lcong 'phro: me rlung rab 'khyil dug rlangs sprin phung gtibs: gzi brjid mdangs stobs bstan srung mthu chen gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun sde: dar rgyas bzang bskul sdong grogs rogs dan mdzod: snang srid dbang sdud lam 'phrang 'jigs sgrol nas: klu g.yang dngos grub 'dod rgu dpal 'byor sdud: bka' srung gter srung mchog khyed ma g.yel bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya: dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta sogs khā hi bar brjod: gnod sbyin dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung gnas po dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul zangs shog gi ldeb ma las hūm̐ gis phab pa'o// // dza)bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: tshogs mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so:

pad 'byung nor lha'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nga nyid dbang sdud sgrub thabs dang : bsod nams tshogs chen mchod pa'i rim pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni: dang po tshogs bsang sbyang chu gtsang gis bran la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid pad+ma rgyal po yi: thugs las byin rlob yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag chags sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po la: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags dbyings rig pho brang nas: longs sku thugs rje 'phags mchog la: zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: stobs bcu gzi byin pho brang nas: rig 'dzin sprul sku pad 'byung la: bka' bab grub thob tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: kun 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po la: 'dod sbyin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dag pa bde chen pho brang nas: lha lcam gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro la: ma sring bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: me rlung 'tshub ma'i pho brang nas: legs ldan zhing skyong mgon po la: dam can gter bdag 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gaṅgā yid 'ong dal mtsho'i dbus: klu mo gzi ldan nor skyong la: dbang sdud skyong ma 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig:

dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: dgos 'dod char 'bebs si li li: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ta la la: dri zhim spos dud chi li li: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la bkrag mdangs bskyed: bkram pa'i mchod par bcud chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang sdud yab yum mgyogs ma bcas: dam can gter bdag chos skyong la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon sna lnga'i gter: nang mchod rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sna tshogs dbang po 'dis: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : 'od ldan klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gter srung dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes pa rab bskyed nas: sgrub la 'dod rgu yid bzhin char ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams pa dang : bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags mchod rdzas chad cing lhag: bag med dam 'gal le lo ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: nyams grib dag nas tshangs pa stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas:

lhag chad bkang : de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du hom yangs lcags khang gru gsum nang : nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang : god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: na mo mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: khyad par bka' gter chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po bar chad rtsom pa'i rigs: rang dbang med par tshogs ling 'di la khug: bskrad cing bsdams nas bsgral gtub phye mar thongs: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las byed badz+ra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang sdud rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dug lnga dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs zhal du bzhes shing mgrin par drongs: bde stong chos nyid rang byung lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi bran zhing 'bul: de nas dga' ston tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ chos dbyings ngang la 'khor 'das gcig: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bram ze khyi phag ji bzhin du: ro snyom lta ba'i tshogs la rol: dngos grub sna tshogs 'di la 'byung : a la la ste e ma hoḥ zhes pad kor phyag rgya dang bcas te blangs nas rol: de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i tshogs: lhag sdud ging dang ma mo sman: gnas nyul zhing skyong phra men ma: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na skyogs bzang bhan+dha thogs: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: la la mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur gzugs:

la la bud med rgan mo'i gzugs: la la smad 'tshong nag mo'i gzugs: la la sha za srin mo'i gzugs: la la dur khrod 'dre mo'i gzugs: sprul pa sna tshogs ma nges kyang : don la gnas nyul dus mtshan ma: rnal 'byor kun gyi drod tshad nyul: dur khrod tshogs khang mtha' la gnas: dngos grub kun gyi sa mtshams 'dzin: legs gnyis kun gyi stangs 'dzin ma: dam tshig can la bu bzhin skyong : ma mo gnas nyul tshogs len 'bum: bka' yi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams zas su zo: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs phye mar thongs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo rak+mo ting ting shag shag dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: dbang sdud rgyal po rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: gsang ba las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: mthu rtsal thugs rjes gzi byin deng 'dir skyed: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dul dka'i tshe: sems can bsod nams dman zhing bar chad sdang : yi dwags bgegs rigs 'byung po mi min gyis: mnga' thang longs spyod phywa la dgra sdang bas: mthu chen khyed kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: phyi yi bar chad rkyen ngan dbyings su sol: nang gi thig le rtsa rlung nyams pa gsos: gsang ba chos srid rang sems dbang du sdus: stong gsum phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: dbang sdud pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: mnga' thang snyan grags spel pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rig 'dzin thugs rje can: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan bdag cag la: 'dod rgu zad med rin chen char ltar phob: thugs dam bskul lo bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya ma hā bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs su:

thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyis: 'od gsal snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi ma sring khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og dur khrod ma la dga' tshal dang : dbang sdud chen po pad+ma rgyal po yis: dngos grub kun 'byung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: nor skyong pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang sdud zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gnyer gtad srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya'i dus kyi tha ma la: mdo smad rong gi dge bsnyen pho brang nas: rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pa yis: zab gsang brda yi shog ser bton pa'i tshe: gter srung pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chad mdo'i tha tshig 'di la gnas pa yi: srung ma dam can gter bdag pho nya rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ya kro ta bha sa ki si bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sha za sman mo yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen mdzes rgyan g.yer kha si li li: glu len nyams dga' bshugs glu kyu ru ru: dgyes pa'i gad mo 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe rogs dan mdzod: sgrub la ma g.yel bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs:

bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo mu kha le ting ting shag shag kha kha khā hi: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rngam pa'i bro ra ru: khro rgyal stobs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra sri dam nyams thal bar brlag: gtum mo rdo rje'i bro ra ru: khro mo 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: bgegs srin 'byung po tshar yang bcad: las mkhan 'tshogs pa'i bro ra ru: gter srung dam can bro brdungs pas: god 'dre dbul sri thal bar brlag: chem chem khro rgyal rol pa'i bro: rdungs shig stobs bcu'i rtsal gyi 'gros: nam yang dam sri ma ldang cig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nanaḥ dam sri mā ra ya rbad ching nan nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar zad la me tog 'thor zhing : rten 'brel gang rigs kyi mchod pa yang bya: skabs su dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lhun grub pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku rig 'dzin 'chi med pad+ma 'byung : dbang sdud rgyal po nor bdag dzam+bha la: mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro rlung gi zhags pa can: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod phywa dang g.yang : snyan grags chos dang mnga' thang 'dod rgu'i tshogs: mchog dang thun mong yid la 'dod pa'i rigs: 'bad med yid bzhin nor bu char bzhin phob: myur du skal ldan rig 'dzin bdag la stsol: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'bru gsum gyis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi puṇ+ye rat+na ma ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dngos grub blang zhing dbang bzhi zhu: de nas tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: tshe chang dang tshe ril thogs nas: hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po 'chi med tshe yi lha: pad+ma rgyal po gsang 'dus dbang chen bdag:

mgyogs ma tshe 'gugs lha mo 'bum gyis bskor: sgo ma'i phyag brnyan steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros: nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho'i bcud: sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga'i khams lnga dang : snang ba srid dang snod bcud skye 'gro yi: bla tshe rnam shes bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rnams: 'od zer lcags kyus bsdus nas bdag la stims: pho nya sgo ma'i tshogs kyis dbang du sdus: rig 'dzin lus la bstims pas gzi brjid rgyas: 'khor lo lnga ldan ye shes 'od kyis gang : bdud rtsi lus kun khyab pas rā ga'i mdog: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe ba ā yur+dz+nyā na hrī pad+ma dha ra hūm̐: ma ma sid+dhi pha la dza dzaḥ de nas tshe chang tshe ril la rol: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: bkra shis bya ba ni: hoḥ chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: rtse gcig ting 'dzin 'char ba'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag: byin rlabs 'gro kun smin pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : zab yang nyi 'od gsal ba'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis dbang sdud nor lha'i mchog: dgos 'dod char bzhin 'beb pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis bde stong gsang ba'i yum: sngags bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: dam can bkra shis sngags srung rdo rje legs: log lta bdud rigs tshar gcod bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : mnga' thang stobs bcu 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis klu mo nor skyong ma: 'dzad med gter la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis dge bsnyen pho brang che: yul ris sa phyogs bde legs bkra shis shog: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs stong gsal rang byung dkyil 'khor lha: ma 'gags zang thal chos dbyings klong du bsdu:

rang rig dran pa'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: a a āḥ zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas nas bsdu'o: de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni: hoḥ bsngo byed rgyal po ye rig shes pa'i rgyu: bsngo yul rang rtsal gshis lugs smra bo che: bsngo ba kun 'byung 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: de dag rig pa bsal bzhag bral bar bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ srid pas bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'ching las rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs nas: mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces smon lam legs par rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don gyi phyir: nga nyid nor bdag lta bu'i bsgrub pa yi: dbang sdud zhags pa'i gdams pa bzhag: 'dod rgu kun 'byung man ngag mchog: dbyangs can brda yi ri mor gzugs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas mdo smad rong 'dzi chen gaṅgā drag tu 'khor ba'i rgyud/ chu bdag dge bsnyen chen po'i pho brang nas khrom mang zhig dang bcas te gdan drangs shing shog ser las bsgyur ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //

wa)nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i bskang ba 'dod rgu'i bsam 'phel bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu lags: pad 'byung nor lha'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bskang ba nor bu bsam 'phel bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bskang ba bya ba'i rim pa ni: tshogs dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsham: phyi nang spyan gzigs longs spyod dang : dkor cha rin chen 'bru sman tshogs: phun sum tshogs par bshams nas su: bskang ba'i rim pa 'di ltar bya: hūm̐: lhun grub bde chen 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: pad+ma rgyal po nor bdag dkyil 'khor lha: dbang sdud ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen pad zla'i khri la bzhugs: ro mchog lnga ldan 'dod yon phud kyi mchod: thugs dam bskangs shing dgos 'dod rab sbyin nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dar mtshon sprin ltar gtibs: rin chen sna tshogs 'bru sman bcal du bkram: dkar mngar phud kyi mchod pa mtsho ltar bskyil: rta glang ma he g.yag lug ra yi gzugs: spyan gzigs bla med yid 'ong mchod pa yis: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gar mo lang ling me tog phreng ba thogs: sgeg mo mdzes ldan dri zhim sgrom bu 'dzin: dmar mo dgyes bzhes snang gsal sgron me 'dzin: ljang mo 'jo sgeg bzhad 'dras dung chos bsnams: klu mo mnyen lcug zhal zas rgya mtsho 'khyil:

'khril ldem brda 'gros rol mo sna tshogs thogs: mchod sprin lha mo yid 'ong gar sgyur gyis: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: mu la rak+ta dbyings kyi rang byung khrag: ba liṃ gtor ma brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: sbyor sgrol sna tshogs spyod pa'i bye brag gis: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: zla rgyas zho dang zla phrom mar gyi phrom: 'bras rgun bu ram ka ra sbrang rtsi chang : phye mar 'brang rgyas longs spyod sna tshogs dang : gser dngul zangs dang mu tig baiḍūr+ya: nor bu rta mchog glang po dmag dpon dang : btsun mo blon po 'khor lo rin po che: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u bum pa zlum: gser nya pad+ma chos dung g.yas su 'khyil: g.yang gi dga' 'khyil sna tshogs bsnams pa 'dis: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

hūm̐: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang : sa le 'bri dang shel sgong lug: ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod dang : bdud rtsi tshe yi a mṛ ta: māṃ sa sna tshogs sha sna'i mchog: ri sgog rlung sgog sha mong dang : co le nyo le nyi khri dang : rgun 'brum sna tshogs shing gi thog: ma tshang med pa'i mchod rdzas kyis: pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam ḍāk+ki'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ye mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba skye med ngang du bskang : mchod pa gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor ba zung 'jug dga' bzhi sbyor: sgrol ba dug lnga dbyings su bsgral: bshags pa ye grol chen por bshags: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur nas: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal mchod pa lo zlar 'das: dam rdzas ma tshang rgyu chung phud lhag shor: lhag ma phri zhing ser sna'i 'dod sred bcings: ma rig rmongs pa'i rkyen dbang ci mchis pa: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: byang zhing dag ste mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nor sgrub yang snying yid bzhin nor bu yi: bskang mchod cha lag zab rgya gnad thig bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs shing sbas tshal chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/

maṅga laṃ// // zha) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma po las: g.yang 'bod srid gsum dbang sgyur rin chen bang mdzod bzhugs so: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma hoḥ 'dod rgu'i dbyings phyug rin chen gter mdzod las: mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor lo 'di phyug pas: sna tshogs srid dang de srid skye 'gro yi: dpal la rab tu 'jo ba'i rmad byung ba'i: gzugs mdzes lha mo snyan pa'i ba dan phreng : yid kyi lang tsho dbus mtha'i gzhal yas 'das: dpag ka'i khyon ltar yongs 'gengs 'dod 'byung can: gling 'di'am ni srid pa'i dpung rtse ru: nam mkha'i nor bu bgrang yas tshar bsgrig cing : srog gi bum dang mthong ba'i dbang po bzhin: rnyed dka' brtse ba dbugs kyi dwangs ma ltar: rin thang brjod bral 'di ko ma ti ka ti: rtsi bcud lba ba'i sbubs gnas ji lta ba: dam tshig dzam bu klu yi dngul chu bzhin: 'dzad med sa le sbram ltar rab tu skyong : dzam+bu pṛk+ṣi'i mdangs g.yo bcud ldan 'di: na ra dza hu'i bdag po des srungs la: pad+ma kā ra'i rnam sprul gang der sprod: sa ma ya: de yang khu ye phywa g.yang 'bod cing rten btsugs nas g.yang rta bsdam pa ni: g.yang rdzas yon bdag gi lag tu bzhag: sngags 'chang gi phywa yi mda' dar lag tu thogs la: steng phyogs lha'i yul nas g.yang 'bod pa ni: kyaiḥ ye thog bskal pa dang po la: phywa yi byung khungs ji ltar srid: g.yang gi rgyu rkyen ci ltar bstan: khu ye'i mtshan nyid gang lags na: srid pa 'phrul gyi mi pho bshad: srog gi yig 'bru 'di ltar 'chang : stong gsal skye med tshig gsan 'tshal: hūm̐: nga ni snang srid bskyed pa'i yab: snod bcud yum la zung 'jug bstan: thabs shes rten 'brel 'tshogs pa las: lam lnga tshogs drug rta la zhon: 'byung ba mas brten gyen la chags: dper na chu nang gzugs brnyan bzhin: ri rab lhun po rdo rje'i dbyibs: ngo bo thur la rnam pa gyen:

mchod rten mthil sprod dbyibs su snang : de bzhin gser gyi ri bdun dang : rol pa'i mtsho mdun che rim chags: gling dang gling g.yog nor bus brgyan: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rang bzhin te: ri rab dbus kyi khang zom la: srog shing dbu ma'i rnam pa can: dzam+bu pṛk+ṣa'i dpag bsam shing : dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ljon pa de: tshangs pa'i yul du lhun gyis chags: dbang po rgyal byin ma hā dhe: gzhon nu khyab 'jug la sogs pa: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang yul: gzhan yang sum cu rtsa gsum dang : mtha' bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' ba: gzhan 'phrul la sogs gzugs khams lha: gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi sogs: che phra grangs med lha yi yul: de ltar dpag bsam rtse yi cha: 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i yongs 'dus tshogs: steng phyogs lha yi phywa g.yang ste: khu ye dang po de nas 'bod: bar pa ri rab bang rim la: sgra gcan rlung gi pho brang ste: nyi zla gza' skar 'gyu ba'i lam: dus kyi bdag po de ru 'tshogs: lo skor bcu gnyis 'byung ba lnga: spar sme la sogs shar ba'i yul: shar phyogs snod kyi phywa g.yang tshogs: khu ye gnyis pa de nas 'bod: tha ma ri rab rtsa ba ru: gser ri rol mtsho chags pa'i yul: sa bdag lto 'phye sa srung dang : klu rgyal nor bu ma dros tshogs: gnyan gyi sde bcas 'du ba'i gling : skye 'gro kun gyi chags pa'i yul: sa gzhi rin chen ri thang gang : 'og phyogs klu yi g.yang phywa de: khu ye gsum pa de nas 'bod: da lta 'dzam gling 'jig rten 'dir: gling bzhi'i gling phran la 'god pa'i: dus gsum dus mkhyen sangs rgyas dang : skyob par bya ba dam pa'i chos: mchod 'os bkur 'os 'phags pa'i sde: 'khor los sgyur rgyal mnga' bdag rje: bsod nams tshogs las grub pa la: dbang bskur de yi srid dang 'khor: bcud kyi skye 'gro'i g.yang phywa de: de ring g.yang phywa de nas 'bod: g.yang rten yon bdag rnams la btsugs:

g.yang rta pho brang nang du bsdam: g.yang rdzas mi shigs rgya yis 'debs: khu ye phywa khungs de bzhin no: da ni 'dod rgu'i g.yang 'gugs so: de nas g.yang 'bod lan gsum gyis la phud rgod mchod: hūm̐: g.yang 'bod pa dang po gang nas 'bod: g.yang 'bod pa chos dbyings klong nas 'bod: mtha' dbus med pa'i pho brang nas: kun bzang sangs rgyas kun gyi yab: dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro kun gyi yum: thabs shes 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas yab yum dang : bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis: sku bzhi ye shes ngo bo nyid: dug lnga dbyings su sgrol ba'i lha: rang bzhin chos nyid dbyings su bzhugs: gzugs brnyan sprul pa sgyur mar ston: ye nas gdod ma'i phywa khu ye: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa yi: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas g.yang 'gugs so: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: yon bdag 'di la rten btsugs so: chos kyi phywa g.yang ma nyams shig: hūm̐: g.yang gnyis pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang gnyis pa ri rab rtse nas 'bod: ri rab rtse yi khyon zhig la: lha yi zhing khams bsam mi khyab: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang yod: 'dod rgu dpag bsam shing las 'byung : dbul zhing phongs pa'i ming yang med: gzhal yas de yi nang shed na: bzhugs pa'i gter bdag chen po ni: lha yi rgyal po tshangs pa sbyin: phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo thogs: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis: steng phyogs dbus kyi phywa g.yang khug: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag 'di: tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan gyur cig: dbyings kyi pho brang shar phyogs su: brgya byin lag na dung dkar thogs: snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab pa yis: shar phyogs lha yi g.yang 'gugs so: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag nyid: brgya byin mdangs dang ldan gyur cig: dbyings kyi pho brang lho phyogs su: gzhon nu lag na nor bu thogs: bsod nams longs spyod rgyas pa dang :

lho phyogs lha yi g.yang 'gugs so: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag 'di: gzhon nu'i gzi brjid ldan gyur cig: dbyings kyi pho brang nub phyogs su: ma hā dhe was lcags kyu thogs: khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba yis: nub phyogs lha yi g.yang 'gugs so: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag 'di: dbang phyug che ltar nus ldan shog: dbyings kyi pho brang byang phyogs su: khyab 'jug lag na mda' gzhu thogs: dpa' rtsal myur mgyogs ldan pa yis: byang phyogs lha yi g.yang 'gugs so: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag 'di: drag shul 'phrog byed ltar ldan shog: gzhan yang 'khor du gtogs pa yi: sum cu rtsa gsum lha rnams dang : mtha' bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang : gzhan 'phrul pa dang sa dbang byed: gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi sogs: steng phyogs lha yi yul rnams kyis: rang byung zas dang rang byung gos: rang byung nor bu rgyan longs spyod: rang gsal 'ja' lus 'od la sogs: lha yi bsod nams longs spyod tshogs: mi 'dzad char ltar 'bebs pa yi: steng phyogs lha yi g.yang 'gugs so: de ring rgyu 'byor sbyin bdag 'di: 'dod yon lha dang mnyam pa yis: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: longs spyod phywa g.yang ma nyams shig: hūm̐: g.yang gsum pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang gsum pa bar snang dbyings nas 'bod: lhun po dbyings kyi bar snang nas: nam mkha'i mdzod kyi gzhal yas su: phrin las bzhi la grub pa yi: phywa dang g.yang la dbang ba yi: rgyu skar lha mo nyi shu brgyad: 'byung ba so so'i rang dbang bsgyur: shar phyogs shel gyi pho brang na: bzhugs pa'i rgyu skar lha mo ni: smin drug dmar mo dbang gi mdog: phyag na nor bu rgyal mtshan phyar: rgyu skar lha mo drug gis bskor: phywa char g.yang char si li li: khu ye khu ye g.yang 'bod do: lho phyogs gser gyi pho brang nas: bzhugs pa'i rgyu skar lha mo ni:

rta chen rā ga rgyas pa'i mdog: phyag na ba dan rtse gsum phyar: rgyu skar lha mo drug gis bskor: phywa char g.yang char si li li: khu ye khu ye g.yang 'bod do: nub phyogs byi ru'i pho brang nas: bzhugs pa'i rgyu skar lha mo ni: lha mtshams sa snying zhags pa'i mdog: phyag na dpal be'u rgyal mtshan phyar: rgyu skar lha mo drug gis bskor: phywa char g.yang char si li li: khu ye khu ye g.yang 'bod do: byang phyogs g.yu yi pho brang nas: bzhugs pa'i rgyu skar lha mo ni: mon gre sa le dwangs ma'i mdog: phyag na rat+na'i rgyal mtshan phyar: rgyu skar lha mo drug gis bskor: phywa char g.yang char si li li: khu ye khu ye g.yang 'bod do: rgyu skar nyer brgyad g.yang 'gugs ni: skar ma smin drug nyi ma la: mdzes ldan gos kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma snar ma'i nyi ma la: bu sring phar 'gro'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma mgo yi nyi ma la: stag shar dpa' bo'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma lag gi nyi ma la: khe tshong mgron po'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma nabs so'i nyi ma la: jag chom 'phrog sogs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma rgyal gyi nyi ma la: rwa ba gnag khyu'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma skag gi nyi ma la: mkhar dang byad kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma mchu yi nyi ma shar: go cha dgra lha'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma gre yi nyi ma la: khyu mo phyugs kyi g.yang shor na:

de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma dbo yi nyi ma la: sa le 'bri'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma me bzhi'i nyi ma la: ru chung lam zhugs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma nag pa'i nyi ma la: khyu mchog rta yi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: karma sa ri'i nyi ma la: tshe tshe ra yi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma sa ga'i nyi ma la: ban sngags dmod pa'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma lha mtshams nyi ma la: g.yang dkar lug gi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma snron gyi nyi ma la: lag dpyad chas kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma snrubs kyi nyi ma la: 'chor mo dre'u g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma chu stod nyi ma la: bang mdzod 'bru yi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma chu smad nyi ma la: rtsi bcud 'bru yi g.yang shod na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma gro zhun nyi ma la: zas bcud longs spyod g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma byi bzhin nyi ma la: mdzod dang dkor gyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma mon gre'i nyi ma la: khyim zin sman chung g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma mon gru'i nyi ma la:

ba glang bong bu'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma khrums stod nyi ma la: pha khu rgan gyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma khrums smad nyi ma la: a phyi myes pa'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma nam gru'i nyi ma la: chung rgyud bu tsha'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma dbyug gu'i nyi ma la: sman chung bu mo'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: skar ma bra nye'i nyi ma la: thab spyad nang gnyis g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis: bsdus pa'i phywa g.yang ma lus kun: sbyin bdag 'di la rten btsugs pas: bsod nams skar 'tshogs ltar bkrag pa'i: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: rgyu skar rgya mtsho'i dpung ldan shog: hūm̐: g.yang bzhi pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang bzhi pa 'byung lnga'i klong nas 'bod: 'byung ba rlung la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod sgra gcan nyi ma la: srid pa las kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'byung ba shing la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod phur bu'i nyi ma la: g.yo ba srog 'dzin g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'byung ba me la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod nyi mas 'dzin pa'i tshe: skyes pa drod kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gza' rgod mig dmar nyi ma la: gsal ba shes rab g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'byung ba chu la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod zla ba nyi ma la:

thabs mchog bde rgyas g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gza' rgod lag pa'i nyi ma la: dwangs ma srog 'dzin g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'byung ba lcags la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod pa sangs nyi ma la: 'phel ba sra brtan g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'byung ba sa la dbang bsgyur ba: gza' rgod spen pa'i nyi ma la: 'dus bya 'tshogs pa'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gzhan yang 'byung lngar dbang bsgyur ba: skyed byed shing la sreg byed me: rtsa rlung drod kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: kun mos chu dang brtan pa lcags: khams dang rus kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'gyur med sa la khyab pa rlung : sha lpags sems kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gzhan yang srog lus dbang thang dang : 'byung ba bcud kyi phywa dang g.yang : sbyin bdag 'di la rten btsugs pa'i: mi shigs mkha' ltar gnas pa yi: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: sra brtan rdo rje'i ri ltar shog: hūm̐: g.yang lnga pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang lnga pa ri rab rim nas 'bod: srid pa'i ri rab bang rim la: lo khyim bcu gnyis pho brang nas: zla ba de bzhin zhag dus kyi: phywa dang g.yang gi bdag po bzhugs: phyag na dus kyi g.yang rdzas bsnams: stag yos gnyis kyi nyi ma la: rga shi skye bas 'dzin pa'i tshe: pho brang shar phyogs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: rta sbrul gnyis kyi nyi ma la: len pa srid pas 'dzin pa'i tshe: pho brang lho phyogs g.yang shor na:

de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: bya sprel gnyis kyi nyi ma la: rig pa skye mched 'dzin pa'i tshe: pho brang nub phyogs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: phag byi gnyis kyi nyi ma la: rnam shes 'du byed 'dzin pa'i tshe: pho brang byang phyogs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'brug dang lug gi nyi ma la: srid pa tshor bas 'dzin pa'i tshe: pho brang de yi mtshams bzhi yi: shar lho nub byang g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: khyi dang glang gi nyi ma la: ming gzugs ma rig 'dzin pa'i tshe: nub byang byang shar g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gzhan yang spar sme la sogs kyis: dbang bstan srung ba'i g.yang len pa: li dang dgu dmar nyi ma la: bu tsha rgyud 'dzin g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: zin dang gsum mthing nyi ma la: pha khu myes po'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dwa dang bdun dmar nyi ma la: nor grogs bsod nams g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: khams dang gcig dkar nyi ma la: bu sring mna' ma'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: zon khon gnyis nag bzhi ljang nyin: ma dang a phyi'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ging khen brgyad drug dkar po'i nyin: mkhar dang sa gzhi'i g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: lo dang spar sme dus 'dzin gyis: rang bzhin 'dus pa'i bsod nams spel: sbyin bdag 'di la rten btsugs pas: longs spyod skyed dang 'dod rgu'i srid:

khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: snod bcud bsdus pa'i g.yang ldan shog: hūm̐: g.yang drug pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang drug pa ri rab rtsa nas 'bod: srid pa'i rus sbal khang zom na: gling bzhi rol mtsho g.yang zhag 'khyil: pho brang de ru bzhugs pa yi: lha srin sde brgyad sa bdag klu: bsod nams snyan grags mnga' thang gyi: 'dod rgu dpal gyi sgrom bu bsnams: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i: yul 'khor srung ba'i rgyal po dang : lha dang rgyal po'i nyi ma la: zhi ba phrin las g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur ba: 'phags skyes po zhes rgyal po dang : gshin rje btsan gyi nyi ma la: rgyas pa'i phrin las g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur ba: spyan mi bzang zhes rgyal po dang : ma mo klu yi nyi ma la: dbang gi phrin las g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur ba: rgyal po chen po rnam sras dang : gnod sbyin bdud kyi nyi ma la: drag po'i phrin las g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ri rab ngos la dbang bsgyur ba: srid pa'i rgyal po ye sngon tshe: gza' dang dam can nyi ma la: thog mtha' bar gsum g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gling phran rnam la dbang bsgyur ba: dregs chen bco brgyad 'jigs byed dgu: phyogs skyong bcu yi nyi ma la: phrin las sna tshogs g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: rol pa'i mtsho la dbang bsgyur ba: nor bu bcud 'phel g.yang gi bdag: de ring gnas 'dir 'gugs pa ni:

dpyid zla rab 'bring tshes brgyad dang : bco lnga nyer brgyad nyer gnyis la: gtsug na dga' bo'i nyi ma la: bkra shis rdzas rtags g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dpyid tha dbyar ra bco lnga dang : nyer lnga nyer brgyad bcu gsum dgu: mtha' yas 'jog po'i nyi ma la: gser g.yu rin chen g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dbyar 'bring tha chung bco lnga dang : gcig lnga bcu gsum nyer gnyis gsum: stobs rgyu rigs ldan nyi ma la: rgyan gos dkor nor g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ston ra ston 'bring bzhi brgyad dgu: bcu gsum lnga drug brgyad cu bdun: nor rgyas dung skyong nyi ma la: bang khang sa bcud g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: bsod nams phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i gter: rol mtsho gling dang gling bar gyis: bsdus te gcig tu bskyil ba nyid: sbyin bdag 'di la brten btsugs pas: 'dzam gling mnga' bsgyur dpal 'byor skyed: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: sa 'og dbang sgyur g.yang ldan shog: hūm̐: g.yang bdun pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang bdun pa gser ri lhun po 'bod: ri rab ri bdun dbang bsgyur ba: 'dzam gling sa gzhi'i bdag po de: dus dang gnas su ma nges pa: khyab cing rang bzhin 'gyur ba yi: sa bdag chen po gnyan dang bcas: snod 'di dbang sgyur de yi g.yang : de ring 'gugs shing 'bod pa ni: lto 'phye gnam khyi'i nyi ma la: ri rab ri bdun snying po'i bcud: gser la sogs pa'i rin chen dang : bdud rtsi dwangs ma snying po'i zhags: rtsa rlung ldan pa'i dbugs la sogs: pho brang dbus kyi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dpyid gsum pho gcig mo gnyis kyi:

skyed byed shing la 'jug pa yi: the se btsun mo blon po dang : dmag dpon dang bcas nyi ma la: dpal dang srog gi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dbyar gsum mo gcig pho gnyis kyis: stobs ldan mo la 'jug pa yi: tsang kun se hang se byi dang : se shar dang bcas nyi ma la: lus dang tshe yi g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ston gsum pho gcig mo gnyis kyis: sra brtan lcags la 'jug pa yi: se ba hang 'phan sras bu dang : sa la dang bcas nyi ma la: bsod nams dbang thang g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: rgun gsum mo gcig pho gnyis kyis: ngad ldan bsil la 'jug pa yi: se'u se bya tsang kun dang : bla mkhyen dang bcas nyi ma la: rlung rta longs spyod g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: mtshams dang phri bsnan chu tshod kyis: dbang chen bzhi la 'jug pa yi: mtshon thogs ka la rta bdun dang : dur 'debs zas 'phrog cho med kyi: tshes dang dus kyi nyi ma la: 'phrod sbyor mi mthun g.yang shor na: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: zhag dang 'byung 'jug dbyug gu dang : chu srang 'dzin dang sbyin pa yi: a dhi ka dang pa na tra: bsgyur dang sbyang ba la sogs kyis: 'phro 'du'i bgos pa'i 'dod don rnams: sbyin bdag 'di la rten btsugs pas: nam mkha'i dbang sgyur mi zad mdzod: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: hūm̐: g.yang brgyad pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod: g.yang brgyad pa 'dzam gling gru nas 'bod: lho rgyal rgyal bas bsngags pa yi: khyon 'dir 'tshogs pa'i bsod nams zhing : mnga' thang bsgyur ba'i 'dod rgu rnams: bkra shis deng gi nyi ma la: dge legs gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i byin rlabs g.yang :

de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: sde dpon rnams kyi mnga' thang g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: che btsun dgra lha'i dpa' rtsal g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: brjid ldan srog skyob go khrab g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: rno bar ngar ldan mtshon cha'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dpung chen shugs 'chang dpa' bo'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: legs dgu mdzes ldan bu tsha'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: sman btsun rgyan bzang bu mo'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes mna' mi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: 'dod rgu bum bzang bang mdzod g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: kun ldan grangs 'phel 'bru yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: bcud chags khyon ldan zhing gi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: lhun mtho rmang rgyas mkhar gyi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: bang mgyogs shugs 'chang rta yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: zal mo zho 'phel 'bri yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ru khyung pho mo mdzo yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: dpung bzang 'gros ldan dre'u g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig:

'jam legs gos bzang lug gi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: tse tse dbyangs snyan ra yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: mgrin bzang dbyig ldan bong bu'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: ngar snyan 'dod 'jo ba glang g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: bya ra 'phrag bzang khyi yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: gzhan yang 'dzam gling gdod ma'i khyon: srid dang de srid ma lus kyi: dpal dang phun sum ci tshogs rnams: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig: khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye: hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: kha skong du phul ba: hūm̐: g.yang dgu pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod/ /g.yang dgu pa 'khor 'das? de nas srung 'dzugs pa ni: phye mar yon bdag rnams kyi spyi bor cung zad re brgyan zhing : sgo phyi lam du g.yang rta bzhag la bsdam: kyaiḥ rgyu 'byor yon gyi bdag po la: de ring phywa g.yang 'di ltar bsdam: pho sa dgra lha'i gdan khri la: skyes pa rnams kyi g.yang rten 'dzugs: rang rang dkor cha'i rta bsdam pa: go khrab mtshon cha sna tshogs dang : lhab lhub ru mtshon phyar dar rnams: pho lha rnams la rten du 'dzugs: g.yang phywa ri la ma bros shig: gal te g.yang phywa nyams srid na: dgra lha'i stag gdong ma stongs shig: de nas sbyin bdag pho mo thams cad dang : chu ra ran 'thag go khrab khang pa'i ka gdung sogs kun la so so bzhin srung btsugs: kyaiḥ mo sa srid pa'i gdan khri la: bud med rnams kyi g.yang rten 'dzugs: rang rang dkor cha'i rta bsdam pa: gser g.yu dar zab sna tshogs dang : rin chen du ma phud sku yis: ma lha rnams la rten 'dzugs so: g.yang phywa gcal du ma 'bros shig: gal te g.yang phywa nyams srid kyang :

pad+ma'i srid phywa ma skam cig: kyaiḥ rang sa bu tsha'i gdan khri la: bu pho bu mo'i g.yang rten 'dzugs: rang rang dkor cha rta bsdam pa: mda' dar rin chen sna lnga dang : dbang thang rgya ma'i tsakra yis: chung rgyud rnams la rten 'dzugs so: g.yang sa rmangs su ma 'khyams shig: gal te g.yang phywa nyams srid kyang : tsha bo tsha mo'i rgyan ma yal: kyaiḥ nang lha phyug mo'i gdan khri ru: thab lha rnams kyi g.yang rten 'dzugs: rang rang dkor cha'i rta bsdam pa: bskyor po zangs dkar lung bzang dang : mkho ba'i rgyan sogs ka cha yi: nang srung lha la rten 'dzugs so: g.yang phywa dbul su ma 'khyams shig: gal te g.yang phywa nyams srid kyang : chu ra ran 'thag ma 'thor cig: grong gi phyogs bzhir srung btsugs: kyaiḥ pho brang so so'i gdan khri ni: sa bdag lto 'phye chen po yis: gser gyi ka ba kha ma gter: dkyil kar lha la srung 'dzugs so: nam mkha'i khyab 'jug sgra gcan gyis: g.yu yi gdung ma sked ma bcag: bar gyi dus 'dzin rgyu skar gyis: mu men dral lcam phyal ma gtor: shar gyi dung sgo dkar po nas: rgya stag khra bo kha ma gdang : lho yi gser sgo ser po nas: g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i mjug ma dril: nub kyi zangs sgo dmar po nas: me bya dmar mo'i gshog ma rdeb: byang gi g.yu sgo sngon po nas: rus sbal rgya bo'i skad ma bsgrag: steng gi gnam sgo bcu gsum nas: bya khyung mchu dang sder ma bgrad: 'og gi sa sgo bcu gsum nas: dur phag nag po ro ma 'khun: shar lho shel gyi sgo mo nas: mi pho dkar po'i shag ma stong : lho nub byi ru'i sgo mo nas: zangs kyi khyi dmar skad ma grags: nub byang mthing gi sgo mo nas: spre'u ser po'i gar ma 'khrab: byang shar mchong gi sgo mo nas: gnyan gyi nya dkar mtsho ma dkrug: kyaiḥ gzhan yang phywa g.yang khyon 'dzin pa: mes po mi bo dbu dkar la: lo brgya thub pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: ma phyi mtsho mo lhun ldan la:

ston brgya mthong ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: lha bu gser gyi thor tsugs la: dpal dang 'byor pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: bu mo g.yu yi lan phran la: srid kyi rgyud 'dzin phywa rten 'dzugs: pho brang bkra shis ling dgu la: rdo rje srog mkhar phywa rten 'dzugs: kyaiḥ gzhan yang phywa yi rten 'dzugs pa: rgya chen gnam bzhin phywa rten 'dzugs: lhun 'thug ri bzhin phywa rten 'dzugs: mun gsal nyi bzhin phywa rten 'dzugs: rab dkar zla ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: grangs mang skar ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: stobs ldan rlung ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: dpal skyed me ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: rgyun chags mtsho ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: mi zad chu ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: 'bru phyur shing ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: bcud smin rtsi ltar phywa rten 'dzugs: kyaiḥ gzhan yang phywa rten 'dzugs pa ni: 'brug ltar grags pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: khyung ltar lding ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: seng ltar 'gying ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: stag ltar rngam pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: dom ltar 'phyo ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: gzig ltar 'gyu ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: dred ltar dpa' ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: sbrul ltar 'khyil ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: chu ltar 'brub pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: gangs ltar 'phyur ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: mtsho ltar mer ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i phywa rten 'dzugs: sprin ltar gtibs pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: char ltar 'bebs pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: 'bru ltar smin pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: rtsi ltar rgyas pa'i phywa rten 'dzugs: phywa g.yang rten mkhar gyen du bstod: kyaiḥ da ni phywa g.yang rta bsdam pa: rgya gar rgyal po'i chos g.yang shog: rgya nag rgyal po'i khrims g.yang shog: tho gar dmag gi dpa' g.yang shog: stag gzig rgyal po'i nor g.yang shog: kha khra mon gyi 'bru g.yang shog: drang srong rnams kyi tshe g.yang shog: sku rgyal bod kyi che g.yang shog:

'khor los bsgyur ba'i che g.yang shog: kyaiḥ srid pa gsum gyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: steng phyogs lha yi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: 'og phyogs klu yi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: bar phyogs gnyan gyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: sa yul lung pa'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: lung pa chu 'dus g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: 'gyu ba rlung zin g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: du ba rtse sprod g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: grong khyer so so'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: ljongs kyi khyim mtshes g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: pha spun nang nye'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: bu tsha mag pa'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: bu mo phar 'gro'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: mna' ma tshur yong g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: rta glang ma he'i g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: go khrab rgyan gyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: gser g.yu rin chen g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: 'jam dar gos kyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: 'bru mchog rdzas kyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: longs spyod srid kyi g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: ka cha sna tshogs g.yang len nas: rin chen mdzod la g.yang rta bsdam: phywa yi rten mkhar rgya ma nyams: klu mo'i gtor ma mdun du bzhag /dge bsnyen gtor ma phyi sgor mtshams su gnyer gtad bya/ kyaiḥ bkra shis dang po rgyal mtshan gcig: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: gser nya rin chen bkra shis gnyis: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo:

chos dung g.yas 'khyil bkra shis gsum: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: dri med pad+ma bkra shis bzhi: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: lhun grub bum pa bkra shis lnga: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: yid 'jo dpal be'u bkra shis drug: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: mkha' yi gdugs mchog bkra shis bdun: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: rtsibs stong 'khor lo bkra shis brgyad: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: mi shigs g.yung drung bkra shis dgu: phywa g.yang brtan par rgyas gdab bo: mi chod mi shigs rgyas gdab bo: sgo lha stag g.yag mtshams su ni: 'byung po zhugs pa'i go skabs med: de nas bsrung zhing rgyas gdab bo: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ni dhi shwa ra tsakra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes pas bang mdzod dam: g.yang rta gang du bsdam pa'i de khar rta bzhag: sgo'am bum pa g.yang sgye'am gang rung de kha la rgyas btab: zhag gsum bdun nam gsum mam tshun chad la longs spyod dkor chas gang yang mi la mi sbyin: g.yang 'gugs skabs su mi mthun pa'i tshig mi smra: rten 'brel shin tu che legs par gsungs: khyad par 'di nyid brtsam pa'i tshe: yugs sa mo'i zas dang gos nag grogs mi gtsang ba grib can rnams la shin tu 'dzem: gong gi gzhung tshig so so'i skabs su phywa g.yang yang 'bod: gzhan yang yul gru so so'i byed spyod ltar la rang gzhung ma bslad pa'i phyag len mdzad pa dang : 'di nyid longs spyod mnga' 'bang yid kyi byed pa'i rtsis yin pas: dam med dam dbul po sdig can rnams sam: byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod cing mchod gnas gtang rag gi yon mi 'dod pa rnams la bstan par mi bya: 'di yi dkyil 'khor gyi phrin las tshar gcig btang ba'i bsod nams ni bgrangs pas kyang mi long zhing : brjod kyang mi nus so: de phyir gang zhe na: yon gser srang gang ma byung sar zhal kha mi phye: sngon rje btsun rin po che la gdams pa zhus pa'i tshe:

gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dong tse dgu phrugs la: rin chen sna tshogs kyi phra bkod te lan mang du zhus nas bka' rgya dam par dang bcas nas gnang ba'o: de nas phyis 'byung gi slob ma nyams len rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gnas so: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ྀatsha: e maḥ kun 'dus snying po bcud kyi yang tig las: rin chen bang mdzod man ngag ti la ka: bla med zab rgya'i gdams pa phul byung 'di: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ྀatsha: lcags byi lor dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha'i lag nas o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas gdan drangs shing me rta lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so// //
