za)nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yi: g.yang 'gugs srid gsum dbang sdud bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: pad+ma rgyal po dbang sdud nor bdag bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin nas: phywa g.yang dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: g.yang rdzas rnams kun gyi lag tu bzhag cing : sgrub pa po'i phyag tu lcags kyu dang ne'u le mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: steng phyogs dag pa ye shes 'phrul gyi dbyings: klong lnga sna tshogs rgyas pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba sangs rgyas byang sems kyi: byin rlabs rgya mtshos sgrub rgyud smin mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: ka dag rtsal snang cho rol longs sku'i mkha': zer thag thod rgal gshis lugs khregs chod g.yang : gnas lugs tshogs gnyis mngon sum smin mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: kun bzang mkha' la 'dod rgu shar ba'i lha: bskyed rim snang gzugs yi dam dngos grub mchog: snang ngor 'dod rgu 'byung zhing spel mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: mthu stobs myur 'byin mkha' la lam lam 'gro: dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki rten 'brel 'khor lo mdzes: gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin brda bzhi'i grogs mdzad ma: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: longs spyod mnga' bdag mi dbang 'khor los sgyur: legs par rgyas mdzad mi dbang gter gyi bdag: dgos 'dod dpal 'byor klong du gter mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: dam tshig las la rgyud bskul sha khrag rngam: dregs sde pho nyas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: mngon spyod las bzhi thogs med sgrub mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: las 'phro can la zab gter dngos su bstan: skal ldan chos bdag legs lam mngon mtho ba: shog ser rnam lnga'i brda bzhi ston mdzad pa: khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig:

gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: dngos grub rmad byung gtor ma g.yang zhag 'khyil: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: sman raka thogs la: hūm̐: dkar dmar bde chen dbu ma'i rgyun 'byung mchog: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: g.yung drung thogs la: hūm̐: g.yang rten mi 'gyur g.yung drung dbyings kyi mkha': de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: de nas mar thud phrom thogs la: hūm̐: zla rgyas zla phrom longs spyod g.yang gi rten: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: g.yag lug ra gsum g.yang rten thogs la: hūm̐: g.yag lug ra sogs 'dod 'jo'i rma g.yang mchog: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: rin chen sna lnga thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen sna lnga yid 'ong nam mkha'i mdzod: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: de nas 'bru sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: 'bru bcud sna tshogs til gyi gang bu'i gter: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: de nas g.yang bal thogs la: hūm̐: 'jam legs sna lnga'i tshon ltar mdzes pa yi: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: de nas g.yang bshos thogs la: hūm̐: bden gnyis zung 'jug spel ba'i bcud ldan pa: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: g.yang rten 'khor lo thogs la: hūm̐: klong lnga'i gter khyim srub cing srid spel ba: de ring skal ldan bdag gis g.yang du len: g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs:

de nas dam tshig rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: mi 'gyur dbyings kyi rdo rje rgyas gdab bo: kun nas glo ba pad+ma'i mkha' ru sdud: bsrub cing srid pa'i rig pa rol pa'i rtsal: kun nas kun tu bzung zhing rgyas btab bo: hūm̐: g.yang phywa 'od skor kyi li li: srid phywa dpal 'byor me re re: rten phywa 'dod rgu chi li li: snyan phywa 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: byin rlabs snyan grags 'byor rgyas shog: phywa khu g.yang khu ye hu ye g.yang sdud do: zhes rim bzhin g.yang rten rdzas rnams rten du gzug cing zhag bdun du g.yang rta bsdam zhing slad nas gcig bskyar to: e ma kho bo pad+ma nga : nor lha ltar du sgrub pa'i thabs: man ngag bcu gsum snying thig rje: phyi rabs bu yi don du bzhag: pre ta'i dbul phongs sel ba dang : nor sgrub snying thig-i atsha rgya: ma 'ongs yang mtha' sum cu'i kha dar dus: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sprod cig dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul rgyal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya'i lor hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga nyin khrom sum brgya skor dang bcas te dge bsnyen mtsho nas khrom gter du bgyis pa sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi byang sgor rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang nye bar mtshungs pa'i ska gnam sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang pad+ma mngon dga'i yang rtse ru shog ser zheng sor bzhi dkyus mdzub gang ba gsum za hor singha'i yi ger 'dug pa bod yig tu bsgyur zhing legs par spel/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // 'a) bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las: drag po kā la yak+sha'i las mtha' bzlog pa dug gi spu gri nyi zla kha sbyor gnam lcags ur mo bzhugs so: bdag 'dra gar dbang pad+ma thod phreng gis: mtha' bzhi'i g.yul bzlog bdud dpung rab gzhom phyir: drag sngags nag po snying gi spu gri 'di: dam nyams log lta snying la snying trum bstan:

thaḥzab rgya: khyad par du yang las bskul rdo rje'i thog mda' 'di ni: shin tu bka' gnyan gar thod du btang mi rung : 'di ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i sa mtshams pa las bskul ba yin pas: 'di yi mi bzlog gang yang med: ces: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sogs dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: 'di bzlog zor 'phyong rnams sbrel ba gnam lcags thog rgod dang mtshungs te: snang srid kyi bdud rigs thams cad skad cig gis 'joms par gdon mi za ba'o: snying la chongs shig: bstan 'gro don du spyod cig: sgrubs shig spel cig: 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po'i bstan pa spel cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas zor la sman raka bran: rnga rdung dung 'bud dar nag g.yab cing drag po'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: rngam brjid stobs ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ snang srid dregs pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs: drag po khros pa'i zil gnon kā la che: snang srid bran du bkol phyir bzhengs pa'i tshe: ri rab 'jig cing gling bzhi nyi li li: khrag zhag rgya mtsho rba klong lhabs se lhab: nyi zla gza' skar thog mda' sha ra ra: cho 'phrul snang stong 'brug sgra di ri ri: tsha grangs gnam lcags ser ba hri li li: nad sprin smug nag bu yug thibs se thib: las rlung dmar nag shwa rbud 'u ru ru: gzugs can gzugs med 'o dod lhangs se lhang : las byed shan pa gri thogs rangs se rang : bdud kyi dgra 'dzin zhags pa khyugs se khyug: btsan gyi jag rgyug shwa kha tha ra ra: sgrol ging dkar nag gri thogs zangs se zang : ma mo'i nad yams bu yug thibs se thib: klu bdud dug gi zor mda' lams se lam: cai spyang sha za 'dur rgyug chems se chem: srid gzhi'i dmag tshogs ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: bka' yi las byed bswo sgra di ri ri:

las la bzhengs shig rngam brjid kī la ya: do nub drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: go cha'i rgyan bskul ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab yul: laṅka bsgral phyir srin po'i pho brang nas: thod mkhar ri ltar brtsegs pa'i khri steng du: dpal chen 'bar ba srin po'i g.yul las rgyal: dbu skra dmar ser bsigs pas stong gsum g.yo: thod skam dbyings nas khro chung dmag tshogs 'gyed: sbrul chun g.yos pas klu bdud bran du khol: smin ma me 'bar rgyal 'gong dam sri sreg: ljags dmar glog 'khyugs srid gsum g.yo zhing 'gul: mche ba gtsigs pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon: shangs nas dug rlangs bgegs dpung thal bar rlog: sku yi phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: dpral bar sku yi dmag tshogs 'jam dpal 'gyed: yang sprul gshin rjes stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong nag po lcags khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: nag po gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: ljags dmar srid gsum bar snang tshwa tshwa khol: mche gtsigs drag pos dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: zhal nas hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri phyar ba las: hūm̐ dgu phaṭ dgu ram̐ dgus mtha' dmag zlog: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bu bsgril ba las: bh+yo dgu rbad dgu bzlog dgus byad ma sgrol: gsung gi phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod phrin las drag po'i dus la bab: hūm̐: mgrin par gsung gi dmag tshogs rta mgrin 'gyed: yang sprul dbang phyug nyi shus stong gsum gang :

nyi khri bdun stong dmar po zangs khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: dmar po dbang phyug dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: glang ko zhing lpags gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms: dur khrod rus rgyan dregs pa las la bskul: sgeg cing brjid pas ma mo dbang du sdud: thugs rje phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: thugs kar thugs kyi dmag tshogs phyag rdor 'gyed: yang sprul khro bo'i dmag tshogs stong gsum gang : nyi khri bdun stong sngon po g.yu khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: mthing nag ral gri'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: spyan mig stong nas drag po'i dmag tshogs bskul: rdo rje'i go khrab srid gsum g.yul las rgyal: yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: lte bar yon tan dmag tshogs khro mo 'gyed: yang sprul shan pas stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong ser po gser khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: las kyi ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ti shwa ri dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: dregs pa tshar gcod glang ko zhing lpags brgyan: srog la rngam byed zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: zhabs gnyis dam sri pho mo'i snying rtsa 'gems: sbrul rigs brgyan pas sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul:

rdo rje drag po'i gar dgu he ru kaḥ gnam lcags dbal ldan bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: stobs ldan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: 'gong po dbul sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gson 'dre pho mo 'dul ba'i dus la bab: che sri chung sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgas sri gzhon sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: god sri bse rag 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rmangs 'dre rmugs 'dre 'dul ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mi mthun bar gcod zhi ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo che btsan mthu ma chung : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ yak+sha kā la dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing drag po las la chas par bsam: de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad drag po'i mngon spyod las la chas te: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad yongs su gang nas: dgra bo'i yul du mtshon cha drag po'i char phab ste ming shul med par mdzad par bsam: kho yi sha khrag dbang po rnams: las mkhan pho nya dregs pa rnams kyis lhag ma med par dpa' zas su rol te: slar yang mi ldang bro brdungs te: dgra bo'i yul du zhing khang nor rdzas bcas kyang las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas srid pa'i ri rab mgo mjug ldog nas zhing rdul dang drag po'i rlung gis nye ba'i sprin gtor ba ltar byas par mos so: de nas gser skyems gtong ba ni: 'bru gro rin chen brdar ba'i phye ma la: yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin byin gyis rlobs: ma nyes dpang btsugs thugs dam rgyud nas bskul: dbyangs chung yi chad lta bu'i tshig gis brjod: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dgongs shig dgongs shig bde gshegs rgya mtsho dgongs: las la grub cig phrin las mthu ma chung :

ma nyes dpang por bzhugs pa'i mthu ldan lha: bdag ni bskyed rdzogs don gyi rnal 'byor pa: thar pa sgrub cing 'gro don byed bsams kyang : bdud dgra 'byung pos byed du ma ster bas: ye shes spyan ldan gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la dpang du btsugs: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral phyir dpung la bzhengs: gang la gnas pa'i seng lcam dkar mo la: dur khrod wa spyang ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: che rtags sku la g.yu ral rgyan byas nas: rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa'i don ma chung : ye shes spyan ldan gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la dpang du btsugs: dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul phyir las la bzhengs: dbyings la gnas pa'i nyi ma zla ba la: phrag dog sgra gcan 'dzin pas brnyas btsugs so: che rtags sku las 'od zer 'phros byas nas: 'jig rten gling bzhir khyab pa don ma chung : ye shes spyan ldan gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dbyings kyi ye shes lha rnams dpung la bzhengs: bar snang gnas pa'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo la: ltas ngan sbrang bu ser pos brnyas btsugs so: che rtags sku la glog gi rgyan byas nas: stong gsum sgra yis bkang ba don ma chung : mthu ldan ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: ye shes spyan ldan gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la dpang du btsugs: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral phyir dmag la bzhengs: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma kā ra la: mtha' 'khob rgyal 'gong ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: che rtags sku la snyan zhu gsol byed nas:

rgyal khrims tshul bzhin skyong ba don ma chung : ye shes spyan ldan gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: ma gnong ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la dpang du btsugs: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral phyir las la bzhengs: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang grub thob rgya mtsho la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yis brnyas btsugs so: che rtags sku la sngags chas spras pa yis: sngags chos bzhin du bsgrub pa don ma chung : dam can chos skyong gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: yi dam lha rnams dbyings nas dmag la bzhengs: rin chen gtsang ma'i phud dang dkar gtor sogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs gdug pa byad ma'i snying phyungs la: mthu ldan ye shes srung ma khyed rnams kyis: dam nyams rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba lo ka dharma pā la bhū mi pa ti i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes bskul zor dang gser skyems rim pa ltar 'bul: mdun du lcags snod nang du ming byang bzhag la 'di skad do: hom khung bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du 'chi bdag nag po'i dbal khang dmar la rngam pa: kha dog la gting zab pa: zin nas thar med gshin rje'i btson khang nag po: klu dang sa bdag ma mo rgyal po rnams kyi gshar lam du: dam nyams pa'i byad ma lus mya ngan bu ga dgu nas khrag rnag chu ser ru gdol ba: nyam thag pa'i nyon mongs kyi ngu 'bod 'o dod brang rdung tsi ri ri 'bod pa yan lag rnams: gshin rje'i lcags sgrog gis bsdams nas 'bros dbang med par gyur: ༈ 'gugs pa ni: na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden? dge 'dun gyi bka'? gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang :

khyad par che mchog rdo rje drag po thod phreng rtsal: sku 'jam dpal: gsung rta mgrin: thugs phyag na rdo rje yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga: sprul pa yak+ṣa me dbal: stobs ldan lcags sdig nag po: drag po rigs bzhi: ye shes kyi khro bo bcu: bka' yi 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dang bcas pa: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul: bka' srung bdud btsan klu gsum: gter srung nā ga rak+sha la sogs srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bdag cag dpon slob mi nor bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po log par 'dren pa'i bdud dang dam sri: khyad par che sri chung sri rgas sri gzhon sri dar sri dur sri phung sri 'gong po bse rag dbul sri pho gdon mo gdon gre bo gre mo: za 'dre shi gshed la sogs: tshe dang bsod nams la bar du gcod pa'i bdud lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rigs byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu: blo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad: la sogs pa gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis 'gugs/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams: de dag bden tshig drag po'i 'di ltar ro: spyi dgra sgos dgra zur dgra thad kyi dgra: khyad par rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po dang : gson 'dre shi 'dre pho gdon mo gdon dang : sgab 'dre yul 'dre mi kha pho mo rnams: bse rag chung sri rmangs 'dre gre pho mo: dmag 'jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren mi kha bsdongs: kha yog skur 'debs ngos bstod lkog nas smad: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren dang : bsam ngan sbyor rtsub ban bon gdug pa'i rigs:

mnan bsad gtad khram gzhan mthu bskul ba dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog cing srog la sdang : byams med srog 'tshe chags med bu lon bsnyags: lam nas sgug cing dgra gshom gnod byed rigs: da lta nyid du gzugs ling 'di la khug: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i dus la bab: srog bdag gnod sbyin sde bzhi'i dus la bab: las mkhan ma mo rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: klu bdud bdud po ging dmar dus la bab: dge bsnyen yak+sha khrag ral dus la bab: gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo'i dus la bab: shan pa btsan rgod sde bzhi'i dus la bab: yang 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dus la bab: las byed pho nya dmag tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: dam can chos skyong myur mgyogs las la bzhengs: dam nyams dgra bgegs gling bzhi gar gnas kyang : shwa ltar bros kyang khyi ltar ded nas shog: lug ltar bros kyang spyang ltar ded la shog: nya ltar bros kyang sram ltar ded la shog: byi'u ltar bros kyang khra ltar ded la shog: sha rtsas lag dmar ded pa ci bzhin du: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la myur du khug: bskrad cing gzir ba myos pa'i rang bzhin du: da lta nyid du dmigs byang 'di la khug: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ stims shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra baṃ: khug cig sgrol cig badz+ra hoḥ zhes 'gugs gzhug yang yang bzlog cing lha dbye ba ni: lha dbye'i rdzas bdug: bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro thogs nas: hūm̐: sgrol ging sde bzhi'i dus la bab: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : phyag na gtor byed spu gri 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo skyabs pa'i lha dang phyes: srung skyob ban bon lha dang da phyes shig: srog gcod 'chi bdag lag tu da sprod cig: 'joms byed las kyi pho nya'i dus la bab: gsod byed bdud po ri ti'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo 'chi bdag lag tu sprod: dus la bab bo las byed mthu ma chung : g.yas su pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes:

g.yon du dgra lha yul lha skyes lha phyes: rgyab tu ban bon byad ma'i mgon skyabs lha srung rnams: bshig gtor bsregs shing rang rang gnas su phyes: dam nyams bdud dang sprod cig phrin las mdzod: ces dud pa bdug cing thun gyis brab pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po shwa ri raṃ: lha rnams yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: nyungs dkar khro bo nyi khri stong : drag sngags tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'phros: me thun tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: chu thun mdze nad thibs se thib: nad kyi na bun thu lu lu: nyungs thun drag sngags sha ra ra: rdo thun rbab rgod nyi li li: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bo myos shing 'bog par gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: oṃ e thun: yak+ṣa du ru badz+ra yak+ṣa shi tri dgra bo byad ma thun thun: mā ra ya bshig gtor rbad rbad: drag sngags thun gyis brab nas dgra bo'i yul zhing phye mar gtor bar bsam: de nas bsgral ba ni: phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: sras mchog las kyi dbal phur 'di: mgo bo rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : 'chang bzung sde brgyad rgyu ba'i yul: chu srin pho nya 'tshogs pa'i gnas: dbal zur shan pa rgyug pa'i lam: ldog med yin pas mthu ma chung : bsrung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor: bzlog phyir sked par lan gsum bskor: byad ma dam nyams las ngan 'di: rnam shes chos dbyings spar ba'i phyir: dbang po lnga la kī la ya: gti mug rigs rgyud kī la ya: zhe sdang pho la kī la ya: 'dod chags mo la kī la ya: dgra bo yul zhing kī la ya: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: da lta nyid du bsgral bar mdzod: rnam shes spar ba ni: dmigs med chos dbyings ngang du: phaṭḥ dam nyams las ngan khyod kyi sdig 'phro ngan pa de ring nas chod pa yin pas: sngar byas las zad cing byed thabs med pas khyod kyi rnam par shes pa de yi ge a dkar po gcig tu gyur nas phur pa'i khong seng nas thon te snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar 'phos shig:

dag par bskyed la dgongs pa zungs shig: ces nan tan du dmigs pa bya: de nas ral gris gtub cing bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: yak+sha kā la skar ltar 'khrugs: phyag g.yas ral gri rdo rje thogs: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bu bsgril: byad ma bsgral ba'i gnyen po che: chung sri 'gong po lan chags rnams: mgo snying nang rol phye mar gtor: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: oṃ yak+sha kā la dgra bo byad ma'i snying srog la hab sha rus truṃ sha ya rbad rbad: oṃ yak+sha du ru dgra bo'i srog la thun hril rbad rbad: ces bzlas shing dum bur gtub: de bzhin zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: kā la yak+sha mngon spyod mthu bo che: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno ngar mche gtsigs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung po lhag med gsol cig kha raṃ khā hi: dgra bgegs byad ma'i dbang po rnam lnga la kha kha khā hi: zhes 'bul lo: rtsang bzlog dug gsum sgrol byed bdud 'joms snying gzir nag po bya ba ni: rtsang rnams ye shes kyi pho nya las byed dregs pa'i dmag tshogs: tsha zhing ngar ba rno zhing myur ba stong gsum thams cad gang zhing mtha' dmag nad mtshon rims yams 'byung bzhi la sogs brlag cing dmigs med chen por bsgom: rtsang rnams sman raka gis bran zhing rol mo rngam brjid dang bcas pas: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba e yi klong : pho nya las mkhan 'tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: che btsan pho nya las mkhan gshegs su gsol: myur mgyogs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad kha dmod tshig bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo chos dbyings mkha' la sleb: mar gyi rtse mo ngan song gnas su brjid: sked pa rgya mdud sku lnga lhun gyis grub: yar gyi rtse la rig 'dzin spungs se spung : mar rtse 'gro drug thar lam sha ra ra:

rgya mdud gnyis med gsal stong khro lo lo: dug lnga bsgral ba'i chos nyid rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa'i snying la thob: rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtse mo me ri wa la la: pha tshogs yab kyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: mar gyi rtse mor mun nag thibs se thib: ma tshogs yum gyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: sked pa rgya mdud dug rlangs chi li li: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal yams dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo la: srid pa'i dmag tshogs ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : gdug pa'i rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo la: 'dre bya sreg pa'i skad ngan tsi ri ri: sked pa rgya mdud glog dmar khyugs se khyug: zor thun shan pa gri thogs zings se zing : rtsang phur dgra bgegs sha khrag ljib ljib za: las byed pho nyas rus pa khrum khrum rol: dam nyams srog la rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: bka' 'gal dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la thob: lo zla dus su ma 'da' myur du sgrol: khyad par dmag sna jag sna ston pa dang : rkun sna ston cing sngon sgug rgyab 'ded byed: bar chad glo bur ye 'drog than ltas rigs: myur mgyogs pho nya rtsang gis sgrol bar byed: dus la bab bo pho nya rtsang gi dmag: dam nyams dgra la thog mda' char ltar phob: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo dgra la chos: bzlog bzlog dgra la zlog: ban byad ban la bh+yoḥ bon byad bon la bh+yoḥ byad ma rang gshed rang la phob cig: gnod pa'i bdud du phob cig: thal ba rdul du rlog cig: mā ra ya byad ma gdug pa'i snying la sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ yul zhing lha dang bcas pa thams cad thul cig: ha la ha la dun du dun du yaṃ yaṃ shig shig gtor gtor rjes shul med par mdzod cig rbad rbad: ces khrag mchod phul zhing : rtsang la gnas pa'i pho nya rnams sra ba'i go gyon: rno ba'i mtshon thogs nas bzlog bsad kyi las byed par bsam:

de nas zlog byang gshin rje myos byed ni: zlog byed drag po'i dmag tshogs thams cad zhal phyir gzigs nas: mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi bu yug dbab cing nad gdon rkyen ngan thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bzlog par bsam pas: rnga rdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran la 'di skad do: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : lha dbang tshangs pa brgya byin gyis: drag po dmar nag zur gsum bzhengs: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gnam lcags ngar ma'i rtsang gis brgyan: 'dod chags khrag sna dgu yis bran: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: gdug pa'i dug mda' sna dgus brgyan: drag sngags zor chen gtab pa'i tshe: bden tshig 'grub pa'i dmod pa phyung : gdug pa'i lha min dmag tshogs gum: rtags mngon dang po de bzhin du: de ring drag sngags dgra la bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: chag chen nyam nga thams cad zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar chos rgyal mu stegs gnyis: brtsad nas chos rgyal pham pa las: slob dpon shān+tiṃ spyan drangs pas: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po rtsang gis brgyan: zhe sdang sgrol ba'i khrag rnams bran: rig sngags 'dus pa'i thod rnga brdungs: phrag dog bsgral phyir zor mdos brgyan: dmod pa'i rig sngags gtab pa'i tshe: bden tshig grub pa'i rtags phyungs nas: mu stegs dmag tshogs khrag bskyugs gum: bdud sprul reg chod de nas byung : do nub drag po'i las la bskul: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: chag chen nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: de nas bzlog pa'i gzhung bstan pa ni: rak+tas bran zhing drag po'i rnga rol sbir: hūm̐: mthing nag e las grub pa'i klong dkyil nas: lha srin dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du:

lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: che btsan khros pa'i dkyil 'khor khro bo'i tshogs: bzhengs shig dur khrod chen po'i dbus nas bzhengs: do nub bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: dus la ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: yang dag dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ sku mdog dmar nag dbang drag rgyas pa'i zhal: ma rungs bdud sde 'joms phyir skur bzhengs la: de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa dmar ba yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha bzlog tu gsol: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: ma rigs srid pa'i lus ngan bzlog tu gsol: snyan la drag po'i wang long brgyan pa yis: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun ma bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri phyar ba yis: srid pa las kyi g.yul 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bu gdeng ba yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po ma rungs bzlog tu gsol: rus rgyan ga shal sbrul lnga'i chings brgyan gyis: gza' klu the'u rang smyo 'bog bzlog tu gsol: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brgyan pa yis: snang sring gdug rtsub ban bon sngags zor zlog: zhabs gnyis dam sri pho mo brdzis pa yis: gson 'dre pho mo'i bram mchu bzlog tu gsol: ya mān+ta ka 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku la bar du gcod pa bzlog tu gsol: h+ya ghṛ wa rta mgrin dbang gi lhas: gsung la bar du gcod pa bzlog tu gsol: badz+ra pā ṇi phyag rdor thugs kyi sras: thugs la bar du gcod pa bzlog tu gsol: badz+ra yo gi mngon spyod ldan pa'i skus: yon tan bar du gcod pa bzlog tu gsol: yak+sha kā la las drug srid pa'i rjes: phrin las bar du gcod pa bzlog tu gsol: shar phyogs khro bo badz+ra he ru kaḥ rdo rje drag pos dri za'i gdon tshogs zlog:

lho phyogs khro bo rat+na he ru kaḥ rat+na drag pos gshin rje'i gdon tshogs zlog: nub phyogs khro bo pad+ma he ru kaḥ pad+ma drag pos klu dbang gdon tshogs zlog: byang phyogs khro bo karma he ru kaḥ karma drag pos gnod sbyin gdon tshogs zlog: shar lho khro mo badz+ra kro ti yum: badz+ra kro tis me lha'i gdon tshogs zlog: lho nub khro mo rat+na kro ti yum: rat+na kro tis srin po'i gdon tshogs zlog: nub byang khro mo pad+ma kro ti yum: pad+ma kro tis rlung lha'i gdon tshogs zlog: byang shar khro mo karma kro ti yum: karma kro tis dbang ldan gdon tshogs zlog: steng phyogs khro bo bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ mkha' lding rgyal pos lha yi gdon tshogs zlog: 'og phyogs pho nya rngam byed sdig gdong ma: sdig gdong klu gdon sa bdag gdon tshogs zlog: sgo bzhi'i las byed gdong can ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: phyi rol sgab 'dre dbul sri'i gdon tshogs zlog: gar dgu dpal chen me dpung rlung 'tshubs ltar: 'byung ba'i bcud nyams bar chad bzlog tu gsol: gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga yis: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho yongs rdzogs kyis: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i sde brgyad yongs rdzogs kyis: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pha tshogs yab kyi drag sngags rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: ma tshogs yum gyi dmod pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: 'khor tshogs sprul pa 'bum sde rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: lha yi bka' chad bab pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: ma mo'i nad yams 'khrug rtsod rnams:

bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gshin rje'i khram kha 'debs pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: bdud kyi shwa rdel bab pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gnod sbyin srog la rku ba rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: btsan gyi jag tu rgyug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: klu bdud gtad khram nag po rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gza' dang the'u rang gdug rtsub rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: shel ging dkar po'i smyo 'bog rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: grong rgyug 'dre mo'i 'o dod rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: shi mig gson la bgrad pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: bse rag za kha zug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: rgya gar rgya nag bsgyur gto rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mthu sgrub ngan sngags gtad khram rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: sum pa'i glang zor dug mda' rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: li yi spar sme gdan bsgos rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: sngags pa'i kong zor 'phen pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa rnams:

bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mtshams kyi byur 'dre ngan pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: rmi ltas pra rtags ngan pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: rbad 'dre rbod stong ngan pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: pha mes dur sri langs pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mi yi gyod sri sgab 'dre rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: za 'dre shi gshed gdug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: sde brgyad za kha zug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: klu yi gtad du bcug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mi kha bram mchu zug pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: mo ngan mtshan ma ngan pa rnams: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra la sgyur: zlog cig sgyur cig phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐: sarba bigh+nān byad ma dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces rtsa sngags dang bcas thun gyis brab:

bzlog 'phyong 'dir bya/ mchan/ sa ma ya: de nas srung 'khor dmigs pa ni: hūm̐: skad cig gis bdag nyid drag por gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng dmar po me yi rang bzhin 'khor zhing lus kyi nang thams cad gang : ba spu dang bu ga thams cad bya khyung nag pos gang : bsrung bya thams cad pho g.yas: mo g.yon mdun du nor rdzas: rgyab tu zhing khang thams cad tshud nas bskal pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa yak+sha kā la sarba ro ṣa na kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes sngags gang mang bzlas shing srung 'khor bsgom: mdun du khro bo rnams kyi gdan gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo: 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'khor bas: bar thams cad dgra bgegs 'byung po mngon du gsal zhing : sngags phreng bzlas pas sha khrag dmar nyi li li gtubs par bsam: oṃ kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma thams cad myog thuṃ dril bh+yoḥ rbad chum byad ma kha la shig shig: baṃ ril rbad bh+yoḥ zhes bsad sngags yang yang bzlas shing liṅga du gsum 'gugs: dmigs pa gsal la sha khrag rnams las mkhan rnams kyis gsol bar bsam: sgo dbye ba ni: gser skyems btang zhing gtum chen rngam pa'i dbyangs rol bsgrags pas 'di skad do: hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po yi: sgo ma stag gdong lcags kyu 'dzin: gser skyems bzhes la shar sgo phyes: zhi ba'i bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho phyogs gser sgo ldan pa yi: sgo ma 'ug gdong zhags pa 'dzin: gser skyems bzhes la lho sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po nas: sgo ma khwa gdong lcags sgrog 'dzin: gser skyems bzhes la nub sgo phyes: dbang gi bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po nas: sgo ma spyang gdong dril bu 'dzin: gser skyems bzhes la byang sgo phyes:

drag po'i bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang so so'i sgo skyong ma: dmag tshogs skyed la ru mtshon phyor: rdzu 'phrul dmag gi dpung gnyen mdzod: bstan dgra bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: gser skyems bzhes la rkyen ngan zlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems phyogs bzhir mchod la sgo ru dpags nas: dmar rlon g.yang gzhi'i gdan steng kha ru dkar gtor cha lnga: glud dang drag po'i zor rdzas bshams: rig sngags dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: srid pa'i dpyi ru zhabs gdan bting : thun rdzas dar phyar rus rgyan spras: gdong la ro sol dug khrag byugs: zhing chen gdan la rol stabs 'khod: rnga gling gtser nas phyi ru nan: mkhyen gsol gzu dpang gser skyems btang : 'gugs gzhug lan gsum zhal 'dren bya: dkar gtor khra tsha bya rog la: sngon gyi tha tshig dam la bzhag: dmar chen zor la dpal 'bar 'dzugs: dam can chos skyong yul lha gzhi bdag lha srin sde brgyad thams cad: sngon gyi tha tshig dran pa'i dam can bskul bas lha srin rnams bran du khol zhing dbang du bsdus te: thams cad kyi rang rang gi las byed pa dmag la chas par bsam: gdung dbyangs yi chad dang bcas nas gser skyems zor rdzas go cha lha lnga nang nas blang la 'phang : hom sbar dmigs pa phur tshugs su gdab nas gsal: rnga drag tu sbir zhing zor 'phang la: dang po zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon rang bzhin phyogs bcu rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams: rdzu 'phrul klong nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: mthu ldan dmag gi dpung bskyed dus 'dir skyed: drag shul stobs kyi pho nya deng 'dir rbad:

shan pa ging chen pho mos zor sna drongs: sde brgyad khrag 'thung 'bum gyis zor dpung skyed: srog bdag 'bum gyis dgra srog chod la shog: phrin las dus la bab bo sa ma ya: de nas zor rnams rim par bsgrigs la: sku 'jam dpal gyi zor la: hūm̐: nga ni kā la yak+sha drag po rtsal: dpral bar sku yi dmag tshogs 'jam dpal 'gyed: yang sprul gshin rjes stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong nag po lcags khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha thog mda' dgra la ya: nag po gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: gsung rta mgrin gyi zor ni: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma yak+sha drag po rtsal: mgrin par gsung gi dmag tshogs rta mgrin 'gyed: yang sprul dbang phyug nyi shus stong gsum gang : nyi khri bdun stong dmar po zangs khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: dmar mo dbang phyug dmag tshogs dgra la chos: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du zlog: oṃ h+ya gh+y-i wa dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: thugs phyag rdor zor ni: hūm̐: nga ni rat+na yak+sha drag po rtsal: thugs kar thugs kyi dmag tshogs phyag rdor 'gyed: yang sprul khro bo'i dmag tshogs stong gsum gang : nyi khri bdun stong sngon po g.yu khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: mthing nag ral gri'i dmag tshogs dgra la ya: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: yon tan khro mo'i zor ni: hūm̐: nga ni karma yak+sha drag po rtsal: lte bar yon tan dmag tshogs mkha' 'gro 'gyed: yang sprul shan pa stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong ser po gser khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya:

las kyi ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ti shwa ri byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: phrin las yak+sha me dbal gyi zor ni: hūm̐: nga ni yak+sha me dbal drag po'i sku: phrin las mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: nyi khri bdun stong gnam lcags go khrab can: dmar nag thog rgod dgra bo'i snying la ya: dam nyams gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs dang : rgyal 'gong phung sri 'gong po 'dre rgod sogs: gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang la gnod pa'i: bdud dang dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la: gnam lcags dbal gyi zor mda' dgra la ya: stobs ldan kā la yak+sha dgra la chos: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ yak+sha kā la dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thuṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag po'i las mdzad nas dgra bgegs brlags par bsam mo: hom sbar dmigs pa phur tshugs su gdab nas gsal: rnga rol drag tu sbir zhing gtor chen 'phang ba ni: hūm̐ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: lan gsum: gsan du gsol lo: lan gsum: gzigs su gsol lo: chos kyi dbyings skye 'gag med pa'i gnas: mtha' bral chos sku'i klong yangs su: kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho gsan cing dgongs su gsol: longs sku zhi khro gar dbang thig le'i klong pad+ma 'byung gnas thod phreng rtsal: rgyal ba rgya mtsho grub thob rjes 'brangs bka' bab rgya mtsho bden tshigs 'grub pa rnams dang : dbu ma phyag rdzogs lam rim gsang sngags gsar rnying dkyil 'khor rgyud sde bzhi drug mdo sde thos bsam sgom gsum rig sngags 'dzin pa rnams: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan: las mgon bya rog gdong can: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu: btsan rgod g.yu yi khrab can: rgyal po li byin chen po:

dge bsnyen yak+sha ging dmar: klu bdud nā ga rak+sha: gnod sbyin shan pa spu gri: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di: gzugs liṅga la bkod pa: ming dkar chag btab pa 'di: dang po sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: ngo log rgyab gtad byed pa: kha 'o ma las 'jam pa: snying nag mda' las rno ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: 'dzing rtsod 'khon zhing srog la 'jab pa: dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa: khyad par du che sri ri bo'i rtse nas langs pa: chung sri rgya mtsho'i mthil du langs pa: rgas sri dur sri nad sri bse rag sgab 'dre pho mo: mi kha bram mchu: nad bdag yams bdag gson 'dre shi 'dre za 'dre shi gshed 'khyams po: sku la bsdo zhing bka' la smad pa'i dam nyams dgra bo'i snying 'gas par gyis: smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: chos skyong mthu med mi srid pas: dam nyams 'di lo dang zla bar ma bzhag: zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang : dus tshod dang tshes grangs ma nor cig: tshe phyi mi dus ma 'bebs shig: las ngan pa'i mtha' ma sgul cig: dmigs pa'i dam nyams las ngan 'di: sprul pa yak+sha me dbal: stobs ldan lcags sdig nag po'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs la: dam nyams byad ma'i 'khor dang bcas: lhag ma med par zhal du bzhes shig: dgra bgegs byad ma'i ma hā māṃ rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes brjod: zlog sngags bzla zhing gtor zor 'phang : zor chen 'khor 'das stobs 'dus mtshon cha thogs: srid pa'i phur bu dang mtshon chas yul zhing gtor: ldog med gnam lcags thog ltar 'phang ba yis: nad mtshon byur dang lo nyes skag chen zhi: dgra phyogs brlag cing dbang po sha khrag rus:

las byed pho nyas rkan sgra di ri ri: slar yang zlog sngags dmod pa'i bden pa bsam: dar nag brdab cing dmod zor drag tu bya: thal mo brdeb cing ming yang med par bsam: tshul log gom pa dgu bgrod so mtshams su: tho dgu brtsegs nas bya khyung dmag tshogs bskyed: hūm̐ khroṃ: tho ni bya khyung mthing nag me 'bar dbyibs: sbrul nag zhal gsol stong gsum tshwa tshwas khengs: rngam mche gtsigs shing sder gshog brkyangs pa yis: sgab 'dre 'byung po rgyu ba'i lam chod cig: khroṃ ram̐ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas sgo drung bshal chus brtan ma skyong : gtor gzhong kha sbub dmigs pas 'gugs bstim bya: rta bro brdungs nas mched lcam zung 'brel zhing : mngon spyod drag pos zur gsum g.yon du bskor: hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje rngam byed bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i bag chags dbyings su gtor: pho brang yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong pho nyas bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang ru tra thabs kyis bsgral: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i mtshan ma zhi: bro ni ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang ye shes chen po'i gar: gsang sngags rdo rje khro bo yis: god sri dbul sri tshar yang bcad: las mkhan pho nyas bro ra ru: rgyas btab ru tra ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan nan: las gzhung gi bro brdungs nas: gtor gzhong kha yar gzed nas 'bru blugs: hūm̐: rgyal ba gcig bsdus rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : pad+ma rgyal po nor bdag dzam bha la: dbang sdud zhags pa gnod sbyin ma hā dhe: kā la yak+sha rdo rje go gyon lha: dpag med sprul pa'i mchod pa dpag yas 'bul: rten 'brel chos bzhin smon lam shugs phyung nas: sku bzhi dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku dri med rig rtsal drag po'i lha:

las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod la mched lcam nang du log nas phye mar dang skyems chang la rol ha ha'i gad mo bcas nang du log la: gtang rag mchod bstod: dngos grub len chog bzod gsol bsngo ba smon lam gzhung ltar bgyis: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: srung 'khor lha rnams mi dmigs hūm̐ gi ngang : hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu ha khog mgo sked dang : zla tshes hūm̐ bsdu mi dmigs 'ja' yal bzhin: 'dzin bral zang thal stong pa'i ngang la bzhag: hūm̐: a a āḥ zhes pas rang rtsal rang bzhin klong du bsdus: las rjes mi mngon las la bsdu bya zhing : bdag gzhan rgyun spyod tshe dpal gong 'phel zhing : mngon spyod dbal gyis bla tshe'i zer nyams pa: gso phyir tshe chog g.yang len ci 'grub bya: mngon spyod las 'grub snyan grags stobs rtsal rgyas: snyigs dus dug lngas rang rgyud 'khrul pa'i tshe: phyi nang dgra 'dre byur dang than ltas mang : nad mtshon mu ge lo nad sad ser ldang : 'dul dka' 'dul bar thugs rje sku ru shar: bdud rigs 'gong po bstan dgra tshar yang bcad: smon lam dbang gis mthu stobs nus rtsal myur: log 'dren bgegs 'joms dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: de phyir nga yi bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams: sgyid lug bag la nyal bu ma song par: bstan dang 'gro phan sems bskyed go gyon te: rten 'brel sna tshogs rgyu rkyen ci 'byor bsag: thugs rje gsum bskyed rdo rje'i mtshon cha phyor: gsang sngags dmod pas bdud dpung phye mar brlag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' gter bdag gling la sprod: zab pa'i mthar thug gsang sngags drag sngags 'di: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: chu bdag klu bdud dge bsnyen rta nag rgya: ma 'ongs las 'phro can la smon lam rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya:

sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas dge bsnyen klu yi pho brang nas gter du bzhes te: mi nub rgyal po'i ur 'gos su sprel zla'i tshes 15nas shog ser nas phab ste bcu dgu nyin par grub pa'o: gong gi gsal byed mchan bu 'debs pa po gu h+ya'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ ya) yang bzlog 'phyong ni: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pha tshogs yab kyi drag sngags zlog: ma tshogs yum gyi dmod pa zlog: 'khor tshogs sprul pa 'bum sde zlog: lha yi bka' chad bab pa zlog: ma mo'i nad yams 'khrug rtsod zlog: gshin rje'i khram kha 'debs pa zlog: bdud kyi shwa rdel bab pa zlog: gnod sbyin srog la rku ba zlog: btsan gyi jag tu rgyug pa zlog: klu bdud gtad khram nag po zlog: gza' dang the'u rang gdug rtsub zlog: shel ging dkar po'i smyo 'bog zlog: grong rgyug 'dre mo'i 'o dod zlog: shi mig gson la bgrad pa zlog: bse rag za kha zug pa zlog: rgya gar rgya nag bsgyur to zlog: mthu sgrub ngan sngags gtad khram zlog: sum pa'i glang zor dug mda' zlog: li yi spar sme gdan bgos zlog: sngags pa'i kong zor 'phen pa zlog: skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: mtshams kyi byur 'dre ngan pa zlog: rmi ltas pra rtags ngan pa zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong ngan pa zlog: pha myes dur sri langs pa zlog: mi yi gyod sri sgab 'dre zlog: za 'dre shi gshed gdug pa zlog: sde brgyad za kha zug pa zlog: klu yi gtad du bcug pa zlog: gshin rje'i dregs pa'i khram kha zlog: mi kha bram mchu zug pa zlog: mo ngan mtshan ngan dgra la zlog: zlog cig sgyur cig phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐: sarba bigh+nān byad ma dgra bgegs snying la mā ra ya rbad rbad:

bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces rtsa sngags dang bcas la thun gyis brab kyang bzlog 'phyong gzhung man ngag zhal shes ltar ro/ maṅga laṃ// kā la yak+sha'i bzlog bsdus grangs gsog ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ lho nub rnga yab khro bo rol pa'i zhing*/ /rdo rje srin rgyal rak+sha thod phreng rtsal/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir che btsan skur bzhengs shig /dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /lha srin gdug pa'i dal kha bzlog tu gsol/ /'gong po dam sri'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol/ /phung sri gri sri'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /dbul sri chung sri sri keg bzlog tu gsol/ /ltas ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go 'khrul snang ka dag ngang du zlog /bsgyur ro rtog tshogs ye shes lnga ru sgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa'ang gu h+yas u tshugs ngor sha sa dhā ras btsir ba'o// //

༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gsol 'debs nges don rab bskul bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/ pad+ma rgyal po'i brgyud 'debs la/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag cag mos blo mthun pas rab bskul nas/ /mos gus yid kyis gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub spros pa'i mtha' bral yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du snying po'i rtsal phyung nas/ /ma gyur 'dren pa'i ngo bo snang mtha' yas/ /bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis deng 'dir stsol/ /byin rlabs dbang dang nus pas bdag la skyongs/ /rang bzhin snying rje 'gags med rmad du byung*/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo spyan ras gzigs/ /'bad med 'dun pa'i gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar bdag skyongs la/ /thugs rje'i rlabs phreng sgyu ma'i gar sgyur bzhin/ /skye dgu rnams la bsod nams char chen g.yo/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'di phyi dge legs stsol/ /skad gnyis smra mchog bud+dha dz+nyā na dang*/ /sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so chos nyid mngon gyur nas/ /rang rig bla mar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun dge legs 'byin mdzad dzam+bha la/ /dbul ba'i phongs sel pad+ma rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgrub rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'dod rgus nyer len khyab par g.yo ba yis/ /rab 'khyil shin tu 'khrugs pa'i gnas kyi bdag /zla 'dzin gnyis dang klu yi dbang mo la/ /mos blos bskul nas dwang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi kun tu tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /bsod nams go 'phang mchog la gzhol bar shog /ces pad+ma rgyal po'i brgyud 'debs nges don rab bskul yongs su dge ba pad+ma badz+ra kā la hūm̐ gis gdams pa'o// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems bzhugs so//

// de nas sngon du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ e ma ho/ rgyal ba'i lung rigs bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /ston pa'i dpal stobs 'chang ba rigs brgya'i tshogs/ /rtsa gsum bla ma bsgrub par sems bskyed nas/ /gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i dkyil 'khor la/ /byang chub bar du rtag par bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i sngon 'gro 'di yang kā la badz+ra hūm̐ gis mdzad pa'o// // hūm̐/ ma gyur 'gro ba gzhan don du/ /o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag gis bsgrubs nas su/ /dbul phongs sel bar sems bskyed do/ hūm̐/ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi mchog /pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /lhun grub bde chen dbyings nas gshegs/ /bsam 'phel 'khor lo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbang phyug bdun ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang*/ /rin chen sna tshogs mu khyud bcas/ /zhing dang bcas pa'i nye zhing du/ /ma tshogs med cing 'tshogs pa dang*/ /phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa rnams/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshogs la 'bul/ /gus pas btud cing dwang ba yis/ /mi dge'i las lam gang gyur bshags/ /rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /ci srid byang chub dge ba'i tshogs/ /de srid ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ /dam pas smon lam deng 'grub shog /ces pa nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i sngon du 'gro ba 'di yang gnam lcags rdo rjes kha skong du sbyar ba'o// // dkar gtor byin rlabs ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: oṃ ā hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba la byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na khaṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal gyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga: lha chen po brgyad: klu chen po brgyad: gza' chen po brgyad: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis: 'jigs byed chen po dgu bcu rtsa lnga: khyad par gangs ti se: la phyi chu bar: mkha' spyod tsā ri: jo bo gze rgyal chen po: rong btsan gangs btsan gnyan po: sbas yul chen po bco brgyad la gnas pa'i srung ma dam can gter srung rnams dang : khyad par brag ra lha: sog ra btsan: chos 'phan klu: ti sgro sman: gtsug na rnam rgyal dkar po la sogs pa: gzhan yang yul ri dben gnas gnyan po 'di nyid la gnas pa'i srung ma dam tshig can: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i: gtsug lag chos 'khor skyong ba: rnal 'byor pa bdag la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan dam pa tshugs shig: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la i dam bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' nyan pa: tshangs pa brgya byin lha chen brgyad: dga' bo 'jog po klu chen brgyad: nyi ma la sogs gza' chen brgyad: smin drug la sogs rgyu skar brgyad: dbang chen la sogs sa bdag brgyad: li la sogs te spar kha brgyad: rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu: lo skor bcu gnyis sme ba dgu: lo rgan drug cu dus 'dzin bcas: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis la sogs pa: khyad par lha klu mthu bo che: sde dpon sum cu so gnyis dang : yul ri dben gnas skyong ba yi: bka' gter srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: rin chen gser skyems gtor ma bzhes: zhi rgyas dbang drag legs nyes kyi:

bya ba phra rags ci byas kyang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gnod 'tshe gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul: bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang : stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du khaṃ las 'dod yon glud kyi gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsum mam bdun gyis bsngos: ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ byin 'bebs bcud bsdus bzhugs so/ de nas byin 'bebs pa ni/ zhwa gos 'chor sbreng rol mo dkrol/ spos bsreg dar mtshon g.yab cing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas la*/ hūm̐: rje btsun mgon po snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs: mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma rgyal po yis: dkyil 'khor g.yang rten rdzas la byin phob cig: tshe yi dbang mo lha lcam man+da ra: chos sku yum chen jo mo mtsho rgyal mas: zas nor snyan grags 'phel ba'i byin phob cig: gtsug na nor bu'i gdengs ka klu yi rgyal: dgos 'dod mchog sbyin klu mo nor skyong mas: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub pa'i byin phob cig: shar lho nub byang 'gugs byed lha mo bzhis: rgyal chen bzhi y-i tshe bsod mnga' thang rnams: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: rnam rgyal khang bzang dgos 'dod bum pa ru: tshangs pa'i 'byor ldan tshogs pa'i bcud chags nas: dgos 'dod 'bad rtsol mi dgos lhug stsol ba'i: phywa g.yang 'dod rgu dpal 'byor byin phob cig: hūm̐: ye sngon lta bur bstan pa mtho ba dang : gser ri'i lhun ltar bsod nams rgyun chags nas: rtsi shing grangs ltar 'dod rgu lhun gyis grub: rol mtsho'i klong ltar g.yang zhag khad kyis 'khyil:

khu rlangs gtibs bzhin phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub: dbyar gyi rnga bzhin grags snyan kun tu ldir: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i byin rlabs glog bzhin myur: 'bad rtsol mi dgos thugs rjes char bzhin 'bebs: dam sri tshar gcod nus pa thog ltar 'bebs: de ltar byin rlabs shugs 'byin bsgrubs pa'i lha: deng 'dir byin rlabs dbang bskur bstsal nas su: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ma ṇi bha dra bi ru pāk+ṣā ra tsa hring hring ma ma thun thun sarba dza dzaḥ maṅga la shrī ye a dhiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: zhes rol mo dang bcas byin 'bebs par bya'o/ de ltar bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ byin 'bebs rgyas pa rin chen khang bzang las khol du phyung la gter tshig sor bzhag las cung zad bsdus pa 'di yang sgrub pa chen po'i phyi thun rnams dang spros med bsnyen sgrub skabs nyer bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas te lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid la lhag par mos pa'i gnam lcags bstan 'dzin ming gis shing sprel hor zla 11pa'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen 25la chos rgyal 'brug gi khab/ mtshan gyi che ba bkra shis g.yang rtse rdzong khungs btsan phyug 'phen dar 'dzoms pa'i btsan mkhar nang pa'i slob khang du sbyar bas rgyal bstan dar rgyas srid zhi'i blar 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // pad+ma rgyal po'i bdud rtsi lag mchod bde chen sprin phung bya ba la don lnga dang bcas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi 'phro 'du rgyud bskul ba: ka ni mtshan ldan dum cig snod mchog tu: pā ni zag med ye shes bdud rtsi lnga: la ni phyogs dus rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: don gsum kun ldan rmad byung bdud rtsi 'di: mchog dang thun mong phrin las bsgrub pa'i rten: bdud rtsis sku ni skye 'chi bgres rgud bral:

bdud rtsis gsung ni chos dbyings dgag sgrub bral: bdud rtsis thugs ni skye 'gag 'khrul 'dzin zhi: bdud rtsis yon tan rlabs chen sngags la spyod: bdud rtsis phrin las mchog thun 'bad med 'grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐: steng du bdud rtsi 'phros pas zhing khams 'gyed: bar du bdud rtsi mchod pas rtsa gsum mnyes: 'og tu bdud rtsi gtor bas dgra bgegs zhi: mtshams su bdud rtsi 'gyed pas dngos grub 'grub: 'khor yug bdud rtsi spros pas mkha' 'gro 'du: de bas byin rlabs rmad byung bla med rdzas: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrī swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: longs sku thugs rje chen po la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la: dam tshig bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: /chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol/ /gar dbang mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: lha lcam man+da ra ba la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul:

tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: nor skyong klu mo 'od sbyin la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: yang sprul rlung zhags 'gengs mdzad la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes nas kyang : sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: ghu ya sid+dhi swā: karma sid+dhi hā: zhes mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyi dbang bzhi thob par bsam: sa ma ya: zhes bdud rtsi lag mchod 'di nyid gter gzhung lha'i spyi 'gros sor bzhag bgyis pa 'di dge bshes bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas thun mtshams su sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // hūm̐: g.yang dgu pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod/ /g.yang dgu pa 'khor 'das khyon nas 'bod/ /kun bzang thog ma'i mgon po yi/ /ma byas lhun rdzogs gdod ma'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /rdor sems rigs lnga'i rtsal chen 'phrul/ /'chi med rnga sgra'i zhing rdul dpyid/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /gangs can mtsho yi pad+ma'i phrum/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mi mjed zhing*/ /bsod nams tshogs las grub pa'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /sku gsum dag pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /rtsa gsum rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i char rgyun g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig

/kun 'byung nor bu'i gzhal yas nas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin nor bdag tshogs/ /mi zad gter gyi bdag po'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /rgya gar rgya nag bal po hor/ /'dzam gling tha grur 'khod pa yi/ /dpal stobs phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig hūm̐: bstan pa mtho ba nam mkha'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /rgyud 'dzin gsal ba'i nyi zla'i g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /srid 'phel grangs mang skar tshogs g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /snyan grags kun khyab g.yu 'brug g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /dgra lha myur mgyogs glog zhags g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /mthu rtsal stobs ldan thog rgod g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /mdzes rgyan bkrag mdangs 'ja' 'od g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /sna tshogs zad med chu 'dzin g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /zab chos mtha' rgyas bar snang g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /stobs bskyed 'ja' lus rlung gi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /longs spyod rgya che sa yi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /mi rgyud grangs mang rtsi shing g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /sra mkhregs rdzong btsan lcags kyi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/

/phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /rta nor lug sogs phyugs kyi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /bang mdzod bcud rgyas 'bru yi g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /yul bzung sa 'dzin rten 'brel g.yang*/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang rten mkhar ma nyams shig /g.yang rten yon bdag rnams la bstim/ /g.yang rdzas rten 'brel snod du bskyil/ /mi nyams mi shigs rgya yis gdab/ /bskal par mi 'gyur g.yang ldan shog /ces pa g.yang dgu pa bka' bsdams su mchis pas ma tshang kha skong singhas bris pa dge legs 'phel// // oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ lo chen bud+dha dz+nyā na'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gter ston rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ drag po kā la yak+sha'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dbang sdud pad+ma rā dza'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gsang ye ḍāk+ki rnam gnyis zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ smug 'dzin dzam lha dkar po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dbang byed gzhon nu rtse gsum zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gnod sbyin tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ bka' sdod klu mo nor skyong zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/

gter srung dge bsnyen chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ kho bo rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos thun mtshams su bris pa'o// // thun mtshams mchod bstod bya ba ni/ byin rlabs byas la/ hūm̐/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin dbang gi rab skyud pa/ /o rgyan pad 'byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dpag yas mchod sprin 'bul/ /bsam 'phel dpal 'byor sbyin la bdag bstod do/ thun mtshams mchod bstod gnam lcags rdo rjes bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa gsum spyi yi me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod las dbang gi me mchod khol du phyung ba bzhugs so/ de yang dbang gi sreg blugs bya ba la/ thog mar/ gzhung las/ phyi'i 'byung khams gza' skar dus sbyor dang : nang 'byung lus kyang rgyan gos kha dog bsgyur: zhes pa phyi'i 'byung ba'i khams dang gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs dbang la shis pa'i dus tshes bzang por/ chu tshod dgong mo yi dus su kha nub tu bltas la/ sgrub pa po rgyan gos dang khri gdan stegs khebs kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba dang*/ thab dbyibs kyang*/ dbang la zla gam dmar po pad+mas mtshan: zhes thab stegs khru gang ba gzhi dmar po la ser bcad dkyil 'khor zla gam pad+ma lcags kyus mtshan pa pad phreng gis bskor ba dang*/ rdzas ni/ me dar dpal 'bar rlung g.yab ku sha mar khu yam shing sogs spyi dang*/ gzhung las/ dbang la me tog glang sna dmar po sogs: 'bru sman shing 'bras dar zab dmar po'i rigs: sin+dhu ra dang li khri mtshal dang sbyar: zhes dbang la khyad par rdzas me tog glang sna dmar po sogs me tog dmar po 'bru sman shing 'bras dar zab dmar po'i rigs sin+dhu ra dang li khri mtshal dang pad+ma rak+ta sbyar ba dang myos byed kyis sbags pa bcas 'du bya/

dmigs bsal bsgrub bya khyad par ba sogs dbang du byed na man ngag gzhan la blta bar bya'o/ mdor na rang gi g.yas su mchod rdzas g.yon du bsreg rdzas/ mdun du nang mchod rdor dril gzar blugs ḍā ma ru las bum bcas bkod/ las kyi gzhung bsrang*/ mchod bstod bsdu zhing rjes thob skad cig gis lhar ldang la/ thog mar rdor dril byin rlob ni/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ dril bu dkrol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā a nu rā ga ṇa dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ thugs kar 'khyud rgya bya la/ de nas gshegs bsdu ma grub bar rdor dril sar mi 'jog 'di man phyag len g.yon pa'i kun spyod dbang gi bzhugs tshul rgyal po rol pa'i stabs dang phyag rgya yang srin lag sgreng ba pad+ma'i rgya kho nas 'bul ba sogs bye brag phyed par bya'o/ dang po thab dang bsreg rdzas la las chus bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha was sbyang*/ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'phros pa yi: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhu ma dag dri ma sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod yangs par: oṃ las dam tshig rdzas rnams bdud rtsir rtogs: āḥhūm̐ ho yis snang srid gang bar spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ badz+ra dharma āḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: bh+rūm̐ rat+na bi shud+dheḥ.āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hos byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hāḥ rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ (g.yon du )bskor la me spar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ ag+ne ye swā hā/ mar khu lan gsum 'bul/ oṃ a pra ti ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi thab dang dam ye dbyer med kyi lha bskyed pa ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing : sor rtog ye shes na bza' dkar mo'i mkhar: ye shes sgyu ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: chu zla'i zlos gar ma 'dres rdzogs par gsal:

thab dbus bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : rin chen las grub rgyas pa'i dbyibs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs: phyi nang brtsegs rim chos tog tshang : de nang dgos 'byung rin chen khrir: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud sogs bstod pa'i bar btang*/ bye brag bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dmar rab 'phros te: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rang sngags kho nas dgang blugs dang yam shing spungs rdzas sogs go rim bzhin 'bul la/ sngags brgya re'i mtshams sogs bstun 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ rgyal ba'i mthu byin lha 'dre'i srog snying dang : che dgu gnyen bcu rgyal blon btsun mo sras: 'khor 'bangs pho mo zas nor longs spyod tshogs: 'bad med rig pa'i ngang du dbang sdud gyur: hrīḥ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sogs sbyar la grangs ma rdzogs bar bsags/ las gzhung ltar mchod pa dang mchod sngags kha phral nas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ mchod pa dang*/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: sman mchod/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta la pū dza āḥhūm̐: rak+ta dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: gtor ma bcas so sor thab la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ zhes gos zung bcas 'bul/ de nas gzhung gi bstod pa bya/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ chos nyid don la nor 'khrul mi dmigs kyang : lta dman rig pa'i 'ub tu ma chub pa'i: lha sngags ting 'dzin cho ga yo byad rdzas: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul rang gnong bzod par gsol:

yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas 'khon gcugs sbyang*/ ye shes pa gshegs*/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ mthar long khom yod na me rang zhi la btang ngam min na chu chang gis bsad/ thal ba chu klung ngam rgya mtshor dor/ rjes su bsngo smon bkra shis mdor bsdus dang mtha' rten tshogs 'khor sogs so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum spyi'i me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod las 'phral mkho'i ched dbang gi me mchod khul du phyung ba po gu h+ya'o/ ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po rab gsal bzhugs so/ pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ na mo/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /gus pas skyabs mchis bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po myur bsgrub bgyi/ dngos gzhi ni*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad gcig gi /snang srid bde chen pad+ma 'od/ /rang byung sprul pa'i pho brang dbus/ /nor bu'i khri 'phang pad nyi'i gdan/ /rang rig hriḥdamar yongs gyur pa'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+mas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul/ /thugs kar rdo rje hrī mthar sngags/

/bde chen rang bzhin zhing kun khyab/ /rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ /'bar ba gsum gyis bdag nus bskyed/ khams gsum brtan g.yo snang grags sems/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa las/ /'du ba gsum gyi phrin las sgo/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mos/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ci nus bzlas la mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsdu la rjes shes pad+ma rgyal po'i nga rgyal ngang bsngo smon sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang lha 'di nyid la mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches nges shes rnyed pa'i pad+ma'i rig sngags 'dzin pa pad+ma myu gu klu yi ming nas/ gter gzhung nas btus la zur rgyan phran bu bcas/ rab byung 17 me sprel lo zla ba 8 tshes la the pe e waṃ du bris pa'o// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ drag po kā la yak+sha'i rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ thog mar skyabs sems lan lag bdun ma ni/ skad cig dpal khro bo rol ba'i lha tshogs mkha' khyab du sad par gyur/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ hūm̐: snang srid bdag med de bzhin las: e mthing klong nas 'byung lnga brtsegs: thabs shes rnam par snyoms pa las: skye med rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang : rnam pa drag po'i pho brang ni: ma 'gags rgyan bkod so sor gsal: de dbus pad+ma zla nyi dang : ti ra dam sri bsnol ba'i steng : mthing smug hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du las: dpal chen rdo rje dpa' bo'i sku: smug nag yak+sha kā la che: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i chas: spyan bgrad am gtsigs smin ma 'bar: thod skam skra chings dar dmar brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri bsnams: g.yon pas lcags sdig phur bu bsgril: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bzhugs: go cha'i lha rnams hūm̐ du gsal:

me dpung mched pa'i klong du bsgom: thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje'i lter/ /hūm̐ mthar drag sngags me tshwa yis/ /srid gsum gdug pa thal bar brlag /snod bcud ka dag dbyings su sbyangs/ /rol rtsal khro bo'i da lar sad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ci nus dang*/ rtsa sngags ni: oṃ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hṛ da he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes thun bsdu ba'i tshe srung 'khor gzhal yas lha sngags sa bon na dā bar bsdu la de yang mi dmigs chos dbyings ka dag ngang du bsdu la bsngo smon bya'o/ 'di ni khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po'am bgegs mthar byed dam stobs po che yak+sha kā la zhes dbang drag gi dkyil 'khor las phrin gang la 'jug kyang ma grol gyi bar 'di nyid kyi srung 'khor dang ting 'dzin la gnas na bar chad mi 'byung/ nor sgrub dang sri'u gso ba la gal che'o/ rang nyid gyi dgos mkhor dmigs te gter gzhung nas gu h+yas phyung ba yin no// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ gtor 'bul khams gsum dbang bsgyur bzhugs so/ de yang pad 'byung mkha' 'gro nor lha'i gtor 'bul 'dod na/ gser skyems dang gtor ma bshams la 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi brlab la/ hūm̐: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi ri rab ngogs: dur khrod dbang mo 'gyu ba gnas kyi bdag: dbang lhun yid bzhin lha chen sgeg pa'i nyams: dkar dmar bsrubs pa'i myos byed bsnun thabs can: srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: yid la 'khu ba'i nor skyug ne'u le thogs: khams gsum snying 'degs lcags kyu'i 'od zer g.yo: ku mud ze'u 'brur 'brub pas kun da bzhad: gsos 'khyil bsod nams zhum med zhabs dkyil bzhugs: stobs ldan mgrin bzang mu kha'i bcud lta bu'i: reg bya g.yo bas lang tsho 'dza' ma'i 'khor: rjes su chags pas gzugs bzang longs spyod spel: pad+ma rā ga'i cha shas lang tsho skyud:

'ga' zhig zla gzhon lan brgyar byi dor dbyibs: la la sa snying bzhed mdzes chu skyes rgyas: phal cher 'dar ma'i sgras bskul ma gad 'tsher: kun kyang sgra gcan srang 'jug gug rtse bsgrengs: yid las spyod pa'i nor 'dzin ne'u 'phyo: pad+ma rā dza 'khor dang phywa brnyan la: bstod cing dus la mi 'da' phrin las nyid: che btsan dmu rab gtsug rab rgyal po 'khor: lung rigs mkhas dbang mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta: btsun mo 'khor 'bangs chos srid lugs gnyis kyis: ci srid bsdus pa'i skye 'gro ma lus dang : de srid lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kun: deng 'dir dbang du sdud pa'i las brtsam phyir: dgyes pa'i phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: chos srid mnga' thang 'dod rgu'i dpal yon sogs: mthong thos dran reg bran dang dbang du bsgyur: rgyal ba'i thugs rje ye shes dbyings nas bskul: pad 'byung nor gyi lha khyod bdag bsgrub kyi: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med deng 'dir stsol: oṃ ā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ ma ma ye swā hā: zhes pas phrin las bcol lo/ thun gtor dang rgyun gtor ci byas kyang rung*/ shin du zab pa'i gter gzhung man ngag las/ gu h+yas rang gi nyer mkhor gud du phyung ba'o// // ༈ pad+ma rgyal po'i dzam dkar las tshogs las/ dbang sdud man ngag khyad par can bzhugs so/ dbang sdud rgyal po la btud nas/ /gud sbas man ngag khyad par can/ /gu ru'i byin mthus dkrol ba'i spobs/ /cung zad rnyed snyam dwang bas spros/ de la gter gzhung las/ man ngag zab pa'i mthar thug las: dbang sdud 'khor lo'i gdams pa ni: ma hā dhe wa'i khyad chos la: 'gugs pa'i man ngag zab khyad can: skye 'gro pho mo ma lus kun: 'chang ba rtsam gyis mdangs 'phrog pa'i: stobs can rdo rje'i lcags kyu bstan: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gu ru pad+ma rgyal pos dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du dbang phyug chen po dbang du bsdus pa'i tshe/ rang gi srog snying dang ma hā dhe wa'i khyad chos dbang sdud 'khor lo sogs 'gugs pa'i man ngag zab khyad can/

'chang ba tsam gyis skye 'gro ma lus dbang du byed pa'i thabs 'di yang phul bas gzhung gi cha lag tu bzhag par mdzad pa yin no/ de yang dbye gsal byed lugs te: dang po shes rab mo zangs la: gser dngul la sogs rin chen sbyar: bskol btul bgyis pa'i zhun ma la: rdo rje chos can gzugs su bcos: tshad kyang tshon gsum longs par bya: zhes zangs sa le sbram dang rang byung zangs la gser dngul bsres pa'i rdo rje'am/ pho mtshan tshon gsum tsam lon pa bcos pa'am/ che ba yang rung/ yang na rdzas rnams bsres la 'dam spyin gis byas kyang rung la/ dbus su tsan+dan dmar po'i srog shing la sngags 'di tsheg med du bris de nas sngags rim bstan pa ni: zhes pas brda yig sum cu 'di thog mar nang du srog shing la dril/ de yi phyi rol sngags 'di yang bris la/ oṃ ma hā de wa khu ta bha la sarba mo ha rā ga ma ṇi bha dra kau rī ma u ma dhe wa ru ta sa twa ti ka li ma ti pra mo du na puṇ+ye ma tsar+ya la nu ta ra sa ma ya pa shaṃ thun thun dza dza sa ma ya du ha ra ni thun thun 'dus 'dus: skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du sdud sdud srid pa'i dkyil 'khor dung sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mi li li ya breng dza dza pra du ra dza dza mi snying 'gul 'gul sems rtsa myog myog mi sems dkrugs dkrugs bla yid dung dung 'jig rten srid pa pho mo dbang du sdud la bla yig srid pa ti ri dza dzaḥ mu shu ya zas nor thams cad dbang du sdus sdus bha ri bha ri ta ma ta ma ya snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad yid 'gul la zas nor thun thun ma ma yar 'dus 'dus swā hā: de nas rdzas ni/ gzhung las/ khye'u pho mo'i byang sems dang : gla rtsi rgya mtshal cu gang dang : bya pho ra lug bong bu yi: ma nyams 'bras dang chu rgyun bcas: zhib btags sbyar ba'i khu ba sogs: sngags dang yig 'bru'i steng du byug: gsungs pas khye'u lo brgyad dang bud med mtshan ldan bcu gsum ma'i zla mtshan bcas byung na rab/

min kyang gzhon nu ma mda' ma phog pa'i zla mtshan sogs dang gla rtsi/ rgya mtshal/ cu gang*/ bya pho dang*/ ra thug /lug thug /bong gseb sogs kyi rlig 'bras ma nyams pa dang*/ de dag gi dri chu bcas zhib btags khu ba btsag ste sngags dang yig 'bru'i steng du byugs la/ sngags ring gong las mar dril phyi la dar tshon skud pa sna lnga'i rgya chings brgyab cing liṅga'i nang du bcug nas sngags 'di sum brtsegs lta bur sgo yang bkag 'di la gzhung ltar bya la mthar rab tu gnas pa'i sngags 'di brgya bgrangs nas: 'bru la sngags nas byin gyis brlab par bya: oṃ a liṅga she pha tri ra pad+ma u ta pra mo te dzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes pas byin rlabs brtan bzhugs sogs spyi ltar grub par bgyis nas lus la 'chang ngam/ gar bde mchod gzhi'i kha ru bzhag la mchod pa'am/ sgrom du 'jug kyang rung ngo/ de la rgyun du sngags 'di bzla zhing byin brlab bya/ oṃ ko ri phe sha ka li ma ma thun dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams yang yang bskyar ro/ de 'ang gzhung las/ rgyun du lus la 'chang ba'am: sgrom bu'i dkyil du sba bar bya: gsang ba kun gyi yang bcud de: snod min rnams la mi ston 'tshal: 'di nyid 'chang ba'i skal ldan la: 'gro ba lha 'dre mi gsum rnams: sha rul sbrang bu btibs pa bzhin: dbang med bdag tu 'du bar 'gyur: longs spyod phywa dang g.yang rnams kun: mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor bar 'gyur: de bas gdams pa 'di nyid zab: lha chen las tshogs sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pas zab bo/ gu h+yas so// // pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med kyi bla 'khor/ pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med sku la 'dud: dar dang gan shog dmar po la rgya snag gam rgya mtshal ci rigs pas tsakra mu khyud lngas bskor ba'i lte bar nor bu mig gsum la hrīḥm:hūm̐ gi mthar: dhe wa ba su rat+na sid+dhi dzaḥ nā ga ba su rat+na sid+dhi dzaḥ ma nu ba su rat+na sid+dhi dzaḥ de'i phyi mu khyud la:
