oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ hrī ma gu ru rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐: bdag la 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi 'dod rgu'i dpal rgyas par stsol cig: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de'i phyi rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badz+ra ku mu le dhe wa a yur+pubh+yai sid+dhi dzaḥ oṃ rat+na ku le shaṃ ma nu ā yur+pubh+yai sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma ku le hu nā ga a yur+pubh+yai sarba sid+dhi bam̐: oṃ karma ku pa ti yak+ṣa a yur+pubh+yai sarba sid+dhi hoḥ rtsibs mchan la: a tri nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ ba su rat+na sdus sdus swā hā: de'i phyi mu khyud la: rtsa sngags dang 'dod byang*/ de'i phyi la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel nor lha'i gzungs rigs/ phyi khog gu ru pad+ma rgyal po zhal gsum phyag drug mngon rtogs ltar bri/ o rgyan nor lha'i srog 'khor bri thabas-i atsha: pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med kyi bla 'khor gzhung nas skyid grong smyon pas khol du phyung ba dge/ // dzam dkar las tshogs las/ tshogs kyi bdag pos lag bsgul zas nor 'gugs pa'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can bzhugs so/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi bdag po las: lag bsgul zas 'gugs gdams pa ni: tsha ba gsum gyi sngo sman dang : cong zhi shing mngar sbyar ba yi: ril bu sran ma tsam du dril: kha dog dmar po dag tu 'dod: lug pho mgo dmar rlig sgrom blug: bcu gsum lo ma'i kha sgrog sbyar: pha bang long bu gcig kyang bcug: zhes pa tsha ba gsum gyi sngo sman ni/ lce tsha*/ dbyi mong dkar po/ srub ka gsum/ ma 'dzoms na sga skya/ pi ling*/ pho ba ris gsum dang*/ cong zhi dang*/ shing mngar bcas sbyar la ril bu sran ma tsam du dril zhing kha dog dmar po'i na bza' gsol/ blugs snod kyang lug thug mgo dmar can gyi rlig khug tu blug bud med mtshan ldan bcu gsum lo ma'i 'khel ba'i bal skud gyi kha sgrog sbyar/ nang du pha bang long bu gcig kyang bcug la rgyun du sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab/

oṃ tri 'u tri 'u tri du tri du 'ur 'ur rgyug rgyug mi yi snying du rgyugs mi snying sgul bla yid khug: zas nor thams cad sdud sdud thun thun dza dzaḥ dus la bab tshe sbyin par bya: de yi longs spyod char ltar 'bebs: zhes pa'i sngags 'di'i ril bu dag: phyi rol gang gis myong gyur kyang : dbang du 'du bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: zhes dzam dkar sgrub thabs sam pad rgyal rgyun khyer dang sbrags gong sngags kyis btab la dgos pa'i tshe sbyin par bya'o/ de yis longs spyod 'du zhing ril bu gang gis myangs pa dag dbang du 'du bar gsungs so/ zhes zab bo// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ myur mgyogs rlung 'khor gdams pa zab mo bzhugs so/ dbang sdud mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la 'dud/ 'dir dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po bsgrub 'khor nang nas/ las byed rlung gi 'khor lo'i gdams pa ni/ 'khor lo bri ba'i bca' gzhi bstan pa dang*/ lag len gyi gnad dang*/ mtha' rgyas phan yon dang gsum la/ dang po bri ba'i dus ni yar tshes kyi dus bzang po/ gza' skar bzang zhing dar ba la brtsam ste/ dang po bri ba'i bca' gzhi ni/ shog bu gtsang zhing dkar 'jam legs pa la/ dri bzang gi chus byugs la/ rgya skag dmar pos kha dog bsgyur zhing zhud 'jam byas pa'o/ snag tsha yang rab gser dngul rin po ches 'bri/ yang na rgya snag bzang po dri bzang gi rigs dang*/ dam rdzas chos sman sogs gang mang bsres pa'i snag tshas 'bri ba'o/ bri tshul ni/ yab 'khor yum 'khor bar 'khor dang gsum las/ dang po yab 'khor la mu khyud rim pa drug tu bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rim pad 'dab 'bru lnga bkod/ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma ṇi sa mā ya dza dza oṃ ḍāk+ki nī bi shwa rū pa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra dharma sam+bha gha tshur+bhi dza dzaḥ yo gi ni u ta rā ga he sha ka ma le ma ma ā gats+tsha su ṇe sa ma pa ri mi ta ku mā ra ṇi dza dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sid+dhi satwaṃ: 'byung ba rlung gi khyab byed kyis mnga' thang thams cad thun dzaḥ ma la rak+ṣa ye hūm̐ hrīḥ ཿ sogs bris pa'i mthar 'dod gsol bsgyur/ de yi phyi rol phyi yi zhags pa'i sngags ni 'di ltar ro: oṃ gu ru yo gi badz+ra ni dza dzaḥ oṃ ma hā ra tsa ni dza dzaḥ oṃ ku mā ra sid+dhi dza dzaḥ oṃ lok+ka pa ti kau ma rī bha ha ya pa shaṃ ku ru a dhe ye ma ma dza dzaḥ oṃ ra tri ta ka ma le dza satwaṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ ma ma sid+dhi dza dzaḥ pa shaṃ thun thun: 'dzam gling srid pa'i snang ba dbang du bsdus thun dza dzaḥ de yi phyi rol dbyangs gsal sogs dang spel tshig bris/ de yi phyi rol rten 'brel snying po sogs dang*/ brtan bzhugs kyi sngags sogs dang*/ rab gnas sngags rnams bris/ de'i phyi rol thabs rdo rje'am yang na nor bus brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i zhags pa sogs kyis bskor/ yig mgo thams cad phyir bstan la chad lhag med par bris pa'o/ ྀatsha: yum 'khor yang snga ma ltar mu khyud rim pa drug bskor ba'i lte bar/ yig mgo nang du bstan la srog yig bkod/ de yi phyi rol pad 'dab la/ ha ri ni sa'am yang na yum sngags snying po bkod/ de yi phyi rol/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma tri ma ma yo gi ni shwa ri ku mā ra dza dzaḥ oṃ yo gi ni ā ru sa bha dra ku mā rā dza dzaḥ nā ga ma ṇi pha la kau ma rī ma ma dza dzaḥ badz+ra pra bha ti a dhiṣ+ṭha te tsit+ta rū pa rat+na sā ti bha dra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ra tsa pu ru kha su khaṃ tsar+ya ma hā pra ni dha na phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ ga ga na bhū mi pa ti ḍāk+ki nī tā re puṇ+ye ma hā dhe wi tshur+dhi lok+ka ka li rā ga he sha ma na tsit+ta pa ri wā ra ma ma thun thun dza u ta ā gats+tsha ba ha ya dza dzaḥ ma ma pa shaṃ thun dza sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ sa ma ya rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i chos srid sid+dhi dzaḥbris/ mthar 'dod gsol bya/ de yi phyi rim/

oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi ma hā puṇ+ye ka ma la ḍāk+ki nī ga ra he sha tshur+dhi oṃ aṅku sha dza dzaḥ badz+ra yo gi ni mu tra ni ru pa ṇi su khaṃ pra mo ti ri pra dz+nyā sūr+ya dhe bi dza dzaḥ i tra rat+na sa ma ya sid+dhi ṇi ma ni ma ma sid+dhi dza dzaḥsogs bris pa'i mjug tu 'dod gsol bsgyur/ de yi phyi rol dbyangs gsal sogs dang spel tshig bris/ de yi phyi rim rten 'brel snying po dang rab gnas pa'i sngags: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza rat+na a dhiṣ+ṭha ma ma kun+da sha ra ṇa sarba tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes sogs bris/ de yi phyi rol shes rab pad+mas mtshan pa'am/ yang na pad+ma'i lcags kyu bcu drug bkod/ sa ma ya: gsum pa bar 'khor dbang sdud dmar po'i tsakra ni/ mu khyud rim pa drug bskor ba'i lte bar/ thabs kyi rdo rje srog gi yi ges mtshan pa bkod/ de yi phyi rol pad+ma rgyal po'i rtsa sngags oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas bskor/ de yi phyi rol las sbyor gyi bsgrub pa'i sngags phreng*/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza sid+dhi sa ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun sid+dhi dzaḥyis bskor ba'i mthar 'dod gsol sbyar/ de yi phyi rol dbang phyug nag po'i sgrub sngags/ oṃ bhe yu ṣe dzaḥ ta ra dzaḥ la ghaṃ dzaḥ gu laṃ gu laṃ dzaḥ ma ma dung dung thun thunaḥ pra mo thun pra mo thun: mi sems dkrugs sems rtsa myog: ka dza dung dung lha 'dre mi gsum gyi longs spyod snang ba dbang du sdud sdud thun thun u tsa ta ya dzaḥdzaḥsogs kyis bskor ba'i mthar/ 'gro ba pho mo sogs dbang du bsdu na gang 'dod kyi ming rus dang thun dzaḥsogs dang*/ gzhan yang khams gsum srid bcud thams cad kyi zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags 'dod rgu dang dpal 'byor sogs dang*/ gang 'dod pa'i don thams cad spel tshig rgyas par bris/

de yi phyi rol dbyangs gsal sogs dang spel tshig bris/ de yi phyi rim rten 'brel snying po dang rab du gnas pa'i sngags sogs gong ltar bris/ de yi phyi rol pad+ma'i lcags kyu brgyad dam bcu drug gis bskor ba bris la/ 'debs grangs gang byed rig pa'i mda' dang bstun la/ de yang kha yar lta mar lta'i khyad par gyis/ yig mgo rnams ma nor par bkod la/ gzhung gi rdzas sman rnams byug /yi ge yang tsheg med dbu can bri zhing*/ bris gsub dang chad lhag nor 'khrul sogs spang bar bya'o/ sa ma ya: de nas lag len gyi gnad ni/ bkra shis dus tshod dge ba'i nyin par/ gzhi dkar gyi steng du nas dkar gyi g.yung drung tshom bu bkod la/ de steng tsakra rnams bkram/ thog mar bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod srung 'khor drag po bsgoms la/ tsakra rnams la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug /de nas sgrub gzhung gi las byang btang la/ bsnyen sngags kyis rab tu gnas par byas la/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po sogs gang mang gis rab gnas bya/ sgrub pa grol ba'i gza' skar rten 'brel bzang po la 'khor lo btsugs te/ sgrub gzhung gi tshogs 'khor dang dngos grub len chog bkra shis smon lam gyis mtha' rgyas par byas pa'i mthar/ thog mar 'khor lo dar dang za 'og dmar pos btums la/ dri bzang pos kyang bdug rlung khang yang lha khang gi gzugs lta bu/ rtse mo tog dang ldan par byas la nang du bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs bkod/ 'khor lo'i srog shing tsan+dan dmar po la byas/ sgro shing glang ma dmar po la byas te/ sgro 'dab yi ge sogs ni spyi mthun du bya'o/ de nas btsugs pa'i dus ni/ yar tshes bzang po'am bcu ste/ thog mar gzhi bdag la bsang mchod 'bul/ bden pa brdar phrin las bcol/ chos skyong srung ma la phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma 'bul/ gtang rag tshogs 'khor rten 'brel bzang po sogs bya ste/ rlung khang yang sgrub khang gi nub phyogs su 'dzugs par bya'o/

sa ma ya: de ltar rlung gi tsakra 'dzugs pa'i phan yon ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ yi dam mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster/ chos skyong srung ma gzhi bdag rnams kyis 'gal rkyen bar chad sel zhing*/ mthun rkyen gyi phrin las gang 'dod ltar sgrub par byed do/ gzhan yang khams gsum dbang du 'dus shing*/ zas nor longs spyod 'phel/ snyan grags mnga' thang 'dul bya'i phrin las/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rnams rgyas shing*/ 'gro ba pho mo mi nor thams cad sha rul la sbrang bu 'tshubs pa lta bur 'dus par 'gyur ro/ ྀatsha: zhes pa 'di nyid gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub gzhung 'khor lo'i lhan thabs las byed rlung gi pho nya bskul ba myur mgyogs rlung gi zhags pa 'di nyid/ sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ gsang ba gu rus sbas pa rgya bkrol ba'o/ gu h+ya kha thaṃ/ zhus dag dang sogs khung nar bshangs byas nas gu h+yas byi dor zhus/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ dzam dkar las tshogs las/ tshogs kyi bdag pos sho dang rgyan dang tshong las rgyal ba'i man ngag bzhugs so/ / gter gzhung las/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi bdag po las: sho dang rgyan las rgyal 'dod na: dngul dkar me long rma bya'i mdongs: sin+dhu ra bcas tshags su bcug: zhes sho dang rgyan las rgyal bar 'dod na/ dngul dkar me long dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs/ sin+dhu ra bcas 'du bya la*/ gzhung sngon du song nas las sbyor ni/ sngags 'di khri yis byin gyis brlab: oṃ a ri ma ṇi rat+na pha la dhi: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas su: sgro mdongs spyi bo'i gtsug tu brgyan: me long brang gi steng du 'dogs: sin+dhu ra ni dpral bar byug: de nas sho rgyan rgyal ba dang : khe tshong dag kyang rgyal bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar sgrub la grub zin nas rma bya'isgro mdongs zhwa sogs gtsug tu brgyan/ me long 'gul du 'dogs/ khyad par sin+dhu ra nyid kyi dpral bar thig le bya'o/

des sho rgyan rgyal zhing khe tshong lon par gsungs so/ gu h+yas phyung ngo*// // ༈ dzam dkar las tshogs las/ za yig longs spyod char 'bebs gdams pa ni/ da ni las tshogs phran bu gdams pa bstan: thog mar bsod nams longs spyod sdud pa las: 'gro ba'i snang ba dbang du 'du ba'i phyir: za yig longs spyod char 'bebs gdams pa bstan: 'di dag 'gro ba gang gis reg gyur na: gdung shugs rtsol med skye zhing dbang du 'dus: de yi gdams pa yig rgod sa ma ya: de las dang po longs spyod dbang sdud za yig ni/ hakalararadang yahaza//ཿ rdzas rnams byugs mjug nas dril te sbyin pas longs spyod 'du'o/ gnyis pa pho mo dbang sdud za yig ni: tamaralahabasag: gsum pa nor 'gugs bgyis pa'i za yig ni: btanyanalab: bzhi pa khye'u dbang sdud za yig ni: kha'angabasag: lnga pa 'byung ba dbang sdud za yig ni: karachanyapar+pa/: drug pa khams bskyed g.yo byed za yig ni: khamakayangabasag: bdun pa ḍāk+ki dbang sdud za yig ni: ṭakagangabangangashangaha: de rnams thams cad mjug nas yar la dril/ rdzas ni/ gi waṃ/ li khri/ cu gang*/ ga pur/ dzā ti/ sug smel/ li shi/ tig ta dang : tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gu gul/ snying zho sha /dbang lag /pha bang long bu/ rgya mtshal/ khab len rdo dang*/ mu tig sogs rin chen rigs dang*/ gser dngul sogs nor bu'i rigs slob dpon yab yum byang sems bcas byugs nas sgrub thabs gzhung ltar bya/ grub nas dbang sdud rnams ni gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ yang za yig gdams pa las/ bud med srid 'phel za yig ni: hadahahirbagyaḥ rnam pa gzhon byed za yig ni: sagasamaganagayashan: rtsa rlung bskyed pa'i za yig ni: tsaralashakayangacagag: shes rab blo 'phel za yig ni: khalarabahalagataya: sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i za yig ni: sadagasatakaṭ+ṭa ṇa/: myong grol man ngag za yig ni: bsalahirgya: sogs rdzas snga ma dang mtshungs/ 'di rnams rang nyid gyis za bar bya: sa ma ya: lag len dus tshes gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang dus su gtsang sbra bcas rgya snag gtsang mas bris la khrus dang bdug brab bya/

bsgrubs nas rab du gnas la dus rtag par tho rangs su bza' ba yin no/ zhes bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las/ las tshogs gud sbas kha thor gyi skor las cung zad gud du phyung ba 'di'ang lugs 'di'i phrin las kyi byed por bsngags pa gnam lcags bstan 'dzin 'bod pas rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bzhin gab pa bsdebs 'khrugs pa bsal nas go bde las sla bar bkral ba'o// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed 'khor lo bzhugs so/ klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed 'khor lo ni: thog mar lte ba'i gnas su sngags 'di bris: de yi mu khyud gu ru sku gsum sngags oṃ badz+ra gu ru a bhi bhu ya ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa mu ṭa sid+dhi hūm̐: bris 'dod gsol kha sgyur dang ci mthun bsgyur: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: oṃ nā ga dha ra hūm̐: rtsibs mchan la oṃ bā su ku puṣ+ṭiṃ hūm̐: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: klu yab yum gyi sngags bris: 'dod gsol la: bdag sgrub pa po'am 'chang ba pos lha klu mi gsum longs spyod bsod nams dpal 'byor kha rje dbang thang zas nor longs spyod thams cad dbang du 'dus shing char bzhin du 'bebs par gyur cig: oṃ pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun sid+dhi dza dzaḥtsakra bh+rūm̐: de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ rgyal rigs la swā hā: oṃ rje rigs la swā hā: oṃ bram ze la swā hā: oṃ dga' bo la swā hā: oṃ 'jog po la swā hā: oṃ dung skyong la swā hā: oṃ pad+ma la swā hā: oṃ nor rgyas la swā hā: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ yaṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ raṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ khaṃ nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ bh+rūm̐ ma'i nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ mu le k+ṣi nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ e ma la nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ lo ha se nā ga dha ra swā hā: oṃ nā ga dhe wi dza swā hā: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la a li sau+ogs dbyangs dang/

de yi phyi rol mu khyud la gsal byed dang/ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la rten 'brel snying pos bskor la rab gnas sngags kyi sham bur bsgyur/ de yi phyi rol me ri pa tra sogs mdzes par bya'o/ rdzas ni klu sman sna tshogs dang : rdo khab len lcags phye bram ze bu mo'i rna cha rnyed na dang*/ mu ku mu ti tra: g.yu byi ru gzi mig dgu mu men spos shel sogs nor bu'i rigs rnams byug /gser gyi 'khor lo dngul gyi rdo rje mtshal gyi pad+ma bris pa dang/ dar zab sna tshogs bcas dril*/ zangs kyi gwa'u'i nang du 'chang la rtsa sngags khri bdun rab gnas bya'o/ lus la 'chang na zhag bdun bar dmar gyi rigs dang mtshon cha spang : ban btsun dam nyams yugs mo dang : shan pa'i lag gis mi reg par 'chang ngo/ zhes dang/ 'di dag khye'u pho mo yi: ma yi lus su gnas pa'i tshe: srung ba 'di nyid btags pa ni: rig ldan gtsang mas longs spyod 'du: gang zhig btsas pa'i dus su ni: bu la klu mgon klu phyug dang : klu rgyal klu 'bum la sogs btags: bu mo klu mtsho klu skyid dbang : klu sgron klu mo bu khrid sogs: khye'u rang gzugs ming dang sbyar: zhes so/ gong gsal 'khor lo bris sgrub tshad ldan byas nas klu bum nang bcug la kha la chas bcad nas nang du chu mi shor ba byas nas klu yi pho brang mtsho dang rten mkhar chu mig sogs la sbas na sa bcud lo thog rgyas pa dang char chu dus su 'bab pa longs spyod rgyas pa sogs dgos pa yod do/ zab bo// // ༈ klu yi be'u bum las char 'bebs man ngag bzhugs so/ gang zhig char 'bebs la sogs skabs: 'khor lo mthing shog ngos su ni: rin chen zhun ma'-i khu bas bris: sngags 'di khri yis rab gnas bya: dri bzang klu sman chu rgyun gyis: klu gtor zhib dang sbrags nas su: me long yi ge 'gying logs khrus: chu mig nang du 'phro bar bya: zhes klu rgyal bsod nams stobs skyed 'khor lo de nyid mthing shog ngos su rin chen gser zhun ma'-i khu bas bris la rdzas ni klu sman gong ltar byug

/zhi ba klu yi sgrub thabs bzhin sgrub la sngags 'di khri yis rab gnas bya/ dngos gzhi char 'bebs kyi las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ rang nyid sha chang sogs ma 'dres pa'i gtsang sbra dang bcas/ dus klu thebs dang bstun/ gnas chu mig gnyen pa dang mtsho mo gtan 'khyil lta bur song nas gu ru'i sku brnyan byin ldan dang rten gsum bshams pa'i mdun 'khor lo yang bkram/ dkar gsum mngar gsum phyi mchod spros/ rig 'dzin thugs rdor gyi chog khrigs zhi ba klu yi sgrub thabs bzhin sgrub la sku khrus skabs/ thog mar brten khrus legs par gsol*/ hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan rin chen gter gyi bdag: yab ni gnod sbyin ma hā dhe: yum ni klu mo dung skyong ma: sogs kyi skabs mtheb skyu klu sman gtsang ma dang ma dar sngon nang dril la chu gtsang dang dri bzang dang me tog sil ma gang mang bcas chu rgyun bar ma chad par blugs/ ma 'dzoms na me tog sil ma dang chu gtsang kho nas chog /de ltar klu gtor zhig dang sbrags nas 'khor lo me long yi ge 'gying logs su shar ba la khrus byas nas chu mig nang du 'gro bar bya'o/ dgos ched ni/ gter gzhung las/ des ni lha srin 'khrug pa dang : char med than pa byung ba dang : klu yi nad las grol bar 'gyur: khyad par dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung : zhes char 'bebs man ngag myong grub ma yin par thugs rdor gyis gsungs pas zab bo/ sa ma ya: gu h+yas phyung ngo*// // ༈ yang klu rgyal gyis gu ru la phul ba'i man ngag klu yi bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs so/ gter gzhung las/ gang zhig shu thor 'brum pa dang : sur+ya bas ldag me dbal la: gzungs sngags sin+dhu ra dang cha la brdar ba'i phye ma la: sngags ni khri 'bum bzla ba dang : chu la sbyar nas byug par bya: rma kha nang du btang mi bya: gang phyir mo nad dag la phan: 'thung dang mkhal sked byug par bya: grum bu chu ser 'bam kyang phan:

de bas gdams pa khyad par can: kun la ma spel sa ma ya: yang gcig bad kan skya smug la: tsha la cong zhi rgya tsha dang : cu gang a ru ra dang bcas: mi rta khyi gsum rus pa dang : bya gcan ri dwags g.yung dag gi: rus pa'i rigs tshang thams cad bsdus: bul tog shug bal gang rnyed nang : btsos nas snum bag med par bya: rus pa thams cad bsdus nas kyang : rdza ma gsar pa'i nang du ni: mtshams su bug pa yod pa bya: rus pa sol ba zung du bsre: sbub rus brgyab nas tshos par bsreg: sol thal ming yang med par bya: rus pa dwangs ma zhib tu 'thag: cong zhi bsregs pa'i thal ba dang : rus thal gsum bcas mang bar bya: de la tshwa sna thams cad bsre: a ru gser gdog khu ba bsdus: tsan+dan cung zad khu ba dang : bzang drug phye ma bag tsam btab: de rnams phyogs gcig 'dam 'thag bya: khyi la wa ra khu ba yang : 'dam 'thag nang du bsre bar bya: sba sbrul nya rus mang na bzang : zhag lnga bar du 'dam 'thag bcad: zhes pa tshwa la/ cong zhi/ rgya tshwa/ cu gang*/ a ru ra bcas zhib btul dang*/ rus pa sna tshogs mi rta khyi gsum dang*/ bya rigs/ gcan gzan/ ri dwags/ phyug nor rigs g.yag lug ra sogs g.yung dag /sbal sbrul nya rus mang bar byas pa'i rus pa'i rigs ci rnyed bsdus/ gsar pa yin na bul tog dang shug bal gang rnyed nang yun ring btsos nas chu phyir 'pho la snum bag med par bya/ gang ltar rus pa thams cad bsdus nas rdza ma gsar pa'i nang du blugs la sol me nang bsregs la dud pa rnams mtshams su bug pa byas pa las phyir thon par bya la*/ rus pa sol me nang bsregs nas dkar seng nger ma gyur bar sbub rus brgyab nas tshos par bsreg ru+us thal dwangs ma zhib tu 'thag la/ cong zhi bsregs pa'i thal ba dang rus thal lhan du bsdus la/ de yi steng du/ rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ tshwa sna thams cad bsres la/ a ru gser gdog khu ba gar por bsdus pa dang tsan+dan khu ba cung zad bsres la de la bzang drug phye ma bag tsam yang btab nas/

de rnams phyogs gcig 'dam 'thag bya/ khyi la wa ra khu ba yang 'dam 'thag nang du bsre bar bya/ zhes pa khyi la wa ra ci yin dpyad par bya'o/ de ltar zhag lnga bar du 'dam 'thag bcad la mtha' ru ril bu sran ma tsam sgril ba ril chags legs par bgyis pa dang spar bu nang du mi sang bya/ klu yi sngags ni khri yis rab tu sngags par gsungs so/ zhogs la gsum re bsten par bya: 'di nyid rlung mkhris bad kan dang : 'dus pa'i nad bcas 'gos nad grol: khyad par mdze la shin tu bzang : sbyar dug btsan dug dag kyang thub: zhes so/ yang gnyen nad nag po sum sgril zhes pa'i gnyen rim nyin gcig pa dang*/ bdun drug sogs 'go nad bcos thabs ni/ nag po sum sgril nad byung ni: dpa' dkar bong nga hong len dang : gla rtsi shu dag ru ta bcas: glang chen myos pa'i rta la bskyon: sil bu bshig nas mnyam por 'thag: des ni nad las grol bar 'gyur: zhes dpa' bo dkar po/ bong nga nag po/ hong len dang*/ gla rtsi*/ shu dag*/ ru ta bcas/ zhib par 'thag la glang chen gi waṃ sbang ba'i khu ba bcas ril bu bsgril la khong du btang bas des ni nad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ khyad par srin rlangs rigs dag la: kha sgyur dur byid thar nu dang : chu rtsa bcas pas 'og sgor thon: mkhris pa'i mig ser lhog nad 'joms: man ngag klu yi bdud rtsi'i bum: khyad par srin rlangs sogs rlangs 'thab rigs gong sman thog kha sgyur sman ni/ dur byid dang*/ thar nu dang*/ chu rtsa bcas bsnan pas bshal sman btang na nad rnams 'og sgo nas thon par 'gyur ro/ 'di mkhris pa'i mig ser dang gag lhog nad la yang ches zab par gsungs so/ zhes gu ru man ngag zab mo 'di dag rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter gzhung las gud du sbas pa gzhan phan ched gu h+yas zur du phyung bas phan thogs par shog cig/ // ༈ pad+ma rgyal po'i dbang sdud man ngag zur rgyan bzhugs so/ de yang gzhung las/ zil gyis gnon na rang nyid pad+ma ni:

dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul du bsgom: zhes pa'i man ngag gud sbas ni/ lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi ri rab ngogs: dur khrod dbang mo 'gyu ba gnas kyi bdag: dbang lhun yid bzhin lha chen sgeg pa'i nyams: dkar dmar bsrubs pa'i myos byed bsnun thabs can: srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: yid la 'khu ba'i nor skyug ne'u le thogs: khams gsum snying 'degs lcags kyu'i 'od zer g.yo: ku mud ze'u 'brur 'brub pas kun da bzhad: gsos 'khyil bsod nams zhum med zhabs dkyil bzhugs: zhais lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du gu ru bzhugs pa'i tshe khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ dbang gi lha chen po dbang phyug ma ha dwe wa dbang mo u ma sogs rang dbang rten pa bral bar dbang du bsdus cing srog snying phul nas rje bor bkur ba'i phyir 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon rtsal zhes grags la*/ dbang mdog ni pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar sku mdog dmar gsal rnam pa lha chen ltar gcer bu khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams dkar dmar bsrubs pa'i myos byed bsnun thabs can zhes gsang rdor gyen du sgreng ba g.yas srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa/ g.yon nor skyug ne'u le 'dzin pa/ khams gsum snying 'degs lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'od dmar las grub pa'i zer phreng g.yo ba/ ku mud ze'u 'brur 'brub pas zhes pad+ma ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i rgya khyon dang mnyam pas kun da'am ga bur thig le te nya gang zla ba bzhad pa'i gdan la/ dzam bha la ltar gsos pa 'khyil zhing bsod nams zhum med zhabs phyed dkyil gyi bzhugs pa/ de yi thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje lte bar hrī dmar mthar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba'i rang sgra dang 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ sogs sbyar/ dbang sdud yid bzhin zhags pa ni/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni:

pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza sid+dhi ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun sid+dhi dzaḥ longs spyod 'gugs pa'i zas nor thun dza zhes dang*/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza sid+dhi ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza zas nor thun dza sid+dhi dzaḥ pho mo 'gugs pa'i ming dang dbang po sbrel/ zhes pa ni/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza sid+dhi ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dzaḥ pho la che ge mo'i ming gi mthar a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang mo yin na bsgrub bya gang yin gyi ming cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo u tsa ta dzaḥdang bcas la bzlas/ dmigs pa ni rang gi thugs srog las 'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can pho yi snying dang mo yi gsang gnas nas 'phros srog snying la phog pas bde ba bzod med g.yos nas 'od mer du zhu ba rang la bstims pas dbang du gyur bar mos la bzla'o/ zhes pa'ang dka' ba'i gnad man ngag zur rgyan mon spa gro stag tshang gi gshams sa mtshams mchod rten du sbyin bdag a ma phur bu'i mchod khang du rab gnas shing sprel lo'i zla ba 12 tshes 4gu h+yas bkral ba'o// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las/ las tshogs nor sgrub phywa spel man ngag skor las/ g.yang rdzas ril bu bya na/ gter gzhung las/ rdzas kyi rim pa bstan pa la: dzā ti pad+ma rgyal po li shi man+da ra ba: a ru ra ye shes mtsho rgyal: gur gum rdo rje dbang sdud: gi waṃ rin chen dbang sdud: tsan+dan pad+ma dbang sdud: sug smel karma dbang sdud: cu gang nor skyong ma: dbang lag klu'i dge bsnyen: rin po che ni gser dngul: zangs lcags g.yu byi ru mu men shel lta bu ste gang bzhin no: khyad par gyi rdzas li khri rgya mtshal mu zi shing mngar mtshal lu'i snying po:

gzhan du bka' gter nor lha rgya mtsho'i rgyud lung man ngag zab mo su la'ang ma khyog pa yod tshul gang nas kyang ma gsungs la*/

lhag par tshul 'di'i gter gzhung du*/ rgyal pos gser g.yu'i maṇ+ṭal phul nas bod 'bangs bsod nams dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i thabs zhus pas/ ma hā gu ru dngos kyi zhal nas*/ rgyal pos dbu mdzad 'bangs rnams kyis sbyin pa rgya che ba thongs: bsod nams sa bcud kyi bum gter sbos: 'phral phug kun tu bsod nams dang dbang thang gi rgyas thebs par 'dod na: kho bo dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du gnas pa'i tshe pad+ma rgyal po'i ngo bor gyur nas lha dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa dbang du bsdus te: man ngag nor bu zhags pa'i gdams pa rnams mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas da lta klu'i rgyal po zla skyong la bcol nas rgya bsdams pa yod de: rgyal pos zhus pa shin tu legs pas de dag 'byin par byas na phan pa yin: zhes dang de yi tshe kho mo mtsho rgyal rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs nas rje gu ru'i phyag tu phul: gu rus rgyal pos dbu mdzad rje 'bangs grogs lnga la gnang : zhes dang yang de'i dus na/ rje ma hā gu rus dbu mdzad grogs dang bcas te mchims phu'i dben tshal du sgrub pa zhag bdun nas me tog dang myu gu shing 'bras dgun dus 'khrungs: mkha' nas 'brug ldir: nyi zla zung gcig tu shar ba sogs ltas bzang po byung : bod mi thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob yul thams cad bkra shis lo legs byung : bsam yas kyi bsgrub bya thams cad 'grub zhes/ rgyal pos dbu mdzad 'bangs dang bcas pa bka' yis gnang zhing kun gyi bsod nams sa bcud kyi bum gter sbos: 'phral phug kun tu bsod nams dang dbang thang rgyas par 'dod na pad+ma rgyal po 'di nyid sgrubs shig dang des kun la phan par gsungs pa las rgyal po las 'bangs kyis mi khyog ces ma gsungs la gal te khyod cag bden na gu ru rdzun du thal lo*/ de 'dra'i rang lugs 'dzin pa yongs la/ blun po'i ngag la yid rton nas pad+ma'i phrin las chud son du mi gtong bar bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med sgrub pa'i khur bzhes mdzad pa dang*/

bdag 'dra le lo dang rnam g.yeng ngang cung zad 'brel ba bzhag pa tsam la yang blos khel thub pa'i nges shes gting nas rnyed par 'dug na lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid la mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa thob cing brtson 'grus kyis nyams su blang bar nus na bstan 'gro'i don chen 'phral yun phun tshogs yon tan mngon par thob par gdon mi za bas de lugs mkhyen ldan yongs kyi thugs la bsti bar gsol ba 'debs par lags so/ zur 'gebs dang*/ las byang chog khrigs gud sbas bcas zur du gsal/ zhes pa 'di'ang gnam lcags pa gu h+yas gzhan phan gyis kun nas bslangs te yang le shod gnam lcags bla brang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ o rgyan nor lha dbang ltar sgrub pa 'chi med bcud dril bzhugs so: pad 'byung nor lha'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rigs 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas ni: pre ta'i 'ching grol dbang gi rgyal: rang ngor chu zla'i rtsal mdangs mkhar: nor lha ltar shar 'di ltar bsgrub: sa ma ya: sgrub rdzas dar dmar kha gang la mdud pa gsum byas la sgrub rten 'chang : mos gus blo yis bskul pa 'di ltar bya: sa ma ya: hrī maḥ mi zad gter 'byung o rgyan nor gyi lha: tshe bsod bcud 'dzin bde stong mtsho rgyal ma: gling bzhi dbang sgyur mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro lnga: gter 'byung dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs la: mos gus gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs: thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs tshe nor dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza lo ka sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gsol ba drag tu btab la rig pa'i rtsal phyung nas 'di skad do/ hrī maḥ rang rig snang stong ma 'gags rtsal snang las: 'phros pas rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: bsdus pas byin rlabs dngos grub 'ub kyis bsdus: hrī ma la thim gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bdag nyid pad 'byung nor lha sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rat+na'i prog zhu gsol: phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i lcags kyu phyar:

g.yon pas thod pa tshe bum bkang ba 'dzin: lha rdzas mar gad mdangs ldan stod g.yogs gsol: pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan smad g.yogs can: dar dang rin chen du mas sku rgyan spras: pang du yum mchog mtsho rgyal nor sbyin ser: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin: zhabs gnyis mi phyed bde stong yab la 'khril: nor bu'i rgyan dang lha rdzas du mas spras: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem bde stong mgul du 'khyud: nor bu pad zla'i steng du phyed skyil 'gying : phyogs bzhir tshe nor dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang gar thabs pad zla'i gar: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas nor skyug 'dzin: dar ljang stod g.yogs dar dmar sku smad dkris: thams cad 'ja' tshon 'od dpung klong du gsal: thugs kar zla steng hrī ma srog yig mthar: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor bas 'od lnga 'phros: skye dgu'i 'ching ba'i dug lnga rab bsal nas: sku lnga mchog thun dngos grub thams cad kun: 'ub kyis bsdus nas bdag la thim par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dz+nyā na sa ga rā dza sarba lo ka sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes sgrub sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i mthar gang dgos pa de la dmigs pas kha bsgyur/ las sngags 'di sham bu btags/ phu la phu la dzaḥ da la da la dzaḥ dha ma na ye dzaḥ dar dmar gyi mdud pa gsum la sngags/ ye dharmās rab tu gnas/ 'grub rtags la lce gzer ba dang*/ skrang ba sogs 'byung*/ de nas bstod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrī maḥ gter 'byung o rgyan yid bzhin nor gyi lha: tshe 'dzin nor bdag mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: 'byung lnga dbang sgyur nor bdag tshogs bcas la: bstod cing bskul nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: tshe chos zas nor mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces rtsa sngags bgrang nas dar dmar la rab tu gnas shing lus la 'chang*/ zas nor longs spyod dbyar chu ltar rgyas par 'gyur/ sa ma ya/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o//

// ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ nor bdag dzam lha dkar po'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin gter 'byung bzhugs so/ e ma ho/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od mtha' yas/ /snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum/ /rang byung sangs rgyas dpal ldan pad+ma skyes*/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+ma rgyal pos 'khor 'das mnga' dbang bsgyur*/ /dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal smin grol gdams pa'i mdzod/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mthu stobs 'gran zla bral/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gyur gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter bka' bab pad+ma gter bdag gling/ /chos kyi bdag po hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul rtsal*/ /chos bdag brgyud 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /longs spyod nor gyi dbang phyug dzam lha dkar/ khams gsum skye 'gro dbang sdud rig byed ma/ /dngos grub char 'bebs lha chen tshogs bdag sogs/ /rtsa gsum nor lha'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yak+sha kā las sri skeg phye mar 'thar/ /'jig rten mes po srid gsum dbang byed bdag /klu mo nor skyong klu g.yang 'dod rgu'i gter*/ /gnod sbyin gter srung bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang snang dbang du 'du ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ /gzhan snang gdul bya'i kha lo chos la bsgyur*/ khams gsum mos bzhi'i phyā dpal dbang du bsdus/ /bstan pa'i mnga' thang rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byor ba drug ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /lhun grub ye shes tshogs chen yid bzhin nor/ /rnyed nas srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel nas/ /don gnyis mthar phyin sku gnyis mchog thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang gsang sngags ming nas shing sprel sa zla'i tshes gnyis nyin zhogs pa'i thun mtshams su gang dran bris pa'o// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ dzam lha dkar po'i sgrub thabs chog khrigs phan bde 'dod rgu mchog sbyin bzhugs so/

mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang dzam lha dkar po'i sgrub thabs la sngon 'gro dngos rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro tshogs dang las kyi kha skong ni: pad+ma rgyal po'i nang nas len par bya: zhes gsungs pas/ dang po gsol 'debs sogs spyi ltar bya la khyad par sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gnas nas rang snang skyabs yul rtsa gsum o rgyan nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥs se gol bcas skyabs yul gsal gdab pa'i mdun/ skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs? sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don sogs/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma yi dam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las gzhi e las nam mkha': yam̐ rlung gi rgya gram: ram̐ me yi tsakra: kham̐ chu yi dkyil 'khor: bh+rūm̐ rin chen pho brang : hri ma a ho zhes pas: rang byung lhun grub kyi pho brang : phyi nang gi bkod pa rgyan yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ste: srid pa gsum g.yo nus pa'i mdangs chags pa khams gsum gyi nor sna dkor cha sogs lta bas chog mi shes pa'i blo las 'das pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba: pho brang gi nang thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'grub pa bsam pas brjod du mi lang pas rab tu gang ba 'di nyid rje ma hā gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yi dkyil 'khor dang khyad par nor bdag dzam+bha la bka' dang gter gyi srung ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas bsgrub pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i rdzas: mchod pa'i rdzas: rten pa'i rdzas: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang nam mkha' bar snang 'khor yug mu mtha' snang bas bzung dang ma bzung 'byams klas pa'i rang bzhin thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ?shab+da rū psogs sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ sarba ga na e ma la shrī pa ri wā ra rat+na pha la ma ṇi dha ra ma la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā whaṃ/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: hūm̐ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: rat+na bh+rūm̐ gyur 'od zer gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad nyi rin chen khri 'phang du: hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i dbang sdud mi g.yo mgon: nor bdag dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: thung la sbom zhing gsus khyim rab tu 'khyil: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan ral pa nor bus brgyan: snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub 'khrol: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nor skyug pho mo brdzis: pang du 'khyud pa'i ku ru kul+le ma: dmar mo mdzes ldan g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor ma: g.yas pas bum pa g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan bde stong brkyang bskum 'khril: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rat+na'i dbus su gsal: hūm̐: yab yum mdun du nor lha tshogs kyi bdag: glang po'i gdong can gser mdog phyag gnyis pa: rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang du ma spras: phyag g.yas thabs kyi dbang sdud chos can 'dzin: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i shes rab pad+ma bsnams: phyed skyil zhabs g.yon nor skyug ne'u le 'dzin: pang du 'khyud pa'i khyab 'jug 'dren bzang ma: sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis nor bus brgyan: g.yas g.yon sgra snyan 'gugs pa'i pi waṃ bsnams: zung 'jug 'khyud sbyor zhabs gnyis sked nas 'khyud: gzhan snang 'gro ba dbang sdud tshur du gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i nor skyong tshogs: sgyu ma rol pa'i cho 'phrul ji lta bzhin: dmigs med snang gzugs tsam du wal gyis gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams:

bsod nams longs spyod 'phel phyir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dang po spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐: dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dzam bha la: yab yum pho nya dang bcas gshegs su gsol: mthun 'grub yid 'ong rin chen khri la bzhugs: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal: oṃ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos 'byor yid sprul snod bcud dpal 'byor dang*/ /nyer spyod 'dod yon bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ /rin chen sna bdun kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs/ /kun 'byung nor bu'i rdzas su byin brlabs nas/ /dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung gnas dzam+bha la/ /'dod rgu mchog sbyin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dkar gsum zag med bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: sman mchog la sogs dza gad rgyas pa'i phud: bha ling tshogs gtor ga ṇa rdzas kyi bcud: mthun spyod yid la rgyal ba'i sbrags ma kun: dpal ldan dzam lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i tshogs: rtsol med lhug pa rgyun gyi sbyin nas kyang : skye 'gro snang srid dbang du sdud pa dang : mchog thun 'dod don 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rin chen las grub 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang : sna tshogs yid kyi 'dod 'jo rin chen steng : dpal ldan nor gyi dbang phyug dzam+bha la: kai la'i mdangs ldan lcags kyu ne'u le 'dzin: rat+na'i rgyan ldan brkyang bskum 'gying bag can: longs spyod bdag po khyod la bdag bstod do:

hūm̐: shes rab gzhon nu chags pa'i yid 'phrog ma: yum chen kul+le pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: bde ba'i lang tsho rab rgyas nor bus brgyan: zung 'jug phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor sgyur byed ma: 'gro ba'i bsod nams dbang du sdud la bstod: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen po ma hā dhe wa'i bu: tshogs kyi bdag po khyab 'jug sna ring gdong : gtso las 'khyud cing mdangs ldan nor bus brgyan: dbang sdud phyag mtshan u ma pang du 'khyud: skye 'gro yid 'gul longs spyod bdag gi che: sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa: lha chen tshogs bdag khyed la bdag bstod do: de nas 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' ltar khyab pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo nas: sgyu ma'i gar gyis cho rol dgyes mdzad pa: longs spyod bdag po skye dgu'i dbang sdud che: nor bdag mgon po pho nya lha chen bcas: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam rgyud bskul lo: lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba dbang du sdud: sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad phyir: deng sang 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: 'dod don dpal 'byor thugs dam deng stsol cig: de nas bzlas dmigs ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng zla zhun dwang ma lta bu las 'od 'phros/ phyogs dus zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ snod bcud sdig sdug gyi rgyu 'bras stong par byas/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi tshe bsod phywa dpal ma lus 'ja' zer thig le'i rnam par sa bon la thim pas bstan 'gro'i don thams cad 'dod rgu yid bzhin du sgrub thub pa'i mthu nus thob par bsams la/ rtsa sgrub sngags 'bum phrag bzla'o/ dang po bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ pad+ma puṇ+yai rā ga pra mo ti ku mā ra sarba sid+dhi thun dzaḥ

gsum pa las sbyor sngags ni/ oṃ pad+ma tsar+ya rā ga h+ya sha mu ṭa dhe wi ma hā gha na pa ti ku ru kul+le sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun sarba sid+dhi: las sbyor snga ma'i bcu cha bzlas/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas dang*/ rjes chog la dang po mchod bstod bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin dbang gis rab skyud pa/ /o rgyan pad 'byung dzaṃ lha'i dkyil 'khor la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dpag yas mchod sprin 'bul/ /bsam 'phel dpal 'byor sbyin la bdag bstod do/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: ma rig 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol: zhes lhag chad bkang zhing yig brgya brjod/ rten bzhugs spyi ltar bya'o/ mthar bdag nyid 'od kyi phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid lhar gsal bar thim/ de thugs srog sa bon la/ de na dā'i bar rim gyis thim nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid la bzhag /slar yang*/ oṃ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ kyis skur ldang nas/ spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ dang badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes lus bsrung zhing go bgos la/ dge ba 'di?sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi tshogs mchod spros pa sogs 'dod na/ gong nas gsungs pa ltar gzhung chen las shes par bya'o/ dzam lha dkar po rgyun gyi ngag 'don chog khrigs 'di ni rang nyid kyi nyams len gyi nyer mkhor gzhi bzung pad+ma rgyal po'i bum sgrub byed pa'i bar seng thun mtshams su tshogs kyi bdag pos skyong bar grags pa bal po'i yul gyi cha shas mchod rten chen mo bya rung kha shor gam zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling du rgyal ba'i chos 'khor chen mo'i dus chen bzang po'i nyin man+t+ra gu h+ya shā sa dhā ras bris pas 'gro kun snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs ming gi lhag mar byas nas rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i las tshogs dzam dkar tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dang po tshogs bsang sbyang chu gtsang gis bran la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros bag chags sbyangs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūṃ/ de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas/ /rtsa gsum nor lha chos skyong bcas/ /tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'dir ru byin phob la/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la bkrag mdangs bskyed/ /'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi/ de nas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon sna lnga'i gter/ /nang mchod rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin/ /gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sna tshogs dbang po 'dis/ /dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gnod sbyin dzaṃ lha dkar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum mchog ku ru kul+le'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'od ldan klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang*/ /gter srung dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes pa rab bskyed nas/ /sgrub la 'dod rgu yid bzhin char ltar phob/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /lha sngags ma gsal mchod rdzas ma tshang sogs/ /phyi nang dam 'gal nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /bskang zhing bshags na tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes yig brgya bzlas: lhag chad bkang*/ de nas bsgral ba ni/ de nas dmigs bya 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni/ dgra bgegs nri tri sha truṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las byed badz+ra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi bran zhing 'bul/ de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i tshogs/ /lhag sdud ging sman laṅka'i tshogs/ /bka' yi lhag ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ ma mo rak+mo ting ting shag shag dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas/ /o rgyan nor lhas thugs bskyed gzi byin skyed/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol/ /'dod rgu zad med rin chen char ltar phob/ /thugs dam bskul lo bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya ma hā bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa ru/ /'og min dga' tshal mchims phu gnas mtsho ru/ /snang mtha' pad 'byung rtsa gsum gling pa yis/ /rgyud gsung gter du sbas dang bton pa'i tshe/ /dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro nor lha gter srung gis/ /ci bcol bka' bzhin bsgrub par dam bcas bzhin/

/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ kro ta kro ti ya kro ta bha sa ki si bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bod skyong brtan ma ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe rogs dan mdzod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ ma mo mu kha le ting ting shag shag kha kha khā hi: de nas rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbang chen rngam pa'i bro ra ru/ khro rgyal stobs kyi bro brdungs pas/ /dgra sri dam nyams thal bar brlag /nam yang dam sri ma ldang cig /oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nanaḥ dam sri mā ra ya rbad ching nan nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar zad la me tog 'thor zhing*/ rten 'brel gang rigs kyi mchod pa yang bya/ skabs su dngos grub 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: ka dag ye shes dbyings nyid las: lhun grub sgyu mar bzhengs pa'i sku: nor bdag chen po longs spyod rje: dbang sdud mgon po 'khor bcas rnams: sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: phywa g.yang longs spyod char ltar phob: pha rol 'gro ba dbang du sdud: dpal dang snyan grags deng 'dir stsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma dha ra bai shra ma na rā ga pra ma ku ru kul+le: pra ti dza sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas 'od zhu bdag la bstim/ bshags pa ni/ oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: ma rig 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol: zhes lhag chad bkang zhing yig brgya brjod/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya'o/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ ye shes ngang las dgongs pa zang thal gyis: dkyil 'khor hūm̐ bsdu hūm̐ yang gsal stong ngang : sku bzhi ma bcos spros bral stong pa yis: ka dag dbyings rig shar grol a la bzhag: a a āḥmathar bdag nyid 'od kyi phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid lhar gsal bar thim/

de thugs srog sa bon la/ de na dā'i bar rim gyis thim nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid la bzhag /slar yang*/ oṃ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti rā ga dha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ kyis skur ldang nas/ spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ dang badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes lus bsrung zhing go bgos la/ de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo byed rgyal po ye rig shes pa'i rgyu: bsngo yul rang rtsal gshis lugs smra bo che: bsngo ba kun 'byung 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: de dag rig pas bsal bzhag bral bar bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ srid pas bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'ching las rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs shing : mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang myur thob shog: bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yid bzhin mchog: zil gnon pad+ma dbang sdud rgyal po rtsal: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho klu mo gter gyi bdag: phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog: rjes kyi tshogs mchod spros pa sogs 'dod pa dag la gzhung nas blang gsungs pa ltar pad rgyal las gzhung las blang la 'ga' zhig tshig sna cung bsdus shing lha mtshan kha sgyur la bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di yang dzam lha dkar po rgyun gyi ngag 'don chog khrigs kyi yan lag nyer mkhor dmigs te klu chen yongs su srung ba'i mtha' yas rgya mtsho chen po g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal ltar 'tsher ba'i dbus su nor bu'i phra tshom bkod pa bzhin gnas pa'i phun tshogs lta na sdug pa the wan gling phran zhes ma hā tsi na'i cha shas su 'bod pa'i mdzes ljongs kyi lte ba the pe gnam lcags chos tshogs su rab byung 17pa'i shing sprel lor bod zla 7 mar gyi ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen bzang po'i nyin man+t+ra gu h+ya shā sa dhā ras bris pas snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs 'joms pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // na mo pad+ma rā dza yai/

'dir nor sgrub bla ma'i bsang mchod rtsom par 'dod na ni/ thog mar klu dang phyogs su 'khod pa'i maṇ+ḍal zla gam mam dal steng phun sum tshogs par byas pa'i khar dbang gi mchod rdzas sman raka gtor ma dkar mngar gyi 'bru sman dar zab phye mar 'o zho mar thud phun sum tshogs pa bcas srid 'dir tshang tshad kyi mchod rdzas zad mi shes pa bshams te/ dmar snum bags kyis brlan zhing dbang gi dbang shing dmar po zla gam sum brtsegs steng mchod rdzas rnams bsregs la rang nyid bag gro lhun chags kyis rje btsun ma hā gu ru la brtse ba'i gdung shugs kyi ngang la 'di skad do/ hūm̐: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi ri rab ngogs/ /dur khrod dbang mo 'gyu ba gnas kyi bdag /dbang lhun yid bzhin lha chen sgeg pa'i nyams/ /dkar dmar srub pa'i myos byed snum thabs can/ /srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /yid la 'khu ba'i nor skyong ne'u le thogs/ khams gsum snying 'dogs lcags kyu'i 'od zer g.yo/ /kun+da ze'u 'brur 'brug pas na da bzhad/ /gsus khyim bsod nams zhum med zhabs dkyil bzhugs/ /stobs ldan mgrin bzang mu kha'i bcud ster ba'i/ /reg bya g.yo ba lang tsho 'dzin ma'i 'khor/ /rjes su chags pa'i gzugs dbang longs spyod spel/ /pad+ma rā ga'i cha shas lang tsho 'khyud/ /'ga' zhig zla gzhon lan brgyar byam dor g.yab/ /la la sa snying bzhad mdzes chu skyes rgyas/ /phal cher 'dar ma'i sgras bskul mar gad 'tsher/ /kun kyang sgra gcan srang 'jug gug rtse bsgrengs/ /yid la bskyod pa'i nor 'dzin ne'u le 'phyo/ /pad+ma rā dza 'khor dang phyag brnyanyan bcas/ /spyan 'dren 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /nor bu rin chen pad nyi'i khri 'phang bzhugs/ /gus pas bstod de ci srid 'dod rgu yi/ /rab 'byams mchod rdzas thams cad phangs med 'bul/ /bstod kyang dus la mi 'da' phrin las nyid/

/che btsan dbu rab gtsug rab rgyal po'i 'khor/ /lung rigs mkhas dbang mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta/ /btsun mo 'khor 'bangs chos srid lugs gnyis kyis/ /ci srid bsdus pa'i skye 'gro ma lus dang*/ /de srid lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kun/ /deng 'dir dbang du sdud pa'i las brtsam phyir/ /phun tshogs bsang mchod rin chen 'di bzhes la/ /chos srid mnga' thang 'dod rgu dpal zhing sogs/ /mthong thos dran rig bdag gi bran du shog /rgyal ba'i thugs rje ye shes dbyings nas bskul/ /pad 'byung nor gyi lha khyed bdag bsgrub kyi/ /rgya gar chos dang rgya nag khrims kyi g.yang*/ /sku rgyal bod kyi zas dang ge sar dmag /za hor gos dang mon gyi 'bru g.yang dang*/ /drang srong tshe g.yang stag gzig nor gyi g.yang*/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i che btsan gzi brjid bcas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med deng stsol shog /ces 'di bzhin nor sgrub cha lag bsang zhig brtsam dgos zhes sngags kyi btsun chung bsnyen sgrub myur len pa rat+na kīrti nas bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun chen po rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug rgyan du bkod pa'i rgyud 'dzin rmongs blun rgyal ming gis rang bzo blo rtsom la zhe gtad mi snang bzhin/ dam pa de'i gsung tshig dzam+bu chu gser gyi zegs ma de nyid rang blo'i dri sbags kyis ma bslad par rang sems rnam par dag pa'i baiḍūr+ya mthing bzang dam tshig rtsi bcud du smin bzhin rnam gsum dag pa chen po'i phrin bcol dpag bsam dbyig tu smin pa yon tan tsā ri ṭa mthong grol gze rgyal rin po che'i shar 'dabs bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du pad+ma rā dza'i thun mtshams su zla tshes dge bar bris pas 'gro kun rje btsun pad+ma rgyal pos dbang bsgyur ba'i mgon du shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gu ru nor lha dbyer med kyi g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung : gang gi thugs rje'i rnam rol rmad po che: mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor los phyug pa'i phyir: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i chu rgyun 'di na spro: de yang g.yang rten rdzas gtor sogs: pad+ma rgyal po'i spyi gzhung 'gal med legs par grub nas: ༈ dang po sgab 'dre bse rag bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag pad+ma he ru kaḥ nyon cig bse rag dbul sri ltogs 'gong tshogs: dbus kyi ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir: spyi mthun chos nor longs spyod spel ba la: rang rang las kyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i: dbul sri mi la bse rag zhes bya ba: gang gi rgyu ni ser sna'i rang gzugs te: rkyen ni rgyu mthun yi dwags yid kyi lus: sna tshogs gzugs su brdzu zhing dpal g.yang rku: snod bcud rten 'brel legs tshogs spel ba la: byur dang mi kha god kha gang stong sogs: rnam kun bar chad sna tshogs sgab 'dre ldang : ltogs 'gong dbul sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs kun: tshwa ram sgog g.yer la sogs mi kha'i rdzas: rang rang yid mthun yas stags 'di longs la: lan chags bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis: myur du mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song : bsgo ba'i bka' las 'da' na lus ngag yid: yi dam drag tu khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ye shes lnga yi srung 'khor brtan par bsgom/ gnyis pa dag byed bsang khrus bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha shing bsang gis mi bsangs gang yang med: chab gtsang khrus kyis mi dag gang yang med: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul snang char: btsog mnol dme yugs mi gtsang grib phog pa: phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs rten 'brel nyes tshogs kun: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings klong : chos nyid rnam dag dbyings su dag gyur cig:

oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ.a a swā hā: zhes gter kha 'og ma sku dgongs las so/ de nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang dbang ba'i gces phrug pho mo rigs ldan gyi phyag tu lcags kyu ne'u le mda' dar dang pad+ma'i zhags pa bcas thogs/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i phyag tu rnga shing dang dam tshig rdo rje rat+na'i zhags pa bcas thogs la dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi mkha'/ /klong lnga zer thag phreng ba'i pho brang nas/ /skal ldan smin grol lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs rjes g.yang khug cig /gzung 'dzin bral ba sems nyid rig pa'i mkha'/ /rang gsal rig pa'i cho rol pho brang nas/ /rang rig sangs rgyas chos skur grol mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems byin rlabs g.yang khug cig /ma 'gags shar grol rang byung rig pa'i mkha'/ /mdo sde 'dul ba lung rigs pho brang nas/ /yo ga rnam gsum chos kyis smin mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rdzogs gzhi grol chos kyi g.yang khug cig /bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin 'dzam gling yongs kyi mkha'/ /snyan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma rig sems can 'khor ba stongs mdzad pa'i/ /skyes chen tshogs 'dus dge 'dun g.yang khug cig /thugs rje'i rtsal las gang 'dul sprul pa'i klong*/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg rim dgu yi lha/ /srid pa gsum na stobs bcus dbang bsgyur ba/ /yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub g.yang khug cig /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la lam lam 'gro/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma'i srog 'dzin ma/ /chos sku yum chen rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /ma sring mkha' 'gros rten 'brel g.yang khug cig /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' btags dam gnas pa/

/mthu rtsal stobs ldan sha khrag srog la rngam/ /dam sri bdud rigs dgra bgegs thal bar brlag /chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal g.yang khug cig /shar phyogs mgyogs ma rdo rje lcags kyu mas/ /yul 'khor srung dang dri za lha mi bcas/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /lho phyogs mgyogs ma rin chen zhags pa mas/ /'phags skyes po dang gshin rje lha mi bcas/ /lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /nub phyogs mgyogs ma pad+ma lcags sgrog mas/ /spyan mi bzang dang klu dbang lha mi bcas/ /nub phyogs ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /byang phyogs mgyogs ma rgya gram dril bu mas/ /rnam thos sras dang gnod sbyin lha mi bcas/ /byang phyogs sgra ma'i snyan la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /dngos grub bdag mo klu mo nor skyong mas/ /lha klu mi yi mnga' thang longs spyod srid/ /tshe dpal mnga' thang snyan grags 'dod rgu'i dpyid/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /gzhan yang lo zla tshes la dbang ba dang*/ /lo dang spar sme dus 'dzin sa yi bdag /chu tshod 'byung lnga'i khams dang rgyu skar gyi/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang*/ /dregs chen bco brgyad 'jigs dgu sde brgyad kyis/ /'dzam gling srid pa'i yid la gang mos pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /phywa khu ye g.yang khu ye hu ye g.yang sdud do/ zhes dang*/ de nas brtan bzhugs gsol ba ni/ e ma ho/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /rnam dag pad+ma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /snang mtha' 'od ma'i 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

/rnga yab dpal ri lhun grub pad+ma 'od/ /zangs mdog tsit+ta'i dbyibs kyi pho brang nas/ /o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes rtsal lnga spras pa'i pho brang nas/ /thod phreng yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /brtan g.yo pad+ma rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang*/ /mi mthun bdud bzhi tshogs las rab rgyal nas/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ gu ru pad+ma sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ brtan bzhugs gsol nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma chags thogs med 'khor lo rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /yid 'ong mdzes ldan btsun mo rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur blon po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /theg chen stobs ldan glang po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /mi 'gyur dbyings kyi sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /kun nas kun tu bzung zhing rgyas gtab bo/ kyai/ bkra shis dang po'i rgyal mtshan gcig /gser nya rin chen bkra shis gnyis/

/chos dung g.yas 'khyil bkra shis gsum/ /dri med pad+ma bkra shis bzhi/ /lhun grub bum pa bkra shis lnga/ /yid 'jo dpal be'u bkra shis drug /mkha' yi gdugs mchog bkra shis bdun/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo bkra shis brgyad/ /mi shigs g.yu drung bkra shis dgu /phywa g.yang brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mi chod mi shigs rgyas gdab bo/ /rtsal chen khyung dang stobs chen sdig /sgo lha stag g.yag mtshams su ni/ /'byung po zhugs pa'i go skabs med/ /de bas srungs shig rgyas gdab bo/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rgyas 'debs bsngo smon sogs rten 'brel bzhin du bya/ g.yang 'gugs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes pa 'di/ gu ru nor lha dbyer med phrin chog kha skong du rong smyon pas sbyar ba dge/ bkra shis shog/ // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ g.yang 'gugs kha skong nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so// // hūm̐/ g.yang dgu pa 'bod pa gang nas 'bod/ /g.yang dgu klu yi yul nas 'bod/ /'og phyogs rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong*/ /'dod rgu phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas/ /nor bu gter rgyas khang bzang dbus/ /rin chen ri rab 'khyud 'khor mtshams/ /dgos 'dod dpag bsam shing gi bdag /lha klu mi gsum kun gyi rje/ /bzhugs pa'i gter bdag chen mo ni/ /ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /nor bu phul nas rten 'brel rnyed/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi la/ /bu nor spyan gyi sbyin bdag mdzad/ /sdug bsngal yongs bral dga' bde rgyas/ /klu yi rgyal po dga' bo yis/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags gling gi bdag /mā ra ti ka'i sgrub gnas su/ /man+da ra bar tshe chu phul/ /ye nas tshogs rdzogs nor gyis phyug /phongs sri kun bral nor rgyas kyis/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig

/lho phyogs 'dzam gling rgya mtsho'i bdag /dha na ko sha 'o mtsho nas/ /pad 'byung 'khrungs pa'i gnas tshang mdzad/ /yid bzhin 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub/ /zad med 'dod 'jo'i 'jog po ches/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /nub phyogs ba lang mtsho gling bdag /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bhi na sar/ /bdud rtsi chang gi dngos grub phul/ /kun la gdung shugs dung bas skyong*/ /snying rje phar phyin dung skyong mas/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /byang phyogs sgra mi rgya mtsho'i bdag /nā ga in+d+ra drang srong cher/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum pa phul/ /bsod nams sbyin stobs phul du phyin/ /longs spyod gter rgyas rtag myos kyis/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /mtshams bzhi gling phran rgya mtsho'i bdag /chos nor dngos grub 'dab stong rgyas/ /pad+ma chen po zhes bya bas/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /gzhan phan re ba'i bsam pa 'grub/ /klu rgyal chen po hu len tas/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /mchog gis srid pa stong khams skyong*/ /'jig rten mes po rigs ldan rjes/

/mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /kun la dbang sgyur stobs kyi bdag /klu rgyal chen po ba su tas/ /mchog thun gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub/ /zas nor 'dod rgu char ltar 'bebs/ /mi zad gter gyi klu g.yang kun/ /de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /gang de klu rgyal chen po brgyad/ /sku mdog mthing dkar ser dmar ljang*/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka bdun dang ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /phyag na yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /sman gyi ljon shing 'bru bcud 'bras/ /rin chen gter sgrom char sprin 'dzin/ /klu rgyal rnams kyi yum chen ni/ /rang rang mdog mtshungs sbrul gdong can/ /phyag na char gyi gzhong pa dang*/ /nor bu bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dzin/ /sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil/ /rin chen rgyan gyis gzi 'od 'bar/ /'khor yug rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs bram ze gdol pa sogs/ /klu rigs grangs med yongs su 'khor/ /bsam 'phel gang 'dod longs spyod tshogs/ /ka cha dkor nor srid rdo dang*/ /'jig rten khams kyi bkod pa kun/ /sa 'og kun khengs gter kha rgyas/ /rma g.yang zhag chags gzi 'bar g.yo/ /dpe zla bral ba ku mud che/ /rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /gser gyi glang chen maṇ+ḍal phul/ /yid bzhin nor sgrub gdams pa gnang*/ /bsam yas rab gnas bgyis pa'i tshe/ /gser gyis gangs can 'gengs pa zhig /phul bas chu bo gser ldan gyur/ /gsang sngags chu bo gar khyab tu/ /klu yis grogs mdzad gter kha dang*/ /yid bzhin nor sogs dpag med sbyin/ /'dod 'byung chos nor dngos grub rnyed/ /gzhan yang klu yi dngos grub dang*/

/gang 'dul mdzad pa'i sbyin bdag grogs/ /'byung ba dus bzhi'i 'phel rgyas bcas/ /klu yi mdzad pa brjod mi langs/ /de phyir dngos grub kun gyi bdag /gang de klu rgyal sems dpa' che/ /gzhon nu rnam rol phyin snga ru/ /sngon gyi tha tshig thugs bskyed bzhin/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sa steng gi/ /lhar bcas skye 'gro mtha' dag kun/ /'phel bskyed g.yo ba 'byung ba la/ /sa gzhi klu yi dngos grub de/ /de ring smon lam stobs kyis 'bod/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad nas/ /phyi snod 'byung bzhi bcud kyi bdag /sman dang rtsi shing lo tog sogs/ /me tog sbrang rtsi dkar mngar dang*/ /'bru sna longs spyod srid dgu'i gter/ /rol pa'i mtsho bdun bdud rtsi'i zhag /'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /rin chen dag dang gser ri bdun/ /dgos 'dod dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*/ /'og phyogs klu yi nor sna bcas/ /'jig rten srid pa'i dkor nor rigs/ /rwa can rmig zlum kha brag khri/ /gser dngul gang 'dod longs spyod kyi/ /sa 'dir srid kun khyod kyis bdag /'dzad med gter gyi khang bzang nas/ /phangs med klu g.yang ma lus pa/ /'byung ba'i dwangs ma bcud kyi bcud/ /nang bcud skye 'gro'i gsos su dpal/ /tshe bsod longs spyod dbang thang gi /lang tsho gsar pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /dpal stobs 'bras bu ches sman zhing*/ /mchog dang thun mong grub gnyis kyi/ /char rgyun gter kha brdol ba yi/ /klu dbang nyid dang mnyam gyur pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bkra tshig ltar/ /phywa g.yang brtan mkhar ma nyams shig /hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no/ zhes pa 'di bzhin dgos ched ci zhe na/ gzhung gi g.yang 'gugs nas dgu pa ma tshang kha skong dang bka' skyong klu yin 'dug pas/ 'di ltar dgos ched che bar sems nas rgyal ming gis gze rgyal bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du bsam pa lhun grub thun mtshams su bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen gyi zhi sgrub khrigs su bsdebs pa bsod nams dpal skyed bzhugs so/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la 'dud: nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen gyi zhi sgrub khrigs chags su bsdebs pa la: gong gnon bdag bskyed kyi bla gtor spyi 'gro dang sman raka nyer spyod bcas bshams pa'i mdun du/ gzhung las gzhi dkar gtsang gi steng du 'bru tshom bkod: snod rin po che las grub pa'i pad gzhong gi nang du: gtor ma nor bus mtshan pa zlum po 'khor rang 'dra bzhi: mdun du klu bshos sngon po sbrul dkris can: gtso 'khor thams cad la nor bus brgyan pa mtheb skyu nyer gcig bcas: zhes dang : bsang mchod gser skyems spyan gzigs dang bcas bshams la: zhi bar bdud rtsis bran: zhes dang : zhi bar klu sman gyis mchod: gzhan yang rol mo dbyangs sogs spyi 'gro ci rigs mos: thog mar pad+ma rgyal po'i mchod sprin nam: rtsa gsum gang rigs thon pa'i rjes su: zhes gsungs pa ltar spro na gu ru nor lha rtsa ba'i sgrub gzhung dang*/ rtsa gsum gang rigs kyi bdag bskyed bya ba gsungs kyang*/ gzhung 'di ga'i khyad par bdag bskyed ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi gtor mchod rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid skad cig pad+ma 'byung gnas dmar: thugs rje'i spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil: smug nag phod ka sngags chas rnam gsum gsol: dbu la zil gnon pad zhwa mthon mthing la: baiḍūr+ya dang nyi zla nor bus brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan+dha bsnams: de nang yid bzhin nor bu'i bcud kyis bkang : gru mor dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: rin chen sna tshogs sku la drwa bas bres: g.yer kha dang ni me long rgyan gyis spras: rgya lham gsol nas zhabs gnyis dor stabs bzhugs:

pad+ma nyi zla nor bu'i khri 'phang mtho: phyi rol nor bu'i gdugs dang gur rwas phub: nor bu'i tog dang drwa ba phyogs bzhir brkyangs: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde bzhi cod pan mdzes: g.yas su tshe la dbang ba'i sgeg mo dmar: g.yon du bde chen bskyed pa'i dpa' mo dkar: gnyis ka gzhon tshul mdzes rgyan rigs lngas spras: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas bhan+dha'i nang : dngos grub ster ba'i nor bu du mas bkang : sgrub la mchog thun stsol ba'i nyams can bsgom: spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nub phyogs o rgyan zhing khams nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum la: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: dkyil 'khor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dal: klu yi pho brang chen po ru: zad med gter gyi khang bzang dbus: dgyes pa bskyed de byon gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: spyan la dgyes pa'i gzugs mdzes ma: snyan la dgyes pa'i sgra snyan ma: shangs la dgyes pa'i dri mchog ma: ljags la dgyes pa'i ro mchog ma: sku la dgyes pa'i reg bya ma: rje btsun pad+ma yab yum gyis: phyi yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: dri bzang byugs pa'i bcud ldan sman: longs spyod ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: dam tshig gtsang ma'i rak+ta bcud: dam rdzas gser skyems dza gad chang : phyag rgya drug bcas bde ba'i mchog: nang gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba oṃṇ+yai pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling+ta rak+ta n+yeṃ ta a si mu pa ṭa ye swā hā: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag mkha' la nyi zla'i dal 'khor ltar: dri med gzi brjid dbang po'i phreng ba bzhin: phyogs bcu'i zhing nas mngon 'phags pad+ma 'byung : kun mkhyen 'khor lo'i khyab bdag bde ba'i bcud:

g.yo ba rab rgyas zungs kyis legs brgyud pa: zla rgyas 'bum gyi mdangs la byi dor bzhin: gsang ye man+da ra dang mtsho rgyal yum: bgrang yas zhing gi bkod pa gcig tu rgyas: snang srid dbang bsgyur zung 'jug 'od kyi sku: mtshan dpe bkod rdzogs bla ma yab yum la: mi phyed gdung bas btud de phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dzab bsnyen ni: oṃ badz+ra gu ru a bhi bhu ya ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa mu dra sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bzla'o: mdun bskyed ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung : yab yum mdun du klu yi pho brang ni: yid mtshar lta na sdug pa'i gzhal med dbus: sa brgyad non pa'i tshul can sems dpa'i gzugs: sku mdog sngon po spyi bor la thod nang : nor bu 'bar ba yid bzhin 'khor los brgyan: sbrul rigs lnga yi chings dang cod pan tshul: phyag gnyis nor bu 'bar ba'i gzhong pa thogs: dar ljang stod g.yogs dar dmar ang rag gsol: gnod sbyin gzugs can pus btsugs gus pa yi: tshul gyi mos pas mchod de 'bul bar bskyed: g.yas g.yon mdun sogs phyogs mtshams brgyad dag nas: klu yi dbang mo yid 'ong mdzes ldan ma: kha dog phyogs mthun spyi bor nor bus brgyan: sku smad sbrul du gnas pa'i rnam pa can: phyag na bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa: nor bu'i rigs byed rna cha'i bye brag sogs: yid mtshar lha klu mi yul ci srid pa: de srid thogs nas rje la 'bul bar bsgom: de yi phyi rol rgyal srid sna bdun dang : 'khor ba'i 'dod rgu phun tshogs tshang bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: tshangs pa'i yul dang ri rab zom gyi gsham: rol mtsho gling sogs rang rang gnas mchog nas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren ni: hrīḥ 'od kyis 'gugs pa'i dzaḥyig las: spros pas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: klu yi gnas su phog pa las: thugs rje'i shugs kyis spyan drangs gyur:

tshangs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: gtsang ma lha yis gshos pa'i bu: lha bu gzi brjid gshegs su gsol: chags pa mi yis gshos pa'i bu: bram ze klu dbang gshegs su gsol: bde ba klu yis gshos pa'i bu: la thod dkar po gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin dga' ba ldan pa'i bu: nor bu 'od 'bar gshegs su gsol: ri rab gling bzhi dbang bsgyur ma: klu mo mched brgyad gshegs su gsol: dus bzhir 'gyu ba gnod sbyin mo: mtsho bdag klu yi dbang mo bzhi: sprul pa dang bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ nā ga rā dza ma hā rā dza ma ṇi dha ra nā ga iṣ+ṭhi rasmi sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang bskur zhing gzi byin bskyed pa ni: oṃ: sku yi dbang bskur bum pa mkha': āḥ gsung gi dbang bskur sngags dbang bcud: hūm̐: thugs kyi dbang bskur chos dbang sems: hrīḥ de bzhin dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: sku gang dri ma dag pa yis: lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las: gu ru yab yum dbu rgyan gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ gu ru bhi dho dha ra dha ra hūm̐: mchod pa ni: hrīḥ yid 'ong 'chi med bcud kyis legs sbyar ba: gtsang ma'i phud dang dri bzang gtams pa'i ro: lnga ldan 'dod yon sna tshogs gser skyems dang : klu bshos dkar gsum phud dang shing 'bras 'bru: yid dang mthun pa'i spyan gzigs la sogs pa: bkra shis rdzas rtags phun sum tshogs pa'i rten: klu yi rgyal po klu mo dbang mor bcas: dngos grub 'dod rgu sbyin la mchod rdzas 'bul: bzhes nas klu g.yang dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ dhe wa nā ga rā dza yakā aṣ+ṭa ma ni dha ra yā: oṃ nā ga de wi ma ṇi mu dra sarba ka na ṣa iṣ+ṭa yā: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta pañtsa pū dza bha ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra oṃ āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: snod bcud pho brang yid 'ong rgya mtsho'i klong : 'dzam gling bye ba khrag khrig bcud du sdus:

rnam rgyal rin chen nor bu'i pho brang dbus: lha klu mi yi 'dod rgu srid kyi mchog: ma hā dhe ba pho nyar bskul ba ltar: 'dod rgu'i dpal la bzhad pa'i gnas mchog tu: klu yi rje bo in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs: kai la sha ltar thod brgyan mdzes pa'i dbus: rin chen rat+na'i zur phud 'od rab 'byin: gdengs ka nā ga ra la'i cod pan brgyan: phyag gnyis 'dod 'byung ma ṇi in+d+ra'i gzhong : legs par bkang ba swo na'i mdangs bzhin 'bar: lha rdzas mar gad mdangs ldan stod du g.yogs: bklubs pa'i smad g.yogs pad+ma rā ga'i bcud: zhabs gnyis gus pas sa la pus btsugs tshul: gter bdag klu yi dbang por bdag bstod do: hrīḥ srub skyed nor bu 'khyil ba'i rol mtsho'i gling : dri med mdangs ldan 'khor yug 'od kyis khengs: 'byung lnga'i zhag g.yo bcud kyis gtams pa'i dbus: smig sgyu spyod pa'i ltad mo snang tshul bzhin: 'phyo zhing rlabs mi g.yo ba'i dkyil shed na: gter bdag chen po nā ga dhā ra ni: mi mo mthing bzang lan tshar kyud pa'i nyams: rab dkar dwangs pa'i zla gzhon g.yo ba ltar: yid 'dzin klu yi dbang mo 'dod 'byung ma: chags pa'i g.yo bas skye 'gro'i bcud du 'dzin: bde ba rtag tu spyod pa'i bum bzang ma: dga' ba 'khor lo phreng ba'i dwangs cha 'dren: khyab 'jug rlung gi dzaḥzhags g.yas su thogs: zad med kun 'byung gzhong pa g.yon du bsnams: thabs kyis bsgrubs pas shes rab bskyed pa'i yum: rat+na'i phreng ba rgyan cha khra la la: rang 'dra bdun kyang rin chen sna tshogs thogs: sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i dbang mo che: gter grogs lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: nor bu 'od mtsho yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i ljongs: rnal 'byor bdag gis bsgrubs shing mchod lags na: longs spyod sna tshogs char bzhin 'bebs pa dang : rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: klu yab yum gyi sngags: oṃ ma hā dhe wa nā ga ra tsa dhe wi iṣ+ṭa rat+na sarba sid+dhi dzaḥdzaḥ

'khor gyi klu mo nor skyong ma'i sngags: oṃ nā ga dha ra ma ṇi mu dra u ma dhe wa iṣ+ṭa pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun swā hā: zhes bzlas so: bskang ba ni: mchod pa rnams kha gsos la: lha grangs mnyam pa'i mtheb skyu klu sman chu gtsang gi gser skyems 'bul zhing : hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan rin chen gter gyi bdag: yab ni gnod sbyin ma hā dhe: yum ni klu mo dung skyong ma: de gnyis ri rab byang phyogs su: 'khrig cing sbyor ba gnas pa las: g.yu yi grod pa skyes pa'i nang : gnod sbyin chen po nya nag gdong : pho brang 'od ldan mtsho la bor: nor skyong klu mo'i zer bskrun pas: sdug bsngal srid pa'i las rgya grol: sangs rgyas gzhon nu rnam rol gyi: dam tshig blangs nas dge bsnyen phog: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de nas ri bo ma la yar: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po yis: dkyil 'khor gral du bcug nas kyang : nor bu 'od 'bar mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bla med sngags la 'jug pa'i phyir: zab lam gnyan gyi bka' gtad tshe: gsang ba yum la mtshan gsol ba: klu mo nor bu 'od mtsho ma: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol:

hūm̐: ston pa shākya thub pa yis: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: nor bu phul nas dam chos bskul: gtsug na nor bu mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: o rgyan za hor gnas mchog tu: chos kyi 'dul bya gzigs pa'i tshe: pad 'byung 'khrungs pa'i bla mtsho phul: klu rgyal 'jog por mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: thor cog dgu ldan pho brang du: chos rgyal -in+d+ra bo dhi la: bu nor spyan gsum sbyin bdag mdzad: klu rgyal dga' bor mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: o rgyan rgyal khams byang phyogs su: rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro bhi na sar: bdud rtsi chang gi dngos grub gnang : dung skyong ma ru mtshan du gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: lha lcam man+da ra ba la: 'chi med tshangs pa'i tshe chu phul: klu rgyal nor rgyas mtshan gsol ba:

de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo ru: drang srong nā ga aṣ+ṭi la: man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum pa phul: klu rgyal rtag myos mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas mchog tu: pad 'byung spyod par gshegs pa'i tshe: so so klu yi gzugs bstan nas: klu chen brgyad du mtshan gsol ba: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bal yul nyi ma khud kyi gnas: slob dpon pad+ma byon pa'i tshe: rin chen nor bu'i sgrom bu phul: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu rir gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: a su ra yi brag phug tu: rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan zhus: sring mo bzhi ni grogs su phul: dge bsnyen drag po rtsal du gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang :
