bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: khye'u sha yi zur phud can: phyag 'tshal gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul: klu rgyal dbang lag mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bod yul me dro'i lung pa ru: sman chu dgu yi gter kha phul: sman sgrub bdud rtsi'i sbyin bdag zhus: rdo rje gzi 'bar mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i tshe: gser phye glang chen rlid bu'i gang : maṇ+ḍal phul nas nor sgrub zhus: mthu stobs dbang phyug mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bsam yas grub nas rab nas skyong : sdong po gser lag gdengs ka nas: rin chen gser phye dpag med phul: drag po brda skyong mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol:

hūm̐: 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro ru: mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe: chu tshan sman dang bcud len phul: dge bsnyen chos phan chen por gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor zab rgya gtad pa'i tshe: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyis: klu mo nor bu mdzes byed mar: gter bdag chen mor mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dge bsnyen mtsho nag rba klung nas: pad+ma rgyal po spyan drangs te: dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'grub pa'i tshe: gter bdag yab yum mtshan yang gsol: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa dang : bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ nā ga rā dza dhe wa aṣ+ṭi sarba ma hā dhe wa yak+ṣa nā ga dha ra aṣ+ṭi rasmi bha wa kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen mnyes pa'i rdzas: ri rab lhun po nyi zla'i phreng bas brgyan: skar tshogs grangs med 'od 'khyil 'bum 'bum 'gyed: rol mtsho gling dgu lcags ri mu khyud bcas: nye ba'i gser ri bdun dang sbas mtsho bdun: dpag bsam ljon shing ma rmos lo tog dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun:

skyed tshal tshang tshing 'khrigs dang nags ma'i khrod: klu yi yul ljongs spang gshong bde mo'i dpyid: ne'u sing sman ljongs me tog skyid mo'i tshal: 'bab chu khron pa lteng ka lu ma dang : dal ldan gtsang po yar 'khor smrig ga chags: gzhan yang rba 'khrugs rlabs kyis bskyod pa dang : yar rgyas tshangs pa'i sgang du 'bab pa sogs: gzhan yang dri zhim khor yug khyab pa'i gling : de ru 'khor ba'i bya gcan ri dwags dang : sbal sbrul sdig srin shol mo rta bla bcas: rkang drug rkang mang dud 'gro'i rigs byed tshogs: gzhan yang mkha' yi rgyan gyur rnam pa lnga: g.yu 'brug sde lnga glog gi zhags pa 'khyugs: chu 'dzin ngam nag khu rlangs phyu ru ru: 'ga' zhig phyogs su sprin dkar thul pa bklubs: me tog spungs 'dra'i sbrang char si li li: 'ja' 'od lu gu rgyud du phrig phrig g.yo: rgya mtsho'i mdangs kun zhag g.yo lnga ldan phyur: rnam par bkod pa'i gling mchog dam pa 'di: yab mchog ma hā de wa'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog klu mo dung skyong thugs dam bskang : sras mchog la thod dkar po'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin nya nag gdong gi thugs dam bskang : klu rgyal nor bu 'od 'bar thugs dam bskang : klu mo nor bu 'od mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : klu rgyal gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : klu yi rgyal po 'jog po'i thugs dam bskang : klu yi rgyal po dga' bo'i thugs dam bskang : klu yi rgyal po dung skyong thugs dam bskang : klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas thugs dam bskang : klu yi rgyal po rtag myos thugs dam bskang : klu rgyal chen po brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ri'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen dbang lag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen rdo rje gzi 'bar thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen mthu stobs dbang phyug thugs dam bskang :

dge bsnyen drag po brda skyong thugs dam bskang : klu mo nor bu mdzes byed thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen gter srung chen po'i thugs dam bskang : gzhi bdag klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : mchod pa 'bul lo nyams chag bshags gyur nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dang : dri chab zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: nang mchod sman raka bdud rtsi gtor ma dang : ga ṇa tsakra ta na sbyor ba'i phud: sman spos dri bzang a ka ru dang ni: klu sman dar zab spyan gzigs dkor cha dang : rta sngon g.yag sngon lug sngon ra sngon dang : bya sngon sprel sngon sbrul sngon sbal sngon dang : dar mdung sngon po nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang : pad+ma rā ga mar gad bai ḍūr+ya: spug dang mu tig byi ru ke ke ru: pha lam gser dngul sbur len man shel sogs: rin chen ri bo khang bzang gram du bdal: lha klu mi yi nor bu ji snyed pa: rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad: dar zab 'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan 'phur: ma rmos lo tog 'bru sna dkar mngar bcud: ga pur gur gum tsan+dan dkar dmar dang : dzā ti chu srin sder mo dbang lag mtshal: dung snying gzi khra zho sha rnam pa bzhi: ras skud spu shel rtse dang rma bya'i mdongs: thang lo smyug lo rdo rgyus ge sar gsum: spos dkar sle tres sug smel a bar skyur: li shi spang spos til dkar ut+pal sngo: zi ra so ma ra tsa ka ped dang : thal ka rdo rje shing mngar kan+ḍa kaḥ ru ta rgun 'brum go yu ka ko la: a 'bras sha 'bras ku ba 'dam bu kaḥ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba sbrul shun klu sman rigs: ba dmar ra dkar 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i: rin chen dam pa mnyes pa'i mchod sprin gyis: yab mchog ma hā dhe ba'i thugs dam bskang : sogs/ oṃ bā ta li bā ta li ma hā bā ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phrum phu swā hā:

de nas bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: 'dod khams dbang bsgyur longs spyod srid kyi rje: gser ri rol mtsho nor bu'i gling gi dbus: mi bo sngon po dung gi la thod can: spyi bor dgos 'byung yid bzhin nor bu'i tog: sbrul rigs lnga yi cod pan 'khyil bas brgyan: sku stod dar ljang stod g.yogs mdzes pas spras: phyag g.yas nor bu g.yon pas gter sgrom bsnams: sku yi cha la rin chen zhu lub brgyan: sku smad dar dmar chun po'i ang rag bklubs: zhabs gnyis bshibs te mchod pa 'bul ba'-i tshul: g.yon du klu mo nor bu 'od ldan ma: sku mdog dkar mo rin chen thor tshugs brgyan: sku stod dar dmar cod pan na ra ra: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: sku yi cha la nor bu'i rgyan drug gsol: zhabs gnyis brda 'gros ldem pa'i nyams dang ldan: klu yi dbang mo mtsho bdag dpal lha mo: 'khor du nor bu sman gzhong bcud bzang gis: gtams pa'i rin chen snod mchog thogs pa 'bum: bro gar glu bcas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dang : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gus pas mchod: gter gyi sgo 'byed gsang sngags sbyin pa'i grogs: zhi bas mthu chen sgrub pa'i cha lugs can: gter bdag yab yum gtso 'khor bdag bstod do: hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho gling gi mnga' dbang bsgyur: rin chen gter gyi rgya srung bya ra bgyid: rtag tu gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzad: sgrub pa'i bu la brtse ba'i ma bzhin skyong : mchog thun yid bzhin dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: bsod nams re skong phrin las sna tshogs sgrub: 'dod rgu'i srid la 'dzam gling kha lo bsgyur: 'bad rtsol med par dbul phongs pre ta bsal: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas skyong : sngags 'chang bdag la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: phyag rgya drug gis grol lam dga' bzhi bskyed: phun tshogs yar zla ltar bskyed phrin las tshogs:

grogs dan bgyis pa'i klu dbang yab yum gyis: rin chen gser skyems phud dang dkar gsum sogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol: gnyis med dgongs par dgyes pa bskyed nas su: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud: dgos 'dod bsod nams dpag med nam mkha'i khyon: ci ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa'i grogs: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma gtsang phyogs su 'bul: de ltar gling bzhi srid pa'i chu bdag dge bsnyen chen po'i zhi sgrub bsod nams dpal bskyed ces bya ba/ 'di yang char 'bebs gcod dang*/ srid kyi phywa g.yang spel ba sogs myur mgyogs kyi phrin las la nges pa rnyed nas/ gter gzhung lhan thabs cung zad kyis bslan te gter slob pa skyid grong smyaun pas bsgrigs pa dge'o// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bsod nams gter bum sba thabs 'dod 'jo bum bzang bzhugs so/ pad 'byung nor bdag rtsa ba'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsod nams zhing*/ /gang la gang 'dod rtsol med lhug stsol ba'i/ /gter bum sbas thabs 'dir 'bri bka' gnang stsol/ dha thim: nā ga rā dza ti pa ra tsa sa ma ya: rak+ṣa: de yang gter bum sbas pa'i don gsum te/ thog mar rdzas bsags pa/ bar du bsgrub pa/ tha mar gter sbas pa dang gsum las/ dang po rdzas bsags pa ni/ rab gser dngul zangs/ ma 'byor na rdza ma dmar po rtsi btang ba la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbyibs che chung gang 'byor bstun/ de yi phyi rol du steng du 'khor lo 'og tu pad+ma/ bar mtshams su bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun nor bu cha brgyad srung bzhi sogs thams cad tshang bar bris/ gzhan bum rdzas nyer lnga la chos sman sna tshogs/ 'bru lnga dar lnga sman spos lnga rin chen rnams gzhung tshig dang bstun pa dang*/

gzhan yang zas sna sa sna chu sna shing thog gi rigs spu sna sogs dang 'bru snas gang ba byas/ kha la chas bsdams la mi rul ba'i thabs bya/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ bum pa bsang sbyangs la gzhi dbus su bzhag nas/ pad+ma rgyal po'i sngon 'gro dang dkar bgegs btang la bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ chu gtsang gis bran la rin chen khang bzang ltar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rat+na mu la mañdza ye sogs nas/ byin 'bebs bya/ de nas gzhung gi las byang ltar/ hūm̐: pad 'byung sku gsum dbang sdud skur ston pa: sogs nas bsnyen par bskyal la/ rab 'bum phrag gsum/ 'bring 'bum phrag /tha ma yang khri gcig gis bsgrub/ sgrub tshe mi yi ma mthong bar bya/ rgyas na g.yang skyabs ltar sbrags na shin tu legs/ gsum pa bum pa sbas nas ni/ bang mdzod sogs la sbas na ni mi rul bar bya/ sa la sbas na mkhar gong shug shun sol ba sogs mang bar bsog /sbas sar phyin tshe bsang btang dkar gtor bsngos la/ bstan ma ltar bstun par brko/ 'og tu rdo g.yam bar du mkhar gong sogs kyis bkang la dbus su bum pa bzhag nas/ nor lha rgya mtsho spyan 'dren zhing 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin dbang gi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : gter 'byung nor mchog bla ma dzam bha lha: dbang sdud ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thugs rjes gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la 'dod rgu bstsal ba'i slad: rin chen khang bzang gter bum dbus su bzhugs: 'dzad med longs spyod dpal gyis phyug par stsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bum pa 'bul zhing brtan bzhugs gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dngos grub mchog stsol bla ma nor gyi lha:

lha lcam mtsho rgyal ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i yum: yum chen dbang mo phyogs kyi mgyogs ma bzhi: gzhi 'dzin klu mo nor skyong klu rgyal che: che btsan rgyal po rnam mang thos pa sras: sras yum skya brgyad gnod sbyin bdun 'bum 'khor: 'khor dang dzam+bha nor lha rta yi lha: lha chen dbang phyug chen po phyugs lha 'bum: 'bum phrag nor lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rnam par bzhugs shing dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten: rten rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa bkod legs mdzes: mdzes mtshon pad+ma stong ldan 'bru yi tshom: tshom bu gter bum gling bzhi'i rgyan bkod 'bum: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rnam rgyal rin chen gter bum brgyan ldan dbus: pad+ma rgyal po o rgyan nor gyi lha: dngos grub stsol ba'i nor lha khrom ltar 'tshogs: srog shing 'dzam bu pṛk+ṣa dbu ma'i tshul: sku rten ri bo mchog rab mtho la brjid: rin chen baiḍūr+ya yi nam mkha' dang : me shel nyi ma chu shel zla ba gsal: mgron bu'i skar tshogs dar zab 'ja' sprin 'khrigs: gser gyi ri bdun dngul gyi rol mtsho brgyad: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: shel dkar shar gling spos shel lho yi gling : byi ru nub gling g.yu 'di byang gi gling : mu tig mu men pad rag mar gad dang : mchong rag zangs dang in+ḍa gling phran brgyad: lcags kyi phyi yi lcags ris 'khor yug bskor: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: phyi yi rgyan bkod bkra shis rtags brgyad dang : rgya stag g.yu 'brug bya sbal srung bzhi tshang : rgyal po'i bla rten glang chen mche ba rno: btsun mo'i bla rten byi ru dbang gi rgyal: thabs shes rgyal po btsun mo rna cha gnyis: rin chen gser bre g.yu bre rgyan dang ldan: lha klu mi yi gtsug phud yid bzhin nor:

dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen rdzas mchog rnams: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rin chen 'od 'bar lha rdzas nor bu 'od: gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs steng mu khyud kyi: thabs mkhas blon po shes ldan btsun mo mdzes: shugs 'chang rta mchog khur theg glang po che: rtsal chen dmag dpon go khrab mtshon chas brgyan: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid tshang ba 'di: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dug lnga sel ba'i sman mchog rnam pa lnga: bang mdzod bcud 'phel 'bru sna phun sum tshogs: dri bzang kun la khyab pa'i ngad ldan spos: 'jam legs dkar dmar bkrag pa'i dar zab gos: mngar gsum rgun 'brum la sogs shing thog rigs: stong nas stong du 'phel ba'i rin chen stong : dung nas dung du 'phel ba'i dung dkar 'khyil: longs spyod kha zas 'phel ba'i ja mar thud: ma tshang med pa'i ji snyed ci 'byor kun: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: zhes lha tshogs rnams gter bum dang dbyer med bzhugs par bsam/ de nas bshags sbyang 'bul zhing dngos grub zhu ba ni/ gus 'dun dang bcas nas/ hūm̐: pad 'byung nor lha rgya mtsho bdag la dgongs: sngon nas da bar bdag sogs sems can rnams: brnab sems ser sna 'dod chags las dbang gis: ma byin blangs pa'i las kyis dbul phongs byung : de la skyob phyir o rgyan nor lha ru: sprul zhing dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'khor bcas thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ser sna'i dbang gis mchod rdzas zhan: le lo'i dbang gis sgrub pa dus las 'das: shes rab zhan pas bskyed rdzogs don ma mthong : smon lam ngan pas nor lhar brten ma shes: mi khom dbang gis lo zla dus mchod chad:

bying rmugs dbang gis thab gzhob dme 'khon shor: brtson 'grus chung bas rten rdzas bskang rdzas chad: slob dpon tshul bzhin ma bsten bla brdol bor: de sogs sngar byas ngan pa bshags sbyang 'bul: dag byed phrin las zhu ba'i rten du 'bul: sa yul gnas khang 'di ru bzhugs phyir 'bul: bdag la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mdo sngags bka' gter chos kyi dngos grub stsol: 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'dzad med rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang bskur dngos grub stsol: srid gsum zil gyis non pa'i dngos grub stsol: rgyal srid mnga' thang stobs kyi dngos grub stsol: btsun mo blon 'bangs bran g.yog dngos grub stsol: dbang thang snyan grags rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor phyug pa'i dngos grub stsol: bu slob chos brgyud rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: brgyud 'dzin rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol: btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzoms pa'i dngos grub stsol: mi 'phel rta hrag ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol: ka cha mkho dgu nang spyad dngos grub stsol: sha thud ja mar zas kyi dngos grub stsol: 'bru dang bang mdzod rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'jam phrug dar zab gos kyi dngos grub stsol: bde skyid dpal 'byor chos kyi dngos grub stsol: rta nor lug sogs phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol: sa bcud yul g.yang rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: rtswa kha lo thog legs pa'i dngos grub stsol: mdor na bdag gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i: dngos grub ma lus myur du stsal du gsol: zhes dngos grub 'dod don gang mos gsol ba gdab/ de nas bum pa gter du sbos la rab gnas 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐: dngos grub mchog stsol o rgyan nor lha'i tshogs: rin chen gzhal med khang bzang gter bum dbus:

bzhugs shing sa phyogs 'di ru bkra shis mdzod: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin chen gter sba'o: nor lha mi 'bral bzhugs pa'i gter sba'o: g.yang lha mi 'bral 'khor ba'i gter sba'o: khyim lha khyim du bzhugs pa'i gter sba'o: 'bru lha zhing du bzhugs pa'i gter sba'o: phyugs lha rwa bar bzhugs pa'i gter sba'o: lha srung 'khon grib sel ba'i gter sba'o: mkhas pa mnyes pa'i bcud 'phan gter sba'o: mtsher sri sel ba'i sa bcud gter sba'o: zhing sa ngan par 'bru 'phel gter sba'o: dur sa nyes par dpal 'phel gter sba'o: khang gsar bzos pa'i sa 'dzin gter sba'o: zas nor bsags pa'i g.yang rten gter sba'o: bang mdzod ka cha 'phel ba'i gter sba'o: pho rgyud dpa' bo'i rdzong chen gter sba'o: mo rgyud mdzangs ma'i bcud chen gter sba'o: rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i char rgyun gter sba'o: bu slob chos brgyud bstan 'phel gter sba'o: dbang thang rgyas pa'i 'khor lo gter sba'o: longs spyod phyug pa'i 'dod 'byung gter sba'o: g.yang rten rin chen nor bu gter sba'o: sa phyogs 'di ru lo legs 'bru 'phel zhing : dkar gzhon bcud 'byung phyugs rigs sgab 'phel rgyas: dus 'khrug nad mug btsa' than sad ser zhi: yul sri god kha mi rung mi 'dod zlog: bkra shis dge legs gong nas gong 'phel shog: ces rab tu gnas la rdo g.yam sogs kyis rgyas gdab/ gter srung yab yum gnyis la dkar gtor gnyis bdud rtsis bran la 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ hūm̐: sngon tshe zab gter srung ba'i klu rgyal che: klu mo nor skyong gzi ldan 'khor dang bcas: gtsang sbyar yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng bka' dam ltar: rin chen gter bum 'di yi bya ra gyis: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: o rgyan nor lha'i tshogs kyi dngos grub bskul: 'dzad med longs spyod phywa g.yang char ltar phob:

de dag 'phel ba'i gter kha khyod kyis zungs: bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: oṃ nā ga ra tsa ma ṇi dha ra sarba pañtsa i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ de nas me tog 'thor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig o rgyan nor gyi lha: āḥbade bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can kun: hūm̐ dngos grub stsol cig mchog thun phun sum tshogs: trām̐ḥgater bum sbas so longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas: hrīḥbartan pa gyur cig yul 'dir bkra shis shog: su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ 'di'-i mtshams su gzhung gi tshogs bskang sogs rgyas par btang : thams cad kyis kha ngan tshig mi smra bar gnad yin/ rten 'brel shin tu legs par bya/ lo re bzhin g.yang skyabs rgyas pa btang la kha gso'ang bya/ sa ma ya/ 'di yi dgos ched ni/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi gter chen po 'byung ba dang*/ sems can rnams la yul gyi bcud nyams nas rtswa dang lo thog mi skye ba dang*/ kha zas bcud med cing bang mdzod sgog por 'gro ba sogs la 'di sbas pas/ bang mdzod 'bru nor gyis gang*/ rtswa kha lo thog legs/ dkar gzhon gyi bcud 'phel/ sa bcud yul g.yang rgyas/ de sogs kun la 'di nyid shin tu zab pa'o/ de ci zhe na/ nor lha brten pa'i gter yin no/ khang pa'i bang mdzod lha khang zhing sa rnams ni 'di gtso che/ khyad par rgyab ri dang mdun ri rnams la bzhag na rang mgo mi 'og tu mi 'gro zhing*/ bsod nams longs spyod rgyas pa'i gnad yod/ thab ka la sbas na kha bsgyur zhal shes gzhan du gsal/ sa ma ya/ kha thaṃ/ gsang rgya/ o rgyan nor lha'i las tshogs so/ zhes rig 'dzin lo ha badz+ra gyi rjes 'jug pa/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gnas mchog dag pa shrī sgrub khang du spel bas 'gro ba sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru shog

/bkra shis dbang phyug yar rgyas 'phel lo/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ bum gter sgrub tshul lag len dwang shel me long bzhugs so// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i ye shes spyi yi gzugs/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig gangs can par/ /thugs brtse'i lhag par skyong mdzad sku drin can/ /gu ru yab yum mi shigs thig ler rol/ de'ang o rgyan nor lha dbyer med kyi bum gter sgrub pa'i las rim la 'jug par don gsum ste/ rdzas bsags pa dang*/ sgrub pa/ sbas pa gsum gyi dang po bum pa tshags su bya ba gzhung ltar la/ rdzas ni thog mar mthil du gtsang chen gyi bye ma dang sa sna chu sna byin can bkram pa'i steng du/ bya rgyud bum rdzas nyer lnga ril bu'am phye ma/ rin po che sna tshogs/ dug rigs dang bshal skyugs ma 'dres pa'i sman sna tshogs/ bra sran sogs 'bru nag rigs ma 'dres pa'i 'bru rigs sna tshogs/ dar zab gos chen rigs bzang 'byor ldan gyi lag nas byung ba'i 'bru sna dang nor sna/ sha khrag sgog tsong ma yin pa'i dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs zas phud gtsang ma/ dgon chen dang rgyal khang sogs bkra shis pa'i khang sa dang thab sa thab chen me rgyun ma chad pa'i thal ba'i sa dang*/ zhing bzang po/ tshong 'dus chen po/ ri rgyun ma chad pa'i rtse sa/ gzhan yang gnas chen rten gsum byin can 'dus sde chen po sogs kyi bag rdul/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi thab rdul/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon/ rgya mtsho chen po chu klung khrus chu byin ldan gnas chen gyi sgrub chu sogs chu sna/ de bzhin rta phyugs nor lug sogs sems can gyi spu sna/ rtsa ba 'bras bu lo ma me tog sogs/ mdor na dam sel can gyi lag nas byung ba ma yin pa'i 'bru sman rin chen zas nor sogs kyis phyur bur gtams pa'i dbus su tsan dan dmar po la srog shing ri rab kyi dbyibs byas bang rim bzhi pa rtse mor khang bzang dang bcas gser gyis bris pa'am bcos pa la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: pad+ma rā dza hrīḥmuṃ: zhes bris dang : de yi phyi rol nas dar ras shog bu sogs la rtsa sngags dang las sngags gnyis bris pa'i mjug tu: gnas 'dir rig 'dzin pad+ma rgyal po o rgyan nor lha'i tshogs thams cad brtan du bzhugs nas/ mdo sngags lung rtogs rgyal bstan bshad sgrub sgom sogs chos dam pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod/ gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs ka cha 'kho dgu'i bang mdzod/ 'bru bcud zas gos la longs spyod 'dod yon gyi bang mdzod/ rta nor zhing khang kha rje dbang thang la sogs srid zhi'i phun tshogs dpal g.yang mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa stsol cig /ces de rnams phreng gcig bris la srung ba ltar dril la dar tshon sna lnga'i skud pas bcing*/ de yi phyi rol pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gzugs gzhung ltar bris pa dang/ yum mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa bzhengs stabs can bris/ yab yum zhal sbyor bar du gong gsal srog shing dar dmar gyis dril la ma yo bar bum pa'i dbus su btsugs pa'i srog shing 'og tu lha 'dre mi yi srog rten bca' bar gsungs so/ bsdus na/ 'dre yi srog pha waṃ long bu la tri dang*/ lha yi srog rten shel rdo zur drug la a/ mi yi srog rten g.yu rgod mig med bcas dang*/ srog shing gi phyogs bzhir shar du shel/ lhor spos shel/ nub tu byi ru/ byang du g.yu rnams gling bzhi yi tshul dang*/ mu tig /margad/ mu man/ pad rag mchong*/ zangs sogs brgyad po gling phran tshul du bkod/ gser ni ri bdun/ dngul ni rol mtsho/ lcags ni lcags rir mtshon la/ de'i steng du me shel/ chu shel/ baiḍūr+ya/ 'gron bu bzhi ni/ nyi zla nam mkha' skar tshogs rnams mtshon la/ de'i steng du me tog dri bzang sogs kyis bkang ba'i ras kyis bcad/ steng du rgya gram dang*/ 'khor lo'i ri mo/ 'og tu pad+ma/ khor yug rtags rdzas sna bdun/ phyi rol srung bzhi bcas bri bar gsungs/

mdun rtags nor bu sogs bum pa spyi dang 'dra/ sku rten gyi g.yas g.yon kun tu rang gzungs sham bu sbyar ba sogs bum gzungs dang*/ nor gzungs rigs/ srog 'khor dang dzam 'khor gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ bkra shis bum gter bsod nams stobs bskyed sogs dang khyad par rang gzhung dbang thang rgyas pa'i 'khor lo dang dbang sdud 'khor lo sogs tsakra'i rigs gang rung gzhug kyang chog la/ las gzhung chen mo'i dgongs pa bzhin bca' bsham sogs snga tshags tshud par bya'o/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ pad+ma rgyal po'i las byang sngon 'gro skyabs sems nas yan lag bdun pa bar bya/ kā la yak+sha'i rgyun khyer ram bdag bskyed bzlas pa khyug tsam btang*/ las bum rta mgrin nam bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgo nas nus ldan bsgrubs la 'od zhu yang bya/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo zhing sa slong bya/ de nas bgegs gtor byin rlabs dang spro na bse rag bkar yas kyang bya/ bsdu na kā la yak+sha'i bgegs gtor dang gul yungs kyis bgegs bskrad srung 'khor rgyas par bya/ sbyang khrus rgyas pa thugs sgrub ltar ram/ bsdu na/ ji ltar dam psogs/ sku phyi gos 'bul bkra shis tshig bcad bcas me tog 'thor/ gzhung ltar bdag bskyed bskyed bzlas mchod bstod gzhung bzhin grub nas mdun rten la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ mdun rten bum pa rnam rgyal khang bzang bskyed pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: oṃ rat+na mu la dha mañdza ye swā hā: zhes pas byin brlab par bya: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza hri ha ho phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las gzhi e las nam mkha': yam̐ rlung gi rgya gram: ram̐ me yi tsakra: kham̐ chu yi dkyil 'khor: bh+rūm̐ rin chen pho brang : hri ma a ho zhes pas: bum pa rnams rang byung lhun grub kyi pho brang : phyi nang gi bkod pa rgyan yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ste: srid pa gsum g.yo nus pa'i mdangs chags pa khams gsum gyi nor sna dkor cha sogs lta bas chog mi shes par blo las 'das pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba:

pho brang gi nang thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'grub pa bsam pas brjod du mi lang pas rab tu gang ba 'di nyid rje ma hā gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yi dkyil 'khor dang khyad par nor bdag dzam+bha la bka' dang gter gyi srung ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas bsgrub pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i rdzas: mchod pa'i rdzas: rten pa'i rdzas: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang nam mkha' bar snang 'khor yug mu mtha' snang bas bzung dang ma bzung 'byams klas pa'i rang bzhin thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ sarba ga na e ma la shrī pa ri wā ra rat+na pha la ma ṇi dha ra ma la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mthar sngags drug phyag drug sbyar byin 'bebs rnam rgyal khang bzang ltar grub nas/ de nas dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: pad 'byung sku gsum dbang sdud skur ston pa: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal bzung nas: nam yang mi shigs tsit+ta dag tu bsgrub: ting 'dzin rnam gsum brda rtags bsten bgyid do: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta nan sa ma ya ho hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal: kun tshang mchod pa phyi nang sgrub rdzas rnams: zad med longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' rgyas bzhin: dgos 'dod 'bad med mchog tu 'grub gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye sogs lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ bris sku dang sngags byang rnams lhar bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī mā: kun khyab ye shes dbyings kyi ngang : rang byung 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs thabs: de dbus bh+rūm̐ gyur skad cig gis/ bum pa rang byung gzhal yas : rin chen las grub rgyas pa'i dbyibs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs: phyi nang brtsegs rim chos tog tshang : de nang dgos 'byung rin chen khrir:

pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+mas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: rat+na'i rgyan 'phyangs dbang sdud tshul: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: dal 'gying 'gros kyi tshul du gnas: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: phyag gnyis rdo rje pad+ma bsnams: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud brda 'gros tshul: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rgyan ldan gar: phyogs bzhir mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan ni: rang rtags ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: mdun du klu mo nor skyong ma: na chung mdzes ma'i cha lugs can: khog stod mi la khog smad sbrul: sbrul mgo gsum gdengs nor bus brgyan: g.yas g.yon nor bu zhags pa bsnams: rin chen 'dod 'byin tshul gyis bskyed: gzhan yang nor skyong dbang sdud ma: phyi nang sprin 'khrigs snang bzhin bsgom: bdag nyid gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin dbang gi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : gter 'byung nor mchog bla ma dzam bha la: dbang sdud ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thugs rjes gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la 'dod rgu bstsal ba'i slad: rin chen khang bzang gter bum dbus su bzhugs: 'dzad med longs spyod dpal gyis phyug par stsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma rā dza badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: dgos 'dod lhun grub rat+na'i khrir:

dbang sdud pad+ma yab yum 'khor: dngos grub kun 'byung brten pa'i phyir: 'dzum bag 'gying brjid tshul gyis bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag gzhan dbul phongs skyon bsal phyir: gu ru nor lha'i dkyil 'khor la: bsod nams bskyed phyir phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ maṇ+ḍal kyang rgyas par 'bul/ de nas bum pa 'bul zhing brtan bzhugs gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dngos grub mchog stsol bla ma nor gyi lha: lha lcam mtsho rgyal ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i yum: yum chen dbang mo phyogs kyi mgyogs ma bzhi: gzhi 'dzin klu mo nor skyong klu rgyal che: che btsan rgyal po rnam mang thos pa sras: sras yum skya brgyad gnod sbyin bdun 'bum 'khor: 'khor dang dzam+bha nor lha rta yi lha: lha chen dbang phyug chen po phyugs lha 'bum: 'bum phrag nor lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rnam par bzhugs shing dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten: rten rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa bkod legs mdzes: mdzes mtshon pad+ma stong ldan 'bru yi tshom: tshom bu gter bum gling bzhi'i rgyan bkod 'bum: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rnam rgyal rin chen gter bum brgyan ldan dbus: pad+ma rgyal po o rgyan nor gyi lha: dngos grub stsol ba'i nor lha khrom ltar 'tshogs: srog shing 'dzam bu pṛk+ṣa dbu ma'i tshul: sku rten ri bo mchog rab mtho la brjid: rin chen baiḍūr+ya yi nam mkha' dang : me shel nyi ma chu shel zla ba gsal: mgron bu'i skar tshogs dar zab 'ja' sprin 'khrigs: gser gyi ri bdun dngul gyi rol mtsho brgyad: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: shel dkar shar gling spos shel lho yi gling :

byi ru nub gling g.yu 'di byang gi gling : mu tig mu men pad rag mar gad dang : mchong rag zangs dang in+ḍa gling phran brgyad: lcags kyi phyi yi lcags ris 'khor yug bskor: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: phyi yi rgyan bkod bkra shis rtags brgyad dang : rgya stag g.yu 'brug bya sbal srung bzhi tshang : rgyal po'i bla rten glang chen mche ba rno: btsun mo'i bla rten byi ru dbang gi rgyal: thabs shes rgyal po btsun mo rna cha gnyis: rin chen gser bre g.yu bre rgyan dang ldan: lha klu mi yi gtsug phud yid bzhin nor: dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen rdzas mchog rnams: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rin chen 'od 'bar lha rdzas nor bu 'od: gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs steng mu khyud kyi: thabs mkhas blon po shes ldan btsun mo mdzes: shugs 'chang rta mchog khur theg glang po che: rtsal chen dmag dpon go khrab mtshon chas brgyan: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid tshang ba 'di: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dug lnga sel ba'i sman mchog rnam pa lnga: bang mdzod bcud 'phel 'bru sna phun sum tshogs: dri bzang kun la khyab pa'i ngad ldan spos: 'jam legs dkar dmar bkrag pa'i dar zab gos: mngar gsum rgun 'brum la sogs shing thog rigs: stong nas stong du 'phel ba'i rin chen stong : dung nas dung du 'phel ba'i dung dkar 'khyil: longs spyod kha zas 'phel ba'i ja mar thud: ma tshang med pa'i ji snyed ci 'byor kun: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: 'bul lo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: zhes lha tshogs rnams gter bum dang dbyer med bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: kun 'byung rat+na'i rdzas su byin brlabs nas: dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung gnas nor lha mo: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma pū dza hoḥ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa tī waṃ se pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta la khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: kun 'byung longs spyod bdag po 'dod rgu'i rje: bde stong mchog gsum rang byung ngang nyid las: ral pa'i cod pan rin chen brgyan pa ni: dgos 'dod nor bu char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: zhi 'dzum rgyan dang ga shal 'phyang ba ni: zab cing spros bral dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: zhal gsum dmar zhing dkar la rgyas pa ni: sku gsum thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams pa ni: rdo rje'i sku brnyes rtogs med don ldan brda: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams pa ni: dam chos rgyas phyir dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i brda: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+ma bsnams pa ni: gzhan snang 'gugs shing pad+ma dbang sdud brda: sgeg cing gsus khyim che la 'gying ba ni: khams gsum zil gnon longs spyod 'byung ba'i brda: thung la sbom zhing rgyan kun rdzogs pa ni: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro nor lhar mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs su dpa' ba ni: ma rungs log 'dren zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: rat+na'i khrir bzhugs gzi brjid ldan pa ni: pad 'byung rjes 'jug 'dzam gling khyab pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs dbang sdud rgyal por bstod: g.yas su lha lcam 'jo sgeg dmar ba ni: tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba'i brda:

rat+na rgyan 'chang mdzes shing gzigs pa ni: pad 'byung brda rtags thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams pa ni: khams gsum dbang sdud dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i brda: dal zhing 'gros kyi tshul du gnas pa ni: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gtso mo'i brda: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar ba ni: gsang sngags bstan rgyas dam chos 'phel ba'i brda: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs 'gro don lhun grub brda: phyag gnyis rdo rje pad+ma bsnams pa ni: thabs shes lam spyod bde stong mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud tshul gyis brda 'gros ni: gzhan snang dbang sdud dug lnga zil gnon brda: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ldan pa ni: rtsa rlung dbang sdud chags lam grol ba'i brda: zung 'jug bde chen rab tu rgyas pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang dbang sdud zil gnon brda: gsang ba bde stong rig ma'i tshogs la bstod: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'gyed pa ni: phrin las bzhi ldan dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: phyag g.yas rang rtags lcags kyus mtshan pa ni: pho nya sgo ma'i sgo gsum 'gugs stim brda: g.yon na nor skyug ne'u le bsnams pa ni: bsod nams longs spyod char rgyun myur 'bebs brda: bzhi ka gar stabs mkha' la bsgyur ba ni: rdzu 'phrul drwa bas gang 'dul ston pa'i brda: phrin las bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: mdun du klu mo nor skyong mdzes pa ni: klu g.yang dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: na chung mdzes ma'i cha lugs 'chang ba ni: zab gter bka' srung khyad par mdzad pa'i brda: khog stod mi mo mdzes 'dzum chags pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang gang 'dod ster ba'i brda: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khyil ba ni: chos dbyings bde drod rig mar brdzu ba'i brda: sbrul mgo gdengs ka nor bus brgyan pa ni: sgrub la grogs mdzad bar chad sel ba'i brda:

phyag gnyis zhags pa nor bu 'dzin pa ni: zab chos mthar phyin kun snang khyab pa'i brda: rin chen gling bzhugs rtse gcig gus pa ni: sa 'og dbang bsgyur sgrub mchog skyong ba'i brda: rol mchog bcud 'dzin klu mo mdzes la bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phra men ma: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin ḍāk+ki nor lha'i tshogs: sku gsum dag pa'i klong yangs bde ba'i ngang : 'khor 'das chos nyid grol bar phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod: las kyi rig ma gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: klu mo nor skyong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod: de nas bshags sbyang 'bul zhing dngos grub zhu ba ni/ gus 'dun dang bcas nas/ hūm̐: pad 'byung nor lha rgya mtsho bdag la dgongs: sngon nas da bar bdag sogs sems can rnams: brnab sems ser sna 'dod chags las dbang gis: ma byin blangs pa'i las kyis dbul phongs byung : de la skyob phyir o rgyan nor lha ru: sprul zhing dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'khor bcas thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ser sna'i dbang gis mchod rdzas zhan: le lo'i dbang gis sgrub pa dus las 'das: shes rab zhan pas bskyed rdzogs don ma mthong : smon lam ngan pas nor lhar brten ma shes: mi khom dbang gis lo zla dus mchod chad: bying rmugs dbang gis thab gzhob dme 'khon shor: brtson 'grus chung bas rten rdzas bskang rdzas chad: slob dpon tshul bzhin ma bsten bla brdol bor: de sogs sngar byas nongs pa bshags bgyi na: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsol du gsol/ zhes dngos grub 'dod don gang mos gsol ba gdab/ dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing slar 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi dbul phongs sdug bsngal thams cad bral bar byas/ snod bcud srid zhi'i dge tshogs dpal yon ma lus pa bsdus pas 'dod rgu thams cad yid bzhin du 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i bum pa bzang por gyur/ zhes rtsa bsnyen rab 'bum gsum 'bring gcig tha ma khri yis mi nyung bar dang rtsa sngags bcu cha las sngags dang*/ gzhan nyin re bzhin bar chad sel phyir yak+sha kā la'i mngon rtogs dang bzlas pa khyug tsam re bya'o/ spro zhing nus na g.yang sgrub dang sbrags na mchog tu 'gyur/ gang ltar mthar mchod bstod bzod gsol rjes/ bla ma o rgyan nor gyi lha dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad log pa'i 'tshe ba ma yin par chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs kyi 'dod gsol sbyar/ gsol mchod tshogs skong sogs las gzhung mtha' sdud rgyas par grub na legs/ rjes su tshe 'gugs dang mchod bstod nongs bshags grub nas rten snying bzla zhing me tog thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub? khyad par du gter chen po'i bum pa 'dir bskyed cing ? bdag dang sems can thams cad la log 'tsho ma yin par chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol lam/ yang na sbyin bdag pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa stsal zhing yul 'dir bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal 'byor gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du sogs nas gzhung gi bsdu ldang dang bsngo smon bkra shis grub nas/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod?sh+lau ka gcig lha yang dus su char 'babs shing*/ /lo rtog phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa dang*/ /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol?sogs bkra shis bzang pos rjes/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis rnams dang bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod pas dge legs bya'o/

oṃ sarba ma hā bha la mu tra tsakra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ ༈ gsum pa sbas pa'i tshe/ bang mdzod du yin na mi rul bar bya/ sar sbas na sol ba dang shug shun mang bar bsags/ bsang dang dkar gtor bsngos la sa slong grub na legs pas cho ga ltar bya/ hūm̐: gter 'byung ye shes sogs spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol bshags sbyang*/ rdo g.yam dang sas g.yogs/ rab tu gnas pa hūm̐: dngos grub mchog stsol?sogs dang*/ gter srung yab yum gyi gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la phrin las bcol gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod nongs bshags grub nas rten 'brel snying po mang du bzla zhing me tog phyogs bcu la sogs sngar ltar bskyal/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig sogs bkra shis rigs rgyas brjod/ rjes su tshogs 'khor dang gtang rag rgya cher 'bul/ slad lo re kha gso bya ched g.yang skyabs sbyar ro/ de ltar bgyid pas snod bcud kyi rgud pa zhi zhing chos dang rigs rgyud 'phel ba dang sgrub la dngos grub chen po 'byung zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen yongs su rdzogs nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug don gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ smras pa/ byang chub sems ni sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /rang khe gzhan pham chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /de phyir sems kyi khyad par bsod nams dang*/ /bsod nams ma yin bya ba so sor grub/ /de slad bstan 'gro'i rgud gso phan bde'i ched/ /log 'tsho tshong dang g.yo rgyu chos min par/ /phywa spel dbang sdud la sogs chos mthun gyi/ /'dod rgu char 'bebs rgyal ba'i phrin las so/ zhes pa bsod nams gter bum sgrub pa'i cha lag zur 'debs 'di'ang sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul ming 'bod pas rang gzhung gi dgongs pa gzhir bzhag /med thabs med pa'i kha 'gengs dgos rigs pad+ma mdo sngags gling pa'i gter bum spyi 'gro las blangs te mkhan slob chos gsum gangs can gdul byar 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed go cha bzhes pa'i gnas mchog bal yul mchod sdong bya rung kha shor ram lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod chen po'i nye bar pad rgyal bsnyen 'brel skabs thun mtshams zhig tu sbyar ba 'dis kyang gsang sngags snga 'gyur ring lugs spyi dang gnubs chen gyi ring lugs bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ (u) gter srung klu yi sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i klu bum sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ rang byung klu yi rgyal po'i pho brang cher/ /rang bzhin rgyu rkyen las 'das pad sdong rtser/ /rang mtshan ma yin 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /rang byung sangs rgyas pad+mar skyes der 'dud/ /gang zhig 'jig rten bde zhing longs spyod phyug /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyug legs pa sogs/ /snod bcud legs tshogs rten 'brel rgyas pa'i thabs/ /klu bum yid bzhin nor bu'i bca' thabs bri/ de la thog mar bum pa sgrub pa la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po bum pa 'di'ang*/ rag gan zha nye lcags sogs ma yin par rab rin po che'i rigs/ ma 'byor na rdza bum shel bum lta bu gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba shong tshad yul bre las mi chung ba/ phyi nang tshon rtsi dkar po'i mdzes par byas pa'i mdun rtags nāṃ yang na dung dang pad+ma bkod/ rdzas ni gter bum spyi ltar mthil du rgya bod kyi gnas chen mang po'i sa sna chu sna byin ldan gtsang ma'i rigs gang 'byor dang*/ khyad par klu chen gnas nges pa'i mtsho rdel gnam ma mthong zhing drod rlangs gzhan ma phog pas mtshon/ mtsho chen chu chen sogs kyi bye ma rag gan mu zi sogs ma 'dres pa'i rin chen rigs/ gla rtsi sha rigs sogs klu la gnod pa'i rdzas dang rigs ma 'dres pa'i bzang drug sogs bzang shing*/ 'bru nag min pa'i 'bru sna tshogs shing tog dkar gsum mngar gsum/ bya rgyud bum rdzas nyer lnga/ khyad par klu sman gtsang ma gang mang dang rnams dang rang gzhung bskang ba nas bshad pa ltar dmigs bsal sa gnad nyes pa gso ba sogs la gang du dmigs pa'i sa chu rtsa shing ldum 'bras/ de'i steng rdo rgyus mdung rtse khab len sbal rgyab dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon/ gsung rab kyi bag rdul/ rtsi shing me tog 'bras bu dri bzang sogs kyis bkang ba'i dbus su srog shing dmar po leb gzugs la'am yang na shog bu sogs la klu yab yum gyi sku gzugs bris/

de'i 'og nas dar ras sogs klu chen brgyad bris pa kha grogs shing gi gtso bo'i sku la bltas nas bris/ gzhan du bsdus na/ srog shing stod du nāṃ zhes gser dang mtshal gyis stod smad gnyis su bris/ de'i phyir nāṃ brgyad bris pa kha nang bstan du dril klu rgyal bsod nams stobs bskyed 'khor lo bris pa'ang nang du gzhug /gzungs ni klu yab yum gyi gzungs dang klu chen brgyad kyi gzungs 'dod gsol bris pa ras gtsang mas kha bcad la| khebs gcod sogs kyang sha lpags kyi rigs min pa'i 'byar spyin gyis kha dam por sbyar nas/ nang du chu mi 'gro ba'i thabs bya/ kha rgyan mgul chings kyang dar dkar po byas la/ ras skud sna lnga'i chings rgya gdab pa sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ sgrub pa'i dus sha chang spangs la gtsang sbra dang bcas la klu thebs dang bstun/ spyi ltar rtsa gsum nor lha gzhung gang rung gi bdag bskyed 'gro dgos par bshad kyang khyad par 'di ga'i bdag bskyed bdag nyid skad cig sogs bzlas pa yan sngon du 'gro dgos/ da ni gnyis pa ji ltar sgrub pa ni| thog mar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i khrus sgrub 'od zhu nus ldan bya/ khro bo'i sprin spros nas bgegs rnams rgyangs ring du bskrad/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang gul yungs kyis bdug brab/ sbyang khrus sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs nges par dgos| bum pa bsang sbyang dngos ni/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i grangs mnyam pa'i pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rin po che dang 'bru bcud zas nor tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ sogs brjod bsam zhing sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs bya'o/ de nas bris sku dang sngags byang lhar bskyed pa ni/ skyid grong thugs rdor gyi chog bsgrigs pad+ma rgyal po'i gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi zhing sgrub khrigs bsdebs bsod nams dpal bskyed gyi mdun bskyed/

hūm̐: bdag nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung : yab yum mdun du klu yi pho brang ni: zhes par bum pa ni zhes bsgyur la bstod pa'i bar btang*/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i dmigs bzlas gtso bor bya/ skabs 'dir bum pa la gzungs thag btags kyang bzang*/ dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros brtan g.yo'i dwang bcud ma lus pa bsdus nas mdun gyi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bskyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ba'i mos pa dang bcas/ klu yab yum gyi rtsa sngags khri bdun sogs gang rung gis bsgrub/ klu chen brgyad dang*/ klu bum spyi 'gros kyi sngags rnams kyang sbyar rung*/ zhi ba'i mchod bskang bstod pa'i bar rgyas pa rang gzhung ltar btang*/ mthar 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis byin rlabs sbyar nas hūm̐/ yid 'ong rgya mtsho gling gi mnga' dbang sgyur?sogs gtor ma phul/ bsdu na/ gter srung klu mo'i mchod bstod mchog gsum pañtsa sogs gtor ma 'bul/ ma 'byor pa dang ?sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten snying sogs kyis byin rlabs byas pa'i 'bru bcas thal mo sbyar la phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub? khyad par du gter chen po'i bum pa 'dir bskyed cing spyan drang ba'i sems dpa' klu yi dbang po yab yum rnams ji srid? bdag dang sems can thams cad la log 'tsho ma yinapar chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol lam/ yang na sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa stsal zhing yul 'dir bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal 'byor gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/

zhes mang du brjod la me tog 'thor/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur? thams cad nam mkha' mdzod? klu rgyal dga' bo nye? lha yang dus su? 'bad dang rtsol? che ba'i che mchog ston mchog? mthar/ sangs rgyas thugs rje'i klu rnams bde skyid ldan/ /nad zhi sdug bsngal dang bral 'jig rten na/ /bde legs rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis dge legs rgya cher spel lo/ sbas pa ni/ sde brgyad gser skyems sngon du btang la gter srung klu yi mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung mthar/ bzhugs su gsol la brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ rten snying bzla zhing me tog thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ phyogs bcu na sogs brtan bzhugs dang gzhung gi bsngo smon bkra shis sogs rgyas par brjod la mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ klu bum 'di dag sgrub pa dang sbas pa sta gon bya ba sogs kun la sha chang spangs shing gtsang sbra dam por mdzad pa gal che'o/ zhes pa'ang klu chen mal gro gzi chen sogs che btsan klu yi rgyal po du ma gnas shing skyong ba'i bal po'i yul nā ga gan rgyal dang nye ba'i mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi drung du pad+ma rgyal po'i bsnyen 'brel bum sgrub skabs bstun nyer mkhor dmigs te kun rmongs sgo sprul ngag dbang klu sgrub tu 'bod pas thun mtshams su sug bris bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/ // oṃ sarba ma hā bha la mu tra tsakra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i g.yang chog dang 'brel ba'i god sri mnan pa dmod pa dgu skor nag 'gros bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// // chos dbyings ngang las log 'dren 'dul bya'i ngor/ /snying rje rab 'phros dmar nag me phreng rtsal/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dpal/ /gnod sbyin nag po khro gtum ldan la bstod/

ces che ba brjod nas yak+sha kā la'i sgo nas god sri mnan pa dmod pa dgu skor ni/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po bsham bkod sogs gzhung ltar grub zin nas/ liṅga bris dang rdzas bsags gzhung ltar byas nas/ dang po gzhi gzi byin bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje dpa' bo'i sku/ /smug nag yak+sha kā la che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i chas/ /spyan bgrad am gtsigs smin ma 'bar/ /thod skam skra chings dar dmar brgyan/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pas lcags sdig phur pa 'dril/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bzhugs/ /go cha'i lha rnams hūm̐ du gsal/ /me dpung mched pa'i dbyings su bsgom/ oṃ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hrī ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya stong bzlas nas gser skyems mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol/ /ma nyes ma len gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs/ /drang shan phye ba'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /dam sri dam nyams log 'dren 'byung po la/ /drag sngags rdo rje phur char 'di 'bebs par/ /ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni/ /de ring dam nyams log 'dren 'di la phob/ /las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ mchod cing hom bskyed gnad la dbab pa ni/ mdun du hom yangs lcags khang gru gsum nang*/ /nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang*/ /god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur/ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

khyad par du che mchog rdo rje drag po thod phreng rtsal/ sku 'jam dpal gsung rta mgrin thugs phyag na rdo rje yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ sprul pa yak+sha me dbal/ stobs ldan lcags sdig nag po/ rigs bzhi ye shes kyi khro bo bcu/ bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul/ bka' srung bdud btsan klu gsum gter srung nā ga rak+sha la sogs srung ma dam tshig can gyi bka' bden pas/ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po log par 'dren pa'i bdud dam sri/ khyad par du che sri chung sri/ rgas sri gzhon sri dar sri dur sri/ phung sri 'gong po bse rag dbul sri pho gdon mo gdon za 'dre shi gshed la sogs/ tshe bsod nams la bar du gcod pa'i bdud/ lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rigs byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad/ gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad dmigs pa'i rten 'dir khug cig oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ lan gcig gam lnga bdun dgu sogs kyis bkug nas/ oṃ ra tri dam sri te phur nag mo'i snying la dza dzaḥ tri tri mu la rmangs sri shag du shag dza dzaḥ 'grig 'grig rak+mo 'grig 'gong po dbul sri kha la dun tshe dza/ dam sri ya ma phung sri ming gzugs la dun shag shag phob phob/ ya ma shin+ta dam sri'i srog la dza dzaḥ khug rtags rdzogs nas thun rdzas gzhung ltar liṅgar gzir ba ni/ oṃ sgrig shog nag mo kha la dun tse rbad: ka li ra tri phe sha nag po'i srog la thun bh+yoḥ nag mo za 'dre rmugs 'dre'i kha chings chings: 'gong po'i kha chings chings: mi la'i kha chings chings: phung sri'i kha chings chings: bse rag gi kha chings chings: chung sri'i kha chings chings:

dbul sri'i kha chings chings: god sri'i kha chings chings: na sri'i kha chings chings: mi kha'i kha chings chings: dam sri'i kha chings chings: gri sri'i kha chings chings: dgra sri'i kha chings chings: byur yugs kyi kha chings chings: oṃ trag thur shag rbad: dun tse mā ra ya nan: oṃ kra ma hri ma bse rag 'gong po'i kha chings chings nan: rtags dang sbyar nas/ che sri pho sri ri bo'i rtse nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: mo sri 'dre mo rgya mtsho'i mthil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: chung sri bse rag mngal du tshud pa mā ra ya nan brub: god sri rwa ba'i phugs nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: dar sri dur khrod mthil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: gri sri phung shul gyi dkyil nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: bse rag tshong 'dus gling nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: phung sri gri bo gling yul la chags pa mā ra ya nan brub: gson 'dre pho mo rgya grong gru nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub: 'gong po sde dgu'i tshogs thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: za 'dre kha kha mu kha zlog zlog: gur ma gur ting gur lan gur sman gur raṃ gur nan: gur srin gser 'brong g.yu 'brong sman 'brong srin 'brong la sogs dam sri pho mo'i snying rtsa la shig shig baṃ ril nan nan tri tri this pa te ya satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes rdo phye yungs dkar nag ke tshe shang tshe g.yer ma ram pa/ lam rgya gram gyi sa mchod rten nam lha khang nyil ba'i sa bcas thun rdzas sngags nan tan bskyar/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dmigs bya lan gsum 'gugs la/ hūm̐/ kā la yak+sha skur bzhengs shig /mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab/ /gdug pa'i byad ma dgra dang bgegs/ /phung sri 'gong po 'dre rgod dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams la gnod pa'i/ /bdud dang dam sri tshogs rnams kun/ /thun gyi gtor mar bstims nas kyang*/ /dpal chen khro rgyal zhal du 'bul/ /lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol/

oṃ i daṃ bha ling+ta dgra bgegs dam sri rnams kyi dbang po rnam lnga la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes 'bul lo/ rjes mnan pa bya ba ni/ liṅga rdzas dang ldan pa 'dre lteb byas nas yugs sa ma'i skras bcing*/ phag thod dam spre'u mgo /ba yi ra co'i nang du bcug la khyi spu ra bal gyis kha bcad nas la chas bsdams/ ra sug gis lam rgya gram du sa tshad dang ldan pa brus la/ 'gugs gzhug dang bcas pas bcug nas/ mi kha yas stags thun rdzas bcas la/ che sri pho sri ri bo'i rtse nas langs pa mā ra ya nan brub/ sogs tshang bar brjod pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags gsum/ /de dag rnams kyi bden pas mnan/ stag phur btsugs dur rdo la rdo rje'i rgya gram ri rab bris pas mnan sa yis dgab/ rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbang chen rngam pa'i bro ra ru/ khro rgyal stabs kyi bro brdungs pas/ /dgra sri dam nyams thal bar rlog /gtum mo rdo rje'i bro ra ru/ khro mo 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /bgegs srin 'byung po tshar yang bcad/ /las mkhan tshogs pa'i bro ra ru/ gter srung dam can bro brdungs pas/ /god sri dbul sri thal bar rlog /chem chem khro rgyal rol pa'i bro/ /rdungs shig stobs bcu rtsal gyi 'gros/ /dam sri nam yang ma ldang zhig oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha nan: dam sri mā ra ya rbad chings: nan nan: gnam lcags mchod rten nag pos mnan par bsgom/ phyi mig mi lta nang du log /dkyil 'khor gzhung gi mtha' skyong la gshegs bsdu bya/ zhes pa 'di yang g.yang chog gi skabs su do gal che bar brten/ rong smyon o rgyan rig 'dzin gyis/ rang gzhung bslad med ltar gong 'og gi 'khrugs bsdebs bsal nas/ bklag chog tu bris pa dge bar gyur cig /dam med slob ma la mi bstan pa'i bka' rgya yod/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/

kā la yak+sha'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa la/ dang po tshogs bsang sbyang chu gtsang gis bran la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po gsal ba yi/ thugs las byin rlob yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag chags sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po la: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags dbyings rig pho brang nas: longs sku thugs rje 'phags mchog la: zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: stobs bcu gzi byin pho brang nas: rig 'dzin sprul sku pad 'byung la: bka' bab grub thob tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: kun 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po la: 'dod sbyin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: laṅka mgrin bcu'i pho brang nas/ gtum drag kā la yak+sha la/ /bdud 'dul khro bo khro mos bskor/ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: me rlung 'tshub ma'i pho brang nas: legs ldan zhing skyong mgon po la: dam can gter bdag 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: dgos 'dod char 'bebs si li li: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ta la la: dri zhim spos dud chi li li: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la bkrag mdangs bskyed: bkram pa'i mchod par bcud chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang drag kā la yak+sha rtsal/ dam can gter bdag chos skyong la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon sna lnga'i gter: nang mchod rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sna tshogs dbang po 'dis: dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : dbang drag kā la yak+sha'i thugs dam bskang*/ gter srung dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes pa rab bskyed nas: sgrub la 'dod rgu yid bzhin char ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams pa dang : bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags mchod rdzas chad cing lhag: bag med dam 'gal le lo ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: nyams grib dag nas tshangs pa stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas: lhag chad bkang : de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du hom yangs lcags khang gru gsum nang : nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang : god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: khyad par bka' gter chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po bar chad rtsom pa'i rigs: rang dbang med par tshogs ling 'di la khug: bskrad cing bsdams nas bsgral gtub phye mar thongs: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las byed badz+ra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ dug lnga dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs zhal du bzhes shing mgrin par drongs: bde stong chos nyid rang byung lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi bran zhing 'bul: de nas dga' ston tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ chos dbyings ngang la 'khor 'das gcig: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bram ze khyi phag ji bzhin du: ro snyom lta ba'i tshogs la rol: dngos grub sna tshogs 'di la 'byung : a la la ste e ma hoḥ zhes pad kor phyag rgya dang bcas te blangs nas rol: de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i tshogs: lhag sdud ging dang ma mo sman: gnas nyul zhing skyong phra men ma: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na skyogs bzang bhan+dha thogs: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: la la mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur gzugs: la la bud med rgan mo'i gzugs: la la smad 'tshong nag mo'i gzugs: la la sha za srin mo'i gzugs: la la dur khrod 'dre mo'i gzugs: sprul pa sna tshogs ma nges kyang : don la gnas nyul dus mtshan ma: rnal 'byor kun gyi drod tshad nyul: dur khrod tshogs khang mtha' la gnas: dngos grub kun gyi sa mtshams 'dzin: legs gnyis kun gyi stangs 'dzin ma: dam tshig can la bu bzhin skyong : ma mo gnas nyul tshogs len 'bum: bka' yi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams zas su zo: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs phye mar thongs:

bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo rak+mo ting ting shag shag dza bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub drag po e yi klong*/ /rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas*/ /dbang drag kā la yak+sha skur bzhengs shig /mthu rtsal thugs rjes gzi byin deng 'dir skyed: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dul dka'i tshe: sems can bsod nams dman zhing bar chad sdang : yi dwags bgegs rigs 'byung po mi min gyis: mnga' thang longs spyod phywa la dgra sdang bas: mthu chen khyed kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: phyi yi bar chad rkyen ngan dbyings su sol: nang gi thig le rtsa rlung nyams pa gsos: gsang ba chos srid rang sems dbang du sdus: stong gsum phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: dbang sdud pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: mnga' thang snyan grags spel pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rig 'dzin thugs rje can: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan bdag cag la: 'dod rgu zad med rin chen char ltar phob: thugs dam bskul lo bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya ma hā bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa ru/ /bkod pa rab rdzogs dga' tshal mchims phu ru/ /snang mtha' pad+ma rgyal dang pad 'byung gis/ /brgyud gsum ston 'khor bkod pa'i spyan sngar ru/ /dbyings kyi ma sring nor skyong srung ma yi/ khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐: chad mdo'i tha tshig 'di la gnas pa yi: srung ma dam can gter bdag pho nya rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ kro ta kro ti ya kro ta bha sa ki si bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni:

hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sha za sman mo yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen mdzes rgyan g.yer kha si li li: glu len nyams dga' bshugs glu kyu ru ru: dgyes pa'i gad mo 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe rogs dan mdzod: sgrub la ma yengs bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo mu kha le ting ting shag shag kha kha khā hi: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje rngam byed bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i bag chags dbyings su gtor: pho brang yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong pho nyas bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang ru tra thabs kyis bsgral: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i mtshan ma zhi: bro ni ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang ye shes chen po'i gar: gsang sngags rdo rje khro bo yis: god sri dbul sri tshar yang bcad: las mkhan pho nyas bro ra ru: rgyas btab ru tra ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la me tog 'thor zhing : rten 'brel gang rigs kyi mchod pa yang bya: skabs su dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: yang gsang 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i gter chen nyid: deng 'dir bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ oṃ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hrī ta he ru ka kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dngos grub blang zhing dbang bzhi zhu: de nas tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: tshe chang dang tshe ril thogs nas: hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po 'chi med tshe yi lha: pad+ma rgyal po gsang 'dus dbang chen bdag:

mgyogs ma tshe 'gugs lha mo 'bum gyis bskor: sgo ma'i phyag brnyan steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros: nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho'i bcud: sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga'i khams lnga dang : snang ba srid dang snod bcud skye 'gro yi: bla tshe rnam shes bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rnams: 'od zer lcags kyus bsdus nas bdag la stims: pho nya sgo ma'i tshogs kyis dbang du sdus: rig 'dzin lus la bstims pas gzi brjid rgyas: 'khor lo lnga ldan ye shes 'od kyis gang : bdud rtsi lus kun khyab pas rā ga'i mdog: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe ba ā yur+dz+nyā na hrī pad+ma dha ra hūm̐: ma ma sid+dhi pha la dza dzaḥ de nas tshe chang tshe ril la rol: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: de nas mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta nas bha su ta kha kha khā hi: me dpung klong bzhugs smug nag dpa' bo'i sku: kā la yak+sha srin po khros 'dra'i zhal: rdo rje drag po gar dgu'i he ru kaḥ dpal chen g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os?sogs kyis bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang ?sogs yig brgya bzlas/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: srung 'khor lha rnams mi dmigs hūm̐ gi ngang : hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu ha khog mgo sked dang : zla tshes hūm̐ bsdu mi dmigs 'ja' yal bzhin: 'dzin bral zang thal stong pa'i ngang la bzhag: hūm̐: a a āḥ zhes bsdu zhing*/ oṃ yak+sha kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā shrī hrī ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes slar ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma ma kā wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ gyis go bgo /de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni: hoḥ bsngo byed rgyal po ye rig shes pa'i rgyu: bsngo yul rang gsal gnas lugs smra bo che: bsngo ba kun 'byung 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: de dag rig pas bsal bzhag dran shes bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni:

hoḥ srid par bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i gzeng las rab sgrol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs nas: mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces smon lam legs par rgyas gdab bo: bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku dri med rig rtsal drag po'i lha: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: ces pa 'di'ang bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i tshogs mchod las lha mtshan kha bsgyur dang bcas 'ga' zhig tshig sna phri snon byas te drag po kā la yak+sha'i gtor zlog dang bsnyen sgrub skabs sogs sgos chos dang sbyar nas nyams su len par mkho gal du dmigs te sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med nas nan bskul bzhin gnam lcags pa gu h+yas rab byung bcu bdun pa shing bya lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs la bal yul yang le shod gnam lcags bla brang du sbyar ba don dang ldan par gyur cig/ // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu bklag chog tu bkod pa srid zhi'i dpal yon 'gugs pa'i 'phrul zhags zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ dbang phyug zhes bya srid gsum la/ /dbang bsgyur lha brgyas bkur nyid kyang*/ /dbang med bran du bkol byed pa'i/ /dbang sdud rgyal po de la 'dud/ /rang sems rang dbang ma 'dus bzhin/ /gzhan snang dbang sdud byis pa yis/ /'ja' tshon bzung nas gos rgyan du/ /re nas rtsol sgrub byed dang mtshungs/ /de phyir rang rig gdong lnga yis/ /rang snang gangs ri'i rtse zin na/ /gzhan snang ri klung phal pa'i 'gro/ /zil gnon ji bzhin srid zhi non/ de'ang gang zhig dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon du rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams len mthar phyin te/ gzhan don phrin las kyi bstan 'gro'i don kho na bya ba las gzhan ma mchis shing*/

de la sngon chos rgyal chen pos gu ru la/ bstan 'gro'i don dang ma 'ongs par bod 'bangs dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzer ba dang*/ bsod nams dang dbang thang nyams pa rnams la phan pa'i thabs bstan par gsol ba btab pas/ gu ru'i spyir rgyal po'i gtsor byas 'bangs rnams kyis spyin pa rgya cher thong*/ bsod nams sa bcud kyi gter bum sbos/ 'phral phug kun tu bsod nams dang dbang thang gi rgyas thebs par 'dod na/ kho bos dur khrod dga' ba tshal du lha chen dbang phyug chen po dbang du bsdus te/ pad+ma rgyal po'i ngo bor gyur tshe man ngag nor bu zhags pa'i gdams pa yod pa 'di rnams nyams su longs shig gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir na 'dir/ dbang sdud kyi las tshogs/ nor sgrub phywa g.yang spel ba'i las tshogs/ srid srung sri'u gso ba/ dbang thang spel ba sogs dbang dang rgyas pa'i las gtso bor byed pa'i bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso byed zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las tshogs mang po dang*/ dzam lha dkar nag pad+ma rgyal po kā la yak+sha sogs sgrub skor du ma bcas bzhugs pa kun la nye bar mkho ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i zur 'debs bltas chog tu bkod pa la gsum las/ sbyor ba bca' bsham sogs sta gon gyi bya ba la/ gzhung dngos bstan ltar rgyas las la/ dkyil 'khor lho phyogs nas kha nang bstan nam/ nub tu phyogs la chas gos sogs dmar po dang*/ thab thig dang mchod rdzas gra bsgrigs rgyas pa'am/ dbang gi sbyin sreg spyi dang mthun/ nyer spyod cha gnyis 'das ma 'das so so'i mchod gtor/ rdzas 'bul gyi rnam lnga dang*/ 'dod yon lnga sogs rdzas rnams kyang cha gnyis su bkod par bya ste/ ku sha chun po brgyad/ yam shing*/ mar khu/ 'bras/ zas mchog /til/ swo ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ bilba/ shing 'bras sna tshogs/ so rtsi/ na bza'/ ku sha sogs dang*/ dpal 'bar/ me dar tshon ldan/ rlung g.yab ljang khu zhes rang gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/

gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun chas ḍā dril nang mchod gzar blugs sogs 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum las/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhar mchod pa/ me lhar gtang rag bcas gsum mo/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bya ba rdzogs rjes sam/ sbyin sreg rkyang pa las rab gnas dang sgrub mchod sogs la bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro mi dgos shing*/ dngos gzhi yo byad byin rlabs kyi sngon du bum pa sgrub pa dang*/ nyer spyod byin rlabs sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs gang rung gis las bum sgrub cing 'od zhu bya/ bdag gnas yo byad la bsang chu 'thor/ de nas nyer spyod byin rlabs ni/ rdor dril la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje thabs kyi rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ mūm̐ las dril bu shes rab kyi rang bzhin stong nyid snying rje'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can du gyur/ rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu 'khrol zhing dkur bsten/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐/ 'khyud rgya bcas/ oṃ ma hā a nu rā ga ni swa bhā wa at+ma kau3 haṃ/ zhes 'di nas bzung bsregs blugs kyi bya ba ma zin bar rdor dril lag nas mi 'bral bar bya'o/ de nas nang mchod dang thab bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li ha na oṃ: bhi mu shu ma ra āḥ bh+rūm̐ eṃ dzeṃ kham̐ hūm̐: oṃ sarba sañtso a mṛ ta rak+ta dz+wa la bha ling+ta pū dza ga ṇa tsakra ga ṇa la badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: hoḥ zhes pas rang byung bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dung dmar snod du rang byung gi dmar chen mchog chen gyi zhal bur gtor ma'i mchod pa:

phyi mchod rnam lnga rnam drug: bsreg rdzas kyi rim pa bsam las 'das pa: dag gtsang lha'i rol pa'i dga' ston gyi rnam par brgyan cing : mchod pa'i bye brag bsam las 'das pa dag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i bla med sngags kyi mchod sprin nam mkha' mtha' las su dmigs shing : gzhal las 'gran su bral ba 'di dag dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshogs la 'bul mchod mnyes pa'i rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi lang tsho ltar zad mi shes par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: mchod rol bcas bsreg rdzas byin rlob ni/ dgang gzar pad+ma'i rgyas bzung la/ oṃ shrī swā hā: oṃ dziṃ swā hā: oṃ a swā hā: oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā: rdzas so sor reg /thab la bskor ba lan gsum oṃ āḥhrīḥ i hūm̐: u trām̐ e muṃ e bh+rūm̐: oṃ dza swā hā: me dar la oṃ dz+nyā na baṃ pañtsa li ka swā hā: rlung g.yab la: oṃ: yam̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ swā hā: dpal 'bar la: ram̐ ri ri badz+ra dz+wa la ye swā hā: sogs kyis sbyang*/ me dar rlung g.yab dpal 'bar rnams kyis mtshon rdzas thams cad byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ me thab bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs? stong pa'i ngang las snang srid dbang du byed pa'i me thab phyi rol rgyas pa'i thab rgya khyon tshad med pa nang dbang gi zla gam dmar po gru chad kha khyer mu ran bcas kha chod rdo rje'i phreng ba mu ran pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'od zer khor yug tu mchod pas gtams pa: de'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla ram̐ dang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rdo rje yi gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pas bsrungs te dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du ma gtong : nang gi dngos grub phyi ru mi 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du gsal ba'o: badz+ra tsakra: de nas dpal 'bar thogs la phyogs bzhi nas sngags bcas/

hūm̐: dam tshig dbang gi gzhal yas su: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir: deng 'dir mchod pa'i zan bya bskyed: oṃ ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ sa ma ye swā hā: rlung g.yab la: hūm̐: dam tshig dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes 'bebs pa'i las brtsam phyir: deng 'dir 'byung bzhi rlung 'phyo la: 'bar mched sreg blugs gzi byin bskul: oṃ yam̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sarba phu ta ya swā hā: de nas me dar me mtshams 'dzin pa ni: hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las: deng 'dir phrin las brtsam pa la: me lce phyogs min mi 'phro phyir: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me sgo skyongs: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ muṃ maṃ tiṣ+ṭha ye satwaṃ swā hā: me lha spyan 'dren zhing dam ye bsre ba ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed chog thams cad me 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang spyan drangs pa'i me lha ye shes pa mos nas dam bsre zhing 'don bsgom gzhung tshig bstun/ de yi dbus su ram̐ dang bgrang phreng lcags kyu las me lha sku mdog dmar ser ra skyes la chibs nas bgrang phreng lcags kyu 'dzin pa drang srong gi nyams 'gyur can: gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas drang srong me lha'i rgyal po la rang mdangs lnga yi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas thab dang zung du 'brel bar bsgom: hūm̐: dad pas tshur gshegs dam tshig 'brel ba'i lha: mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog drang srong 'od po che: srid gsum dbang du byed pa'i las brtsam phyir: bstar ba'i sreg blugs 'bul phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dhe wa ag+ne ye dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: spyan drangs dbang bskur snang mthas dbur brgyan nas: gdan 'bul thab tu 'bar ba'i nus pa bskyed: ku sha dag gtsang brgyan phyir 'bul gyis bzhugs: rdo rje sbu gu'i ljags kyis mchod pa bzhes: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye tiṣ+ṭha lhan: badz+ra sa twa āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ

ku sha'i gdan 'bul/ oṃ ag+ne ye a dhi bh+ya a dhi bh+yaḥbi shud+dho ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya: bha ha na ya swā hā: mar khu lnga'am bdun gang rung rjes gzar kha sbyar/ hoḥ phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin kho na nyid: bla med sngags rdzas mchod mchog 'dod rgu'i gter: bcom ldan me lha'i 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: badz+ra shab+da swā hā: oṃ ag+ne ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: ma hā rak+ta swā hā: ma hā bha ling+ta swā hā: lnga bdun 'bul ba ci rigs 'dod/ che bar bsngags pa/ hūm̐: tshangs dbang lha chen mgon sras gzhon nu legs: rjes chags dbang gis phrin las mdangs 'phrog pa: ma rig ka dag sa le 'od po che: shes rab nyi ma 'bum 'dra'i dbang 'byin bstod: badz+ra pu ru sha ya hoḥ mar khu/ oṃ dā+e wa dz+wa la ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu lan bdun sogs phul zhing mthar oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye bdag gis sbyin sreg gi mchod pa dam pa 'di brtsams pas skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar gyur cig ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas rdzas 'bul ba ni: yam shing la: oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ye swā hā: mar khu la: oṃ ag+ne swā hā: 'bras la: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā: zas mchog la: sarba saṃ sa ye swā hā: til la: sarba pa paṃ ye swā hā: so ba la: badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā: nas la: ma hā bhe ga ya swā hā: gro la: badz+ra gasma ri swā hā: sran ma la: ma hā bha la ya swā hā: dūrba la: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: bilba la: oṃ badz+ra bi wa shu swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la: oṃ mu la ge sar bi shwa swā hā: ku sha la: oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā: slar yang mar khu dang bcas phul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni:

bdag gis sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di brtsams pa la brten nas lha dang drang srong gnod sbyin dbang phyug la sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa dang skyong ba khyad par 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'khor 'bangs rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum bdag gi dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun 'dus 'dus ye swā hā: zhes pas phrin las dmigs yul gang yin dngos 'byung bar bsam/ zhi rol bya ba kun la 'dres/ me lhar gtang rag 'bul rgyu'i rdzas lhag cung zad re ma gtogs gzhan rdzogs rjes/ mthar 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i rang bzhin 'dag pa'i phyir: ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog: dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog: de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ na moḥ rig pa'i rgyal po khyed kyi sreg blugs kyi rdzas rnams lha'i zhal du 'bul ba dang ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas phrin las rnams yongs su 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa thab kyi shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi me dpung tsha ba'i dbal ldan ngad g.yo zhing mchod pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du hūm̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug?sogs kyis lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren gzhugs phyag 'tshal bar bya/ mchod pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma hā bha ling+ta la khā hi/
