zhes mchod rdzas sman raka gtor gsum skabs dang bstun te mchod rdzas phyed bcad byas te thab tu phul/ 'dir bsreg rdzas 'bul zhes gzhung nas gsungs kyang gsang ba spyi'i phyag len ltar bstod pa'i mjug /phyi nang mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod: nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rin po che'i sbug gu'i bsreg rdzas kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ ag+ne?sogs mar khu bdun/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams rtsa sngags la 'dod gsol bcas phul/ grangs gsog dgos tshe rtsa sngags kho na'i rjes su wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā zhes sbyar/ dmigs pa gzhung las shes so/ dmigs bsal yak+sha kā la'i mngon rtogs dang sbyar la bsreg rdzas 'bul bar gsungs pa ltar grub na legs/ mthar bsreg rdzas yongs rdzogs zad nas/ sngar mchod rdzas lhag ma ma lus par 'bul nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi ri rab ngogs: dur khrod dbang mo 'gyu ba gnas kyi bdag: dbang lhun yid bzhin lha chen sgeg pa'i nyams: dkar dmar bsrubs pa'i myos byed bsnun thabs can: srid gsum dbyings la bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: yid la 'khu ba'i nor skyug ne'u le thogs: khams gsum snying 'degs lcags kyu'i 'od zer g.yo: ku mud ze'u 'brur 'brub pas kun da bzhad: gsos 'khyil bsod nams zhum med zhabs dkyil bzhugs: stobs ldan mgrin bzang mu kha'i bcud lta bus: reg bya g.yo ba lang tsho 'dzin ma'i 'khor: rjes su chags pas gzugs bzang longs spyod spel: pad+ma rā ga'i cha shas lang tsho skyud:

'ga' zhig zla zhal lan brgyar byi dor g.yab: la la sa snying bzhed mdzes chu skyed rgyas: phal cher 'dar ma'i sgras bskul mar gad 'tsher: kun kyang sgra gcan srang 'jug gug rtse bsgrengs: yid las spyod pa'i nor 'dzin ne'u 'phyo: pad+ma rā dza 'khor dang phywa brnyan la: bstod cing dus la mi 'da' phrin las nyid: che btsan dmu rabs gtsug rabs rgyal po 'khor: lung rigs mkhas dbang mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta: btsun mo 'khor 'bangs chos srid lugs gnyis kyis: ci srid bsdus pa'i skye 'gro ma lus dang : de srid lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kun: deng 'dir dbang du sdud pa'i las brtsam phyir: sreg blugs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: chos srid mnga' thang 'dod rgu'i dpal zhing sogs: mthong thos dran reg bdag gi bran du shog: rgyal ba'i thugs rje ye shes dbyings nas bskul: pad 'byung nor gyi lha khyod bdag bsgrub kyi: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med deng 'dir stsol: oṃ ā gu ru pad+ma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ ma ma ye swā hā: gtor ma phul/ de nas rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi 'jam po 'bul la/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ gos zung ni/ gang la reg na 'jam pa'i lha rdzas kyang*/ /dbang po'i mtshon gyis bsgyur ba smig sgyu yi/ /bar snang za 'og gcal du bkram pa ltar/ /'bar ba'i 'gro kun bzod pa'i go thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ ye shes stobs kyis snod bcud rgud pa sel: thugs rjes dbang gis rtsol med dgos 'dod 'byung : nus mthu rtsal gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud: 'dod rgu'i srid rje mkha' 'gro nor gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: spros pa la dga' bas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ lha tshogs rnams kyis thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan rang rang sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od mdang dmar pos snod bcud thams cad khyab par 'phros rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/

snang ba dbang du bsdus shing snang srid thams cad bran du khol bar bsams la rtsa sngags mthar puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru btags pa'i bzlas pa bya/ tshim pa drug ldan gyi tshogs kyi 'khor lor mnyes par bya ba dang*/ rtsa sngags la kā ya a bhi?sogs btags pas dngos grub blangs rjes/ byon skyems dgang blugs lan gsum 'bul/ ma 'byor psogs yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ khyad par sgrub mchod sogs tshom bu gzhan nas gdan dgos tshe spyan 'dren dang bzhugs gsol sngon du 'gro la de nas ye shes me lha bskyed pa khyad par dang mthar ye shes pa dkyil 'khor du gshegs la tshom bu spyan 'dren pa'i khyad par ro/ gsum pa ni/ a mṛ ta'i bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ dam tshig me lha rang bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ byon skyems dgang blugs lan gsum 'bul zhing oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā gsum/ rdzas lhag rnam rim bzhin yam shing la/ oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ye swā hā: mar khu la: oṃ ag+ne swā hā: 'bras la: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā: zas mchog la: sarba saṃ pa ye swā hā: til la: sarba pa paṃ ye swā hā: so ba la: badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā: nas la: ma hā bhe ga ya swā hā: gro la: badz+ra gasma ri swā hā: sran ma la: ma hā bha la ya swā hā: dūrba la: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: bilba la: oṃ badz+ra bi wa shu swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la: oṃ mu la ge sar bi shwa swā hā: ku sha la: oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā: rdzas so so'i rtsa sngags mthar oṃ ag+na ye ri khi rā dza ya/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams kyi cho ga'i lhag chad 'gal 'khrul thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sngar mchod pa'i skabs mchod rdzas lhag ma rnams thab tu dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā:

oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: badz+ra shab+da swā hā: sman la/ oṃ ag+ne ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: rak+ta la/ ma hā rak+ta swā hā: gtor ma ā kā ros gtor ma bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyi phrin las bcol/ de nas rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi 'jam po 'bul la/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ gos zung phulab ni/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ phyag rgya dril stabs dang bcas/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa gang mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gshegs gsol ni/ don gnyis 'grub pa'i me yi lha/ /rang rang yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dus su 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge ba bsngo la smon lam gdab/ shis brjod bya/ gang ltar mthar long khyab yod na me rang zhir btang*/ med tshe dri bzang chus bsad/ thal ba ri rtse mthon po'i rlung la bskur/ las rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ skabs 'dir dbang gi sbyin sreg gtso bo ru 'dug pas de ltar bshad kyi/ gzhan du las bzhi'i sbyin sreg so sor sbyar na rig pas 'phrul shes pa gal che'o/ de ltar bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las tshogs g.yang skyabs dang*/ bum sgrub sogs kyi cha lag sbyin sreg med du mi rung ba'i phyir gter gzhung rtsa ba sor bzhag kha 'gengs dgos pa 'ga' zhig rigs mthun gzhan nas brgyan te rang nyid 'di yi bsnyen 'brel la gnas tshe bar skabs su rang gi lag len 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du bris pa la nyes 'gal mchis na rtsa gsum lha la bshags shing*/

dge bas 'gro kun tshogs gnyis dpal la spyod de kun bzang pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang gnas ma chen mo pu kā si'i nye bar srung ba'i bal po'i yul dur khrod lhan grub brtsegs pa'i gnas mchod sdong bya rung kha shor gam du/ zhe chen gnyis pa'i bsti gnas su sgo chen sprul ming pas sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i bsnyen yig dgos 'dod char 'bebs chig brgyud gu h+ya bzhugs so/ srid zhi'i dbang phyug snang zil gnon rtsal/ /rā ga'i lhun por nyi ma'i zer 'khyud bzhin/ /yid dbang gter gyi dngos grub mi zad mdzod/ /mnga' mdzad pad rgyal nor lha'i zhabs la 'dud/ gang de'i bsnyen yig gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig /blo mchog cig car rim gnyis snang stong lam/ /bla med don gyi chos tshul ma bslad par/ /las sbyor dbang 'byor dmigs bcas bsnyen yig bri/ de la o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha dbyer med du bsgrub pa'i sngon dngos rjes gsum gyi bya ba ni/ dang po gzhung las/ phun tshogs yid 'ong dgos 'dod 'grub pa'i sar: bsod nams rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang gi dal: rab thig 'bring thang tha ma 'bru tshom ni: lha grangs ci ltar lag len bzhin du bkod: mnga' thang rgyas pa'i longs spyod dkor cha dang : phun tshogs 'byor ldan can gyi zas nor dang : sa sna chu sna shing sna 'dzoms tshad dang : sman sna 'bru sna dar sna rin chen rnams: legs par bsags shing dkyil 'khor mtha' bzhir bskor: mchod rdzas gzhung bzhin gang 'os dkor chas bsham: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan kha sbyor nang : bsod nams nor rdzas dbang sdud 'khor lo bzhag: g.yas su dzam gtor g.yon du bum rdzas gtams: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang la 'os pa'i sa 'dzin/ rab dkyil 'khor sa thig spyi ltar du bya zhing*/ dbus kyi lte ba gzhi dmar po nor bu'i tshul gyi tshom bu dang*/ de yi phyi rol pad+ma 'dab bzhis mdzes par bya zhing lha'i sku mdog sa bon mtshon par bya/

de'i phyi 'od zer sgo khyud rta babs dang*/ phyi'i khor yug tu dpag bsam ljon pa dang*/ 'dod 'byung nor bu/ gter gyi khang bzang*/ ma rmos lo tog khrus kyi rdzing bu/ ne'u le'i rkyal pa/ cha bdun nor bu/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje me ris bskor ba mngon par 'du bya ba shes par bya'o/ de nas bsham pa ni/ dbus su bum pa dar dmar gyi mgul chings can nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga kha rgyan sogs kyis spras pa/ nub phyogs kyi char stegs bu'i khar/ bla ma pad rgyal gtor ma/ g.yas su dzam gtor/ g.yon du kā la yak+sha'i gtor ma/ sku 'khor bla rdo dbang sdud 'khor lo rnams gzhung ltar brgyan zhing*/ mdun du mtshan ldan thod pa g.yang rdzas dang*/ rin chen sna tshogs sman sna rgya bod kyi sa sna/ dbang thang can gyi ka cha sogs kyis bkang nas steng du me long la sin+dhu ras byugs shing ha ri ni sa yis mtshan par bris pa la dar dmar gyis bkab pa dang*/ gzhan yang sman raka sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i pū dza/ chos skyong gi gtor ma ga ṇa'i tshogs rdzas sogs bkod legs mngon par 'du bya bar shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ phrin las kyi gzhung la 'jug cing skyabs sems bka' bsgo nas bzung mchod bstod kyi bar mthong brgyud bla med lugs su shes shing*/ lhag par bsnyen dmigs gnad kyi lde mig tu gnad rag las pas/ bdag mdun 'khor lo rnam pa so so mar me gcig la gnyis mched tshul du ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i ngang tshul sgyu ma lta bu'i chos can du shes bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga nas 'bru tsam 'greng thabs su gnas pa'i lte ba kun zlum dbus su ting 'dzin sems dpa' thugs srog hūm̐ yig gi ha khog tu hrīḥyig dmar po tsheg drag dang ldan pa gcig lam gyis mos shing*/ de la sngags phreng g.yas bskor 'od zer gyi phreng ba g.yon du bskor zhing yum rnams de las ldog par bya zhing*/

bzlas pa ni/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i lugs su yid bzlas bya ba dang*/ rlung gi bzlas pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bar bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa dang sgrub chen bya/ dmigs pa ni/ gzhung las/ zil gyis gnon na rang nyid ni: dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul du bsgom: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer hrī yig las hrīḥdamar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ lho nub pad+ma 'od dang ris med sku gsum mtha' klas pa'i zhing khams su 'phros pas/ phyogs dus rgyal ba rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ thugs rgyud yongs su bskul ba'i thugs rje'i gzi byin nus shugs mthu stobs rnams sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud nas bskul ba'i mthus 'od dmar mdangs dang ldan pa byung nas rang gi sgrub rdzas lhar gsal bar thim pas mchog thun grub gnyis zad mi shes pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'grub par mos bzhin pa'i ngang nas rtsa ba'i snying po 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ de ltar mtshan ma mngon nas las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor 'od zer hrī yig dmar po la 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa mang po 'phros pas/ 'das pa'i lha pho rgyud mo rgyud dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i zhal bzhi mig stong pa/ lus ngan mo sras btsun mo/ gnod sbyin rtse gsum 'chang byed tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs te/ tshe bsod mnga' thang phywa g.yang la dbang 'byor ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin sa bdag sogs rang dbang med par gzi brjid ma bzod cing 'ub kyis bsdus nas ci bsgo ba'i phrin las thogs med du bsgrubs par mos bzhin las sngags gong gi phyed cha 'khyol bar bzla'o/ de nas 'khor gyi bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i sngags zer 'khor la phog pas gla gzan las la bskul ba bzhin rang srog las rang sngags kyi bskor bas 'od zer gyi lha dza yig lcags kyu'i rnam pa mang po 'phros pas/

lha 'dre mi gsum che btsan dregs ldan phywa g.yang thams cad shing lo skam po rlung gis ded pa ltar 'ub kyis bsdus par bsam/ hūm̐ yig zhags pa'i rnam pas nga rgyal gyi tshor ba gzhom nas phyogs bcu'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rang dbang med par stobs kyi zhags pas 'ching zhing bsdus par mos/ baṃ yig lcags sgrog gi rnam pas lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal blon btsun 'bangs bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun sde bcas dang rig byed mkhan sogs kyi shes rab 'gro ba pho rgyud mo rgyud kun gyi longs spyod phywa g.yang thams cad thabs shes phyag rgya'i 'od kyis sems can snang ba bkug nas rang dbang med par sha rul sbrang bu'i tshul du 'dus par mos so/ ho yig las dril bu rnam pas che btsan drag shul dbang chen stobs ldan dpa' bo shugs 'chang de rnams kyi 'gran zla'i stobs bcom nas/ snang srid thams cad zil gyis mnan cing ci ltar bsgo ba'i las thams cad thogs med du bsgrubs nas dmigs bcas dang*/ dmigs med kyi khams thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye bsdu ba ltar bur chil chil bsdu bar mos bzhin las sngags kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor sngags bzlas par bya'o/ lar bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags gang zag sngon sbyangs la rag las shing*/ bsnyen tshad ma 'khyol bar mngon rtags gsal ba dang*/ bsnyen tshad 'khyol bar rtags gsal ba sogs cha mchis pas/ tshogs dang bskang ba la 'bad nas rdzogs pa sogs bla ma'i man ngag gi zhal rgyun las gab bzhin shes so/ gsum pa/ rjes kyi rim pa ni/ sgrub rdzas rnams thogs shing gzhung gi dngos grub bskul tshig nas sgo gsum du dbang bzhi len pa sogs bya zhing sgrub rdzas 'khor lo 'chang tshul sogs gzhung bzhin shes par bya ba'o/ tshogs dang bskang ba sogs nas las kyi mtha' sdud bya zhing las rjes mi mngon pa dang dag mnyam phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas gnas srung dang lus srung la sogs bya'o/

lar bsnyen yig dpe mthong gi las la sbyor na/ lag rdum brag la 'byar ba'am/ khyi gu la skar ma bston pa dang 'dra bas/ bla ma'i zhal shes gab dkrugs gnad 'di phan gnod ma 'tsher ba'i lag len bstan pa dang*/ sems can pre ta sel ba'i ched dang bsgrub par rigs so/ bgrang yas gter chen chos kyi rgyal mtsho'i tshul/ /dbang gi phrin sgrub rin chen bum gang las/ /bsnyen yig gcig bsdus bdud rtsi'i thigs gcig 'dis/ /bstan 'gro'i pre ta gzhom pa'i gsos su shog /ces pa 'di rnam 'dren dam pa ri pa sprul sku'i bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ phran kun rmongs pa bla tshang seṅge'i ming gi hor zla9tshes 13la dge bsnyen brag gnas kyi nye mtshams su chos 'khor bskor ba'i thun mtshams su bris pas nyes 'gal mchis na srung ma'i tshogs la bshags shing dge des bdag gzhan grub gnyis mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ zin bris 'don bsgrigs gsal ba shel dkar me long bzhugs so/ phyogs dus rgyal sras kun gyi mthu dpal rnams/ /yongs 'dus sa gsum lus can skye rgu'i tshogs/ /dbul phongs pre ta'i duḥkha mthar mdzad pa/ /yid bzhin dbang rgyal pad+ma rā dzar 'dud/ pad 'byung nor lha dbyer med bsgrub pa yi/ /g.yang skyabs rten du btsugs pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ /dngos gzhi rjes kyi las rim bltas chog gi /zin bris shel dkar me long spro bar bya/ de yang sngon du 'gro ba'i thog mar sgrub pa po'am/ yon bdag 'byor ldan gang zhig pad+ma rgyal po'i g.yang rten 'dzugs pa la/ gza' skar dus tshes dge bar nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad 'tshogs par bsags nas rtsa gsum kun 'dus gang rigs kyi sgrub pa zhag lnga bdun skabs dang bstun nas dbul sri rmangs 'dre bkar chas gzhung ltar bsgrigs rjes: rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas yas rdzas la bsang chu 'thor zhing :

oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas tre pre ta a kar+ṣa ya thun thun: bar brjod la: 'gugs gzhug lan gsum mam bdun dang 'gugs sngags brgya rtsa gyis bkug: yas rdzas dang thal ba cung zad re 'thor zhing : oṃ sgrig shog nag mo kha la dun+tse rbad: yas glud rnams la drag tu dmigs pas gzir/ gzhung tshig ltar rdzongs btab la/ hūm̐: nyon cig dam sri bgegs rigs rnams: zhes pa nas/ 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bar dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags sham du drag sngags sbyar nas bgegs bskrad la/ kā la yak+ṣas mtshams gcod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen dpa' bo'i sku: zhes pas mtshams gcod dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra tsakra: bar gyi srung 'khor bsgom/ 'di yi skabs dam sri sgab 'dre mnan pa'i rdzas dang liṅga gzhung ltar byas la 'gugs gzhug yang yang bgyis nas thun gyis brab liṅga spyi ltar btum/ yugs sa ma'i skras bcing*/ mnan pa dang dmod pa dang 'gugs gzhug gzhung ltar bya/ slar yang kā la yak+sha nang ltar srung 'khor bsgoms nas/ pad+ma rgyal po'i las byang gzhung la 'jug skabs khyi sprang dam dme g.yang sgrub la mi dbang ba la dkyil 'khor mthong mi bcug rang nyid ting 'dzin ye shes sems dpa'i ngang nas/ hūm̐: pad 'byung sku gsum dbang sdud skur ston pa: sogs bsnyen pa ci 'grub skabs dang bstun/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas kā la yak+sha'i gzhung du 'jug nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sarba pū dza me gha a hūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas bsnyen pa'i bar 'don nas bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas thun gtor 'bul/ 'di'i bar du chos skyong chag med dgos pa'i skor gang yod dang*/ gter srung dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod tshogs bcas btang*/ bskang ba bya/ tshogs phud 'bul/ lhag phud 'bul/ lhag chad bskang*/ tshogs tha ma bsgral ba'i lcags snod du liṅga bzhag la 'gugs bzhug bya bstims nas bsgral gtub zhal du bstab/

hoḥ chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis tshogs dngos grub tu rol/ de nas g.yang 'bod rig 'dzin khang bzang bcas legs par grub nas/ g.yang rdzas/ g.yang rten rin chen dar zab 'bru sman dkar mngar zas sna sku 'khor dbang rdzas tsakli sogs yo byad ma tshang ba med par gnam rgyan sa rgyan yol ba dar dmar gyi gdugs dang 'phen dar rnga rol bza' btung khri gdan rgyan gos rten 'brel phun sum 'tshogs pa dang ldan pas rang nyid bla ma pad+ma ye shes rol pa chen po'i ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang nas/ rnam rgyal khang bzang bskyed chog la 'jug pa ni/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gsum dang : oṃ rat+na mu gu la mañdza ye swā hā: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas bskyed chog g.yang rdzas byin brlab/ maṅga la shrī a dhiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: zhes pa'i bar 'don/ de nas phywa 'gugs rgyas pa/ kyaiḥ ye thog bskal pa'i dang po la: zhes pa nas/ hu ye hu ye phywa ldan no: zhes pa'i bar 'don/ spro na/ hūm̐: steng phyogs dag pa ye shes 'phrul gyi dbyings: sogs nas/ khu ye phywa g.yang 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig: bar 'don yang na rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ lhag ma 'bul/ thugs dam bskul/ 'di'i mtshams su chos skyong gang 'os la/ dge bsnyen klu mo sogs kyi gtor 'bul bya/ chad mdo gtong*/ brtan ma skyong*/ gtor bro brdung*/ shis brjod la 'jug bsngo smon rgyas gdab mi dmigs ka dag chen po'i ngang la gnas par bya/ zhag mang po tshar grangs bsog tshe g.yang 'gugs rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la/ nyi shar/ nyi dros/ nyin phyed/ dgong mo bcas la tshar re 'don/ sngon 'gro dngos rjes sngar bzhin bskyar/ grol ba'i skabs pad+ma rgyal po'i las byang tshar gcig btang la tshogs 'khor rgya chen bshams la tshogs bskang rgyas pa bya/ de nas lha bsang btang*/ bar khang sogs la g.yang thag 'then/ de nas g.yang gtad bya ba ni/ gzhi gdan dkar gtsang gi steng du nas kyi tshom bu'am g.yung drung bkod pa'i steng du sbyin bdag chas gos legs par brgyan la 'god/

mdun du g.yang gtor thogs/ gzhan yang bu tsha bu mo sogs kun gyi lag tu mda' dar phye mar sogs g.yang 'gugs srid gsum dbang sdud kyi gzhung ltar thogs la/ hūm̐: steng phyogs dag pa ye shes 'phrul gyi dbyings: mtshams su thams cad kyis phywa 'bod bya/ hūm̐: klong lnga'i gter khyim srub cing srid spel ba: sogs 'don tshig de'i gzhung tshig /g.yang rdzas rnams g.yang mdzod dam g.yang snod gang yin du 'jog/ de nas g.yang 'gugs mang ba'i srung 'dzugs pa ni/ kyaiḥ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la: sogs kyi tshig rim dang sbyar nas yon bdag pho mo bu tsha thab ka zangs chu ra ran 'thag la phye mar bku zhing srung btsugs/ kyaiḥ pho brang so so'i gdan khri la: sogs sbra khang gang yin gyi ka gdung dral lcam thams cad phyogs bzhi sgo bzhi mtshams bzhir srung 'dzugs/ myes po a phyi tsha bo sogs tshig dang bstun nas srung btsugs/ phywa yi rten mkhar rgya ma nyams: zhes pa'i bar 'don/ 'di'i mtshams dge bsnyen dang klu mo gnyis kyis rgyas gdab pa zhal shes so/ kyaiḥ bkra shis dang po rgyal mtshan btsugs: sogs bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyas gdab bya/ de nas sna tshogs rdo rje thogs la/ hūm̐: mi 'gyur dbyings kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: sogs kyis rgyas legs par gdab nas/ slar dkyil 'khor gzhung gi dngos grub len chog bsdu rim shis brjod bsngo smon sogs rgyas par bya/ g.yang rdzas phyi mi la mi sbyin zhing zhag bdun la g.yang rta bsdam/ slar gcig bskyar/ zab gsang gzhung lugs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /bsrubs 'thon mar gyi zhun khu 'di spel bas/ /'dzin 'chang sgrub nus dad gus gang 'brel pa/ /'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po nyid du gyur/ /dpal yas 'byor pa'i stobs dpal phun tshogs nas/ /bstan 'gror dga' ston 'bad med lhug stsol shog /gu ru pad+ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer las shar ba bstan 'gro skye dgu dpal gyi bsod nams dga' ston du gyur pa'i 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba 7rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho bdud 'dul gnam lcags rdo rje drag po rtsal kyi bka' lung spyi bor 'khur zhing*/

don nyams su blangs pa'i a nan karma'i ming 'dzin zung gis bskul ngor byas pa'i gang de'i phyag len 'khrul med brjed tho ru bkod 'dug pa la zhib dpyad nan tan du byas nas gsal bar bkod pas thams cad bkra shis dpal 'byor stobs nus dus dang gnas skabs gtan du phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // dge'o// //
